article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : un déficit de 70 millions de dollars menace la riposte (OMS) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a $70 million shortfall threatens the response (WHO) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns of a $70 million funding shortfall threatening Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Kinshasa on July 15, 2026, the UN agency states that only 39% of the $115 million required has been mobilized, leaving a gap of about $70 million. The funds are needed to bolster epidemiological surveillance, testing capacity, contact tracing, patient care, and the deployment of new vaccines, treatments, and diagnostic tools to curb transmission and save lives. Dr. Ihekweazu emphasizes that ending Ebola is possible with sustained commitment, community engagement, and adequate resources. The DRC has faced recurrent Ebola outbreaks since 1976, with the eastern 2018–2020 outbreak being the deadliest, causing more than 2,200 deaths. While ERVEBO and Zabdeno vaccines and monoclonal antibody treatments have improved survival, cross-border porousness and insecurity complicate surveillance and raise costs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：7000万ドルの資金不足が対応を脅かす（WHO）－ACP
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ対応における深刻な資金不足を警告しており、監視・治療体制の低下により国際的拡大リスクが高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行への資金不足による対応能力低下を報じたもので、新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの深刻化に関するもの。国境地帯の不安定さが越境拡大リスクを高めている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: City-state supports Ebola outbreak response
article.articleSummary: Singapore will contribute US$2 million to support Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, aiming to bolster laboratory testing, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and case management on the ground. The funding, channeled through Africa CDC and the World Health Organization (WHO), supports the Continental Preparedness and Response Plan launched June 5. The current Ebola outbreak was declared an international health emergency by WHO on May 17. As of July 12, Congo has 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases. Health Minister Ong Ye Kung stated the Congo- and Uganda-linked outbreak is rapidly evolving, requiring swift, coordinated international action to deliver supplies to frontline healthcare workers. This contribution follows Singapore’s May pledge of US$12 million over four years to CEPI, which aims to develop vaccines within 100 days of identifying a new pandemic threat.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: WHOが5月17日に国際的な公衆衛生危機（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、コンゴ民主共和国では7月12日時点で1926例の確定例が報告されており、国際社会が資金・技術支援を継続的に投入している重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびシンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはこのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として5月17日に宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: الأرض على صفيح ساخن.. زلازل وموجات حرّ و"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Earth on a hot plate... earthquakes and heat waves and "Ebola"
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting and internal/external bleeding. The U.S. barred Americans in Congo from flying to the United States until 21 days in a third country; 24 Americans were slated to depart after Congo travel. The CDC says an American aid worker is infected with the Bundibugyo strain; another American diagnosed in Congo was treated in Frankfurt, Germany, and a May case identified as Dr. Peter Stafford was also transferred to Germany. Typhoon Bavi drives heavy rains in Liaoning, northeast China, prompting evacuations of about 260,000 and disruptions in Shenyang and Jilin. France’s Fontainebleau forest fires have burned over 1,900 hectares near Paris, forcing about 1 million people to evacuate, with 850 firefighters deployed. Venezuela reports oil production unaffected after two earthquakes last month.

triage.headline_ja: 大地は熱い鉄板の上に…地震、熱波、そして「エボラ」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が1,926例・702名の死亡に達し、米国への渡航制限や感染者の国際的な搬送（ドイツ）が発生しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の世界的災害（中国の台風、フランスの森林火災、ベネズエラの地震）をまとめた世界プレス欄の一部で、エボラに関する記述はコンゴ民主共和国での大規模流行と米国・ドイツへの感染者搬送に焦点を当てている。他国（中国・フランス・米国・ドイツ）はエボラとは無関係の別事象であり、verified_locationsには含めない。記事の具体的な日付や出典の一貫性が不明確なため、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : ce que le taux de létalité de 37,5 % dit, et ne dit pas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: what the 37.5% case-fatality rate says, and what it does not say.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reports an overall case-fatality rate of 37.5% as of July 13, with 754 deaths among 2,011 laboratory-confirmed cases since the start. The bulletin notes 753 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, with unknown outcomes; if only cases with known outcome are counted, 366 recoveries and 754 deaths imply ~67% fatality. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, identified in Uganda in 2007–2008, shows historically 25% to 34–40% CFR, lower than Zaïre and Sudan strains (53–90%). Congolose sequence lies at the upper end of that range but does not exceed it. No approved vaccine or specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo; Ervebo protects only against Zaïre, and the PARTNERS clinical trial has started evaluating two experimental treatments since early July. Emphasis remains on early care and rapid case detection; contact tracing at 67.4% underperforms relative to targets.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：致死率37.5%が示すもの、示さないもの
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定症例2,011例・死亡754例という大規模なエボラ出血熱の続発事例であり、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であることから公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは2007-2008年の同株同定という歴史的文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。承認済みワクチン（Erveboはザイール株のみ）・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であり、接触者追跡率も目標を下回っているため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : avec Steve Ahuka au poste de manager de terrain, Kinshasa reprend la main sur la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: with Steve Ahuka as field manager, Kinshasa regains control of the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo deepened as Kinshasa named Steve Ahuka-Mundeke as field operations manager on July 13, during a National Task Force meeting at the African Union City. A professor of microbiology and virology at the University of Kinshasa and head of virology at INRB, Ahuka has led Ebola and COVID-19 responses in the past. The move adds an operational layer without replacing Minister Roger Kamba, who chairs the Task Force; the plan aims to centralize command after prior fragmented efforts. More than 300 people have recovered; the outbreak spans five provinces from Ituri to Tshopo. But funding lags: a $510 million government/WHO plan was only 35% funded by mid-June; security constraints from CODECO and ADF impede access; a treatment center was attacked in Ituri. Washington reaffirmed over $600 million in support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:スティーブ・アウカ氏を現地対応責任者に、キンシャサが対応の主導権を取り戻す
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、資金不足や治安上の制約(CODECO/ADF)によるアクセス困難が続いており、国際支援も継続していることから公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関与が認められる。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラ流行の継続報道であり新規発生ではないが、資金不足・治安悪化・体制再編という新展開があり、フルRRAでの継続評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Virus killer, Sant'Orsola in allerta: "Ecco il protocollo anti Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus killer, Sant'Orsola on alert: "Here is the Ebola protocol."
article.articleSummary: Two rooms in Emilia-Romagna hospitals are equipped for maximum biocontainment in response to the Ebola outbreak raging in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Located at Sant’Orsola in Bologna and in Rimini, they are not for confirmed Ebola patients but to manage individuals arriving from affected areas who develop symptoms. Those individuals would be initially managed under fiduciary isolation, potentially moving to home isolation if they come from the epicenter and have had healthcare exposure. If Ebola-like symptoms such as fever appear, they would be admitted to the high-containment units for immediate testing for Ebola. The rooms are bunker-like, with dressing rooms, decontamination zones, boxes and showers; entry prep takes about 30 minutes. Test results come in roughly 6–12 hours from Milan Sacco lab. If negative, patients become standard cases; if positive, transport to Spallanzani in Rome by ambulance or medevac. Context: ongoing Ebola epidemic in Uganda and the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスキラー、サンオルソラ病院が警戒態勢:「これがエボラ対策プロトコルだ」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はイタリアの病院における受け入れ体制・プロトコルに関する内容であり、DRC/ウガンダでの実際のエボラ流行に関する新規の疫学情報は含まれていないため、既知の継続流行の文脈情報として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア国内の病院での受け入れ準備・プロトコルに関する内容であり、DRC・ウガンダでの実際の流行状況に関する新規データは含まれない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。イタリアも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 15 mil casos de influenza já foram registrados em todo o país em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 15,000 influenza cases have already been recorded nationwide in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases are rising across Brazil in 2026, with more than 15,000 cases recorded nationwide so far, driven by cold in the South and Southeast. Up to July 11, 2026, 14,700 influenza cases were reported nationally, with São Paulo state accounting for 5,056 cases from January through July. Vaccination remains incomplete: about 39.7 million doses administered, equating to 40.68% coverage. The government aims to reach at least 90% vaccination for children under six and for adults 60 and older, though the influenza vaccine is available free through the SUS for everyone aged six months and above. Vaccines are reformulated annually to track viral mutations. In addition to vaccination, authorities recommend mask use for symptomatic individuals, especially indoors and on public transport, and frequent hand hygiene to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、ブラジル全土でインフルエンザ症例が1万5000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況を報じる内容で、ワクチン接種率向上のための公衆衛生キャンペーンが中心。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Duga Jumlah Kasus Ebola di Kongo Bisa Empat Kali Lebih Besar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO suspects the number of Ebola cases in Congo could be four times higher.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) says the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times larger than official counts. Official data show about 1,960–1,963 infections with more than 700 deaths, and the outbreak was first detected and announced on May 15, 2026. WHO Emergency Health Programme Executive Director Chikwe Ihekweazu told journalists in Geneva that the true scale is at least 2–4 times the reported figure. As of July 15, 2026, authorities acknowledge substantial undercounting and are assessing transmission dynamics to gauge the outbreak’s reach. The article does not provide details on infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ感染者数は公式発表の4倍に上る可能性を示唆
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死亡者700人超、実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍と推定されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenèveやSwitzerlandが含まれているが、これはWHO本部の所在地であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。記事は感染源や輸出入例について言及していないため国際拡散リスクは不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Власти Конго сообщили о 754 умерших от лихорадки Эбола в стране
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese authorities report 754 deaths from Ebola fever in the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases, with 754 deaths and 366 recoveries. Active patients total 753, remaining in isolation or hospitals. The outbreak persists across five provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. The case fatality rate is 37.5%, and contact tracing covers 67.4% of infected individuals. The latest status was released by the Ministry of Communications and Media via X. A WHO representative, Chikwe Ihekweazu, warned that the true number of infections could be two to four times higher than official tallies, with about 80% of new patients not previously listed as contacts, signaling undetected transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ当局、国内でのエボラ熱による死者754人を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州にわたり2,011例・死者754人と大規模化しており、致死率37.5%、未検出の伝播チェーンの懸念もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO関係者が公式集計の2〜4倍の感染者数の可能性を指摘しており、未検出の伝播チェーンが疑われる点は特に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго от лихорадки Эбола умерли 754 человека
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, 754 people died from Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, as reported by Reuters citing the Ministry of Information and Communications. Five eastern regions are affected. The true number is likely higher due to the collapse of healthcare infrastructure. The United Nations has previously estimated the outbreak could cause billions of dollars in potential damage. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission amid strained public health systems, with no further details on symptoms or infection sources in this brief update. This data highlights the severity of the eastern DR Congo Ebola outbreak and the risk of undercounting in crisis conditions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱で754人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるコンゴ民主共和国東部での大規模流行(2011症例、754死亡)であり、医療インフラ崩壊による過小報告の懸念、国際的損害の可能性も指摘されており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 国連による経済的損害の予測や医療崩壊による症例過小評価の可能性が指摘されており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続・悪化を示す重要な続報。

article.articleHeadline: US bars direct return of citizens from Congo over Ebola
article.articleSummary: US imposes a 21-day third-country waiting period for Americans who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo, blocking direct return to the United States and placing affected travelers on a federal do-not-board list. The policy, implemented under federal transportation authorities, aims to prevent Ebola spread as Congo’s outbreak expands. Health authorities report 1,926 Ebola cases and 702 deaths across multiple provinces, a figure WHO cautions may underestimate true infections. Two U.S. citizens working with humanitarian groups contracted Ebola in Congo; one was evacuated to Germany for treatment, the other case previously identified with CDC and State Department assistance. Bundibugyo strain has driven the outbreak since May, with no approved vaccine targeting this variant. Insecurity, displacement, and attacks on health facilities hinder containment. The administration has funded and staffed international response and explored offshore quarantine facilities; critics warn the policy may deter volunteers and shift responsibility abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴからの帰国者の直接入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の感染が拡大し（症例1,926件、死亡702件）、米国が渡航制限措置を導入し、米国・ドイツへの感染者輸出も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の輸出先（治療目的の後送・帰国制限対象）であり、発生国はDRCのみのためverified_locationsから除外。WHOは実際の感染者数がより多い可能性を指摘し、承認ワクチンがない新変異株（Bundibugyo）による拡大、治安悪化・医療施設への攻撃が封じ込めを阻害している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 中国疾控专家赴乌干达参与埃博拉疫情防控国际合作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC experts head to Uganda to participate in international cooperation on Ebola outbreak prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, two Chinese CDC experts departed Beijing to Uganda to join Ebola outbreak prevention and control efforts under the IMST, a joint initiative of Africa CDC and WHO. The move follows WHO’s May 17 declaration that Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. IMST comprises 14 working groups spanning coordination, governance, laboratories, and detection. An Zhijie will join the Coordination and Governance group, tracking outbreak dynamics, cross-border transmission risk, and information sharing. Wang Huanyu will join the Laboratory Diagnostics group, expanding testing networks and disseminating pan-filovirus detection methods, with emphasis on point-of-care operations and sample transport efficiency. The mission uses a “technology embedding” approach within IMST to enhance data analysis, risk assessment, and technical guidance, reinforcing global public health security.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センターの専門家がウガンダのエボラ出血熱対策国際協力に参加へ
triage.triage_reason: WHOが2026年5月17日にコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行をPHEICと宣言しており、国際的拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響が明白なため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生中のエボラ出血熱（WHO PHEIC宣言済み）への国際対応として中国CDC専門家派遣を報じたもの。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は支援国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rapidez con que avanza brote de ébola alarma a la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rapid pace at which the Ebola outbreak is advancing alarms the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Africa’s second-largest country and one of its poorest, is the third largest ever recorded. The spread is accelerating at the fastest monthly pace, with the majority of new cases arising from unknown transmission chains. About 80% of new infections are not linked to established contact lists, signaling uncontrolled transmission. A significant number of deaths occur in communities before patients reach health facilities, hampering containment. WHO projections estimate the outbreak’s true scale to be at least 2–4 times the number of officially reported cases, underscoring gaps in surveillance and response capacity. The situation stresses the DRC’s health system and calls for intensified international support and resources to curb further spread. — Published July 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の急速な拡大がWHOを警戒させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上3番目の規模に拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が8割に達するなど制御不能な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが公式報告数の2〜4倍の実際の流行規模を推定しており、監視体制とレスポンス能力のギャップが深刻。国際支援の緊急強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية أكبر ممّا هو معلن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is larger than announced.
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be up to four times larger than official tallies. Official figures show over 1,960 cases and more than 700 deaths since the outbreak was identified about two months ago. WHO Emergency Program Director Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu told reporters in Geneva that agency models indicate the outbreak size is at least two to four times the detected cases, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The 17th outbreak was declared on May 15 following fatalities in Ituri province, in the mineral-rich northeast where armed groups operate. Infections have been recorded in five Congolese provinces and neighboring Uganda, with more than 90% of cases still in Ituri. A clinician returning from the region noted many newly reported cases involve people who died before reaching healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO):コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は公表より規模が大きい
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(第3位規模)がコンゴ民主共和国で確認され、既に国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるがこれはWHO本部の所在地であり、実際の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（一部ウガンダに拡大）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。公式集計の1,960症例・700人死亡に対しWHOはモデルで実際は2〜4倍の規模と推定しており、報告体制の限界と医療アクセス不足（死後に報告されるケースが多い）が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в ДР Конго: количество жертв превысило 750
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: the death toll has surpassed 750.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,011 cases with 754 deaths. As of July 13, the transmission has spread to two new provinces, Upper Uele and Chopo. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for DR Congo and Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV), for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. In the absence of specific medical therapies, clinicians provide pallative care, including patient isolation, fluid replenishment, and pain relief. A WHO spokesperson warned about the scale and called for urgent international support and measures to curb spread. The situation requires immediate action from local authorities and the international community to prevent further losses.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱:死者数が750人を超える
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大を続け、死者750名超・新規州への拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事にはウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、サマリー本文はDRコンゴの状況を主として記述しており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。PHEIC宣言(5月17日)済みで既にWHOがフルリスク評価・介入を行っている段階と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS advirtió sobre la rápida expansión del brote de ébola en el Congo: ya es el tercero más grande registrado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warned about the rapid spread of the Ebola outbreak in the Congo: it is already the third largest on record.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has intensified, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported July 11, making it the third-largest outbreak. The epicenter is Ituri, with new foci in Haut-Uele and Tshopo. About 80% of new cases are not linked to known surveillance chains, hindering early detection and containment; many deaths occurred in communities before reaching healthcare facilities, suggesting the true burden may be two to four times higher than reported. Challenges include attacks on health workers and facilities, necessitating trust-building with communities, safe and dignified burials, and engagement of local leaders before opening treatment centers. Health system capacity has improved to over 700 Ebola beds, 14 diagnostic labs, and 21,000 trained community workers, but funding remains only 40% of the $115 million requirement. No approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo; early care improves survival. Solidarity and PABS negotiations in Geneva are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行の急速な拡大について警告：既に史上3番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上3番目の規模に拡大し、新規症例の80%が既知の感染経路と無関係でコントロールが困難な状況であり、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ジュネーブ（スイス）は連帯・PABS交渉の場として言及されているが、疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。資金は必要額の40%のみ確保されており、真の感染者数は報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 中国疾控专家赴乌干达参与埃博拉疫情防控国际合作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC Experts Go to Uganda to Participate in International Cooperation on Ebola Outbreak Prevention and Control
article.articleSummary: Two Chinese CDC experts, An Zhijie and Wang Huanyu, departed Beijing on July 15 to Uganda to join the Ebola Emergency Management Support Team (IMST) formed by Africa CDC and WHO. The move follows WHO’s May 17 designation of Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as an international public health concern. Within IMST, An will coordinate governance, track outbreak dynamics, analyze cross-border transmission risk, and promote information sharing; Wang will join the Laboratory Diagnostics group to expand testing networks and disseminate pan-filovirus detection methods, focusing on testing site operations and sample transport efficiency. The pair will employ a 'technical embedding' approach, integrating with Africa CDC, WHO, and other national experts to conduct data analysis, risk assessment, and provide technical guidance. China CDC says this demonstrates continued support to Africa’s outbreak response and global health security.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理専門家、ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行対応国際協力に参加のため派遣
triage.triage_reason: WHOが既にDRC・ウガンダのエボラ流行を国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念と宣言しており、IHR基準複数該当・国際的対応体制構築が進行中であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事は中国CDC専門家のウガンダ派遣に関する報道だが、実際の流行発生国はDRCおよびウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。中国は派遣元であり流行発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le suivi des contacts à 67,4 %, l'autre faille inquiétante de la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: contact tracing at 67.4%, the other worrying flaw in the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo hinges on contact tracing, with a 67.4% follow-up rate as of July 13 per INSP. Each confirmed case has contacts who must be identified and monitored daily for 21 days, the maximum incubation, to isolate at first symptoms. A fully tracked chain breaks transmission; a lost contact can spark a new outbreak. In Ituri's epicenter, Bunia volunteers face fear and hostility, though some residents are volunteering for testing. Community acceptance is central: without trust, patients hide, families conceal contacts, and tracing stalls. Hurdles include a government-OMS plan valued at $510 million only 35% funded by mid-June, plus provider strikes; insecurity from CODECO and ADF and an attacked treatment center disrupt access. Dr. Steve Ahuka was appointed July 13 as field manager to strengthen tracing with more, safer, paid relay networks and rebuilt trust. Until tracing is complete, transmission chains remain hidden.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：接触者追跡率67.4%、対応におけるもう一つの懸念すべき欠陥
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続流行であり、接触者追跡の不備・資金不足・治安悪化により国際的拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: Ituri州Bunia地区が流行の中心。接触者追跡率67.4%、対応計画の資金充足率35%、CODECO・ADFによる治安悪化、治療センターへの攻撃など多重の障害あり。継続的な進展のフォローが必要。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل أكثر من ألفي إصابة بفيروس الإيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 Ebola virus infections recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: As of July 14, 2026, 2,011 confirmed Ebola virus infections have been reported, including 754 deaths, with 366 recoveries and 753 patients in isolation. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chobo—with transmission remaining intense in Ituri; recent cases in Haut-Uele indicate geographic spread. The outbreak is in a phase of continuous transmission with rapid case growth since its onset. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain was declared on May 15. The report does not provide details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases. The numbers highlight a substantial ongoing outbreak requiring intensified surveillance, diagnostics, and case management across affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染者2000人以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模アウトブレイクで、確定例2,011人・死亡754人、5州に拡大し感染拡大が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola（Cuanza Norte Province含む）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Haut-Uele、Chobo）でのアウトブレイクのみが言及されており、Angolaへの拡大は確認されていないため除外した。致死率は約37.5%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: KAEF Siapkan Produksi 500 Juta Tablet per Tahun Dukung Eliminasi TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KAEF to Produce 500 Million Tablets per Year to Support TB Elimination
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces a heavy TB burden with about 1.09 million annual TB cases and roughly 125,000 deaths, per Global TB Report 2024 and 2025 Health Ministry data; 885,000 cases were detected in 2024. PT Kimia Farma (Persero) Tbk (KAEF) aims to bolster national elimination efforts by producing up to 500 million TB tablets per year at its Jakarta and Banjaran facilities, supported by an end-to-end integrated health ecosystem. The company offers DS-TB and DR-TB therapies, with fixed-dose combinations and the 2025 introduction of the anti-TB antibiotic Moxifloxacin. Beyond production, KAEF operates a nationwide distribution network of 44 branches, over 1,000 pharmacies, 350 clinics, and 65 laboratories, plus diagnostics (LAMP TB tests and X-ray screening) and patient services linked to the Kemenkes SITB. Objectives: TB elimination by 2030 and a TB-free Indonesia by 2050.

triage.headline_ja: KAEF、TB撲滅支援のため年間5億錠の錠剤生産を準備
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核流行に対する製薬企業の生産能力拡大に関する報道であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 既存の結核対策・産業ニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 广东6月传染病共夺129命 新冠与流感确诊录显著增幅
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, Guangdong's infectious diseases claimed 129 lives; confirmed COVID-19 and influenza cases on record rose sharply.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 in Guangdong recorded 429,628 statutory infectious disease cases and 129 deaths. COVID-19 and influenza led their respective classes, with Class B COVID-19 infections reaching 26,117 cases (no deaths) and ranking first, followed by hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis, and gonorrhea. Class C registered 365,082 cases and 1 death, led by influenza with 274,328 cases (1 death). The flu surge continued a rising trend from April (~71,000) to May (~140,000) to June (~274,328). Guangdong issued a July health risk alert for COVID-19, influenza, and other infectious diseases such as dengue fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, malaria, monkeypox, and Ebola virus. Public health measures emphasize ventilation and disinfection in crowded spaces, hand hygiene, vector protection, avoiding poisonous mushrooms, and preventing heat illness. Prompt medical care is advised for fever, cough, sore throat, or muscle aches to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省、6月の伝染病で129人死亡 新型コロナとインフルエンザの確定症例が大幅増加
triage.triage_reason: 広東省の月次法定感染症統計であり、季節性のインフルエンザ・COVID-19増加を示すが、異常な発生や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、定例報告の域を出ない。ただしインフルエンザの継続的な増加傾向は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 広東省当局による月次法定感染症サーベイランス報告。COVID-19・インフルエンザの季節的増加が中心で、Mpoxやエボラは注意喚起リストに含まれるのみで実際の症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: كارثة صحية تتفاقم في الكونغو.. ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا إلى 2011 حالة و754 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A health disaster is worsening in the Congo: Ebola infections rise to 2,011 cases and 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola infections and 754 deaths, according to Cairo News Channel. Previously, on 1 July, confirmed cases reached 1,333 with 399 fatalities, illustrating ongoing transmission and significant mortality. Africa CDC officials said regional countries will review national preparedness levels, exchange lessons learned from the response, and reinforce cross-border cooperation to address the outbreak. The report underscores a sustained, large-scale Ebola outbreak in the DRC with evolving transmission and ongoing public health challenges. No symptom details or treatment outcomes are provided in the article. Surveillance and regional coordination remain central to the public health response, highlighting the importance of continued vigilance and international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで悪化する保健災害…エボラ感染者が2,011人、死者754人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が進行中で致死率も高く、国際的な拡大リスクと地域協力の必要性が明確なためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 感染者数・死者数が2週間で大幅に増加しており、Africa CDCが地域協力を強化していることから急速な拡大が懸念される。詳細な症状・治療転帰は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Over 700 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: First-ever human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine -- when will it be ready?
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo strain has surpassed 1,900 cases and 700+ deaths, spreading from Ituri Province into other areas and crossing into Uganda. It is described as the worst outbreak the country has seen, with ongoing control challenges due to conflict, attacks on clinics, and unpaid health workers that hamper contact tracing and patient care. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; existing vaccines target the Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo. In May, the WHO declared a global health emergency. Oxford University has launched the first human trial of a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine (BD-Ebov, ChAdOx1 BDBV) in Phase I with 50 healthy adult volunteers in Oxford, assessing safety and immune response; if successful, larger trials in outbreak settings and regulatory steps will follow, potentially taking years. Current care remains supportive, with experimental options like remdesivir and MBP134 under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死者700人超：ブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験はいつ実現するか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラが1900症例・700人超死亡と拡大し、ウガンダへの越境も確認、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(226074)及び英国/イングランド(Oxford含む)は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Oxfordでの臨床試験は発生地域ではなく研究拠点。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 2 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo exceeded 2,000.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 2,011 as of 15 July 2026. According to the daily bulletin from the DRC Ministry of Communications and Media, 20 new lab-confirmed cases were recorded in the last 24 hours. Official figures report 754 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of 23.4%. Currently, 376 patients are hospitalized or in medical isolation. Contact tracing has reached 64.4% of close contacts. The outbreak began on 15 May in eastern DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri Province, where transmission remains concentrated. No details are provided on imported/exported cases. The data reflect ongoing transmission and public health response efforts in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ感染者数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数が2,000例を超え、致死率23.4%と高く、ウガンダにも拡大していることから国際的拡大リスクが高い深刻な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染拡大も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。症例数2,011、死亡754、致死率23.4%、接触者追跡率64.4%と詳細なデータがあり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 中國新冠病例翻倍上升 廣東單月傳染病已破百死 | 新冠疫情 | 確診病例 | 流感
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 cases double; Guangdong records more than 100 infectious-disease deaths in a single month | COVID-19 pandemic | confirmed cases | influenza
article.articleSummary: China’s COVID-19 activity remains high as Guangdong Province reports 129 infectious-disease deaths in June. Nationally, June adds 79,000 new confirmed cases, 130 severe cases, and 1 death; influenza accounts for 592,906 cases. Guangdong’s June statutory infectious diseases total 429,628 with 129 deaths; Category B: 64,546 cases, 128 deaths (led by COVID-19); Category C: 365,082 cases, 1 death (led by influenza, 274,328 cases). Influenza is at the forefront of summer transmission, with April 71,000; May 140,000; June 274,000 cases. Other key threats include dengue fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, malaria, monkeypox and Ebola. Outside mainland China, Hong Kong and Macao report rising COVID activity, with NB.1.8.1 and PQ.16.1.1 lineages. On July 14, officials warned COVID-19 has surged roughly fourfold and urged vigilance for diphtheria, RSV, influenza, SARS-CoV-2 variants, norovirus, measles, Nipah, hantavirus, and Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でCOVID-19感染者が倍増、広東省では単月で感染症死者100人超 | COVID-19パンデミック | 確定症例 | インフルエンザ
triage.triage_reason: 広東省で単月129人の感染症死亡、COVID-19が約4倍に急増したとの当局警告があり、香港・マカオでも新変異株(NB.1.8.1, PQ.16.1.1)による活動増加が報告されているため、フルリスク評価による確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 发热畏寒肌肉痛 厦门正值夏季流感高发阶段 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever, Chills, and Muscle Pain: Xiamen in the Peak of the Summer Flu Season
article.articleSummary: Xiamen is experiencing a summer peak of influenza activity. China's CDC Week 27, 2026 surveillance shows influenza viruses are most frequently detected in respiratory samples from influenza-like illness patients at sentinel hospitals. Hot, humid weather and closed indoor spaces with air conditioning create favorable conditions for spread. Preventive measures emphasize daily ventilation, hand hygiene, masking in crowded settings, and vaccination for high-risk groups (pregnant women, children, elderly, and those with chronic diseases). Early flu symptoms resemble COVID-19—fever, chills, myalgia—requiring laboratory confirmation by influenza nucleic acid or antigen testing. Treatment should be guided by clinicians; oseltamivir and baloxavir marboxil remain effective against current strains. Ibuprofen can alleviate fever; Lianhua Qingwen capsules may be used as adjunct. Avoid self-medication or mixing antivirals with antibiotics; seek urgent care for persistent high fever or respiratory distress.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱、悪寒、筋肉痛 厦門は夏季インフルエンザ流行のピーク時期
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行に関する公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況に関する市民向け健康啓発記事であり、通常の予防・治療ガイダンスが中心。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus HIV-AIDS Meningkat di Riau, Tahun 2025 Tercatat Seribu Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV-AIDS Cases on the Rise in Riau; 1,000 Cases Recorded in 2025
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS cases are rising in Riau Province, Indonesia. From 1997 to Q1 2026, 11,523 people living with HIV (ODHIV) have been recorded; 7,137 remain alive, while 4,524 are at AIDS stage. Transmission occurs via three primary routes: HIV-contaminated blood exposure, mother-to-child transmission (via placenta during pregnancy or at birth), and unprotected sexual contact. Annual counts show 570 (2021), 835 (2022), 1,001 (2023), 1,006 (2024), 1,051 (2025), and 187 new cases in the first quarter of 2026. To curb spread, the Dinas Kesehatan Riau implements the STOP strategy—focusing on early detection, treatment, and education. Programs include Suluh (outreach/education), Temukan (case finding), Obati (treatment), and Pertahankan (sustaining viral suppression). Efforts stress multi-sector collaboration, engaging students, PKK cadres, and religious institutions to enhance screening and care in the Bumi Lancang Kuning region.

triage.headline_ja: リアウ州でHIV/AIDS症例が増加、2025年は1,000件を記録
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、地域の年次統計報告に過ぎず、突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病的HIV流行の統計報告であり、地元保健当局による通常の対策プログラム（STOP戦略）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS inicia primer ensayo clínico con antiviral contra ébola en RDC | Noticias RCN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO begins the first clinical trial of an antiviral against Ebola in the DRC | Noticias RCN
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo variant, is the focus as the World Health Organization starts the first human trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to test obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). The EBO-PEP trial aims to recruit about 1,000 participants aged 12+ who had direct contact with a confirmed Bundibugyo case within the past five days and are asymptomatic. Obeldesivir, an oral antiviral developed by Gilead Sciences, has shown efficacy in preclinical filovirus models. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. The outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri Province (northeast DRC), has infected more than 1,960 people and caused over 700 deaths, with some cases also reported in Uganda. The trial seeks to provide a preventive tool amid insecurity and weak health systems complicating containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱に対する抗ウイルス薬の初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中で、1960人以上が感染し700人以上が死亡、ウガンダへの越境例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い深刻な事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安不安と脆弱な医療体制が封じ込めを困難にしている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ações de prevenção às arboviroses chegam a 16 bairros - Prefeitura da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arboviral disease prevention actions reach 16 neighborhoods – City Hall of Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: 16 neighborhoods in Rio de Janeiro across Norte, Sul, Sudoeste and Oeste zones will host SVS preventive actions against dengue, Zika and chikungunya from July 15–17, 2026. Inspections begin July 15 in Cidade Nova, Andaraí, Vargem Pequena and Taquara; July 16 in Botafogo, Brás de Pina, Inhaúma, Honório Gurgel, Irajá, Senador Camarão, Bangu, Campo Grande, Pedra de Guaratiba and Santa Cruz; July 17 in Copacabana, Guaratiba and Campo Grande again. The effort targets Aedes aegypti, the vector for these arboviruses. Up to July 4, 2026, 6,108,007 property inspections and 848,047 potential breeding deposits were treated or eliminated. In 2025, 12,297,072 property visits and 1,684,674 containers were treated or eliminated. Educational actions by the Municipal Health Secretariat stress public participation; residents can request inspections or report breeding sites via Central 1746 to support prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の予防対策が16地区に拡大 – リオデジャネイロ市役所
triage.triage_reason: 定例のベクター対策（蚊防除活動）の広報記事であり、異常な流行拡大や新規感染急増を示す情報はない。ルーティンの公衆衛生活動として社会的緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は市による定例の蚊媒介感染症予防活動の告知であり、症例数急増や異常事態を示す内容ではない。既存の年次防除実績（2025年及び2026年前半）の報告が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo spreading faster than it can be tracked
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in eastern Congo (Ituri’s Bunia) is spreading faster than officials can track. Since May, 1,926 infections and 702 deaths have been reported across three provinces; cases have also been confirmed in Uganda. About 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, with many deaths occurring in communities before reaching health facilities, hindering isolation and contact tracing. The Africa Centres for Disease Control calls it Africa’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. Health capacity is expanding: Bunia now has near 800 treatment beds and laboratory capacity has grown from one to 14 labs, but the response lags behind transmission. Contributing factors include funding gaps, attacks on health centres, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict with local mistrust. Dozens of health workers at an Ebola treatment centre briefly struck over pay; outbreak declared May 15, with treatment trials begun last week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、追跡が追いつかないほど急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが1,926症例・702死亡と急拡大し、ウガンダにも越境感染が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例確認が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。紛争地域での対応困難、資金不足、医療従事者ストライキなど対応能力に関する懸念材料あり。

article.articleHeadline: ประเด็นข่าวรอบโลก : "ทรัมป์" ยกเลิกค่าผ่านฮอร์มุซ / จับตา "เฟด" แถลงเงินเฟ้อคืนนี้ / แผ่นดินไหวเขย่า ฟิลิปปินส์ 6.5 / "อีโบลา" ฆ่า 754 ศพ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World News Roundup: "Trump" cancels Hormuz transit tolls / Watch the "Fed" inflation announcement tonight / 6.5-magnitude earthquake strikes the Philippines / "Ebola" kills 754 people
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths reported. The outbreak has reached five provinces: Ituri (center of transmission), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chopo. So far, 366 patients have recovered, while 753 remain in isolation or under care. The available data indicate ongoing transmission, with Ituri remaining the epicenter of the current outbreak. In a separate event, a 6.5-magnitude earthquake struck offshore Davao Occidental, southern Philippines, on July 14 at 23:49 local time, at a depth of about 10 km; there are no reports of damage, fatalities, or injuries. All figures reflect the situation on July 15, 2026, as reported in the roundup.

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola: plus de 2.000 cas recensés, mais l'OMS redoute une ampleur réelle de deux à quatre fois plus importante (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: more than 2,000 cases recorded, but the WHO fears that the real magnitude is two to four times greater (GENERAL ARTICLE).
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths, as of July 14, 2026, with the outbreak driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The World Health Organization warns the true magnitude could be two to four times higher due to undetected transmission chains, high community mortality, and rapid geographic expansion from Ituri’s Bunia epicenter to Haut-Uele (14 cases, 13 deaths) and Tshopo, including Kisangani. Cross-border risk is heightened by population movements toward Uganda. As of July 13, 12,430 contacts were under follow-up (67.4% traced; target 95%). Despite improved lab and surveillance capacity, 80% of new cases are outside existing contact lists. No licensed vaccine or specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; an early post-exposure trial of obeldesivir is under way in DRC and Uganda with up to 1,000 participants. The PARTNERS trial, evaluating MBP134 and remdesivir, began July 2 in DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Singapore Boosts Ebola Response: S$2.5 Million Aid Supports Congo and Uganda - Best Breaking News and Beyond: Singapore, Batam and some say JB
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, Singapore pledged S$2.5 million to bolster Ebola response efforts in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The funding will strengthen surveillance systems, treatment capacity, laboratory testing, and community engagement to contain the virus. The move comes amid the WHO warning that funding for emergency operations is less than half of what is required, prompting calls for urgent international support to avert escalation. Ebola is described as a deadly, rapidly spreading threat, with rapid containment, early detection, and access to healthcare essential to reduce transmission and improve survival. The announcement underscores the importance of international cooperation, as health experts note that infectious diseases cross borders and rapid deployment of medical supplies and personnel is critical. Singapore’s aid signals a broader role in global health security.

article.articleHeadline: From smartphones to clinics: What Indonesia can learn from Thailand's disease tracking
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 spurred health-digital investments in Southeast Asia. Thailand’s integrated surveillance—more than 10,000 COVID-19 labs and a nationwide system linking local and central authorities—tracked outbreaks including among migrant workers. Mid-2025 COVID wave: roughly 374,000 cases and 84 deaths. Thailand’s early leadership in 2020 also showed strong results: 3,195 confirmed infections with 3,072 recoveries (96%). The Centre for COVID-19 Situation Administration (CCSA) coordinated across ministries, and public compliance with health measures was high (mask-wearing and hygiene 89–98% in a 2020 Imperial College London survey). Digital tools MorChana (GPS/Bluetooth for contacts) and MohPromt (digital vaccination records/EHRs) serve about 36 million users, enabling real-time test reporting and accessible records, including migrants. Indonesia built 600+ labs (2020–2021) and many health apps, but fragmentation persists (SatuSehat plus local Pikobar, Sawarna, PaPa Sulbar). Net Pracharat and Universal Coverage help; Indonesia should boost connectivity, regional integration, and public trust.

article.articleHeadline: 境外移入茲卡病毒感染　今年現首例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First imported Zika virus infection this year.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections continue to rise in Taiwan: 2,811 outpatient visits for July 5–17, up 34.4% WoW. From July 7–13, 17 new severe domestically acquired cases were reported; no additional domestic deaths. Since ROC year 114 (October 2025), 136 severe locally acquired cases and 18 deaths have occurred; 72.1% were 65 or older, and 83.8% had chronic diseases. Last week marked Taiwan’s first imported Zika virus infection this year—a man in his 30s in the north who had returned from Thailand in mid-June with fever, dizziness, and headache. Zika transmits via Aedes mosquitoes, sexual contact, and vertical routes; most adult infections are mild, but pregnancy can risk fetal microcephaly or death. Three new Japanese encephalitis cases were reported domestically: two men and one woman in their seventies, in Guanyin District and Taoyuan District (Taoyuan City), and Huatan Township (Changhua County).

article.articleHeadline: Mahasiswa D3 Farmasi Universitas Harkat Negeri Edukasi Warga Cegah DBD dan Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D3 Pharmacy Students of Harkat Negeri University Educate Residents to Prevent Dengue Fever and Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: On 27 June 2026, 30 PKK cadres from Desa Dukuhbangsa in Jatinegara District, Tegal Regency, Indonesia participated in a health education outreach led by second-year D3 Pharmacy students of Universitas Harkat Negeri. Part of Praktik Kuliah Lapangan for Civic Education, the session educated residents about Dengue fever (DBD) and Chikungunya—causes, symptoms, transmission, and prevention—with emphasis on environmental hygiene and eradicating mosquito breeding sites. Students also demonstrated making wedang jahe merah, a ginger-based herbal drink believed to boost immunity during recovery. Desa Dukuhbangsa head Abdul Khofif praised the initiative, noting high local incidence of DBD and Chikungunya and urging broader knowledge dissemination. The activity highlights university–community collaboration to enhance promotive and preventive health measures in the area.

article.articleHeadline: Is every second person ill in Mumbai? Why monsoons bring a dangerous disease back
article.articleSummary: Mumbai faces an annual leptospirosis risk during the monsoon as flooding and waterlogging create exposure to Leptospira bacteria shed in animal urine. While a wave of influenza-like illnesses dominates, doctors warn that leptospirosis requires attention due to potential life-threatening progression if untreated. Leptospira are carried by rats, dogs, cattle and pigs; contaminated floodwater can enter the body via cuts or through the eyes, nose or mouth, with barefoot contact increasing risk. Early symptoms mimic other monsoon illnesses: sudden fever, severe headache, muscle pains, vomiting and red eyes; severe Weil's disease can cause jaundice, kidney and liver failure, bleeding, respiratory distress, and death if not treated. Diagnosis is challenging due to overlap with dengue, malaria, influenza, and Covid-19. Antibiotics are most effective when started early. Prevention emphasizes avoiding floodwater, wearing protective footwear, sealing wounds, hygiene, rodent control, and reducing waterlogging; Mumbai authorities highlight waste management. As of 15 July 2026.

article.articleHeadline: 眼睛奇痒干涩久治不愈？当心蠕形螨在睫毛根部"安了家"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Persistent itchy, dry eyes? Beware of Demodex mites taking up residence at the lash roots.
article.articleSummary: Demodex blepharitis with Meibomian Gland Dysfunction caused by Demodex mites at lash roots was diagnosed in a 32-year-old patient (alias Xiao Li) in Kunming, China. She had persistent itchy, dry eyes and tearing unresponsive to over-the-counter drops, with later conjunctival injection. Ocular surface testing revealed abundant Demodex and eggs, confirming Demodex blepharitis with Meibomian Gland Dysfunction. Demodex mites inhabit lash follicles and sebaceous and Meibomian glands; their secretions and waste can block glands, impair lipid secretion, and cause evaporative dry eye with itching, foreign body sensation, discharge and lash shedding. A four-cycle, in-hospital eradication plan was paired with anti-inflammatories and preservative-free artificial tears, plus daily home cleansing of lash roots with medical demodex swabs. Symptoms improved after the first course; final consolidation cleared the mites. Transmission can occur via direct/indirect contact; close contacts may need screening. Highlights: seek expert evaluation for persistent dry eye/itching; avoid indiscriminate antibiotics or steroids.

article.articleHeadline: 台风"巴威"致辽宁多地积水 专家提醒蹚水后防感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Typhoon Bavi causes waterlogging in many parts of Liaoning; experts warn to prevent infection after wading through floodwater.
article.articleSummary: Typhoon Bavi-triggered flooding across Liaoning Province, China, left streets waterlogged. After wading, residents reported skin redness, itching, fever, and diarrhea. Shengjing Hospital experts warn floodwater is a polluted mix harboring bacteria (E. coli, Streptococcus, Staphylococcus aureus, Salmonella, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Clostridium tetani, Leptospira), enteric viruses (norovirus, rotavirus), parasites (Cryptosporidium), and chemical pollutants (pesticides, heavy metals, oil). Prolonged exposure in sandals can breach the skin barrier, risking cellulitis or erysipelas and worsening fungal infections; pathogens may enter via hands to mouth or, in women, ascend to vaginitis or acute pelvic inflammatory disease. Flooded environments also contain feces and animal carcasses, increasing enteric, vector-borne, and zoonotic infections. Cleaning requires chlorine disinfection, boiling bed linens for 15 minutes, sun-drying non-wet fabrics, and thorough hand/skin hygiene. Seek medical care for diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, fever, or skin/eye and gynecologic symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: OMS inicia histórico ensayo clínico con antiviral oral para frenar la variante Bundibugyo en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches historic clinical trial of an oral antiviral to curb the Bundibugyo variant in Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO launches the first clinical trial of an oral antiviral, obeldesivir, to prevent Ebola in exposed individuals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak involving the Bundibugyo variant. The EBO-PEP trial aims to recruit about 1,000 volunteers aged 12 years and older who had direct contact with a confirmed case within the last five days and are asymptomatic, to determine if the antiviral can prevent disease development. Obeldesivir, developed by Gilead Sciences, has shown activity against filoviruses. This emergency study complements the PARTNERS trial, started in July, which is evaluating treatments such as remdesivir plus the monoclonal MBP-134 in hospitalized patients with a positive diagnosis. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expresses hope that the intervention could help high-risk exposed individuals and curb a highly destructive Ebola variant to avert a potential global health crisis.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ変異株）のアウトブレイクが継続しており、WHOが緊急の臨床試験を開始するなど国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事案であるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола в ДРК превысило 2000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola fever cases in the DRC has surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 15 July — In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola virus disease confirmed cases have reached 2,011, including 754 deaths. The outbreak spans five provinces: Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Chopo. A total of 366 patients have recovered, while 753 remain in isolation. The outbreak remains in a phase of sustained transmission, characterized by rapid case growth since its onset. The cluster is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was declared on May 15. Health authorities are continuing containment and isolation measures as the situation persists across the affected regions.

article.articleHeadline: പ്രതിസന്ധിയിലായ ക്ഷീരമേഖലയെ ചര്‍മമുഴ രോഗം പിന്നോട്ടടിക്കുന്നു. വില്ലനാവുന്നത് ഈച്ചയും കൊതുകും കൊക്കും. അന്യസംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളില്‍ നിന്ന് പശുക്കളെ വാങ്ങുന്നത് വര്‍ധിച്ചതും തിരിച്ചടിയായി എന്ന് കർഷകർ. രോഗ വ്യാപനത്തിനൊപ്പം ചികിത്സാ ചെലവും വർധിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crisis-hit dairy sector is being held back by a skin disease. Flies and mosquitoes are the culprits. Farmers say that the rise in purchasing cows from other states is a setback. With the spread of the disease, treatment costs have also risen.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), a viral, vector-borne cattle illness, is hindering Kerala’s dairy sector, with Kottayam and several districts reporting rising cases. Farmers say spread has intensified as cows are bought from other states, elevating cross-border transmission risk. LSD causes initial skin nodules that progress to ulcers, accompanied by pain, fever, and a marked drop in milk production; severe cases can kill calves. Treatment costs are rising, straining smallholders. Farmers allege inadequate preventive action by the veterinary department and demand free treatment and vaccination for LSD-affected cattle, plus clear directives to veterinary hospitals to prioritize containment. They urge a structured LSD vaccination program with properly timed doses, akin to schedules used for other cattle diseases, to avert further outbreaks. The report highlights import-related risks and local transmission in Kerala, starting from Kottayam.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak: Democratic Republic of the Congo | Uganda Weekly External Situation Report 09, Data as of 12 July 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with 339 new confirmed cases and 198 additional deaths since 5 July 2026, raising transmission and expanding geography to five provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo). A 36.6% case fatality rate among confirmed cases; 42 health zones affected. Ituri bears the majority, with 775 cases (89.2%) and 382 deaths (86.6%). In the past 21 days, 869 confirmed cases and 441 deaths were reported across 33 of 42 zones; Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, and Nizi are the top transmission sites, with Nizi emerging as a hotspot. Nia-Nia and Mangala fuel spread to Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. Katwa in North Kivu remains a major mortality hotspot. Outside DRC, Uganda and France report no new cases; no evidence of secondary transmission. Ariwara near South Sudan and Uganda borders increases cross-border spread risk; sustained regional surveillance is needed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイク：コンゴ民主共和国｜ウガンダ 週次外部状況報告書09（2026年7月12日時点データ）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率36.6%のエボラ（ブンディブギョウ型）が5州42保健地区に拡大し、直近21日間で869症例・441死亡を記録。国境地帯での越境拡大リスクもあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
