article.articleHeadline: 中國公共衛生專家組啟程前往烏干達 支援埃博拉疫情防控 | 內地
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese public health expert group departs for Uganda to assist in Ebola outbreak prevention and control | Mainland
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, two Chinese public health experts depart Beijing for Uganda to assist Ebola outbreak prevention and control, joining the Africa CDC and WHO in an Incident Management Support Team (IMST) effort. Selected by the China CDC, the specialists bring extensive field experience in major infectious diseases and international public health cooperation, and will participate in Ebola outbreak assessment, control strategy development, and on-site coordination. Africa has recently reported multiple outbreaks; on June 2, the first Chinese Ebola relief team arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, for a three-month mission, and on July 3 a second team arrived to continue support. From July 8–11, after completing Congo assignments, the group visited Uganda to discuss cooperation with the Ministry of Health and to tour the Uganda Virus Research Institute, Makerere University Infectious Diseases Institute, the Institute of Pulmonary Diseases, and the Africa Ebola IMST Headquarters, with China providing emergency anti-epidemic supplies to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 中国公衆衛生専門家チームがウガンダへ出発、エボラ出血熱の防疫対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ（コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ）で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、中国・WHO・Africa CDCが国際支援チームを派遣する国際的公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ対応に関するもの。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は支援チーム派遣元であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 80% من إصابات إيبولا الجديدة في الكونغو مجهولة المصدر - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 80% of new Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are of unknown origin.
article.articleSummary: 80% of new Ebola infections in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo arise from unknown transmission chains, signaling transmission is outpacing contact tracing. As of July 15, 2026, government data report 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC with 754 deaths. The Public Health Institute's latest update notes 54 new infections on Monday across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu, underscoring persistent spread in the eastern region and ongoing outbreak. The unknown-origin chains highlight gaps in surveillance and the need for intensified tracing and response measures in affected provinces. WHO warns this pattern complicates containment and could raise regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国における新規エボラ感染症例の80%が感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つが該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WHOが地域リスク上昇を警告する進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイクであるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 2,011例確定・754例死亡（致死率約37.5%）、80%が感染経路不明という点は接触追跡の限界を示し、封じ込めの困難さと地域拡大リスクをWHOが指摘している。イトゥリ州・北キブ州を含む3州にわたる継続的な流行状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kolejne zakażenia ebolą. Bilans przekroczył 2 tys. przypadków
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More Ebola infections. The toll has surpassed 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) was declared on May 15, 2026—the 17th Ebola epidemic in the country since 1976. As of July 15, 2026, confirmed infections have surpassed 2,000, reaching 2,011, with 754 deaths. The surge centers in Ituri, North Kivu, and Upper Uele provinces, with 54 new cases reported on Monday, and Uganda reporting cross-border transmission linked to these regions. The epidemic has spread beyond the DRC, reflecting cross-border spread toward Uganda’s Ituri and North Kivu-adjacent areas, where many new cases have been documented. Ebola is a severe, highly infectious disease transmitted by direct contact with blood, secretions, and excreta of infected individuals. Over the last five decades, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa; the deadliest Congo outbreak (2018–2020) killed about 2,300.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染がさらに拡大。累計は2,000例を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染者2,000例超・死者754人に達し、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）が認められるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率は約37.5%と非常に高く、2018-2020年の大規模流行に匹敵する規模に拡大している。

article.articleHeadline: Trials of a potential Ebola treatment have begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: First clinical trial of obledesivir, an antiviral from Gilead Sciences, for Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The trial, announced by the World Health Organization, will assess whether the drug can prevent disease in asymptomatic contacts of confirmed Bundibugyo cases. Nearly 1,000 participants aged over 12 will be enrolled and monitored daily for 21 days. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo. Official DRC data report over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths; WHO cautions the true scale could be two to four times higher, with many new cases outside known transmission chains. In parallel, a second study in Ituri is testing MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir as potential therapies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療薬候補の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラの感染者1,960人超・死者700人超が報告され、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を指摘しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的対応（WHO主導の治験）が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Ituriは州(ADM1)でありDRC国内のためDRCに集約。既知感染連鎖外の新規症例が多いとされ、感染規模拡大・管理困難のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 80% من إصابات "إيبولا" الجديدة في الكونغو مجهولة المصدر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 80% of new Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have unknown origin.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the World Health Organization reports that 80% of new Ebola infections in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo arise from unknown transmission chains, indicating faster spread than health authorities can trace, despite intensified response efforts. Government data show total confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC reaching 2,011, with 754 deaths. The latest update records 54 new infections on Monday across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu. The figures point to sustained transmission hotspots in the eastern DRC and highlight gaps in linkage to known chains. These data underscore the challenge of mapping sources and containing the outbreak in the region, with ongoing surveillance needed to understand and interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国における新規エボラ感染例の80%が感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（累計2,011例、死亡754例）が継続しており、80%の感染経路が追跡不能であることから国際的拡大リスクと管理不能性が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOがコンゴ東部（イトゥリ、北キブなど3州）における継続的なエボラ流行を報告。感染経路追跡の失敗率が高く、既存の対応能力を超えている可能性が示唆される。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 Cases In India: Don't Ignore Fever, Cough And Body Ache, Doctors Warn
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Covid-19 has re-emerged in India with fresh cases and two Covid-related deaths reported in Andhra Pradesh. The report notes no need to panic, but urges attention to common respiratory symptoms such as fever, cough, sore throat, fatigue, and body aches. Doctors reference recent medical guidance highlighting these symptoms as possible Covid-19 indicators. The text does not provide nationwide case totals, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources, nor any information on imported or exported cases. The situation centers on Andhra Pradesh signals of renewed transmission, with guidance aimed at early recognition and appropriate care.

triage.headline_ja: インドでの新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）症例：発熱・咳・体の痛みを軽視しないよう医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州でCOVID-19の再燃と死亡例が報告されているが、全国的な症例数や検査確認情報、感染源に関する情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の感染症であり定期的な再燃が見られるため新規性は低いが、死亡例の報告があり地域的な動向として注視が必要。全国的な規模や検査確認の詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says number of confirmed Ebola cases surpasses 2,000
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo rise to 2,011, with 754 deaths, according to government data on 2026-07-15. The latest report records 54 new cases detected on Monday in Ituri, North Kivu and Haut-Uele, signaling ongoing transmission in eastern DRC. Health officials warned that the outbreak could rapidly spread to new areas if public health measures are not implemented promptly. The update shows continued multi-province spread, with recent detections indicating expansion beyond earlier hotspots. The released data do not provide details on vaccination status or specific viral lineages. Ongoing monitoring, rapid case identification, and prompt public health response are emphasized as critical to curbing further infections and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ確定症例数が2,000人を超えたと発表
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例2,011人・死亡754人と規模が大きく、複数州にわたる継続的な人-人感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%と高く、複数州（Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele）にまたがる継続的な感染拡大が報告されている。ワクチン接種状況やウイルス系統の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Rath Yatra on Alert: Odisha Steps Up COVID-19 Surveillance Amid Regional Spike
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Odisha steps up COVID-19 surveillance and public health preparedness ahead of Rath Yatra, one of India's largest religious gatherings, as cases rise in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. Odisha authorities aim to minimize virus transmission during the festival, with lakhs of devotees expected to attend from July 16 onward. The enhanced measures reflect regional transmission concerns and coordination with neighboring states to ensure event safety, public health messaging, and rapid response capacity during the festival period. The development signals heightened vigilance for travel-related infection risk during large-scale gatherings in the region and requires community compliance with health guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ラート・ヤートラ警戒:地域での感染拡大を受けてオディシャ州が新型コロナウイルス監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 大規模宗教行事に伴うCOVID-19監視強化の報道だが、重症度や異常性を示す情報がなく、IHR基準は該当しないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域的な感染増加とラート・ヤートラという大規模集会前の予防的監視強化に関する報道であり、重症度や新規変異株等の情報は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: число заболевших Эболой может значительно превышать официальные данные
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola case numbers may significantly exceed official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be significantly undercounted. The World Health Organization reports about 2,000 people infected and more than 700 deaths, with modelling indicating the true scale is at least 2–4 times higher than identified cases. About 80% of new infections are detected outside the official contact lists, and many deaths occur at home without hospital care. Ebola is a highly contagious viral hemorrhagic fever with mortality up to roughly 70%. The figures come from a WHO briefing in Geneva, highlighting substantial under-detection and access barriers amid the ongoing outbreak in DR Congo. The article provides no specific details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources beyond the modelling results.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ感染者数は公式データを大幅に上回る可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、WHOが公式集計の数倍の実際の感染者数を示唆しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ジュネーブはWHO本部の所在地であり、発生地域ではないため除外。実際の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo registrerer mere end 2000 ebolasmittede
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records more than 2,000 people infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola variant spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is driving an outbreak in the DRC, with a case fatality rate of 37.5% currently reported. Confirmed Ebola cases have surpassed 2,000, according to a late-night post by the country’s Ministry of Communications on X. The report notes ongoing transmission and the scale of the outbreak within the DRC. Details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection source, or imported/exported cases are not provided in the excerpt. The development underscores the severity of the situation and the need for sustained surveillance, public health measures, and resources to protect affected communities across the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者2,000人超を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率37.5%、確定症例2,000人超という大規模かつ深刻な疫病発生であり、稀なブンディブギョ株による継続的な人-人感染が示唆されるためIHR基準の複数該当が見込まれる。
triage.notes: 稀なブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で致死率が高い。感染源・輸出入例・検査手法は記事に記載なし。続報でWHO通知状況や国際的拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases Top 2,000 In Congo As Outbreak Spreads In Haut-Uele
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 2,000 as the Bundibugyo outbreak spread into three additional health zones in Haut-Uélé province, highlighting the world's fastest-growing outbreak of the deadly disease. Congo’s National Institute of Public Health reported 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of July 13. The latest figures add 54 new confirmed cases, largely in the outbreak’s Ituri epicenter, and seven new cases in Haut-Uélé, where the virus has now been detected in four health zones. The spread into Haut-Uélé marks expansion of the Bundibugyo outbreak beyond Ituri, underscoring ongoing transmission across multiple regions and the challenge of containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が2,000人を超え、アウトブレイクがオート・ウエレ州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が2,000症例・754死亡に達し、複数州へ拡大していることから国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められ、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率約37.5%（754/2011）と高く、Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクがIturiからHaut-Uéléへ拡大中。封じ込めの課題が明示されており、国際的な支援と監視強化が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: От вспышки лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго погибли более 750 человек - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 750 people have died from the Ebola virus disease outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 754 fatalities and 2,011 confirmed cases, according to Reuters citing updated briefings from the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media. The death toll has risen from about 640 previously reported, indicating continued transmission across affected regions. The report provides ongoing counts but does not specify precise outbreak locations or laboratory confirmation details beyond the totals. Separately, Russian Deputy Head of the Russian Academy of Education Gennady Oniushenko stated that Ebola is not transmitted by airborne droplets and that its pandemic potential remains low, a claim intended to reassure Russians about import risk. The article highlights updated figures and public messaging but offers no details on infection sources or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により750人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が754人の死亡・2011症例に達し、継続的な感染拡大を示しており、公衆衛生上重大な影響と国際的懸念がある。
triage.notes: ロシアの発言は輸入リスクに関する安心材料であり、ロシア国内での症例発生を示すものではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Започна изпитване на потенциално лекарство срещу ебола в Демократична република Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A trial of a potential Ebola drug began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues with no approved vaccines or treatments. The World Health Organization announced the first clinical trial of the antiviral obeldesivir for people exposed to Bundibugyo Ebola to see if it can prevent disease progression. The trial, led by the American company Gilead Sciences, will enroll about 1,000 contacts aged 12 and older, who will be monitored daily for 21 days. Official counts report over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths, though WHO cautions the true burden may be two to four times higher due to transmission chains that are not detected. In Ituri province, parallel research tests MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir as potential therapies for Ebola. No vaccine exists yet for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療薬候補の治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、感染者1960人超・死者700人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響がある。WHOとGilead社による治験開始など国際的関与も大きく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 実際の感染者数はWHOによれば報告数の2〜4倍に上る可能性があり、伝播チェーンの未検出が懸念される。Ituri州はDRC国内の一地域として集約。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus outbreak: Three children dead, four on life support in Gujarat, surveillance intensified
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat, India, reports three pediatric deaths and four children on ventilator support over two weeks. Since July 1, 32 suspected CHPV infections have been recorded; 23 have been tested, with seven positives and 16 negatives. All seven confirmed patients are under 10 years old. Among confirmed cases, three have died and four remain critically ill on life support; nine suspected cases await test results. The virus, transmitted by sand flies, can cause acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) in children. The latest suspected case is a two-year-old girl from Meghraj taluka, Aravalli district, admitted to Himmatnagar Civil Hospital. Gujarat Health Minister Praful Pansheriya said surveillance, treatment, and containment are ongoing and that the situation is under control, with two recovered and discharged. Authorities are intensifying monitoring across affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス感染症の流行：グジャラート州で子供3人死亡、4人が生命維持装置管理下に、監視体制強化
triage.triage_reason: 小児における複数の死亡例と重症例（人工呼吸器管理）が確認されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介性で、ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、小児における高い致死率と重症化が懸念される。グジャラート州では過去にも同様の流行歴があり、季節性の再燃の可能性がある。続報でのケース数増加・地理的拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kongos neuer (alter) Business-Zweig - Das "Ebola-Geschäft"? - UNSER MITTELEUROPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo's new (old) business arm - The "Ebola business"? - Our Central Europe
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is under scrutiny as officials cite a severe outbreak to justify international aid. Reported numbers claim more than 1,000 confirmed cases and hundreds of deaths since mid-May, prompting a US response of over $1.4 billion, plus $270 million direct funding from the State Department and $107 million from the CDC. The article questions the figures, recalling the 2018–2020 ‘Ebola business’—inflated contracts, bribes, and per diems that sustained the crisis and attacks on health workers. It cites a US military peer-review finding that Ebola PCR tests produced conflicting results on the same samples, with primer/probe sequences not routinely checked. Congo loses an estimated $10–15 billion annually to corruption; no independent verification proves the 2026 numbers are false, but no transparent review has been published.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの新たな（古い）ビジネス分野－「エボラビジネス」？－Unser Mitteleuropa
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,000例超・死亡数百とされるエボラ流行が報告され、米国から巨額の支援金（14億ドル超）が投入されているとの情報があり、事実であればIHR基準を複数満たす重大事案。ただし記事自体は数値の信憑性に疑義を呈する論説であり、公式情報源（WHO/DRC保健省）による裏付け確認が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は米国等からの支援金投入とその妥当性を疑問視する論説であり、報告されている症例数・死亡数の真偽については独立した検証が公表されていない点に留意。実際のアウトブレイク状況はWHOやDRC保健省の公式発表で確認する必要がある。米国（USA）は資金提供元として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 80% من إصابات الإيبولا الجديدة في الكونغو مجهولة المصدر - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 80% of new Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have an unknown source.
article.articleSummary: 80% of new Ebola infections in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo arise from unknown transmission chains, indicating the outbreak is spreading faster than contact-tracing capacity, according to the World Health Organization. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved treatment or licensed vaccine. Since May, three provinces in Congo have reported transmission; Africa CDC calls it the fastest Ebola outbreak on the continent. A WHO official, after returning from Bunia in Ituri Province, warns many newly reported deaths occur among people who never reached a health facility, hindering isolation and rapid tracing. As of Monday, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died in three Congo provinces; cases have also been confirmed in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak’s persistence and cross-border spread underscore ongoing containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国における新規エボラ感染例の80%が感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で稀なブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行が発生し、感染追跡能力を超える速さで拡大、国境を越えてウガンダにも感染が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、致死率が高い点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ quan sau khi bị chó cắn, thêm một người tử vong nghi do bệnh dại ở Nghệ An
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carelessness after a dog bite, another person dies of suspected rabies in Nghe An
article.articleSummary: Two suspected rabies deaths in Nghệ An, Vietnam, within about a month, linked to failure to receive post-exposure vaccination after dog bites. On 15 July 2026, a man born in 1981 in Quảng Châu, Nghệ An, who had brought a dog from Laos for meat, developed rabies symptoms about three months after the bite and died despite medical care. Earlier, in early June 2026, a man born in 1957 in Bach Hà, Nghệ An, who did not seek vaccination and treated with herbal remedies after a domestic dog bite, died about five months later; the dog had died five days after the bite. Health authorities are reviewing exposed individuals and reinforcing prevention. Rabies is a viral disease transmitted mainly by bites or saliva; once symptoms appear, survival is unlikely. Prevention includes washing wounds for 15 minutes, disinfection, and seeking vaccination and immunoglobulin at a healthcare facility, with pets vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に噛まれた後の油断により、ゲアン省でさらに1人が狂犬病疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでは狂犬病は風土病であり、本件は曝露後ワクチン接種を怠ったことによる個別の死亡例の報告に過ぎず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の風土病であり、本記事は個別死亡例2件の報告と予防啓発が主目的。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese public health experts head to Uganda to aid Ebola response at invitation of Africa CDC and WHO
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, two Chinese public health experts departed Beijing to Uganda to join the Joint Continental Incident Management Support Team (IMST), formed by Africa CDC and WHO, to bolster Ebola response. They will operate within an IMST working group alongside experts from other countries to assess the Ebola outbreak across DR Congo and Uganda, develop prevention and control measures, and coordinate on-site emergency response. The World Health Organization had on May 17 declared the Ebola situation in DR Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. The IMST comprises 14 working groups covering coordination/governance, risk communication, surveillance/cross-border preparedness, and laboratory testing. This dispatch marks another step in China’s ongoing support—after two prior batches of China Medical Expert Teams—to the Central African outbreak response, with the NDCPA noting the experts’ extensive experience in major infectious diseases and international public health cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の公衆衛生専門家、アフリカCDCおよびWHOの要請によりエボラ対応支援のためウガンダへ派遣
triage.triage_reason: WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しているコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダにおける既存のエボラ流行（WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み）への中国からの支援派遣に関するもの。ウガンダおよび中国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。既にPHEICが宣言されている継続的イベントであり、フルリスク評価の対象として引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Започна изпитване на потенциално лекарство срещу ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A clinical trial of a potential Ebola drug began in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Obeldesivir is being tested in the Democratic Republic of Congo in a first clinical trial evaluating post-exposure prophylaxis for the Ebola Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization reports the study will enroll about 1,000 participants aged 12 and older who have had contact with confirmed cases but are asymptomatic. Participants will be followed daily for 21 days to assess whether Obeldesivir prevents disease onset. There are currently no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola; vaccine development may take about nine months. The outbreak in DRC has infected more than 1,960 people and caused over 700 deaths, with WHO cautioning that the true scale may be 2–4 times higher and many new cases occur outside known transmission chains. In Ituri province, parallel research tests MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir as potential therapies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療薬候補の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行は感染者1960人超、死亡700人超に達し、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない中でWHO主導の治験が開始されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関与が高い。
triage.notes: 既知の伝播経路外での新規症例が多く、実際の感染規模は報告の2〜4倍の可能性があるとWHOが指摘。ワクチン開発には約9か月を要する見込み。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية أكبر ممّا هو معلن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is larger than announced.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be twofold to fourfold larger than official counts. Official data show over 1,960 cases and more than 700 deaths since detection about two months ago. WHO Emergency Programme Director Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu said models indicate true outbreak size is at least double to quadruple the detected cases, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The 17th outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri province, northeast DRC, with cross-border infections extending to Uganda and cases reported in five Congolese provinces. More than 90% of current cases are in Ituri. Ebola spreads via direct contact and bodily fluids, and many recently reported cases involve people who died before reaching a health facility, highlighting access gaps.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は公表数より大きい
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式集計の2〜4倍規模と警告する史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行であり、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染規模がWHO公式発表の2〜4倍とされる点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Proben für die Epidemie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Samples for the Epidemic.
article.articleSummary: MSF operates an Ebola simulation center near Nairobi, Kenya, ahead of sending personnel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, in preparation for the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The facility replicates a real treatment center; four weekly workshops in English and French focus on structure, access controls, and, crucially, donning/doffing PPE to prevent self-contamination in hot, sealed suits that require careful planning. MSF currently employs over 1,400 staff in the DRC, with regional colleagues from South Sudan and Uganda training in Nairobi before deployment. Since 15 May 2026, the Congo outbreak has 1,926 lab-confirmed cases, 702 deaths, and 318 recoveries. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo; supportive care remains standard. Trials of MBP134 and remdesivir began in July; transmission is via body fluids, including during funerals; adaptation allows families to observe deceased through transparent barriers.

triage.headline_ja: 流行のためのサンプル採取
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる史上最速拡大とされるアウトブレイクで、確定症例1,926例、死亡702例、承認済みワクチン・治療法なしという重大な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイロビ（ケニア）、ウガンダ、南スーダンはMSF職員の訓練・派遣拠点として言及されているのみで、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ケニア・ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれない、または主題の発生国でないため除外した。
