article.articleHeadline: Finland signals end of Salmonella outbreak
article.articleSummary: Finland reports the end of a major Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouted seeds from India. In spring 2026, Salmonella Bovismorbificans illnesses were detected in Finland, with 64 suspected domestically and 37 confirmed to share the outbreak strain. Most cases occurred March–May (one in June); ages 4–86, mean 43; 41 women; 10 hospitalizations; 2 deaths within 30 days, both with underlying conditions. Uncooked sprouts were the likely source; the implicated sprouts are no longer on the market. Across Europe, 2023–2025 saw 700–800 Salmonella cases annually; 2025 had 712 infections, including four Bovismorbificans; by 2026 so far, 380 infections. Affected countries: Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, Ireland, Luxembourg, Spain, Netherlands, United Kingdom. The primary vehicle is alfalfa sprouts; Italy-linked seeds traced to a supplier in India; introduction to Europe in Oct 2025 via two consignments, with outbreak strain detected in water samples in the Netherlands and UK.

triage.headline_ja: フィンランド、サルモネラ菌アウトブレイクの終息を発表
triage.triage_reason: サルモネラ菌アウトブレイクは既に終息が報告されており、感染発生地域は欧州諸国（フィンランド、オーストリア等）であり、対象国（インド等）とは無関係。疾患タグ（Paratyphoid/Typhoid）も実際の病原体（Salmonella Bovismorbificans）と一致せず誤分類の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はサルモネラ菌（Salmonella Bovismorbificans）による欧州でのアウトブレイクの終息報告。インドは汚染種子の供給元として言及されているのみで、感染事例発生国ではないため対象国リストには含めない。疾患タグ（Typhoid/Paratyphoid）は実際の病原体と異なり誤分類と思われる。対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）における発生事例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria claims life of another school student in Odisha's Rayagada district
article.articleSummary: Malaria has claimed another life in Odisha's Rayagada district. Nine-year-old Jaysen Kandagari, a Class IV student from Badakashipadu village staying in a government ST&SC hostel in Atada, died on July 14 after being treated at MKCG Medical College and Hospital, Berhampur. He was diagnosed with malaria last month and initially treated at Jamadeipentha Community Health Centre; condition worsened, leading to referral to Rayagada District Headquarters Hospital, and later transfer to MKCG MCH on July 7. This death follows another malaria fatality in the district— a 10-year-old Class IV student from a residential school in Kolnara block who died last week after testing positive. Health authorities have stepped up vector control, surveillance, and early detection, with mobile health teams deployed to vulnerable pockets and campaigns to curb mosquito breeding and raise public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州ラヤガダ県で、また一人の学生がマラリアで死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドの風土病地域における散発的なマラリア死亡例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性は限定的で、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアはオディシャ州の一部地域で風土病的に発生しており、今回の事例は地域の保健当局によるベクターコントロールや早期発見の取り組みが既に進行中。国レベル・国際レベルでの緊急対応は現時点で不要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo dịch Ebola tại Congo nghiêm trọng hơn số liệu chính thức
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is more severe than official figures.
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warned that the true Ebola caseload in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) may be 2–4 times higher than official figures, as the outbreak continues in a high-transmission phase. The strain is Bundibugyo, a rare lineage with no vaccine or approved treatment. Officially, the DRC has reported over 1,960 cases and more than 700 deaths since the outbreak was detected about two months earlier (May 15), making it the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country and one of the fastest-growing in history. The epidemic has been identified in five provinces and in Uganda, though more than 90% of infections occur in Ituri province. Many new cases are found after patients die in the community without seeking care. Response capacity is expanding: beds exceed 700, laboratories have improved, and close contact follow-up approaches 80%. Daily confirmed cases have recently topped 80, the highest since the outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ流行、公式統計より深刻と警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(Bundibugyo株)がDRCで急速拡大し、致死率高く複数州及びウガンダへ拡大、ワクチン・治療法未確立でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC国内のイトゥリ州が主要発生地であることを確認。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria claims second Ashram school student
article.articleSummary: Malaria fatalities among Ashram residential schools in Rayagada district: 9-year-old Jayasen Kandagari, a Class IV pupil of SSD Government High School at Atada (Badakasipadu village), died during treatment after fever began July 5. He first received care at Jemadeipentha Community Health Centre, was moved to Rayagada DHH on July 7, then to MKCG Medical College and Hospital in Brahmapur, where he died Tuesday morning. Rayagada CDMO Dr Prashant Mishra said the death has been confirmed and an inquiry has been ordered; Dr Ruma Mahapatra and Dr Mamata Sahu will inspect the school hostel and submit a report, with action to follow under the law. The death follows another malaria fatality a week earlier: Chandu Ula ka, a Class IV student of Suri Upper Primary School in Kolnara block, who died on July 7.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアにより2人目のアシュラム学校生徒が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・オリッサ州の特定地区における学校寮でのマラリア死亡例が続いているが、風土病であり国際的拡大の懸念は低く、地域当局が調査対応中であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 同一地区（ラヤガダ）の複数のアシュラム系寄宿学校で短期間にマラリア死亡例が2件発生。地域保健当局が調査・視察を実施中であり、学校寮の衛生・防蚊対策の不備が疑われる。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至らないが、同種事例の増加有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 2.000 bestätigte Ebola-Fälle in DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,011 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases with 754 deaths, per Kinshasa government data; the true toll is likely higher due to underreporting. The deadly Ebola virus is transmitted through direct contact and contact with contaminated body fluids. The current Bundibugyo-type outbreak is particularly difficult to contain, as there is no licensed vaccine and no specific therapy for this Ebola strain. The report provides no information on imported or exported cases. These figures underscore the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and highlight the lack of targeted medical countermeasures for the Bundibugyo lineage. Time reference: Published 2026-07-15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人以上のエボラ確定症例
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例超・死亡754名の大規模エボラ流行（ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ型）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラで承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないため管理が困難。過小報告の可能性が指摘されており、実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。輸出入例に関する情報は記事になし。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Covid deaths put Odisha's Ganjam on alert
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, Odisha's Ganjam district was placed on alert after fresh Covid-19 deaths were reported in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh. With thousands commuting daily across the border, authorities described the spread risk as precautionary and directed preparedness measures. The chief district medical and public health officer ordered all government hospitals, Berhampur City Hospital, sub-divisional hospitals, CHCs and PHCs to remain ready to tackle any rise in cases. Covid-19 testing is mandatory for all patients with severe acute respiratory infection (SARI); those with influenza-like illness (ILI) should also be tested. Hospitals must keep isolation wards functional, ensure adequate oxygen-supported beds, and maintain stocks of essential medicines, oxygen plants, concentrators and cylinders. Field health workers will monitor unusual fever or respiratory illness spikes and report suspected cases. Berhampur City Hospital has established a 10-bed isolation ward with oxygen support.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデシュ州でのコロナ死亡例を受け、オディシャ州ガンジャム県が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 隣接州でのCOVID-19死亡例を受けた予防的な警戒態勢であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大の兆候は現時点でないが、越境交通による感染拡大リスクはあるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はインド国内（オディシャ州・アンドラ・プラデシュ州）の地方レベルでの予防的対応を報じており、死亡者数や重症度の詳細は不明。COVID-19の季節的な再燃に対する通常の医療体制強化措置と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 影音／新冠高峰又要來了！台估8月下旬單週5萬人次確診│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video/Audio — The COVID-19 peak is coming again! Taiwan estimates 50,000 confirmed cases in a single week in late August | TVBS News Network
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity is rising globally. Taiwan’s CDC projects a peak in late August, with up to 50,000 weekly confirmed cases in Taiwan. In June, Mainland China reported 79,000 new confirmed cases, 130 severe cases, and 1 death; Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, and Singapore are also escalating. Dominant variants are NB.1.8.1, with JN.1 and XFG following, prompting vigilance in Taiwan. In Xiamen, emergency department visits have risen; influenza remains common, but COVID-19 proportion is increasing. Symptoms among flu and COVID patients often include fever above 38°C, body aches, and sore throat, with many lacking cough or rhinorrhea. July positivity exceeded June. The BA.3.2 (Cicada) variant may reduce vaccine effectiveness. Vaccination is advised for the elderly and children, and masking in crowded places remains a key defense.

triage.headline_ja: 動画／新型コロナの流行ピークが再来！台湾は8月下旬に週5万人の感染者を予測 | TVBSニュース
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・中国本土・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールで同時にCOVID-19が再拡大しており、新変異株（NB.1.8.1、BA.3.2等）によるワクチン効果低下懸念や政府機関（台湾CDC）による将来予測発表があり、社会的・行政的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾におけるCOVID-19流行予測だが、中国本土（福建省・アモイ含む）の具体的な感染データ（6月に79,000例、重症130例、死亡1例）が記事内で言及されているためChinaのみverified_locationsに含めた。台湾・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。新変異株BA.3.2（Cicada）によるワクチン効果低下の懸念は今後の続報で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese experts head to Uganda to help with Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Two Chinese public health experts left Beijing early Wednesday for Uganda to assist with Uganda's Ebola outbreak response, responding to invitations from the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO). Selected by China's National Disease Control and Prevention Administration (NDCPA), they will join the Incident Management Support Team coordinating the Ebola response from Kampala. Their duties include outbreak assessment, response planning, and on-site coordination. The move illustrates international collaboration in Ebola containment, with China contributing its expertise to support Uganda under Africa CDC-WHO coordination. The article notes no detailed case counts or outbreak timeline, but confirms ongoing, coordinated international efforts as of 2026-07-15.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家がウガンダのエボラ対応支援のため現地へ出発
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は本質的に重篤で国際的懸念が高く、WHO・Africa CDCとの国際協調対応が行われていることからIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）を2つ満たすと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダで発生中のエボラ出血熱への中国専門家派遣。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。中国は支援国であり感染発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Започна изпитване на потенциално лекарство срещу ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trial of a potential Ebola drug begins in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) prompts a preventive-drug trial. The study tests whether a medication can prevent onset of disease in about 1,000 contacts of confirmed cases who are asymptomatic, with daily monitoring for 21 days. Participants are aged 12 years and older. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo strain. As of July 15, 2026, DR Congo reported more than 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths; the World Health Organization cautions the true outbreak size may be two to four times higher, noting many new cases occur outside known transmission chains, complicating containment. Separately, in Ituri province another study investigates potential therapies, including the monoclonal antibody MBP134 and the antiviral remdesivir.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱に対する候補薬の治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が拡大し、感染者1,960人超・死者700人超、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株のエボラで、既知の感染連鎖外での新規感染が多く封じ込めが困難とWHOが指摘。国際的な治験・支援が行われている状況。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 80% من إصابات "إيبولا" الجديدة في الكونغو مجهولة المصدر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 80% of new Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are of unknown origin
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the World Health Organization reports that 80% of new Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo arise from unknown transmission chains, indicating faster spread than tracing capacity can manage. The Public Health Institute tallies 2,011 confirmed Ebola infections and 754 deaths. A latest update records 54 new cases on Monday across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu. The data reflect ongoing transmission and the challenge of identifying infection sources. The report underscores the need for intensified surveillance and response efforts in affected regions to curb further spread of Ebola. These figures highlight the ongoing challenge of tracing transmission and the need for sustained, targeted interventions in the eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国における新規エボラ感染例の80%が感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染源不明例が80%に達し、複数州にまたがる持続的な感染拡大と高い死亡者数（754人）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: WHOおよび公衆衛生研究所のデータに基づき、感染源追跡能力を上回る速さでの感染拡大が指摘されている。イトゥリ州・北キブ州を含む複数州での継続的な感染拡大は国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態に発展するリスクがあり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 80% Of New Ebola Cases Linked To Unknown Chains Of Transmission
article.articleSummary: 80% of new Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo are linked to unknown transmission chains, WHO said as of 15 July 2026, indicating the outbreak is spreading faster than authorities can trace amid an expanding response. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola form with no approved treatment or vaccine. Confirmed cases have risen to 2,011, with 754 deaths, according to government data. The latest public health institute report notes 54 new cases detected on Monday across Ituri, North Kivu and Haut-Uele provinces. Described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on the continent, the rapid spread challenges containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：新規エボラ症例の80%が不明な感染連鎖に関連
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で確認例2,011人・死亡754人に達し、感染連鎖の80%が追跡不能という異常事態であり、承認された治療法・ワクチンがない稀な型のエボラが複数州に急拡大している。
triage.notes: Ituri、北キブ、オー・ウエレ各州で感染拡大中。承認された治療法・ワクチンがない稀な型のエボラウイルスとされ、大陸最速の拡大速度と報道されている。続報でのIHR緊急委員会招集や渡航制限措置の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 700 morts enregistrés en deux mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 700 deaths recorded in two months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: from May 15 to July 15, 2026, marking the 17th outbreak, it is now spread across five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. As of the latest official tally, 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths have been recorded since the declaration. The response has yielded hundreds of recoveries, including 300 discharged from treatment centers. Government funding has reached over 50 million USD, complemented by additional mobilizations from international partners, enabling the operation and equipping of about ten Ebola treatment centers in Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde, Komanda, and Aru. Ongoing challenges include a health worker strike impacting facility operations, security concerns, and public noncompliance with barrier measures, which threaten containment and transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で2か月間に700人以上の死亡者を記録
triage.triage_reason: 第17次エボラアウトブレイクが5州に拡大し、確定症例1,926人・死亡702人という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、医療従事者のストライキや治安不安、住民の感染対策非遵守など制御困難な状況が続いているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内5州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele）での発生のみが言及されており、ルワンダでの症例確認は記載されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo top 2,000, being the fastest-growing outbreak ever recorded
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-15, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 366 recoveries and 753 in isolation. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo; Ituri is the main hotspot, with new transmission in Haut-Uele indicating geographic spread. The WHO calls this the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, driven largely by infections from unknown chains of transmission; single-day counts have exceeded 80 cases. Many deaths occur in communities without access to care. Despite improved diagnostics and contact tracing, about 80% of new cases are outside existing contact lists. The WHO recommends a dual strategy: intensify response at the epicenter while mapping travel routes to identify high-risk areas. For Bundibugyo virus, no approved treatment exists yet; early supportive care improves survival.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数が2,000人を突破、史上最速の拡大を見せる流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで5州に拡大し、史上最速の増加率と評価されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOが史上最速拡大の流行と認定。感染経路不明の症例が約80%を占め、コンタクトトレーシングの限界が示唆される。承認された治療法が存在しないBundibugyoウイルス株である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosna bolezen se širi: "Epidemija bi lahko bila štirikrat večja, kot mislimo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly disease is spreading: "The epidemic could be four times larger than we think".
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of a deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with officials suggesting the epidemic may be two to four times larger than current official estimates. As of today, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is neither a proven treatment nor an effective vaccine. The disease has spread this week to two additional provinces. WHO Emergency Programme Chief Chikwe Ihekweazu notes daily improvements in detection capacity, but field teams face severe funding shortfalls; WHO has received less than half of the $115 million requested to combat this strain. To date, about 40% has been raised. The international community is urged not to abandon the response and to sustain detection, isolation, and prevention efforts to protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性の病気が拡大：「流行は私たちが考えているより4倍大きい可能性がある」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が拡大し、感染者1,926人・死者702人、治療薬・ワクチンなしで新たな州にも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが資金不足を訴えており、国際支援の必要性が高い。治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョ株であることが特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية الأسرع انتشارا على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-spreading on record.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, as the fastest-spreading on record. As of July 11, around 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been recorded across five provinces, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. Bunia in Ituri Province remains the epicenter. The outbreak has shown its fastest monthly growth since it began, including days with more than 80 confirmed cases in 24 hours. Despite improvements in diagnostics and contact tracing, about 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, signaling transmission from unknown chains. The DRC declared the 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, and the WHO has issued an international health alert.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは史上最速の拡大速度
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最速拡大・史上3番目の規模と報告し、5州で約2000症例・700人超死亡、国際保健警報も発出されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 80%の新規症例が既知の感染経路と結びつかず、未知の感染連鎖が示唆されている点は流行制御上の重大懸念。WHOにより国際保健警報が発出済み。

article.articleHeadline: 廣西洪水剛退又被淹 民眾憂災後恐有大瘟疫（視頻） | 廣西洪災 | 廣西貴港 | 洪水一直未退
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangxi floods have just subsided but are flooding again; residents fear a major plague after the disaster (video) | Guangxi flood disaster | Guigang, Guangxi | Floodwaters have not yet receded.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, floods in Guangxi's Guigang City have subsided but heavy rains have re-emerged, triggering renewed flooding. The Guangxi Meteorological Observatory issued a Level 3 heavy rain warning after 39 towns recorded more than 50 mm in the past 12 hours, with 26 towns at 100–250 mm; most of Guigang is forecast to face continued heavy to torrential rain with isolated thunderstorm winds over the next 24 hours. Hengzhou, the hardest-hit area, has seen some towns flooded for up to 10 days; floodwater has receded in some places but streets remain clogged with mud, debris, and widespread animal carcasses, including rotting pigs from a pig farm. Clean-up labor is scarce and costly, with workers paid about 2,000 yuan per day. Residents fear that post-disaster conditions could unleash a major plague, given the death toll and sanitation challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 広西の洪水がようやく引いたと思ったら再び冠水、住民は災害後の大瘟疫を懸念（動画）｜広西洪水災害｜広西貴港｜洪水はいまだ引かず
triage.triage_reason: 記事は洪水災害と衛生状態悪化への住民の一般的な懸念を報じているのみで、ペストを含む具体的な感染症の発生・症例は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 見出しの『大瘟疫』は具体的な病原体特定のない住民の懸念表現であり、Plagueタグは実際のペスト症例発生を意味しない。洪水後の衛生状態悪化（動物死骸放置等）という環境リスクの記事であり、感染症発生の確定情報はない。続報で実際の感染症症例報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kanyemba Clinic upgrade boosts outbreak readiness
article.articleSummary: Zimbabwe upgrades Chapoto Clinic in Kanyemba, Mashonaland Central, into a rural hospital to improve local healthcare access and bolster cross-border outbreak readiness, including Ebola, in a border district near Zambia and Mozambique that handles travellers from across the sub-region. Chapoto Clinic, together with Mvurwi Hospital, has been designated as Ebola isolation and treatment centers; activating them would suspend normal services to manage cases. Preparedness measures include infection prevention and control training for health workers, stockpiled medicines and PPE, and a UNDP-funded on-site pharmacy. Gaps persist: unreliable water supply, inadequate accommodation and office space, ambulance shortages for referrals to Chitsungo, and a need for at least four non-contact thermal screening cameras (about US$4,000 each). A borehole site is identified, and border surveillance has been strengthened with environmental health officers and expanded community monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: カニェンバ診療所のアップグレードでアウトブレイク対応力強化
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ症例発生の報告はなく、ジンバブエ国境地域における医療施設整備・準備態勢強化に関する記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はジンバブエ・マショナランド中央州のカニェンバにおけるエボラ対応準備（診療所改修、隔離治療センター指定、国境監視強化）に関する内容であり、実際の症例発生報告はない。ザンビア・モザンビークは国境を接する近隣国として言及されているのみで、これらの国での症例発生は記載されていないため、対象国リストとの一致はあるが実際のイベント発生国としては確認できず、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Health Dept says science informs SA's preparation for possible Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Science, not fear, guides South Africa's preparations for a possible Ebola outbreak, says the Department of Health. As of 2026-07-15, there are no confirmed Ebola cases in South Africa. The virus has been reported mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, prompting regional authorities to review preparedness for any imported cases. South Africa is focusing on readiness, surveillance and rapid response to prevent local transmission should the disease arrive. Ebola is a highly infectious viral illness that can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in some cases, bleeding. With no cases detected domestically, officials aim to stay ahead by science-based measures and heightened vigilance for suspected cases and potential importation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、南アフリカのエボラ発生の可能性への備えは科学的根拠に基づくと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラはIHR基準で重篤な公衆衛生イベントであり、DRC・ウガンダでの発生を受けて南アフリカが越境拡大を懸念し予防的対応を取っていることから、国際的拡大リスク及び重大性の観点で2つ以上の基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南アフリカの準備状況であり、南アフリカ国内での確定症例は報告されていない。実際の発生国はDRCとウガンダだが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるためUgandaとSouth Africaはverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Mehr als 2000 bestätigte Fälle in DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 2,000 confirmed cases in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, Ebola outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths reported by Kinshasa’s health authorities. A Monday update adds 54 cases in Ituri, North Kivu, and Haut-Uele, signaling ongoing transmission across eastern provinces. Officials caution the official tally may underestimate the true burden due to drastic quarantine measures for infected individuals. Tropical medicine specialist Martin Grobusch says the outbreak could continue into the coming year. The figures are laboratory-confirmed and originate from the government’s Kinshasa data, reflecting continued regional spread rather than a contained event.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で確認例2000人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確認症例が2000例を超え、死亡者754人に達しており、複数州にまたがる継続的な伝播が確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサ、イトゥリ、北キブ、オートウエレ州にわたる継続的な感染拡大を報告。当局は検疫措置により実際の症例数は過小評価されている可能性を指摘。専門家は来年まで流行が続く可能性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO cảnh báo 80% ca bệnh không rõ nguồn lây
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO warns that 80% of cases have no known source of infection.
article.articleSummary: 80% of new Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo have no known infection source as of July 13, 2026, signaling rapid spread. The Bundibugyo-strain outbreak began in May; at least 1,926 cases and 702 deaths have been reported, with Uganda confirming related cases. Despite expanded treatment and testing capacity, response lags behind transmission, hindered by funding shortages, conflict in eastern DR Congo, attacks on health facilities, and erosion of public trust. On July 13, healthcare workers at an Ebola treatment center staged a brief salary-related strike, returning if paid within 72 hours. WHO cautions that true cases may be higher than official counts. CDC confirmed a U.S. citizen working in Congo infected. The U.S. announced a temporary ban on Congo-based Americans flying home on commercial flights; re-entry requires 21-day quarantine in a third country; about 24 Americans affected. State Department will assist.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:WHOが新規症例の80%で感染源不明と警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が急速に拡大し、死亡者702人・症例1926人に達し、ウガンダや米国にも波及、渡航制限も発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国やウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当するため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例茲卡境外移入！男泰國返台後發燒出疹　醫：8成患者恐無症狀 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first imported Zika case! A man who returned to Taiwan from Thailand developed fever and rash; doctors say 80% of patients may be asymptomatic.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus infection this year. A northern man in his 30s returned from Thailand in mid-June, developing fever, dizziness, and rash; laboratory testing confirmed Zika infection. He recovered with outpatient care; no hospitalization was required, and contacts were asymptomatic after rapid tracing and vector-control measures. Zika is mainly transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; most adult infections are mild, though about 80% may be asymptomatic, and maternal infection can cause fetal microcephaly and other abnormalities. Pregnant women should avoid travel to outbreak areas and use protective measures (government-approved repellents, screens, air conditioning, long sleeves). The virus may also spread sexually; after return, men should use condoms or abstain for 3 months and women for 2 months. Blood donation should be deferred for 1 month. Since 2016, Taiwan has 31 imported cases; most from Southeast Asia (Thailand 8, Vietnam 6, Philippines/Myanmar/Malaysia 3 each). Globally, 97 countries affected; Americas >11,000 cases by 6/30; Thailand 76 cases by week 28.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の輸入ジカ熱症例！タイから帰国した男性が発熱・発疹　医師：8割の患者は無症状の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: タイ滞在後の輸入ジカ熱の単発例で軽症・接触者無症状と管理良好だが、タイ国内での継続的な発生（第28週時点で76例）があるため、地域の流行状況として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾における輸入症例だが、感染源国はタイであり、タイ国内で第28週時点76例の発生が報告されている。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナム・フィリピン・ミャンマー・マレーシアは2016年以降の累積輸入症例数の言及のみで、現在の発生地域としての言及ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО започва първо клинично изпитване на ново лекарство срещу ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO begins the first clinical trial of a new drug against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, the World Health Organization launched the first clinical trial of an antiviral, obeldesivir, in individuals exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The study aims to determine if the drug can prevent disease progression among contacts who are asymptomatic. Nearly 1,000 volunteers aged 12 and older will be enrolled and monitored daily for 21 days. There are no approved vaccines or specific therapies for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC. WHO data indicate the outbreak has infected over 1,960 people and caused more than 700 deaths, with actual numbers likely higher due to incomplete contact tracing. Concurrently, a second trial in Ituri province is evaluating MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir. Bundibugyo virus, first identified in 2007 in Uganda, transmits via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or tissues and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱に対する新薬の初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo型エボラが1,960人感染・700人超死亡という深刻な流行を継続しており、WHOが新薬治験を開始するなど国際的な対応が進行中であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC（イトゥリ州含む）でのBundibugyoエボラアウトブレイク。Ugandaは病原体の初発見地として言及されているのみで、現在の流行地ではないため verified_locations から除外。既に1,960人感染・700人死亡という大規模流行であり、続報でのフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例茲卡境外移入！男泰國返台後發燒出疹　醫：8成患者恐無症狀
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first imported Zika case! A man who returned to Taiwan from Thailand developed fever and rash; doctors say 80% of patients may be asymptomatic.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika case in 2026. A man in his 30s in northern Taiwan returned from Thailand in June and developed fever, dizziness, and a rash; lab confirmation followed. He did not require hospitalization; contacts were asymptomatic. Authorities conducted vector control and tracing. Zika is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and can be sexually transmitted; infections in adults are usually mild, but pregnancy risk includes fetal microcephaly. Pregnant women or those planning pregnancy should avoid travel to outbreak areas and use preventive measures such as repellent, screens, and protective clothing. Sexual transmission risk: male partners within 3 months and female within 2 months after return should use condoms or abstain; blood donation should be delayed 1 month. Taiwan’s 2026 tally: 1 imported case; total 31 since 2016, all imported. Globally, 97 countries affected since 2016; Americas >11,000 cases. Clinicians should obtain travel histories and report suspected cases; 1922 hotline available.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の輸入性ジカ熱！タイから帰国した男性が発熱・発疹、医師「8割の患者は無症状の恐れ」
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入症例であり、重症化なし・二次感染なし・国内伝播の証拠もないため、通常のサーベイランス事案としてシグナル化には至らない。
triage.notes: 本症例は台湾在住男性がタイ滞在中に感染したとみられる輸入例。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源とされるタイのみを記載した。局所伝播や重症例の報告はなく、通常の輸入症例監視の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa: Health Department Ramps Up Ebola Readiness - South African News Briefs - July 15, 2026
article.articleSummary: South Africa's Department of Health is ramping up Ebola readiness based on scientific risk assessments, with no confirmed cases currently. The government has designated 36 hospitals to manage suspected infections and has strengthened surveillance and rapid-response systems to detect and contain any introductions. Health Minister Aaron Motsoaledi said Ebola spreads only through direct contact with infected bodily fluids, not through the air. The initiative reflects risk posed by Ebola outbreaks reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, underscoring cross-border vigilance. The plan focuses on early detection, rapid mobilization, and clear escalation procedures at designated facilities to prevent local transmission should imported cases occur.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ:保健省がエボラ出血熱への備えを強化 - 南アフリカニュース速報 - 2026年7月15日
triage.triage_reason: 南アフリカでの確定症例はなく、記事は同国の準備態勢強化に関する内容であり、DRC・ウガンダでの既知のアウトブレイクへの越境リスク対応が主題のため、新規シグナルというより経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南アフリカ（対象国外）の準備態勢強化であり、DRC・ウガンダのアウトブレイクは背景情報として言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの現在の症例状況等、詳細情報は本記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Why stomach infections and waterborne diseases rise during the monsoon - India TV News
article.articleSummary: Monsoon in India elevates stomach infections and waterborne illnesses due to waterlogging, sewage contamination, and warm, humid conditions that accelerate bacterial/viral growth. Acute gastroenteritis is commonly reported, causing diarrhea, vomiting, stomach cramps, and dehydration; typhoid (fever, fatigue, abdominal pain, reduced appetite); cholera (possible severe dehydration with watery diarrhea, if untreated); and hepatitis A (fever, vomiting, fatigue, stomach ache, jaundice). Dr. Tushar Goyal of Kailash Hospital, Greater Noida, notes consumption of contaminated water, street foods, or inadequately stored leftovers heightens risk. Warn signs include persistent diarrhea/vomiting, fever, abdominal pain, blood in stool, dehydration. Preventive measures: drink boiled or purified water; eat freshly prepared foods; avoid uncovered street foods and raw salads; wash hands with soap; clean fruits/vegetables; proper storage and refrigeration of leftovers. High-risk groups—infants, elderly, pregnant women, and those with diabetes or low immunity—need extra precautions.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期に胃腸感染症や水系感染症が増加する理由
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、モンスーン季節性疾患に関する一般的な健康啓発・予防情報。具体的な症例数や地域的発生状況の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число жертв Эболы достигло 754 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola death toll reached 754.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of July 15, 2026, according to KP.RU citing Reuters. The outbreak has affected five eastern regions, with the true case load likely higher due to weak sanitation infrastructure. The flare‑up began in May 2026 and has also affected Uganda. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on June 15, 2026. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission and notes that official counts probably underestimate the burden in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラによる死者数が754人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（2,011症例・754死亡）がDRC東部5地域とウガンダに拡大し、WHOがPHEICを宣言していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、既にフルRRA相当の重大シグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Covid Deaths Trigger Southern Alert
article.articleSummary: Two Covid-19 deaths and eight active cases in Andhra Pradesh on 15 July 2026 prompt heightened surveillance as Odisha and Tamil Nadu tighten monitoring. The first death, a 52-year-old man admitted to Tirupati’s Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences, died June 28; he also had Klebsiella pneumoniae infection, diabetes and chronic kidney disease. A second death, a 46-year-old man at Kadapa’s Government General Hospital on July 7, involved bilateral lung damage and pneumonia. Hospitals were instructed to keep isolation wards and ICU beds ready. Odisha has heightened Rath Yatra-area vigilance; border districts named. Authorities report no evidence of a more aggressive variant; Omicron descendants are circulating, with XFG and BA.3.2 monitored. Global cases ~45,000 in the past three months; test positivity 1.2%. Messaging stresses vaccination and prior infection yielding immune memory. Cumulative Andhra Pradesh Covid counts: 2,575 (990 in 2024, 1,250 in 2025, 335 in 2026).

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州のコロナ死亡、南部諸州に警戒を促す
triage.triage_reason: 既知のオミクロン系統による散発的死亡例で、基礎疾患を有する高齢患者が中心。当局は新規の強毒性変異株の証拠なしと明言しており、通常の季節的サーベイランスの範疇と判断される。
triage.notes: 死亡例は基礎疾患（糖尿病、慢性腎疾患、肺炎合併など）を有する患者であり、COVID-19単独による重症化とは言い難い。既存のOmicron系統（XFG、BA.3.2）の監視は継続中だが、新規変異株の証拠はないとされている。地方当局によるルーチンの病床確保・監視強化措置であり、国際的関心や渡航制限には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Liberia: NPHIL Strengthens Ebola Surveillance At Liberia's Border Crossings
article.articleSummary: Liberia bolstered Ebola surveillance at land borders, airports, and seaports as the Bundibugyo strain sparks a cross-border outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 15 July 2026, Liberia has reported no suspected or confirmed Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared a public health emergency in May. NPHIL conducted a nationwide assessment across 15 counties to appraise entry points, labs, and isolation facilities; surveillance cadres include 98 DSOs, 17 CSOs, and 22 ZSOs. Of 987 travelers screened—mostly returning from the Hajj in Saudi Arabia—966 completed 21 days of monitoring, with 21 under active follow-up and none symptomatic. The global outbreak totals 1,481 cases (1,460 DRC, 20 Uganda, 1 France), 454 deaths, and 229 recoveries (213 DRC, 16 Uganda). Liberia cites cross-border cooperation and World Bank support; a US$4.2 million Ebola preparedness budget is proposed.

triage.headline_ja: リベリア：NPHILがリベリア国境検問所でのエボラ出血熱サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダ・フランスに拡大しているブンディブギョ株エボラのクロスボーダーアウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生緊急事態として既に宣言済みでIHR基準・WPRO基準の多くに該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生し国境を越えて拡大しているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへのリベリアの対応。ウガンダ・フランス・サウジアラビアは症例発生地として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが感染源かつ主要発生国として対象国リストに該当。

article.articleHeadline: 影音／新冠高峰又要來了！台估8月下旬單週5萬人次確診 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: The COVID-19 peak is coming again! Taiwan estimates 50,000 confirmed cases in a single week in late August.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan projects a COVID-19 peak in late August, with weekly confirmed cases potentially up to 50,000 as five consecutive weeks of increases continue and last week’s ED visits rose 35%. Mainland China recorded 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June, including 130 severe cases and 1 death. Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore are also experiencing rising COVID activity. Globally, NB.1.8.1 remains dominant, followed by JN.1 and XFG, warranting vigilance in Taiwan. In Xiamen, a major hospital reports rising COVID share among outpatients, though influenza remains most common; most patients with COVID-like illness have fever above 38°C, body aches, and sore throat, with fewer coughs or runny noses. July positivity rate exceeded June. The BA.3.2 variant (“Cicada”) may exhibit weaker vaccine protection. Summer waves appear steeper than winter since 2023. Vaccination is advised for elderly and children; masking in crowded settings remains prudent.

triage.headline_ja: 動画／新型コロナ流行のピークが再来！台湾は8月下旬に週5万人の感染確認と予測
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19増加であり深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や異常性は認められないが、中国本土・香港等での感染増加と変異株動向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾・日本・韓国・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国本土（福建省アモイ含む）および香港は中国として集約。季節性の感染拡大であり重症度・異常性は低いが、新変異株BA.3.2の免疫回避性については情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Hog deaths in Negros Occidental 'under control' amid ASF outbreak
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in Negros Occidental remains under control as of July 13, 2026, with 14 localities affected and nine confirming ASF-positive cases. A total of 2,185 pigs have died across the 14 localities due to various swine diseases, representing 3.53% of the 61,854-strong hog population. Gov. Eugenio Jose Lacson said on July 14 that despite the deaths, the mortality is low and the situation is manageable, but warned against complacency. He attributed the containment to ongoing protocols and border controls designed to prevent ASF spread and urged continued vigilance. The report emphasizes the outbreak status as still under control, underscoring the need to maintain surveillance, biosecurity, and adherence to containment measures to avert a broader impact in Negros Occidental.

triage.headline_ja: ネグロス・オクシデンタル州で豚の死亡、ASF流行下でも「制御下」
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は人に感染しない動物疾病であり、記事では死亡率が低く状況は制御下にあると明記されているため、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病であり人への感染はないため、IHR基準上の公衆衛生への直接影響は限定的。地域当局は状況を制御下と評価し、外部支援の必要性も示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Το μέγεθος της επιδημίας στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό μπορεί να είναι τετραπλάσιο από τον επίσημο απολογισμό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The scale of the epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be four times the official tally.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, WHO cautions the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times larger than official counts. Official data show more than 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths since the outbreak began two months ago, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, declared May 15 after fatalities in Ituri province in the northeast. Cases have been detected in five DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda, though more than 90% are in Ituri. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Health capacity has expanded to over 700 treatment beds; laboratory capacity has grown; contact tracing approaches 80%. Many new cases involve people who died in the community before seeking care. In recent days, over 80 new infections were confirmed in a single day, indicating improving detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国における流行規模は公式発表の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（第17次流行）はウガンダへの越境拡大、治療薬・ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による高致死率、公式集計の過小評価の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダへの症例拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOによる過小評価の指摘は流行規模の不確実性を示し、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बुखार, सांस लेने में दिक्कत... देश में फिर दस्तक दे रहा कोरोना, जानें UP समेत कहां-कहां मिले नए केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever, breathing difficulties... COVID-19 is making a comeback in the country; find out where new cases have been detected, including Uttar Pradesh.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurges in India with new cases detected in Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and eight in Andhra Pradesh. In Uttar Pradesh’s Varanasi, a 27-year-old man with breathing difficulties tested positive at BHU's Sir Sundarlal Hospital Chest and TB department and is admitted. Andhra Pradesh reports eight active cases; in recent weeks, two COVID-19 deaths have occurred, including a 46-year-old man from Masapeta in Kadapa district. Samples from Andhra Pradesh patients have been sent for genome sequencing to identify circulating variants. In Maharashtra, a new case is reported in Mumbai. Additionally, singer Kumar Sanu’s son, Jay Kumar Sanu, has tested positive and is receiving treatment. Health department has been alerted in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱、呼吸困難...国内で再び現れるコロナ、UPを含めどこで新規感染者が見つかったか
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な新規症例と死亡例がインド複数州で報告されているが、大規模流行や異常な変異株の証拠は現時点で不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患（COVID-19）の季節的・散発的な再流行と考えられる。ゲノム解析結果など続報が待たれる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo 80% ca bệnh Ebola không rõ nguồn lây
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that 80% of Ebola cases have unknown sources of infection.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that 80% of new Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo have unknown sources, indicating transmission outpacing contact tracing. The Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak began in May; by July 13, Congo had at least 1,926 cases and 702 deaths, with Uganda confirming related cases. Many fatalities occurred in the community before detection or treatment, increasing transmission risk. Although treatment and diagnostic capacity have expanded, the response lags behind the outbreak’s spread, hindered by funding gaps, ongoing conflict in eastern DRC, attacks on health facilities, and erosion of public trust. On July 13, staff at an Ebola treatment center went on strike over delayed salaries, returning within 72 hours if paid. Transmission is said to have occurred weeks before the official May 15 detection. The CDC confirmed a U.S. citizen working in Congo contracted Ebola. Separately, the U.S. announced temporary flight restrictions for Americans in DRC, requiring a 21-day stay in a third country before return, affecting about 24 people.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：エボラ新規症例の80%で感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で感染源不明の症例が80%に達し、患者数1,926人・死者702人、ウガンダへの拡大や米国籍者の感染も確認されるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国はCDCが自国籍感染者を確認し渡航制限を発表しているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウガンダも同様に対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: SUA blochează întoarcerea cetățenilor veniți din Congo din cauza epidemiei de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States blocks the repatriation of citizens who arrived from Congo due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United States blocks repatriation of citizens who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an Ebola outbreak. Under Title 49 transportation regulations, those affected are placed on a do-not-board list until the 21-day period outside the DRC expires. The measure follows a worsening outbreak in the DRC, with counts of 1,926 cases and 702 deaths nationwide. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and bleeding. About 24 U.S. citizens were set to board flights home; the State Department will assist during the waiting period. The CDC reported a U.S. humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola; another American infected in Congo was hospitalized in Frankfurt, Germany after transfer from Congo, involving Dr. Peter Stafford identified by the Serge Christian missionary organization. Health Secretary Kennedy Jr. cited rising risks near Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行によりコンゴから来た自国民の帰国を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、米国人感染者の発生・国際搬送・渡航制限措置まで生じているため、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行が主題であり、米国・ドイツは感染者の搬送先・渡航規制の対象国であって発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kendalikan Populasi Kucing Liar dan Cegah Rabies, DKPP Kota Bandung Gelar Aksi Jemput Bola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Control the Stray Cat Population and Prevent Rabies, Bandung City DKPP Holds a Doorstep Outreach Campaign.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Bandung City’s Department of Food Security and Animal Husbandry (DKPP) launched the Bangsawan campaign to curb rabies through free rabies vaccination and population-control measures. The effort, centered at RW 02 Taman Ciko Arena in Maleer, Batununggal, seeks at least 70% vaccination coverage of the city’s rabies-susceptible animals, in partnership with local kelurahan and kecamatan offices. The program includes Kopi Cinta (Controlled Population of Stray Cats Identified), a sterilization drive to slow cat birth rates alongside veterinary screening before vaccination to ensure animals are at least four months old. DKPP emphasizes post-vaccination care and urges owners to obtain annual boosters every 12 months to maintain herd immunity. The initiative aims to reduce human exposure to rabies by mitigating transmission from animals to people, with vaccination provided free of charge and community education on responsible pet care.

triage.headline_ja: 野良猫の個体数管理と狂犬病予防のため、バンドン市DKPPが戸別訪問キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病予防のためのルーチン的な動物ワクチン接種・啓発キャンペーンの実施報告であり、実際の感染事例や異常発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の予防的公衆衛生活動（ワクチン接種・不妊手術・啓発）についてであり、具体的な症例報告や発生増加を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola de más rápido crecimiento ya suma casi 2 mil casos y 702 muertes en Congo, mientras una huelga, la violencia y la falta de vacuna hacen más difícil detenerlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fastest-growing Ebola outbreak now totals nearly 2,000 cases and 702 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as a strike, violence and the lack of a vaccine make it harder to stop.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo totals 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of July 15, 2026. The fastest-growing outbreak on record is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The virus circulated for weeks before identification, creating multiple transmission chains; roughly 80% of new cases arise from unknown chains, hampering rapid isolation and contact tracing. The WHO declared the Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. Most transmission occurs in Ituri province, with cases also in other eastern provinces and neighboring Uganda; suspected cases in Tshopo and presence in Goma indicate cross-border risk. A strike by unpaid staff at a treatment center in Rwampara, Ituri, threatens care, surveillance and safe burials. The WHO launched the PARTNERS trial to evaluate remdesivir and MBP134 with standard supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で最速拡大のエボラ出血熱、症例数約2000人・死者702人に。ストライキ・暴力・ワクチン不足が封じ込めを困難に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、承認ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による過去最速の流行拡大、死亡者数も多く越境リスクもあるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを2026年5月17日に宣言済み。ウガンダ・ルワンダへの越境リスクも報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: El Ébola se propaga más rápido en el Congo de lo que puede ser rastreado, dejando ya más de 700 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading faster in the Congo than can be traced, leaving more than 700 dead.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing a rapidly spreading Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. In Ituri's Bunia and neighboring provinces, at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths have been reported across three provinces, with additional confirmed cases in Uganda. The World Health Organization notes that 80% of new cases arise from transmission chains not linked to known contacts, signaling spread beyond tracing capacity. The outbreak involves a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. While treatment capacity in Bunia now approaches 800 beds and laboratories increased from 1 to 14, response efforts are hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health facilities, ongoing conflict, and community distrust. Health workers at a treatment center briefly went on strike over pay on July 13, 2026, resuming after wage payments were pledged within 72 hours. A U.S. citizen aid worker tested positive on July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが追跡不能なほど急速に拡大、死者700人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで承認された治療薬・ワクチンのないブンディブギョ型エボラが急拡大し、死者700人超・感染者1900人超、ウガンダへの越境例や米国籍者の感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。米国籍者の感染は渡航関連事例であり、米国自体は発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinilai Cukup Tinggi, Dinkes Catat Temuan 186 Kasus Baru HIV di Kota Malang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deemed Quite High, Health Office Records 186 New HIV Cases in Malang City.
article.articleSummary: Malang City Health Office reports 186 new HIV/AIDS cases from January through May 2026, updating an earlier 97 through March. Of these, 100 cases involve men who have sex with men (MSM), identified as the largest group. To accelerate detection, the city provides 16 HIV testing services across health centers (puskesmas) and hospitals, offering testing, care, treatment, and support for People Living with HIV (PLHIV/ODHIV). HIV requires lifelong treatment to keep viral load suppressed, unlike tuberculosis which is cured in about six months. The health office promotes voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) and self-assessment; services are available at all 16 puskesmas. ODHIV support is reinforced to ensure regular therapy. Malang's case findings remain lower than Surabaya's.

triage.headline_ja: かなり高いと判断、マラン市保健局がHIV新規症例186件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるHIVの通常の症例報告であり、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、日常的な公衆衛生モニタリングの範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地方保健局による定例的なHIV/AIDS症例報告であり、MSM層での感染が主体。地域保健当局は既存の検査・治療体制で対応可能と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: பாசன வாய்க்கால் கரையில் குவியும் குப்பைகள்... தஞ்சாவூர் அருகே தொற்றுநோய் அபாயம்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Garbage piling up along the irrigation canal bank... Infectious disease danger near Thanjavur!
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, in Thanjavur district along the Muthalai-Muthuvar Irrigation Canal bank, illegal dumping of plastics, household waste, broken glass bottles and cow dung has surged, with waste often burned, releasing smoke and air pollution. The canal serves thousands of acres across Ramanathapuram, Pillaiyanatham, Kalimedu and Chakrasamanthan villages, providing irrigation water for rice, sugarcane and banana crops. Burning waste and stagnant litter raise concerns about air and water pollution, soil fertility decline, and potential health hazards for nearby residents, including dengue, malaria and chikungunya due to increased mosquito breeding. Farmers and residents demand immediate cleanup, strict enforcement with fines, monitoring cameras, warning boards, and awareness campaigns. Authorities at district and panchayat levels are urged to act promptly to protect agriculture, environment, and public health.

triage.headline_ja: 灌漑用水路の土手にゴミが山積み…タンジャヴール近郊で感染症の危険！
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、ゴミ投棄による衛生環境悪化とそれに伴う蚊媒介感染症リスクへの懸念を報じた記事であり、具体的な症例報告や公衆衛生上の実害は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症発生の報告ではなく、ゴミの不法投棄による蚊の繁殖環境悪化とデング熱・マラリア・チクングニア熱のリスク増大への懸念を伝える環境衛生に関する記事。具体的な症例数や発生状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: الإصابات المؤكدة بإيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز الألفين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo exceed two thousand.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths. The Public Health Institute in Congo says 54 new infections were detected two days earlier across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu, indicating ongoing transmission. The outbreak has now surpassed 2,000 cases, underscoring the sustained burden in the eastern region. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or whether any cases are imported or exported. Ongoing data collection continues to track the trajectory of Ebola in the affected provinces, notably Ituri and North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ確定症例数が2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ確定症例2,011人、死亡754人と大規模で、複数州にわたる継続的な感染拡大がみられ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%と高く、複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ）にわたる継続的な伝播が報告されている。輸入・輸出症例や感染源、検査方法の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 2000 إصابة بفايروس إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,000 Ebola virus infections in the Congo
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 754 deaths were reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Congo Public Health Institute, in its latest report, records 54 new infections on July 13, 2026, across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu. The outbreak remains ongoing; the article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. A third province is unnamed in the report. The data indicate persistent transmission within the country as of 13 July 2026, underscoring the continued public health risk to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルス感染2,000例
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおいてエボラ出血熱の確定症例2,011例・死者754例が報告され、複数州にまたがり新規感染が継続していることから、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威および国際的拡大リスクがあると判断される。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37%（754/2011）と高く、複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、未特定の第三州）にまたがる継続的な感染拡大が確認されている。詳細な検査方法や感染源については記事に記載がなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ایبولا وائرس امریکہ نے کانگو میں موجود امریکیوں کی وطن واپسی پر پابندی لگادی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: The United States has imposed a ban on the repatriation of Americans in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the United States imposed a temporary ban on immediate repatriation flights for Americans in the Congo amid an expanding Ebola outbreak. Under Title 49 of the U.S. Code, Americans in Congo or who recently left Congo cannot board U.S.-bound flights immediately and must spend at least 21 days in a third country before returning to the United States. The outbreak has escalated to 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases with 702 deaths in the Congo. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. Health officials report one American in Congo is infected, while several other infected individuals have been evacuated to Germany for treatment. The State Department will assist affected nationals, and authorities continue to monitor the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス:米国がコンゴにいる米国人の帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ流行が拡大し(1,926症例・702死亡)、米国が渡航制限措置を講じるなど国際的対応が発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の退避・治療先として言及されているのみで、発生国はコンゴ(DRC)のみ。致死率が高く(約36%)、国際的な渡航制限措置も既に発動されている重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, Typhoid, or Leptospirosis? Doctors Warn These Diseases Can Look Alarmingly Similar
article.articleSummary: Dengue, leptospirosis, and typhoid can begin with indistinguishable symptoms during the monsoon season, complicating early diagnosis. Overlapping presentations include fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, nausea, and appetite loss, making reliance on symptoms alone insufficient. Mumbai-based Dr. Niranjan Patil of Metropolis Healthcare Limited warns that delays in correct diagnosis and treatment can occur without timely testing. Timely diagnostic testing is essential because each disease has a different cause and requires a different treatment approach. While the diseases share symptoms, their infectious agents and management differ, underscoring the need for laboratory confirmation to guide therapy and avoid mismanagement. The report does not provide case counts or outbreak figures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、腸チフス、レプトスピラ症?医師らが警告、これらの疾患は驚くほど似た症状を示す
triage.triage_reason: 季節性疾患の鑑別診断に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイク情報がないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はモンスーン期における3疾患の症状類似性と鑑別診断の重要性を説く医療啓発記事であり、具体的な発生状況・症例数の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية أكبر ممّا هو معلن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is larger than what has been announced.
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be up to four times larger than official tallies. Official figures show over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths since the outbreak began about two months ago. Chikwe Ihekweazu, executive director of WHO’s Health Emergencies Programme, told reporters in Geneva that WHO models indicate the true outbreak size is at least 2–4 times the detected cases. If confirmed, this would make it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は発表よりも大規模
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式集計の2〜4倍規模である可能性を指摘しており、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模流行として国際的関心・拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にジュネーブ・スイスが含まれるが、これはWHO記者会見の開催地であり、実際の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。既存の集計（1,960感染、700死亡）から見て、既に大規模流行であり続報要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford'da Bundibugyo Ebola aşısı insanlarda test ediliyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine is being tested in humans in Oxford.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine is being tested in humans in Oxford amid ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Oxford University’s Vaccine Group launched the first-in-human trial of the Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine, enrolling 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. The study will assess safety and the immune response, with subsequent steps including administration in Uganda after regulatory approvals. Uganda plans additional clinical work in collaboration with the Uganda Virus Research Institute and the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine Uganda Research Unit. CEPI calls the development a critical step for outbreak preparedness and protecting vulnerable communities; Africa CDC welcomes the acceleration of research under high safety and regulatory oversight. As of 11 July, DRC reported 1,926 cases and 702 deaths across five provinces; as of 12 July, Uganda confirmed 20 cases, including 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォードでブンディブギョ・エボラワクチンがヒトで試験中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702死亡、ウガンダでも20症例・2死亡と継続中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが背景にあり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はオックスフォードでのワクチン臨床試験に関する内容だが、DRCおよびウガンダで進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行の状況（症例数・死亡数）が明記されているため、DRCの流行状況を主眼にトリアージした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例茲卡境外移入！男泰國返台後發燒出疹　醫：8成患者恐無症狀 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first imported Zika case! A man who returned to Taiwan from Thailand developed fever and rash; doctors say 80% of patients may be asymptomatic.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus infection of the year: a man in his 30s in northern Taiwan who returned from Thailand in mid-June developed fever, dizziness, and rash; laboratory tests confirmed Zika virus infection. Most adult infections are mild; about 80% are asymptomatic, though maternal infection can cause fetal microcephaly and congenital abnormalities. The patient recovered after treatment; contacts showed no symptoms, and authorities completed vector control and contact tracing. No local transmission has occurred. Zika spreads via Aedes mosquitoes and can be sexually transmitted; travelers should report symptoms at entry and use safe sex practices—men for 3 months and women for 2 months after return—and avoid blood donation for 1 month. Taiwan’s cumulative imported Zika cases since 2016 total 31, with Thailand the source for 8 cases, Vietnam 6, and the Philippines, Myanmar, Malaysia 3 each. Globally, 97 countries affected since 2016; Americas >11,000 cases by June; Thailand reports 76 cases through week 28.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の輸入性ジカ熱症例！タイから帰国した男性が発熱・発疹　医師：8割の患者は無症状の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入例であり、症状は軽快、接触者に異常なし、現地感染の発生もなく、ベクター対策・接触者追跡も完了している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国リスト外）における輸入例が主題であり、タイは感染源国として言及されているのみで、本記事の主眼はタイ国内での新規発生事案ではない。タイの週28時点の76例という数値は背景情報として提示されているに過ぎず、記事の中心的トピックではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉確診破2千宗　華派專家赴烏干達支援
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 2,000; Chinese experts head to Uganda to provide support.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have surpassed 2,000 cases, with 2,011 confirmed infections and 754 deaths (case fatality ~37.5%), as of Monday, July 13, 2026. The World Health Organization warns this is among the fastest-growing Ebola outbreaks on record, with roughly 80% of new cases from unknown transmission chains. Modelling suggests the true scale could be 2–4 times official counts, while funding gaps for response approach US$70 million. China dispatches two IMST public health experts to Uganda to aid international containment efforts, departing from Beijing in the early hours of July 15. An Zhi Jie will coordinate governance and cross-border risk analysis; Wang Huanyu will lead laboratory diagnostics and expand testing networks, including broader filovirus detection methods and sample transport oversight.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ確診が2000例を突破、中国専門家がウガンダへ支援に赴く
triage.triage_reason: エボラ症例が2000例超・致死率37.5%と深刻で、感染経路不明が8割に上り急速拡大の恐れがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・中国は支援国として言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダ・中国はGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الإصابات المؤكدة بإيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز الألفين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed two thousand.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 2,011 confirmed infections with 754 deaths, according to government data. In the latest briefing from the Institute of Public Health in Congo, 54 new Ebola cases were identified two days earlier across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu. The updated counts confirm ongoing transmission in eastern DR Congo, with authorities continuing to monitor affected regions. The report provides no further details on laboratory confirmation methods or infection sources in the excerpt. This disclosure of case numbers and geographic spread highlights the persistent public health burden of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例が2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病が2000例以上・死亡754人と大規模化し、複数州にまたがり感染が継続していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%と高く、複数州(イトゥリ、北キブなど)にまたがる継続的な感染拡大が確認されている。検査方法や感染源の詳細は記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Mehr als 2.000 Ebola-Fälle im Kongo bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: More than 2,000 Ebola cases in the Congo confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 2,000 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 2,011 infections and 754 deaths, and 753 patients currently in hospitals or isolation centers. The five-province outbreak is centered in Ituri in the northeast, which borders Uganda and South Sudan; Uganda has reported Ebola cases, including two deaths. In South Kivu, no new cases have been detected for 47 days, a cautiously encouraging sign. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; the Bundibugyo strain currently has no specific vaccine or approved therapy. Since early July, clinical testing of two antiviral therapies has begun to curb the outbreak. The update reflects ongoing containment challenges in this multi-province epidemic across the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：コンゴでエボラ感染2,000例以上を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例超・死者754人の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ウガンダにも国際的拡大が確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際拡大の事実としてihr_criteriaに反映した。特効薬・ワクチンがなく、2種類の抗ウイルス薬の臨床試験が開始されたばかりで管理は困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths double in two weeks as WHO warns virus is outrunning response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (epicenter Ituri; spread to at least one additional province, including North Kivu, with the outbreak reaching Kisangani) has 2,011 reported cases and 754 deaths as of July 14. Deaths have doubled since June 28; WHO calls it the fastest-growing outbreak managed to date. The crude case-fatality rate is 37% (up from 32%), driven by delays in diagnosis, isolation and access to care; 92% of the 430 lab-confirmed deaths occurred before treatment facility arrival. More than 240 people have fled treatment or isolation facilities; 100 fled in the last month. Isolation sites in North Kivu are over 120% full; safe-burial activities in Rwampara disrupted with >400 confirmed cases. Bunia’s Elikiya Treatment Centre (90 beds) is nearly full. Bundibugyo may cause respiratory symptoms, with about one-third experiencing breathing difficulties. Cross-border risk to South Sudan remains a concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死者数が2週間で倍増、WHOはウイルスの拡大に対応が追いついていないと警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが急速に拡大し、致死率37%、死者数が2週間で倍増、WHOが「史上最速の拡大」と警告するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事本文はイトゥリ州を震源地とし、北キブ州やキサンガニへの拡大、南スーダンへの越境リスクに言及。ルワンダ（キガリ州）およびスーダンは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事の主題（実際の症例発生）はDRC国内であり、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaausbruch: Mehr als 2.000 Ebola-Fälle im Kongo bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: More than 2,000 Ebola cases confirmed in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases. The Information Ministry reports 754 deaths and 753 patients currently being treated in clinics. The outbreak is tracked across five provinces, with Ituri province considered the center; Ituri borders Uganda, where Ebola cases have also been reported. The report notes ongoing transmission within the DRC and potential cross-border risk with neighboring Uganda. Details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, and imported/exported cases are not provided in the article. The figures indicate a persistent and expanding epidemic across multiple provinces, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and regional cooperation to mitigate spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：コンゴで2,000人以上のエボラ症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例以上・754名死亡という大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、複数州に拡大、ウガンダとの国境を越えた感染リスクも指摘されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。イトゥリ州はDRCのADM1のため、DRCとして計上。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 2.000 casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths in the eastern outbreak declared May 15. As of July 13, the case fatality rate stands at 37.5%, with 753 patients in isolation or hospitalization and 366 recoveries. The Congolese Ministry of Communication and Media’s latest bulletin provides these updated counts, underscoring persistent transmission in the eastern region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and a substantial mortality burden. Data compiled through July 13 reflect a continuing outbreak since its May declaration, affecting health facilities and communities in the area. The report highlights the ongoing severity of Ebola in this outbreak and the need for sustained surveillance and response in the affected eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確認症例数が2,000人の壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率37.5%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 5月15日宣言以来、東部で継続するアウトブレイク。確定2,011例、死亡754例、致死率37.5%、隔離・入院中753例、回復366例。持続的な人-人感染とサーベイランス強化の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths double in 2 weeks as WHO warns virus outrunning response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates: 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, up from 377 on June 28; two new provinces affected beyond Ituri, and Kisangani reached, expanding cross-border risk toward South Sudan. WHO characterizes it as the fastest-growing outbreak managed; true scale could be at least two to four times the official count, with 80% of new infections outside contact lists and 92% of 430 deaths occurring before presentation to care. Crude case-fatality is 37% (up from 32%), reflecting delays in diagnosis, isolation, and access to treatment rather than greater virulence. Over 240 people have fled treatment or isolation facilities, including 100 in the past month; North Kivu facilities >120% occupancy; safe-burial activities disrupted in Rwampara. Elikiya Ebola Treatment Centre (90 beds) is nearly full. Bundibugyo strain may cause more respiratory symptoms, with about a third reporting difficulty breathing, raising cross-border transmission concerns to South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数、2週間で倍増 ― WHOはウイルスが対応能力を上回りつつあると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例・死亡数が急増し、複数州への拡大と国境を越えた伝播リスク(南スーダン方面)が指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、キサンガニ含む）を主題としたエボラ流行の急拡大を報じている。ルワンダ・南スーダンは越境リスクとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: "سلاسل مجهولة وحصار صامت".. إيبولا الخارج عن السيطرة يضرب بـ"سلالة نادرة" لا لقاح لها والعدوى تتخطى حدود أفريقيا - جنوبية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown transmission chains and a silent siege: Out-of-control Ebola strikes with a "rare" strain that has no vaccine, and infections cross Africa's borders - Southern.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and East Africa, as of 15 July 2026, reaches unprecedented pace in Africa. The World Health Organization reports that 80% of new eastern Congo infections stem from unknown transmission chains, signaling widespread undetected spread. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no vaccine or approved targeted therapy; vaccines like Ervebo do not cover Bundibugyo. Care is supportive. Total cases exceed 1,960 with over 719 deaths, with Ituri and North Kivu provinces most affected. The outbreak began officially in May. Border controls have failed to contain spread, with Uganda reporting at least 20 confirmed cases linked to imported infections from eastern Congo. International cases include a French doctor infected in DRC, and a U.S. citizen employed by an NGO evacuated to Germany. WHO has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: 「未知の感染連鎖と静かな包囲網」…制御不能なエボラがワクチンのない「希少株」で猛威を振るい、感染はアフリカの国境を越える - ジャヌービア
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言し、ワクチンのない希少株（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模流行で、ウガンダ・フランス・米国への越境感染も確認されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 感染はウガンダ、フランス人医師、米国人NGO職員にも拡大しているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。WHOによりPHEICが宣言された重大事案であり、続報の監視とフルRRAの実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО започна първото клинично изпитване на лекарство срещу ебола Бундибуджо
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO began the first clinical trial of a drug against Bundibugyo ebolavirus.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-15, the World Health Organization launched the first clinical trial of the antiviral obeldesivir (remdesivir) in the Democratic Republic of Congo to prevent Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease among individuals exposed to the virus but not yet symptomatic. The trial will include about 1,000 participants aged 12 and older, monitored daily for 21 days. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has caused over 1,960 officially reported cases and more than 700 deaths; WHO cautions that true numbers may be two to four times higher, with many new infections outside known transmission chains. No vaccines or treatments are approved specifically for Bundibugyo; parallel testing in Ituri includes MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir. Ebola, caused by Ebolavirus, spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids, with an incubation of 2–21 days and symptoms ranging from fever and fatigue to vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and potential bleeding; laboratory confirmation is required, and supportive care is critical.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスに対する薬剤の初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（1,960例超、700人超の死亡）が継続中であり、WHOが治療薬の臨床試験を開始するなど国際的対応が進行しているため。
triage.notes: 既知の流行（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病）に対するWHO主導の臨床試験開始に関する続報。感染連鎖不明の症例が多く、報告数より実際の感染者数が2〜4倍多い可能性が指摘されている点はリスク評価上重要。
