article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പനിബാധ കുതിച്ചുയരുന്നു; രണ്ടാഴ്ചക്കിടെ എറണാകുളത്ത് മാത്രം എട്ട്​ മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever outbreak on the rise in the state; eight deaths in Ernakulam alone in two weeks.
article.articleSummary: July 15, 2026: Kerala faces rising fever outbreaks. In Ernakulam, July has seen 10,050 fever cases so far, with eight deaths in the past two weeks. Dengue activity is up, with 262 cases treated in the last 13 days; Kalamasheri accounts for 51 dengue cases since July 1 (18 on July 1; five the next day; 12 last Sunday), with cases also reported in Aluva, Kakkanad, Binanipuram, Cherunni, Chottanikkara, Idappilly, Kadavanthra, Thrikkakara and Edappilly. Monkeypox (elippani) totals 19 cases with seven deaths; a 23-year-old interstate migrant worker from Kadavanthra died. In June, deaths (27 district-wide) were driven by influenza, West Nile, and H1N1, with 11 deaths due to monkeypox. Monkeypox symptoms include fatigue, leg pains, headache, fever, and abdominal pain; prevention emphasizes hygiene, avoiding soil/contact exposure, timely treatment, and, where advised, prophylaxis for high-risk workers.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で発熱症例が急増；過去2週間でエルナクラム地区だけで8人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーララ州エルナクラム県でデング熱・インフルエンザ・H1N1・West Nileに加え「サル痘（elippani）」による死亡例（累計18名）が報告されており、致死率が異常に高い点で公衆衛生上の懸念が大きい。ただし『elippani』はマラヤーラム語で『ネズミ熱＝レプトスピラ症』を指す可能性があり、疾病名の誤訳・誤分類の疑いがある。
triage.notes: 記事中の『monkeypox (elippani)』はマラヤーラム語の『elippani（ネズミ熱）』＝レプトスピラ症を指す可能性が高く、実際の疾病はMpoxではない可能性がある。Bluedotの自動分類・翻訳による誤りの疑いがあるため、続報でウイルス学的確認（PCR等）の有無を確認する必要がある。デング熱・インフルエンザ・H1N1・West Nileも同時流行しており、複合的な発熱疾患サーベイランス強化が求められる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Počet nakažených ebolou v Kongu překročil dva tisíce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in Congo has surpassed two thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 2,000, with government figures listing 2,011 infections and 754 deaths as of July 15, 2026. The World Health Organization warned the true number could be two to four times higher. WHO also said tracing new cases is failing, with about 80% of infections not on contact lists, indicating transmission from unknown chains, and many deaths occurring outside healthcare facilities. The United States has banned direct travel from Congo and requires a 21-day stay in a third country before entry; Germany has treated an infected American in Frankfurt. Ebola spreads by contact with an infected person or contaminated materials, with symptoms including fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and bleeding. ECDC and WHO regard the risk of spread beyond the affected region as low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が2000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: 感染者2,000人超・死者754人と大規模で、感染経路追跡が破綻し未知の感染連鎖が示唆されており、米国の渡航制限やドイツでの輸入症例発生など既に国際的影響が出ているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは輸入症例・渡航制限の文脈であり、実際の流行発生国はDRCのみ。ECDC/WHOは域外拡大リスクを低いと評価しているが、追跡不能例の増加や致死率の高さから継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 80% من إصابات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 80% of injuries.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization data from Geneva on July 15, 2026 indicate that 80% of new Ebola infections in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo arise from unknown transmission chains, suggesting faster-spreading transmission than health authorities can trace, despite intensified response efforts. Laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC total 2,011, with 754 deaths to date. The latest health bulletin reports 54 new infections recorded before Monday across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu. The figure underscores expanding, largely untraceable transmission in the eastern DRC, reinforcing the need for expanded surveillance and rapid public health interventions to curb community spread. The update notes an ongoing outbreak affecting multiple regions, with challenges for containment.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：新規感染の80%が...
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の集団感染が拡大し、感染経路不明の新規感染が80%に達するなど制御困難な状況にあり、致死率も高い（754/2011）ため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Geneva/Switzerlandは発生地域ではなくWHO本部所在地のため除外。イトゥリ州・北キブ州など複数州にまたがる感染拡大が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Начались первые испытания вакцины против лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first trials of an Ebola vaccine have begun.
article.articleSummary: First trials of a Bundibugjo Ebola vaccine have begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Phase I includes 50 healthy adults to assess safety and immune response. The Serum Institute of India has produced about 620,000 doses, with 4,000 for Phase I. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform, as with COVID-19 vaccines. Africa CDC's director-general said that even if effective, the vaccine is unlikely to change the current outbreak but could aid future epidemic responses. Congo declared the outbreak on May 15; Bundibugyo ebolavirus was first identified in Uganda in 2007, with the epicenter in Ituri and affecting North and South Kivu. On May 22, WHO raised national risk to very high, regional to high; global risk remained low. The deadliest Ebola outbreak occurred in West Africa (2014–2016), with over 11,300 deaths and 28,600+ cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ワクチンの初の治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関し、WHOが国内リスクを非常に高いと評価しており、国際的なワクチン治験も開始されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）として記載されているのみで、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat: Symptoms, treatment & who's at risk | FAQs
article.articleSummary: Three children have died in Gujarat's Sabarkantha and Panchmahal districts from Chandipura virus (CHPV). The outbreak prompted intensified screening, lab testing, and awareness campaigns as health teams conduct door-to-door checks and vector-control measures amid the monsoon, which boosts sand fly populations. CHPV can cause Acute Encephalitis Syndrome, ranging from fever to rapid brain inflammation; there is no vaccine or antiviral; treatment is supportive and requires hospitalisation for IV fluids, seizure control, oxygen, and close brain-function monitoring. Transmission is primarily via bites from infected sand flies; ticks may be a secondary carrier, but there is no evidence of human-to-human spread. Vulnerable groups are children under 15, rural/forested areas with poor sanitation and high insect density during monsoon. Prevention focuses on insect avoidance: nets, protective clothing, repellents, sanitation, and reducing sand-fly breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症が発生:症状・治療・注意点に関するFAQ
triage.triage_reason: 小児3名が死亡するチャンディプラウイルスによる急性脳炎症候群の発生であり、重症度が高く、モンスーン時期の砂バエ増加により曝露が継続する可能性があるため、フルリスク評価が推奨される。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはインド・グジャラート州で過去にも周期的に発生している既知の病原体であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はない。今回はモンスーン期の砂バエ媒介による小児の重症例・死亡例が報告されており、地域内での監視強化が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Serviços de Saúde acompanham 23 mil pacientes de hepatite B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health services monitor 23,000 hepatitis B patients.
article.articleSummary: Macau SAR Health Services (SSM) monitor about 23,000 hepatitis B patients. By the end of last year, over 19,000 people were tested for the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), with more than 1,300 positives (roughly 6.8%). Since June this year, the minimum age for HBsAg testing without prior records was lowered from 50 to 40 years. Up to last month, 2,866 people were seen in Hepatology outpatient clinics. The Macau Health Survey 2026 has been completed, with preliminary results due by year-end. The 2016 survey estimated adult HBsAg positivity at 7.6% (about 34,000 infections), with around 4% cirrhosis and 2% liver cancer per 100 positives; roughly 70% were over 50. Vaccination of those born in the 1990s reduced positivity to about 2%; in 2025, HBs positivity in children under five was 0.03%, meeting WHO target ≤0.1%. The government will promote World Hepatitis Day with free, anonymous rapid HBs tests and coordinating referrals for treatment with the Social Welfare Institute.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、B型肝炎患者2万3千人を継続フォローアップ
triage.triage_reason: 既存のB型肝炎対策・監視活動の通常報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 世界肝炎デーに合わせた通常の啓発・検査プログラムの報告記事。マカオはChina (1814991)に含めて分類。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Weekly Situation Update on Ongoing Health Emergency Events in South Sudan - Week #: 28; Date: 06 - 12 Jul 2026 - South Sudan
article.articleSummary: South Sudan remains in EVD/BVD preparedness and readiness mode with no confirmed cases to date, despite sustained regional risk. DR Congo reports 1,926 confirmed EVD cases and 702 deaths (CFR 36.5%). Cumulative Point-of-Entry screening rose from 394,410 to 552,071 travellers (157,661 additional). The National Master Training of Trainers completed, producing a pool of 90 trainers. Two EVD alerts (Yambio and Tambura) were investigated and discarded. Cholera declined 23.7% week-on-week with 347 new cases; the Oral Cholera Vaccine (OCV) mop-up campaign is set for 10 July. Poliovirus surveillance detected a new circulating VDPV1 (cVDPV1) environmental isolate in Juba. No new measles or rubella cases this week. Guinea Worm disease remains at zero cases for 2026. Week 28 (06–12 Jul 2026).

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダンにおける進行中の保健緊急事態に関するWHO週次状況報告 - 第28週（2026年7月6日～12日）
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは1,926例確認・702例死亡（CFR36.5%）と深刻であり、国境を越える地域拡大リスクもあるため、継続的なリスク評価対象とすべきである。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南スーダンの複数疾患サーベイランス週次報告だが、DRCの進行中エボラアウトブレイク（高CFR）に関する具体的な実数（症例数・死亡数）が報告されており、地域リスクとして重要。南スーダン自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ポリオ（cVDPV1環境分離）の新規検出は南スーダンでの新展開だが対象国外のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ni tos ni fiebre común: los síntomas iniciales de estos dos virus mortales que se parecen a una gripe común tiene a los expertos en alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Neither cough nor fever: the initial symptoms of these two deadly viruses that resemble a common flu have experts on alert.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola and hantavirus have global health authorities on alert. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola reports 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths; 753 patients remain isolated or hospitalized, and 318 have recovered. Ebola, caused by multiple Orthoebolaviruses, has a median fatality near 50% and varies; transmission occurs from wildlife (notably frugivorous bats) via contact with blood, organs, or secretions, and human-to-human spread through contaminated fluids and surfaces. Incubation ranges 2–21 days; early symptoms resemble flu—fever, severe fatigue, malaise, muscle and throat pain—followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and liver/kidney involvement; hemorrhage is less common early. Hantavirus, a rodent-borne group, causes HCPS in the Americas (up to 50% fatal) and HFRS in Europe/Asia; Andes virus shows limited person-to-person transmission. Transmission occurs via urine, droppings, or saliva; risk rises with cleaning enclosed spaces, farming or sleeping in rodent-infested dwellings; incubation 1–8 weeks with fever, headache, myalgias, and GI symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 咳でも一般的な発熱でもない：一般的なインフルエンザに似たこれら2つの致死性ウイルスの初期症状に専門家が警戒
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが確定症例1,926例・死亡702例と大規模かつ重篤であり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクもあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラとハンタウイルスの症状に関する一般的な健康啓発記事だが、コンゴ民主共和国における進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（死亡702例）の具体的統計を含むため、当該アウトブレイクについてフルリスク評価が推奨される。ハンタウイルスは特定の対象国に紐づく記述がないため地域検証対象外。カナリア諸島・スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Katastrophe im Kongo: Über 2000 Infizierte - und kein Impfstoff in Sicht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Catastrophe in the Congo: More Than 2,000 Infected—and No Vaccine in Sight.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 753 patients currently treated in clinics and isolation centers. Five provinces are affected, centered in Ituri, which borders Uganda and South Sudan; Uganda has reported Ebola cases including two deaths. South Kivu has had 47 consecutive days with no new cases. Ebola virus disease is transmitted via direct contact with body fluids. For the Bundibugyo strain causing this outbreak, there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific therapy, though since early July two antiviral regimens are in clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ大惨事：感染者2000人超、ワクチンの見通し立たず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000人超の感染・754人の死亡が確認され、複数州に拡大しウガンダにも越境しており、ワクチン・治療法未確立という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、IHR基準を複数満たしPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。ワクチン・特効薬が未承認である点は渡航・貿易制限のリスクを高める可能性があるが記事からは不明。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA WATCH: Experimental drug trial aims to stop Bundibugyo Ebola after exposure
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola is being targeted by the EBO-PEP trial, evaluating obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk contacts in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. It would be the first PEP trial for Bundibugyo Ebola, aiming to stop infection after exposure before symptoms appear. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called it a milestone; DR Congo's INRB, France's ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases, and ALIMA lead, with WHO support. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Separately, a UK vaccine trial against Bundibugyo began, and in DRC the WHO-backed PARTNERS trial is testing MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir in patients. Together, these efforts pursue prevention before and after exposure and therapeutic options, potentially protecting household contacts and healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウォッチ：実験的治療薬治験がバンディブギョ・エボラの曝露後感染阻止を目指す
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（バンディブギョ株）に関するWHO主導の曝露後予防治験がコンゴ民主共和国で進行中であり、国際機関の高い関心と支援体制が示されているため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染者数や新規アウトブレイクの詳細を示しておらず、主に治験（EBO-PEP、PARTNERS試験など）の進行状況を報告する内容。ただしWHO事務局長のコメントや国際機関（INRB、ANRS、ALIMA）の関与から、エボラ対応への高い国際的関心が伺える。ウガンダ・フランス・英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Vaka Sayısı 2.000'i Aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case count in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: Fatalities reach 754 among 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 15, 2026, with 753 patients in isolation and 366 recoveries. The outbreak centers on Ituri Province, with spillover into North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Health authorities warn of ongoing rapid case rise and describe the transmission as an uninterrupted phase. The new cases detected in Haut-Uele indicate further geographic spread, underscoring the need to urgently bolster surveillance, diagnostic capacity, and response preparedness. The DRC formally declared Bundibugyo ebolavirus as the causative virus on May 15. No laboratory-confirmed imported/exported cases are reported in the article. Ongoing containment requires intensified public health measures in Ituri and adjacent provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ感染者数が2,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（2,011症例、死亡754人）が複数州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはイトゥリ州を中心に北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、ツォポ州へ拡大中。致死率は約37.5%と高く、原因ウイルスはBundibugyoエボラウイルスと確認されている（5月15日発表）。国際的な輸出入例は現時点で報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RDC supera los 2.000 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 2,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to escalate, with 2,011 confirmed cases reported across Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo provinces. Updated figures show 2,011 total cases; 753 patients are currently isolated or hospitalized; 366 have recovered; deaths total 754, yielding a case fatality rate of 37.5%. Ituri remains the epicenter, driving most new infections and straining the health system, as authorities sharpen early case detection, isolation, and contact tracing. Contact monitoring stands at 67.4%, with plans to increase to curb transmission. In contrast, South Kivu has not recorded a new confirmed case in 47 days and has reported 15 recoveries in that same interval, indicating some epidemiological stabilization. The government maintains a sustained, on-the-ground response, prioritizing surveillance, patient care, and transmission interruption.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱流行、確認症例2,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で2,000例超・致死率37.5%と深刻化しており、IHR基準の複数該当（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 南キブ州では47日間新規症例なしと改善傾向がある一方、イツリ州が引き続き流行の中心であり、複数州にまたがる継続的な感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola lan nhanh, vượt khả năng truy vết ở miền Đông Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads rapidly, outpacing contact-tracing capacity in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than contact-tracing capacity. WHO reports 80% of new cases arise from unidentified transmission chains, with Bundibugyo Ebola virus currently circulating—no approved treatment or vaccine exists for this strain. Africa CDC labels it the continent’s fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak. Many deaths occur in the community without medical care, and about 80% of new infections are not linked to monitored contacts, hindering tracing and containment. As of July 13, at least 1,926 cases and 702 deaths have been reported across three provinces, with rising cases in neighboring Uganda. In Bunia, treatment beds approach 800 and laboratories have expanded from 1 to 14. Response efforts are constrained by funding gaps and ongoing eastern Congo conflict. A second American aid worker infected has been moved to Germany, following an earlier American doctor infection. WHO cautions the true scale may be 2–4 times the officially reported figures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが急速拡大、コンゴ東部で追跡能力を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大）、WPRO基準も全項目該当し、国際的な医療従事者感染や資金不足による対応制約から緊急のリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株が流行中。WHOは実際の症例数が公式報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘。ウガンダへの越境拡大やアメリカ人医療従事者のドイツへの搬送など国際的影響も見られるが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases top 2,000 amid WHO warning of hidden toll
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths, with the true toll likely 2–4 times higher due to undetected transmission. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, has spread to five provinces beyond the Ituri epicenter, including new cases in Tshopo and Haut-Uele and detection in Kisangani, raising cross-border transmission risk along the Congo River. WHO notes the fastest growth of any current Ebola outbreak and a shift to wider geographic spread. About 12,430 contacts are under surveillance, but only 67.4% are followed, well below the 95% target; roughly 80% of new patients are not known contacts. There is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo; trials of obeldesivir post-exposure and the PARTNERS trial with MBP134/remdesivir are ongoing. Health-system strain, insecurity, and 5.8 million internally displaced people compound the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が2,000人を超える中、WHOが「隠れた被害」を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）の感染者が2,000人を超え、複数州に拡大、接触者追跡率も目標未達でヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが高く、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないため国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、複数の臨床試験（obeldesivir、PARTNERS試験）が進行中。580万人の国内避難民や治安不安が対応を複雑化させている。国境を越えたコンゴ川沿いの感染拡大リスクにも言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情波及5省　确诊病例破2000宗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to five provinces; confirmed cases exceed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—with 2,011 laboratory-confirmed cases and 754 deaths. As of July 14, 753 patients were in isolation or hospital, and 366 had recovered; North Kivu’s facilities were at 120.6% bed occupancy. Haut-Uele reported 14 confirmed cases, 13 deaths. The outbreak near the Uganda border raises cross-border spread risk, and Uganda has also reported cases. The World Health Organization says the epidemic scale could be 2–4 times higher than official counts, marking it as the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus with no licensed vaccines or therapies. A post-exposure prophylaxis center is operating near ALIMA-operated Ebola treatment centers in Bunia and another Ituri site, enrolling nearly 1,000 people for a trial of obeldesivir, MBP134, and remdesivir (alone or in combination), with 21-day monitoring and 42-day follow-up, starting July 2 and extending for months into next year.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、5州に拡大　確診症例2000件突破
triage.triage_reason: 5州にまたがる大規模流行で致死率が高く、ウガンダとの国境地帯での感染拡大リスクがあり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる急速な拡大が確認されているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOは実際の流行規模が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、第3位の規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行と評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS alerte sur la progression très rapide de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the very rapid progression of the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths across five provinces as of July 11, 2026. WHO warns this is the fastest progression observed for a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. From Bunia in Ituri province, the epicenter, WHO Emergency Program chief Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu reported more than 80 new cases in 24 hours, and that 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, complicating response efforts. The true case count could be two to four times higher than official tallies. Most cases remain in Ituri, with recent spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. WHO calls for sustained interventions at the epicenter and tighter movement surveillance to prevent new foci.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱流行の急速な進行を警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が5州に拡大し、約2000症例・700人超の死亡が確認され、感染経路不明の伝播が80%に達するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: WHOが『史上最速の進行』と警告する事例であり、感染経路不明の症例が多いこと、実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に及ぶ可能性がある点から、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Deaths Double in Two Weeks as WHO Warns Virus Is Outrunning Response
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows a crude case-fatality rate of 37%, up from 32% a week earlier. About 92% of confirmed deaths occur before patients reach treatment facilities, reflecting persistent delays in diagnosis, isolation, and access to care. Deaths have doubled in just over two weeks, and the World Health Organization warns the virus is outrunning the response. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the critical impact of care-seeking delays on mortality. Symptom details and infection source are not provided in the excerpt. This reflects significant gaps in diagnosis and access to care hindering outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死者、2週間で倍増 WHOはウイルスが対応を上回っていると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の致死率上昇・死者数倍増・WHOによる対応追いつかず警告があり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴うためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 致死率37%と高く、診断・隔離・治療アクセスの遅延が死亡の大部分に関与。WHOが対応の遅れを公式に警告しており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh's COVID Cases Explained: Why Experts Say This Isn't A New Outbreak | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, in Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa district, fresh COVID-19 cases and two virus-related deaths have been reported, renewing public concern that India could be entering another wave of infections. State authorities have stepped up surveillance, activated rapid response teams, and bolstered hospital preparedness to quickly detect and respond to any uptick. Infectious-disease experts say this does not denote a new outbreak; SARS-CoV-2 continues to circulate endemically, similar to influenza and other respiratory viruses. Officials emphasize there is no evidence of widespread community transmission, and most active cases are mild or asymptomatic, underscoring a sporadic pattern rather than a surge.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデシュ州のCOVID症例について説明:専門家が新たな流行ではないと言う理由
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な新規症例と死亡例が報告されているが、専門家は新規流行ではなく地域流行的な循環と説明しており、広範な地域社会感染の証拠はない。ただし続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 専門家により新規流行ではなく既存のエンデミックなCOVID-19循環であると明言されている。州当局はサーベイランス強化と対応体制を整えているが、重症度・拡大リスクは低いと評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ೩೨ ಮಂದಿಗೆ ಕೊರೊನಾ ದೃಢ: ಆತಂಕಕ್ಕೆಡೆ - Sanjevani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 confirmed in 32 people in the state: panic sets in
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 has been confirmed in 32 people in Karnataka, India, as cases rise in neighboring Andhra Pradesh. Of 193 individuals tested in June–early July, 32 were positive. June saw 14 positives, while the first ten days of July added another 18, reflecting an uptick but with no reported severe illness so far. Most infections in Karnataka were detected via mandatory pre-operative screenings, with patients asymptomatic. Health department commissioner Gurudath Hegde said the recent deaths reported in Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, are suspected cases and that information is being exchanged with the Andhra Pradesh government. Officials emphasize daily monitoring and urge the public not to panic. The article mentions the broader concern over a circulating virus variant, though no linkage to a specific strain is confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で32人の新型コロナウイルス感染が確認され懸念が広がる
triage.triage_reason: カルナタカ州でのCOVID-19陽性者増加は主に無症状で重症例なしだが、隣接アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州での疑い死亡例との関連が未確定であり、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパ県での死亡例は疑い例であり、COVID-19との因果関係は未確認。無症状者が大半で、術前スクリーニングによる発見が多い点から、現時点では重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは判断できないが、隣州との情報共有状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns Ebola Outbreak May Be Four Times Larger
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda may be substantially larger than reported. WHO warns the number of infections could be two to four times official figures, as many cases go unreported. Official tallies reach nearly 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths to date, with transmission accelerating faster than response efforts can keep up. The organization also highlights a funding shortfall, having received less than half of the $115 million needed to combat the outbreak, hindering containment and treatment. International support is urged to prevent further loss of life, as many patients continue to die in their communities before reaching healthcare facilities. The warning underscores the critical need for expanded case finding, rapid isolation, and sustained funding to curb spread across DR Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行は報告の4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行が公式統計の2〜4倍に達する可能性を警告し、資金不足と拡大が深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威となっているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。国際的な資金不足と症例把握の遅れが感染拡大の主要因として強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bloomberg: Число смертей от лихорадки Эбола удвоилось за две недели
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bloomberg: The number of deaths from Ebola fever has doubled in two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have doubled over two weeks, with 754 confirmed deaths among 2,011 confirmed cases. The outbreak has spread to two new provinces beyond the initial epicenter in Ituri. Médecins Sans Frontières notes that the number of infected has already surpassed half of the total cases registered during the 2018–2020 outbreak. The World Health Organization says this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak it has faced and warns the true scale could be at least two to four times higher than official figures. Officials also caution about a new strain and the risk of spread to South Sudan. The United Nations Development Programme warns the outbreak could trigger a large socio-economic crisis, with worst-case damages to African economies potentially up to $3.6 billion.

triage.headline_ja: ブルームバーグ:エボラ熱による死者数が2週間で倍増
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、死者数が2週間で倍増し複数州へ拡大、WHOも過去最速の拡大と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの拡大リスクが指摘されているが、現時点では感染確認事例の報告はないため、Sudan/South Sudanはverified_locationsに含めていない。新変異株の可能性やWHOによる過小報告の懸念など、フルリスク評価が必要な重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد الإصابات المؤكدة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 2011 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in the number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 2,011.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of July 15, 2026, according to Kinshasa authorities cited by Reuters. The outbreak remains ongoing in the DRC, with transmission through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected persons or animals. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. The report centers on confirmed case counts and fatalities, without detailing laboratory confirmation methods or specific infection sources beyond fluid contact. There is no information provided about imported or exported cases. The situation underscores a continuing, deadly public health emergency in central Africa, necessitating sustained surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数が2,011例に上昇
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（2,011例、754人死亡）が継続しており、致死率の高さと国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%（754/2011）と高く、継続的な監視と国際支援が必要。詳細な感染経路や検査手法は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Dodental ebola in twee weken verdubbeld
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll has doubled in two weeks
article.articleSummary: July 15, 2026 — Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has intensified. The death toll stands at 754, up from 377 on June 28, with confirmed cases exceeding 2,000. WHO official Chikwe Ihekweazu warned the outbreak may be two to four times larger than currently known, noting the fastest growth in a month among all Ebola outbreaks to date. Efforts to curb spread face challenges: patients leaving treatment centers, quarantine facilities overcrowded, and safe burial programs suspended due to unpaid staff. There are fears the virus could reach South Sudan. The outbreak remains ongoing, with authorities intensifying surveillance and response as cases continue to rise.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者数、2週間で倍増
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が2週間で倍増し、症例数も2000人超と急増。WHOも過小評価の可能性を指摘し、対応体制の崩壊や国際拡大（南スーダン）の懸念があり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの拡大懸念が記載されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 700 muertos por ébola en Congo: la Organización Mundial de la Salud alertó por contagios de origen desconocido
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 700 dead from Ebola in Congo: the World Health Organization warned of infections of unknown origin.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches alarming scale, with 1,926 infections and 702 deaths across three provinces; infections have also been detected in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization warns that about 80% of new cases arise from transmission chains not on contact lists, and many recent deaths occurred in communities before patients could reach health facilities, hindering isolation and contact tracing. Declared May 15, the Congo outbreak is described as the fastest-growing Ebola surge on the continent. Bunia, among the hardest-hit cities, has expanded treatment capacity to nearly 800 beds and laboratory capacity from 1 to 14. Despite efforts, the response is strained by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and community mistrust; health workers have even gone on strike. Clinical treatment trials commenced last week as authorities monitor imported/exported cases, including Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者700人超:世界保健機関(WHO)が原因不明の感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが発生し、死者700人超・感染1,926人に達し、隣国ウガンダにも波及、伝播鎖の80%が追跡不能という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。資金不足、医療施設への攻撃、地域社会の不信感、医療従事者のストライキなど対応能力に深刻な課題があり、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm một người bị chó cắn tử vong nghi do bệnh dại ở Nghệ An
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another person dies after being bitten by a dog, suspected to have rabies, in Nghe An.
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths in Nghe An, Vietnam: As of July 15, 2026, Nghệ An Province recorded two rabies-suspected deaths after dog bites. The latest case, N.V.H. (born 1981) of Quảng Châu commune, reportedly contracted rabies after being bitten by a dog while in Laos; he did not receive post-exposure vaccination. About three months later he developed hydrophobia, aerophobia, vomiting and agitation and died despite medical care. Earlier in early June 2026, N.V.V. (born 1957) of Bạch Hà commune died after a dog bite; he did not vaccinate and treated himself with traditional remedies, and about five days after the bite the dog died; the patient later developed classic rabies symptoms and died. Authorities are reviewing exposures and intensifying rabies prevention. Public health guidance: immediately wash wounds with soap for at least 15 minutes, disinfect, seek medical evaluation and receive rabies vaccination and immunoglobulin if indicated; avoid traditional remedies; vaccinate pets.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省で狂犬病疑いにより犬に噛まれた男性がまた死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの風土病である狂犬病の散発的な死亡例（犬咬傷による individual case）であり、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病として毎年多数の死亡例が報告されており、本件も予防接種未接種者の散発的な咬傷死亡例（2件）である。国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはなく、ルーチンの公衆衛生報告として扱う。ラオスでの咬傷例が1件含まれるが、ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Doctors report rise in Influenza A, COVID-19 and H1N1 this monsoon: 'No need for panic, but there is a need for responsibility'
article.articleSummary: During Mumbai's monsoon, doctors report a surge in Influenza A, COVID-19, and H1N1, with cases described as almost epidemic-like. Notable events include singer Jaan Kumar Sanu's COVID-19 hospitalization and multiple Mumbai hospitals reporting COVID-19 and H1N1 positivity. Experts stress awareness rather than panic. Symptoms overlap across viruses: fever, cough, sore throat, body pains, fatigue, nasal congestion and breathlessness; laboratory testing is essential for moderate to severe cases or high‑risk individuals. The rise reflects a ‘viral cocktail’ typical of the monsoon, with Influenza A, H1N1 and COVID-19 circulating simultaneously; transmission is facilitated by crowded indoor spaces and poor ventilation. Most infections are mild and self‑limited, but high‑risk groups—those over 60, diabetics, and patients with chronic diseases or immunosuppression—should seek care promptly. Antibiotics are ineffective against these viruses. Andhra Pradesh reported recent COVID‑19 deaths in patients with significant comorbidities. Emphasis: timely testing, early treatment, and responsible preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らが今年の雨季にインフルエンザA、COVID-19、H1N1の増加を報告：『パニックになる必要はないが、責任を持つ必要がある』
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期に典型的な複数の既知の呼吸器系ウイルス（インフルエンザA、COVID-19、H1N1）の季節的増加であり、専門家も『パニックの必要なし』としているが、持続的な曝露が続くため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ及びアンドラプラデーシュ州における季節性ウイルス感染（既知の病原体）の増加を報告する一般的な医療報告記事であり、通常のモンスーン期のパターンとして説明されている。重症例や国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Imus City steps up anti-dengue drive amid over 250 reported cases
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Imus City, Cavite, has 259 dengue cases (180 confirmed, 42 probable, 37 suspected), down from 263 on July 1 (180 confirmed, 44 probable, 39 suspected). Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; symptoms include high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, and rashes, with severe cases causing persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, blood in excretions, or breathing difficulties. Early diagnosis and prompt treatment are critical to prevent complications and deaths. The City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) is intensifying measures to eliminate breeding sites and urges daily 4 p.m. search-and-destroy activities to remove stagnant water, aligning with peak Aedes activity. The DOH has promoted the '4 o'clock habit' nationwide since 2013 to curb dengue during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: イムス市、デング熱250件超の報告を受け対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はフィリピンの流行地域における季節性の風土病であり、症例数も減少傾向にあるため、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向にあり、地方自治体レベルでの通常の予防活動（4時のsearch-and-destroy活動）として対応されている。毎年雨季に発生する既知の風土病パターン。

article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 2 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 2,000 cases, with 2,011 confirmed and 754 deaths (case fatality rate 23.4%). About 376 patients are under medical observation, and contact tracing covers roughly 64.4% of contacts. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province and has persisted since mid-May, with hundreds of deaths in recent weeks. The World Health Organization notes rapid progression and ongoing challenges due to hard-to-reach areas hindering treatment and isolation. Cases have also been detected in neighboring Uganda, with fatalities reported. France reports the first confirmed Ebola infection in a doctor who had worked on humanitarian missions in the DRC. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via close contact with bodily fluids; travelers should monitor health and seek care if febrile.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が2000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つが該当し、致死率23.4%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクがウガンダやフランスへも波及しており、国際的緊急性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダとフランスでの症例も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyo株が原因であり、コンタクトトレーシングも64.4%にとどまるため今後の拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo top 2,000, with 754 dead
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 753 patients currently in hospitals or isolation centers. The outbreak is tracked across five provinces, with Ituri in the north-east as the centre; Ituri borders Uganda and South Sudan. Uganda has reported Ebola cases, including two deaths. No new cases have been reported in South Kivu for 47 days. There is no vaccine or targeted treatment for this Bundibugyo strain; clinical trials of two antiviral therapies have been ongoing since early July. Ebola is transmitted via direct contact with infected people and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定症例が2,000人を超え、死者754人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・死者754人の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、ワクチン・特効薬がなく、ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラでワクチン・特効薬なし。ウガンダで死亡例含む症例報告あり、南スーダンとも国境を接するIturiが震源地だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。南キブでは47日間新規症例なしと改善傾向も一部にあり。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford begint met eerste proeven op mensen voor het ebola-vaccin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford begins first human trials of the Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University researchers have started first-in-human trials of a Bundibugyo-ebola vaccine. In Phase I, 50 healthy volunteers aged 18–55 in Oxford will be monitored for safety and immune responses. Regional efforts also underway with the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and the Medical Research Council/Uganda Virus Research Institute in Uganda, pending regulatory approval. The Bundibugyo strain continues to drive a large outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of July 11, the Congolese Ministry of Health reported 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across five provinces; Uganda reported 20 infections and two deaths on July 12. The vaccine is not a cure but a stepping stone toward long-term protection for high-risk groups and outbreak control. CEPI's Nicole Lurie and Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya praised the rapid progress, while noting no immediate cure.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、エボラワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模なブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（1,926症例、702死亡）が継続しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心（CEPI、Africa CDC等）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオックスフォードでのワクチン第I相試験だが、背景として言及されているDRC・ウガンダでの実際のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が深刻（致死率約36%）であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。英国（Oxford/London）はワクチン試験地であり、疾病発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tartuntataudit | Kaksi kuoli kevään salmonellaepidemian seurauksena Suomessa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious Diseases | Two died as a result of the spring salmonella outbreak in Finland.
article.articleSummary: Finland's spring Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts sickened 64 people, with 37 confirmed to carry the same bacterial strain. Ten were hospitalized and two died within 30 days of onset; both had underlying conditions (one under palliative care). THL declared the outbreak over as of July 15, 2026. Most patients reported eating undercooked sprouts before symptoms. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control documented 109 cases in 10 countries during spring. The largest Finnish sprout producer, Lounasidun, linked the fatalities to alfalfa sprouts produced by the company; the seeds were Italian alfalfa seeds whose true origin was India. Salmonella typically spreads via food contaminated with fecal matter; common symptoms are diarrhea and fever. Authorities emphasize maintaining cold chains and thoroughly rinsing sprouts.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症 | フィンランドで今春発生したサルモネラ集団感染により2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: フィンランドおよび欧州で発生したサルモネラ集団感染は既に終息宣言されており、対象国（India等）は種子の原産地として言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではないため、対象国に関連する事案ではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はParatyphoid/Typhoidとタグ付けされているが、記事内容はSalmonellaのアウトブレイクであり、種子の原産地としてインド・イタリアが言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はフィンランド及び欧州10カ国。対象国リストにフィンランド・イタリアは含まれず、インドも発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: DR Congo Ebola cases top 2,000 amid WHO warning of hidden toll
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 reported cases, underscoring a prolonged outbreak. As of 15 July 2026, the World Health Organization warns of a hidden toll, suggesting undercounting of infections and deaths. The article frames the figure in a round-up and highlights the challenge of fully capturing the outbreak’s scope, with no laboratory confirmation details, transmission settings, or infection sources provided in the excerpt. There is no information on vaccination campaigns or on imported/exported cases. The dispatch is from Geneva, dated 06 July 2026 and published on 15 July 2026. The piece centers on the DR Congo outbreak and the WHO warning, offering limited epidemiological specifics in the available text.

triage.headline_ja: まとめ：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が2000人を超え、WHOは把握されていない被害を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2000症例を超え、WHOが過小報告の可能性を警告する等、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: ジュネーブはWHOの発信地であり、実際の発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。症例確認方法、感染経路、ワクチン接種状況等の詳細情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: COVID cases climbing in parts of India. Here's why panic isn't needed
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising locally in parts of India, with Andhra Pradesh reporting a small uptick and a few related deaths, prompting enhanced surveillance, testing, and hospital preparedness. While similar upticks have appeared in other cities and states, the surge is not nationwide and hospitals are not experiencing overwhelming admissions seen in previous waves. Experts say SARS-CoV-2 has become an endemic respiratory infection, with spikes driven by weather, travel, festivals and new variants, and most infections are mild—fever, sore throat, cough, fatigue, runny nose, and body aches. Population immunity from vaccination or prior infection reduces risk of severe disease. Public health systems are stronger now, enabling early detection and rapid response. High-risk groups (older adults, pregnant people, chronic conditions, weakened immunity) should practice precautions: mask indoors in crowded settings, hygiene, seek care if symptoms worsen, and consider boosters as advised. No need to return to strict restrictions; vigilance remains.

triage.headline_ja: インドの一部でCOVID感染者が増加中。パニックは不要な理由
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は地域的な軽微な増加にとどまり、エンデミック化した状態で医療逼迫もなく、専門家もパニック不要としているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: COVID-19はエンデミック化しており、季節的な変動と捉えられている。医療体制も対応可能であり、通常のサーベイランス対象として扱うのが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진 2천명 돌파...700여명 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 2,000, with about 700 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases, with 2,011 cases and 754 deaths reported as of July 14, 2026, according to authorities; 366 recoveries and 753 people in isolation are noted. The outbreak is centered in the northeastern Ituri Province and has spread to five provinces. The World Health Organization reports that about 80% of new infections have unknown transmission sources. Figures reflect laboratory-confirmed cases from local authorities, underscoring ongoing transmission and challenges in tracing infection chains. No details are provided on imported or exported cases. This update highlights expanding geographical spread and the need for continued public health response in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラ確定症例2000人突破…約700人死亡

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases top 2,000 in Congo, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, according to government data released overnight. In Bunia, 753 people remain in isolation or in hospital, and 366 have recovered. Contact tracing coverage of exposed individuals is 67%. The outbreak began May 15 and, two months in, continues to spread faster than health authorities can track. The World Health Organization said that at least 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains, highlighting ongoing containment challenges. The reported figures underscore persistent transmission and strain on health systems; no imported/exported case details are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が2,000人を超え、死者754人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、致死率も高く、感染経路不明の症例が80%に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 2011症例・754死亡、接触追跡カバー率67%、新規症例の80%が感染経路不明という点から封じ込めが困難な状況。WHOも関与しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Anjing Rabies Serang Turis China dan 3 Warga di Bangli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid dog attacks Chinese tourist and 3 residents in Bangli.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Bangli, Bali after a domesticated dog attack injured one Chinese tourist and three Bangli residents. Li Qiujun, 30, was bitten in Kelurahan Kawan, Bangli District, with case reported on 13 July 2026 at 19:40 WITA. The visitor, treated at RSUD Bangli and later linked to anti-rabies vaccination (VAR) arranged via Klinik Ubud, resides in Ubud. The four Bangli victims — Ni Luh Pitriani (42), Jero Suciasih (54), and Gede Adnyana Adipa (6) — received medical care and rabies vaccines at puskesmas. Laboratory results from the attacking dog, a household pet, tested positive for rabies. Dinas Pertanian launched emergency vaccination for two nearby dogs and conducted selective elimination of six dogs suspected of contact, following sampling of the attacking animal.”}{

article.articleHeadline: Parasites Are Causing Explosive Diarrhea to Surge. Here's How to Avoid The Worst Ones
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-15, a Cyclospora outbreak in the United States is concentrated in Michigan, with lettuce and salad greens as a suspected vector; a specific source has not been confirmed and officials caution against bagged salads. Produce should be washed or peeled; avoid "washed and ready to eat" labels when possible. Cyclospora infections can cause explosive diarrhea. Separately, a World Health Organization report in The Lancet estimates that foodborne parasites caused about 4,886,427 DALYs in 2021. Taenia solium (pork tapeworm) has the largest global burden, contracted from undercooked pork or contaminated vegetables; prevention includes thorough cooking and freezing pork (-10 C for 5 days) and minimizing fecal contamination. Clonorchis sinensis is common in Asia and Russia (China heavily affected), acquired from raw/undercooked fish. Toxoplasma gondii is widespread, risky for pregnant women; avoid cat litter. Other parasites include Cryptosporidium, Fasciola, Trypanosoma cruzi, and Ascaris; emphasize hygiene and safe water.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫が引き起こす激しい下痢が急増中。最悪の事態を避ける方法とは
triage.triage_reason: 米国ミシガン州でのCyclosporaアウトブレイクおよび食品由来寄生虫に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、対象国における具体的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国ミシガン州のCyclosporaアウトブレイクと、食品由来寄生虫に関するWHOレポートの一般的な解説。中国・ロシアはClonorchis sinensisの一般的な流行地として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生イベントの主題ではないため、対象国リストとの合致は認められない。米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Potvrđeno da je više od 2.000 ljudi oboljelo od ebole u DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It has been confirmed that more than 2,000 people have contracted Ebola in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,011 cases, including 754 deaths, with 753 patients currently receiving treatment in hospitals and isolation centers. The Ministry of Information reports activity across five provinces, with Ituri in the northeast remaining the epicenter; Ituri borders Uganda and South Sudan, the latter also reporting Ebola cases including two deaths. Encouragingly, Southern Kivu has seen no new cases in the past 47 days. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected individuals and their bodily fluids. The ongoing epidemic is hard to contain because there is currently no specific vaccine or targeted treatment for the Bundibugyo strain; clinical trials of two antiviral therapies have been underway since early July.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数が2,000人を超えたことが確認された
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で拡大し、死者754人・症例2,011人と規模が大きく、隣国スーダンへの越境例も報告されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 南スーダンでも症例・死亡が報告されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・特異的治療薬がなく管理が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Cyclospora outbreak: What is causing the explosive diarrhea in US, can it be prevented, and is there a risk for India? | Mint
article.articleSummary: The United States reports its worst Cyclospora cayetanensis outbreak, with about 5,000 cyclosporiasis cases across 30 states, led by Michigan with over 3,300 cases since late May. Lettuce is suspected as a source, but no definitive cause has been confirmed. Cyclospora is a microscopic parasite causing intestinal illness; transmission is fecal-oral via food or water contaminated with human feces, and infection requires days to weeks to become infectious. It is not typically spread directly between people. No general advice to avoid lettuce is issued unless recalls or advisories exist; consumers should buy produce from reputable sources and practice hygiene. Rinsing may reduce contamination but does not reliably eliminate Cyclospora; household disinfectants and other washes are not proven to kill it. In India, infections occur regionally; outbreaks linked to commercially distributed produce are less common, but sporadic cases may be underdiagnosed. Prevention centers on safe water, sanitation, and good agricultural practices.

triage.headline_ja: サイクロスポーラ症の集団発生：米国での爆発的下痢の原因は何か、予防可能か、インドへのリスクは？
triage.triage_reason: 本件は米国内での食品由来サイクロスポーラ症集団発生であり、インドへの言及は仮定的なリスク考察にとどまり実際の発生報告ではないため、対象国における実発生事例は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国（ミシガン州中心）の集団発生であり、インドについては『リスクがあるか』という仮定的問いかけに過ぎず、実際の症例発生は報告されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Gyorsan terjed a halálos járvány: riasztást adott ki a WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly epidemic is spreading rapidly: the WHO has issued a warning.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached a critical phase amid insufficient funding. WHO warns that actual infections may be up to four times higher than officially reported, with Chikwe Ihekweazu noting undercounting. Since mid-May, more than 1,000 confirmed cases and at least 260 deaths have been registered. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. Two additional provinces have reported new cases, prompting intensified case finding, isolation, and contact tracing to break transmission chains. Early symptoms are nonspecific, delaying recognition, while advanced signs include bleeding in urine, stool, and nasal discharge. Prevention relies on general hygiene and supportive care to halt bleeding, prevent dehydration, and alleviate pain. WHO appeals to donors to increase funding and sustain the long, marathon-style response.

triage.headline_ja: 急速に拡大する致死的な感染症流行：WHOが警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行が拡大し、確認症例1,000人超・死者260人以上、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ資金不足でWHOが警告を発出しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数が公式報告の最大4倍に上る可能性があると指摘。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のBundibugyo株による流行で、資金不足が対応の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS anunţă primul studiu clinic pentru un medicament împotriva Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces the first clinical trial for an Ebola drug.
article.articleSummary: WHO launches first clinical trial to test the antiviral obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) for the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The trial, named EBO-PEP, enrolls people who had contact with laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo cases to assess whether oral obeldesivir can prevent disease after exposure. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for this Ebola variant. The drug is developed by Gilead Sciences and showed efficacy in preclinical filovirus models. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus confirmed the launch. The outbreak has caused over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths, with cases in five provinces and Uganda; Ituri province accounts for more than 90% of cases. Declared on May 15, this Bundibugyo outbreak may be 2-4 times larger than official counts, according to WHO assessments.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱治療薬の初の臨床試験開始を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のブンディブギョ変異株エボラ流行（感染1960例超、死亡700例超、ウガンダにも拡大）に関する重大な進行中アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによる臨床試験開始の発表が主眼だが、背景となるコンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ変異株エボラ流行（5州に拡大、ウガンダにも波及、実際の感染規模は公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性）は極めて深刻であり、フルリスク評価が必要。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO sebut wabah Ebola di Kongo catatkan pertumbuhan tercepat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in Congo has recorded the fastest growth.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths across five provinces, making it the largest third Ebola outbreak on record. Most new infections originate from unknown transmission chains, with daily confirmed cases exceeding 80 in recent days. A notable share of deaths occurs in communities, indicating patients are not seeking care at facilities. WHO notes about 80% of new cases fall outside official contact lists, implying undetected transmission. Epidemiological modeling suggests the true scale could be two to four times higher than reported. Declared two months ago, about 95% of new cases remain in Ituri, though the outbreak has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Response strategy emphasizes doubling down at the source, mapping travel routes, and identifying high-risk areas; early case identification and supportive care are critical, as no approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, despite clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が過去最速の増加を記録していると発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例約2,000人・死者700人超と過去最大級のエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、未知の感染連鎖や過少報告の可能性も指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に流行状況を発表しており、症例の80%が接触者リスト外で発生するなど、感染連鎖の追跡が困難な状況。承認された治療法がない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 稱霸自費市場 95% 還不夠！高端防堵克沙奇病毒推「多價腸病毒疫苗」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dominating the out-of-pocket market, 95% isn’t enough! Advanced protection against Coxsackievirus promotes a multivalent enterovirus vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan-based High-end Vaccine announced that its Multivalent Enterovirus Vaccine Development Plan was designated an IDX (Center Indicator Case) by China's Center for Drug Evaluation (CDE) and qualified for TFDA's Drug Project Consultation Guidance. The plan will guide early regulatory-science consultations, clinical development strategies, and CMC discussions to advance a second-generation multivalent enterovirus vaccine. Enteroviruses remain a major infant health threat; EV71 can cause severe neurological complications and death, while Coxsackie A persists as a source of hand-foot-mouth disease and herpangina, underscoring the need for broader protection. EV71 vaccine achieved up to 100% efficacy in multinational Phase 3 trials (VE 96.8%), published in The Lancet; in Taiwan it holds over 95% of the self-paid enterovirus vaccine market, with nearly 600,000 doses sold. In March 2026, Vietnam granted market approval for the EV71 vaccine. The company will leverage its platform, PIC/S GMP cell-culture vaccine facilities, and CMC capabilities for the multivalent program.

triage.headline_ja: 自費市場を席巻、95%でも足りない！高端(High-end Vaccine)がコクサッキーウイルス対策として「多価腸ウイルスワクチン」を推進
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発・規制承認・市場動向に関する企業発表であり、疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性やシグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン企業の規制指定・市場実績に関する報道であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの記述はない。台湾・中国・ベトナムはワクチン承認・市場に関する言及のみで、いずれも対象国リストに該当するがアウトブレイク発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se potvrdila v 2000 případech. WHO se domnívá, že nakažených je mnohem více
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has been confirmed in 2,000 cases. The WHO believes that more people have been infected.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 2,000, with 754 deaths reported, according to Congolese authorities. The outbreak began in May and has spread rapidly, with several cases also confirmed in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization warned at a Geneva briefing that the true scale is probably far larger; Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu said cases may be two to four times higher, with many unrecorded. WHO has only about half of the $115 million needed to fight the epidemic. Doctors Without Borders notes an unprecedented surge in cases for such a short period. Ebola first emerged in 1976 in Zaire (DRC). Five strains are named Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, Reston, and Zaire; three cause severe disease in humans. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, secretions, and bodily fluids, putting health workers at high risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、2000例が確認される。WHOは実際の感染者数はさらに多いとみている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000例超・754人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、隣国ウガンダへの拡大やWHOの資金不足も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ジュネーブはWHO本部所在地であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ ആളിപ്പടർന്ന് എബോള; സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ച കേസുകൾ 2000 കടന്നു, മരണം 754 ആയി! ചരിത്രത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും വേഗമേറിയ വൈറസ് വ്യാപനമെന്ന് അധികൃതർ; പുതിയ കേസുകളിൽ 80 ശതമാനത്തിന്റെയും ഉറവിടം വ്യക്തമല്ല, സമ്പർക്കപ്പട്ടിക തയ്യാറാക്കാനാകാതെ ലോകാരോഗ്യ സംഘടനയും ആരോഗ്യ മന്ത്രാലയവും പ്രതിസന്ധിയിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, Ebola spreads among people; confirmed cases exceed 2,000, with deaths at 754! Authorities say it is the fastest-spreading viral outbreak in history; for 80 percent of new cases, the source is unknown, and WHO and the health ministry are in crisis as they are unable to prepare contact tracing lists.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,011 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths, making it the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. About 753 patients are currently in isolation or hospital, and 366 have recovered. Only 67% of cases have been linked to known contacts, while 80% of new infections have unknown sources, hindering tracing efforts. The outbreak began on May 15 and is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO and the health ministry warn that the crisis is impeding response, as authorities struggle to assemble and maintain contact tracing lists."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急拡大；確認症例2,000人超、死者754人に！当局は史上最速のウイルス拡大と表明；新規症例の80%が感染源不明で、WHOと保健省は接触者追跡リストの作成が困難な危機的状況
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで2,000人超・死者754人と急拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が80%に達するなど接触者追跡が破綻しており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上最速の拡大とされ、感染源不明の新規症例が80%に達しており、WHOと保健省が接触者追跡に苦慮している点が重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon May Be On Pause In Delhi-NCR But Why Are Diseases Rising?
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR, even as the monsoon pauses, reports rising respiratory illnesses, allergies and water-borne infections. High humidity and fluctuating temperatures, plus lingering stagnant water from earlier showers, foster mould, fungi and dust mites, triggering allergies, asthma and breathing difficulties, while viral respiratory infections such as the common cold and influenza rise with indoor crowding. Damp indoor air can increase mould spores and irritants, affecting air quality. Water-borne risks persist from prior flooding, including typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A & E, and leptospirosis, with dengue also associated with monsoon periods. Those most at risk include people with asthma, COPD and other chronic lung diseases, as well as children, older adults and the immunocompromised. Preventive steps: keep homes clean, dry and ventilated; repair leaks; service AC filters; wash hands; wear masks; stay up to date with vaccinations (seasonal flu). Seek care for persistent cough, fever, wheeze, or breathlessness, especially with chronic lung disease.

triage.headline_ja: デリーNCRでモンスーンは一段落も、なぜ疾病が増加しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではなく、モンスーン季節に伴う一般的な健康リスク（呼吸器疾患・水系感染症）に関する生活情報記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の症例数や具体的な発生状況を報告しておらず、モンスーン季節における一般的な健康アドバイス記事に近い。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・アウトブレイク情報が無いため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Is Covid Making A Comeback? What Andhra Pradesh's Deaths And Fresh Cases Really Mean
article.articleSummary: Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, reported two Covid-related deaths and a small number of active cases; both deceased were elderly with multiple comorbidities. Odisha intensified surveillance in Ganjam ahead of the Jagannath Rath Yatra to guard against cross-border spread. Singer Jaan Kumar Sanu recently tested positive, illustrating ongoing transmission without a nationwide surge. India shows localised outbreaks and sporadic cases with no rise in hospitalisations. Covid-19 is now endemic, circulating at low levels with occasional spikes, especially among the elderly and those with chronic illnesses. Symptoms mirror earlier variants: fever, cough, sore throat, body ache, fatigue, headache, runny nose, and loss of appetite; testing is advised for persistent symptoms or high-risk individuals. Masks are not mandated nationwide but recommended in high-risk or crowded indoor settings. Authorities note vaccination and prior infections confer immunity and see no evidence of a dangerous new variant driving a large outbreak as of 15 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コロナは再来しているのか?アンドラプラデシュ州の死亡例と新規症例が本当に意味すること
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19はインドで既に流行状況が季節性・低レベルの状態として認識されており、記事も新規変異株や大規模流行の証拠はないと明記している。局所的な散発例に留まり深刻な公衆衛生上の異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19が地方風土病化し低レベルで循環している状況を説明する解説記事であり、危険な新変異株や大規模アウトブレイクの証拠はないとされている。オディシャ州のラート・ヤートラ前のサーベイランス強化は予防的措置であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaausbruch: Mehr als 2.000 Ebola-Fälle im Kongo bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: More than 2,000 Ebola cases confirmed in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola cases exceed 2,000, with 2,011 confirmed infections and 754 deaths; 753 patients are currently in clinics or isolation centers. Five provinces are affected, led by Ituri in the northeast, which borders Uganda, where Ebola cases have occurred, including two deaths. South Kivu has had no new cases for 47 days. Authorities and the WHO are intensifying public education and efforts to reduce reluctance to seek care, as survival is higher in specialized treatment centers and transmission chains are better interrupted there. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Since early July, two antiviral therapies are undergoing clinical testing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:コンゴで2,000人以上のエボラ感染確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例以上・死者754人に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が発生し、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されており、国際的拡大とワクチン未承認株による管理困難性からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染例（死者2名）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。原因ウイルスはBundibugyo ebolavirusで承認済みワクチンがなく、抗ウイルス薬2種が臨床試験中。
