article.articleHeadline: جامعة أكسفورد تجرى أول تجربة فى العالم للقاح إيبولا لسلالة بونديبوجيو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: University of Oxford is conducting the world's first trial of an Ebola vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Oxford University is conducting the world’s first human trial of a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, testing 50 UK volunteers within weeks. The non-replicating vaccine, produced with the Serum Institute of India, uses a safe viral vector to deliver Bundibugjo genetic material, prompting antibody production; MHRA approved after animal studies. Phase 1 safety/immunogenicity will monitor participants for up to a year, with researchers noting the possibility of expanding trials to Uganda. The outbreak is currently centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with about 645 deaths and ~1,800 confirmed cases, including 100 deaths in the first week of July per the US CDC; one confirmed case in France. Four vaccines are in development; besides Oxford, Moderna’s mRNA vaccine is underway, and two others by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative and US Public Health Vaccines are in development.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、ブンディブジョ株エボラワクチンの世界初の臨床試験を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダを中心に645人死亡、約1800症例が確認され、フランスでも感染例が報告されるなど国際的拡大が見られる深刻なエボラアウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオックスフォード大学によるBundibugyo株エボラワクチンの臨床試験だが、背景として現在進行中のDRC・ウガンダでのアウトブレイク（645人死亡、約1800症例）とフランスでの確認例に言及。ウガンダとフランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。インド・イギリスはワクチン製造・試験実施国であり感染発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria: DR Congo Health Workers On Ebola Front Line Threaten Strike Over Unpaid Wages | South Africa Today
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is experiencing an Ebola virus disease outbreak with more than 700 deaths among nearly 2,000 laboratory-confirmed infections since the outbreak was declared on May 15. As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warned the true scale could be four times higher than reported. Health workers on the Ebola frontline in DR Congo have threatened to strike over unpaid wages, potentially hindering containment and patient care. The toll is based on confirmed infections and deaths, underscoring ongoing transmission and the need for sustained funding, supplies, and personnel to support surveillance, isolation, and treatment efforts. The report highlights the tension between frontline response and financial constraints while international health authorities scrutinize the accuracy of reported figures and the adequacy of the global response.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア発:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ最前線の医療従事者、未払い賃金を巡りストライキも辞さない構え
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（700人超死亡、約2000人感染確認）に加え、WHOが実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性を指摘。医療従事者のストライキ懸念が対応能力を脅かしており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 見出しにNigeriaとあるが、これは配信元メディアの拠点であり、記事内容はDRCにおけるエボラ流行対応に関するものでNigeriaでの発生ではないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಕೊರೋನಾ ಕಂಟಕ; 32 ಜನರಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋಂಕು ದೃಢ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The state faces another coronavirus menace; infections confirmed in 32 people.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurges in Andhra Pradesh with spillover into Karnataka. Karnataka reports over 32 confirmed cases, with 193 suspected, up from 14 positives in June; in the first 10 days of July, 32 more cases were confirmed. Authorities warn the public and keep COVID wards ready across all government and private hospitals. A high-alert has been declared in districts bordering Andhra Pradesh, and checkposts have been set up at Pavagada in Tumakuru district to monitor cross-border movement. In Andhra Pradesh, Kadapa district records eight new cases in recent weeks, including two deaths: a 52-year-old man from Rajampet who tested positive and died during treatment at Christian Medical College, Vellore, and a 43-year-old Kadapa resident who died in Government General Hospital ICU. A 25-year-old medical student at Kadapa Medical College is also infected.

triage.headline_ja: 州に再びコロナウイルスの脅威；32人の感染が確定
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の症例増加と死亡例が報告されているが、既知の疾患であり大規模な国際的拡大の兆候はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: アンドラプラデーシュ州とカルナータカ州でのCOVID-19症例増加と2件の死亡が報告されている。国境検問所設置など地域内対応が行われているが、国際的拡大の兆候はなく既知の疾患であるためIHR基準の該当は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情波及5省　确诊病例破2000宗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to five provinces; confirmed cases exceed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for most infections; Haut-Uele has 14 cases and 13 deaths. Across the country, 753 patients are in isolation or hospital, with 366 recoveries; North Kivu bed occupancy exceeds 120%. Proximity to Uganda raises cross-border transmission risk. WHO projects the true scale could be 2–4 times higher, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus as the strain and no licensed vaccine or therapy yet. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, declared after Ituri deaths on May 15; Uganda has reported cases. Response capacity includes over 700 beds and expanded labs with strong contact tracing (~80%). A post-exposure prophylaxis trial of obeldesivir, MBP134, and remdesivir began July 2 in Ituri (Bunia and another ALIMA site), recruiting up to 1,000 direct contacts aged 12+ who had exposure within the past 5 days for 21 days of monitoring and 42-day follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、5州に拡大　確定症例2,000件超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例2,011人・死者754人と大規模かつ致死性の高い流行が5州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダも症例報告ありとされるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは実際の規模が報告の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘しており、監視継続と支援状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Antiviral împotriva Ebola, testat în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An antiviral against Ebola, tested in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola antiviral, obeldesivir, is being tested in the Democratic Republic of Congo for post-exposure prophylaxis (EBO-PEP) in people exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The oral drug, developed by Gilead Sciences, is given to up to about 1,000 asymptomatic contacts of confirmed cases (age 12+), within five days of exposure, to prevent disease. Participants are monitored daily for 21 days, with a final visit at 42 days. Sites near ALIMA-operated Ebola treatment units in Bunia and Rwampara, Ituri province, host the trial. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or treatment. The outbreak has infected over 1,960 people and caused more than 700 deaths since it began May 15, with cases in five provinces and Uganda; about 90% of cases occur in Ituri. WHO warns the outbreak could be larger; 80% of new cases arise outside known contact lists. Parallel trials of MBP134 and remdesivir are underway.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療薬候補、コンゴで試験
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株によるアウトブレイクが5州とウガンダに拡大し、感染者1,960人超、死者700人超に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イトゥリ州でのブンディブギョ・エボラ株アウトブレイクに関する抗ウイルス薬（obeldesivir）試験について述べている。ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域として付与されているが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、既知接触者外からの新規感染が8割を占めるなど流行制御が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19疫情連5週升溫　疾管署示警8月中下旬恐迎高峰 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise for five straight weeks; Taiwan CDC warns mid-to-late August could see a peak
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity in Taiwan continues to rise for five straight weeks, with the Taiwan CDC warning a new wave could peak in mid-to-late August. Week 27 (July 5–11) ED visits reached 2,811, up 34.4% from the prior week. Since October 2025, there have been 136 local severe cases and 18 deaths; 72.1% of severe cases are aged 65+ and 83.8% have chronic conditions. Modelling suggests a wave begins when weekly ED visits exceed 5,000, with peaks typically 1–1.5 months later. The annual peak is not expected to exceed last year, estimated around 50,000 weekly visits, though summer holidays may reduce transmission. Government-funded vaccination for residents aged 6 months+ continues until July 31, 2026, with about 450,000 Moderna single-dose and 6,000 Novavax doses remaining. Notably, 94.9% of severe cases were unvaccinated this season; high-risk groups should receive boosters promptly and maintain protective measures in crowded settings, amid rising cases in nearby regions (China, Japan, Hong Kong, Korea, Singapore).

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19感染が5週連続で増加、台湾疾病管理署は8月中下旬にピークを迎える可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でCOVID-19患者数が5週連続で増加し、重症例・死亡例も継続的に発生しており、当局が公式警告を発出していることから社会的・行政的関心が高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾国内のCOVID-19季節性流行であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。中国・香港等は『近隣地域での増加』として言及されるのみで詳細データがなく、主題としては扱われていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിയേക്കാൾ വില്ലൻ വ്യാജ കൊതുകുതിരികൾ: ഇക്കാര്യങ്ങൾ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കണം, മുന്നറിയിപ്പുമായി വിദഗ്ധർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More dangerous than dengue: counterfeit mosquitoes; experts warn.
article.articleSummary: Counterfeit mosquito traps sold in India, often without government approval or registration, pose greater respiratory risk than dengue and malaria. While mosquito controls are common to combat vector-borne diseases, experts warn that these fake traps release toxic aerosols when used, with fumes comparable to cigarette smoke. Contaminants include pyrethroids, organophosphates, and heavy metals, causing cough, wheeze, and allergic reactions with chronic exposure. Vulnerable populations—elderly, children, and individuals with asthma or COPD—are at higher risk. Readily available herbal products and other brands may be unsafe; consumers should avoid fakes and ensure packaging bears a CIR registration number. The article underscores the urgency of using only government-approved traps to mitigate vector-borne disease risk in India.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱より危険な偽物蚊取り線香：注意すべき点、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: 偽造蚊取り製品の健康リスクに関する啓発記事であり、デング熱やマラリアの実際の流行・症例急増を報じるものではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は偽造蚊取り製品による健康被害(呼吸器系リスク)を警告する消費者向け記事で、デング熱・マラリアの発生状況そのものを報じていない。感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: شرق الكونغو .. "الصحة العالمية" تعلن 80% من إصابات "إيبولا" الجديدة مجهولة المصدر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eastern Congo: WHO announces that 80% of new Ebola cases have unknown origin.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of Monday, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 died across three provinces, with confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization reports that 80% of new Ebola infections in eastern DRC arise from unknown transmission chains, signaling rapid spread and limited ability to trace contacts. Since May, the outbreak involves a rare Bundibugyo strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. Africa CDC Director Chikwe Ihekweazu, returning from Bunia in Ituri Province, warned that many recent deaths occurred in communities without access to health facilities or surveillance. He noted that 80% of new infections are outside contact lists, complicating isolation and case management. Officials say the outbreak continues to outpace response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴ:WHOが新規エボラ感染例の80%が感染経路不明と発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが拡大し、感染経路不明例が80%に達し、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも確定症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認された治療法・ワクチンがない稀なブンディブギョ株による流行で、致死率が高く(約36%)、監視体制の弱い地域での拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠連5周升溫！疾管署估8月高峰「單周確診恐5萬人」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 rises for five consecutive weeks! Taiwan CDC estimates August peak could reach 50,000 weekly confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports COVID-19 rising for a fifth consecutive week, with an August peak estimated up to 50,000 weekly confirmed cases. Last week recorded 2,811 COVID-19 ED/clinic visits (up 34.4% from the prior week), plus 17 new severe cases and no additional deaths; since October 2025, 136 severe cases and 18 deaths, mainly among those aged 65+ with chronic disease, with 94.9% unvaccinated this season. The Taiwan CDC says the epidemic threshold could be breached this week, predicting a rapid rise to a peak within about 1–1.5 months. Internationally, Mainland China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, and Singapore show rising positivity; globally NB.1.8.1 predominates, followed by JN.1 and XFG. An XFG-specific vaccine is not due until October; until then, existing vaccines remain protective for high-risk groups. Public-funded vaccination covers all residents over 6 months through July 31, 2026, with Moderna monodose (450,000) and Novavax (6,000) doses in stock.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ、5週連続で増加！台湾疾病管理署は8月にピークで週5万人の確定診断もあり得ると推計
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19流行拡大であり、既知の病原体・変異株、既存のワクチン対応が可能であるため、特段の異常性・国際的懸念は認められない。記事の主題は台湾（対象国外）であり、中国等への言及は付随的な国際比較情報に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾の季節性COVID-19流行状況であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。中国・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールでの陽性率上昇は国際比較として言及されているのみ。中国について明示的に陽性率上昇が述べられているため、参考としてverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: OMS : L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC se propage plus rapidement que toutes les précédentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is spreading faster than any previous outbreak. By 11 July 2026, WHO reports nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths across five provinces, with Bunia in Ituri province in the east identified as the epicenter. This marks the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, and the true scale is estimated to be 2–4 times higher than reported. The fastest month-over-month growth rate of any Ebola outbreak has been observed. International partners are urged not to relent, as response efforts are bearing fruit, but continued, intensified action is essential.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去のどの流行よりも速く拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最速の拡大速度を示すエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、約2000症例・700人超の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: WHOはBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行が過去最速のペースで拡大していると警告。実際の症例数は報告の2〜4倍と推定されており、国際的な支援継続が強く求められている。

article.articleHeadline: جامعة أكسفورد تنفذ أول تجربة عالمية لقاح إيبولا سلالة بونديبوجيو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: University of Oxford conducts the world's first global trial of an Ebola vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University is launching the world’s first global trial of an Ebola vaccine directed at the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. In coming weeks, 50 UK volunteers will receive the candidate vaccine, the first human test for Oxford’s immunization, developed eight weeks earlier. The effort aims to induce immunity against a rare strain with up to ~50% mortality. The broader outbreak is concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with about 1,800 confirmed cases and roughly 645 deaths reported, including one imported case in France; around 100 deaths occurred in the first week of July. Four Ebola vaccines are in development, but Oxford’s would be the initial human trial. Researchers may expand to Uganda, where around 20 confirmed cases have been documented.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、ブンディブギョ株エボラワクチンの世界初の臨床試験を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで約1,800例・645死亡の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行があり、フランスへの輸入例も確認されているため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランス・英国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要発生地として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число жертв Эболы достигло 754 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the Ebola death toll has reached 754.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with five regions in eastern DRC affected. The true case count is likely higher due to a fragile sanitation and health infrastructure. The flare-up, which began in May, also affected neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 15 June. The figures come from journalists citing Reuters, as reported by Oxu.Az. Ongoing transmission underscores regional spread and the need for continued containment, surveillance, and international support in a densely affected humanitarian setting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が754人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行し、WHOがPHEICを宣言、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みで国際的懸念が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Muškarca zaraženog ebolom dopremili u Njemačku: SAD pooštrava mjere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man infected with Ebola was brought to Germany: the U.S. tightens measures.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient, a humanitarian worker in his sixties employed by Samaritan's Purse, was transported from Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, to Germany for treatment and observation. The Ituri outbreak is the current Ebola epidemic declared mid-May, the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. The virus strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or proven therapy. WHO confirms more than 1,900 cases and over 700 deaths so far. Germany's Federal Ministry of Health said the man poses no significant risk to the public or Frankfurt hospital; risk of entry is low. U.S. authorities requested German assistance given experience with Ebola and the shorter flight from DRC than to the United States. A late May case in Berlin Charité recovered after two weeks of treatment. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した男性がドイツへ搬送：米国は対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で発生中のエボラ流行（第17回、ブンディブギョ株、症例1900超・死者700超、ワクチンなし）の患者が国際搬送されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアから治療目的でドイツへ搬送。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・有効治療法のないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、国際的な医療支援要請も発生している点で懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in de DRC, twee maanden later: dringend nood aan meer internationale hulp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC, two months later: urgent need for more international aid.
article.articleSummary: Two months into the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, it has become the second-largest and fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record. Confirmed cases rose from 650 to almost 2,000 by 12 July, with deaths climbing from about 130 to over 700, surpassing half of the cases seen in the 2018–2020 outbreak. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for roughly 90% of confirmed infections. Limited access to care, an overstretched surveillance system, and pressure on treatment centers are leaving many communities outside major cities underserved. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) urges rapid scaling of resources for all aspects of the response—surveillance, testing and diagnosis, patient care, survivor support, and safe, dignified handling of the deceased—while maintaining attention to other essential health needs. MSF runs seven Ebola Treatment Centers and 15+ isolation units (430+ beds) across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo; by 14 July they admitted 968 patients (357 confirmed) and supported 116 survivors. Movement restrictions and security challenges complicate deployments amid concurrent cholera and malaria crises and the approaching rainy season, underscoring the need to bring the response closer to communities and strengthen surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、2ヶ月後：国際支援の緊急強化が必要
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に大きく急速に拡大しているエボラ流行が継続中で、症例・死亡者数が急増しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行（2018-2020年に次ぐ規模）が急拡大しており、コレラ・マラリアの同時流行や雨季接近により対応がさらに複雑化。MSFが国際支援の緊急強化を訴えている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC, deux mois après : l'épidémie se propage à un rythme alarmant, MSF appelle à un renforcement urgent de la réponse médicale internationale en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC, two months on: the outbreak is spreading at an alarming rate, MSF calls for an urgent strengthening of the international medical response in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is spreading, with Ituri as the epicenter (about 90% of confirmed cases). In five weeks, confirmed cases rose from 650 to about 2,000 by 12 July, and deaths from 130 to over 700, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history. The geographic spread, limited healthcare access, and strained surveillance hinder containment. MSF urges a stronger international response—expanded surveillance, contact tracing, community engagement, patient care, survivor support, and safe and dignified burials—while ensuring other essential health services. MSF operates seven Ebola Treatment Centers and 15+ isolation units across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo (capacity >430 beds). Since outbreak start to 14 July, MSF admitted 968 patients (357 confirmed) and supported 116 survivors. Centers include Bunia, Mongbwalu, Komanda, Goma, Butembo, Bukavu, Lwiro; more facilities are in preparation. Security and cholera/malaria pressures complicate response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、2か月経過:流行が警戒すべき速度で拡大、MSFがイトゥリ州への国際的医療対応の緊急強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており(5週間で症例数650→2000人、死者130→700人超)、国際的な医療支援が緊急に求められている重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: MSFが国際的な医療対応の緊急強化を要請しており、コレラ・マラリアの同時流行も対応を複雑化させている。致死率が高く（約35%）、地理的拡大と医療アクセスの制限、サーベイランスの逼迫が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: وزارة الصحة في الكونغو تؤكد تجاوز حالات الإصابة بإيبولا 2000 - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health in the Congo confirms that Ebola infection cases have surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Ebola infections in the Congo have surpassed 2,000, with 754 deaths, according to government data released overnight and described by authorities as the fastest Ebola outbreak on record. The Ministry of Health reports 753 people remain in isolation or in hospital, while 366 have recovered. Contact tracing remains a challenge, with about 67% of those exposed being tracked. The data reflect ongoing transmission and rapid spread, underscoring surveillance gaps that hinder containment. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or whether there are imported or exported cases. Authorities are monitoring the situation closely.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ保健省、エボラ感染者数が2000人を超えたことを確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で2000人超・死者754人と急速に拡大し、史上最速のアウトブレイクとされ、追跡調査も67%にとどまるなど封じ込めの課題があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.7%と高く、接触者追跡率も67%にとどまるため感染拡大リスクが高い。詳細な感染源や検査手法、国際的拡大の有無は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le coût caché d'une épidémie 2 à 4 fois plus importante que prévu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the hidden cost of an outbreak 2 to 4 times larger than expected.
article.articleSummary: Officially in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola deaths reach 702 and 1,926 confirmed cases as of July 14, 2026, though the WHO warns actual cases may be 3,852–7,704 due to home deaths and unrecorded cases. Direct care costs climb to about $5,000 per patient, with potential immediate-care gaps of $9.6–$29 million. Many undetected cases fuel transmission (3–5 secondary cases each) and hidden costs. Response expands to 700 beds across five provinces—Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé—with lab capacity rising from Kinshasa to 14 sites; mobile labs cost $200k–$500k. Contact tracing is 80% effective, requiring ~2,000 field agents and >$4 million monthly. Uganda reports 20 imported cases; Ituri accounts for >90% of detections. The outbreak disrupts mining (DRC supplies ~70% of global cobalt) and trade, with monthly mining losses of $15–$25 million. Five provinces represent ~35% of eastern GDP; growth could slow 1.2–1.8 points beyond Q3 2026. PPE trials using obeldesivir cost $8–$15 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：予想の2〜4倍規模となった感染症の隠れたコスト
triage.triage_reason: DRCで702人死亡・1926例確定（実際は最大7704例の可能性）、5州に拡大しウガンダへの越境例も報告。鉱業・貿易への経済的打撃も甚大でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例（20例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの5州（Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé）にまたがる大規模流行で、経済損失・鉱業（世界のコバルト供給の約70%）への影響も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: देशात चांदिपुरा व्हायरसची दहशत! गुजरातमध्ये ३ मुलांचा मृत्यू, गाईडलाईन्स जारी, आरोग्य यंत्रणा अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide panic over Chandipur virus! Three children die in Gujarat; guidelines issued, health system on alert.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat near Maharashtra has raised concern after three children died and four more are under treatment, with eight suspected cases awaiting results. All affected are under 10 years old, prompting fear among parents. The Gujarat health department urges calm and vigilance; anyone with suspected symptoms should visit a nearby health center. Health Minister Praful Panjariya said targeted measures are in place, with support from the Indian Medical Association to alert pediatricians. Doctors are instructed to admit suspected cases promptly and ensure oxygen and ventilator support; severe patients from small hospitals should be moved to larger facilities. Chandipura virus, first identified in Chandipur village, Nagpur district, Maharashtra, is transmitted via mosquitoes, sandflies, and dust mites, and can cause fever with flu-like symptoms and potentially acute encephalitis; it belongs to Vesiculovirus genus in the Rhabdoviridae family. In 2024 Gujarat saw 61 locations report cases; vector-control campaigns reduced transmission, with no new cases reported since.

triage.headline_ja: 全国的にチャンディプラウイルスへの恐怖が拡大！グジャラート州で子ども3人死亡、ガイドライン発出、保健当局警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州で稀な致死性ウイルス（チャンディプラウイルス）による小児の死亡例が複数発生し、脳炎症状を伴う重症例もあることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBangladeshが含まれているが、記事サマリーではインド（グジャラート州・マハラシュトラ州）のみが主題であるため除外した。2024年にも同州で61地点での発生歴があり、季節性・地域的な再発パターンが見られる。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo supera los 2.000 casos confirmados y 754 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (centered in Bunia) has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. There are 753 people in isolation or hospitals and 366 recoveries. The outbreak, identified on May 15 and caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has persisted two months after detection, with transmission expanding faster than the response can fully contain. Contact tracing coverage among exposed individuals stands at 67%. The World Health Organization notes that at least 80% of new infections arise from transmission chains that remain unknown. The situation underscores challenges in tracing contacts and interrupting transmission, sustaining ongoing risk in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、確認症例2,000件・死者754人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(2,000例超、死亡754人)で致死率が高く、感染連鎖の67%が追跡未了、80%が不明感染源というヒト-ヒト感染拡大の懸念が強く、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: 史上最速拡大のエボラ流行とされ、接触者追跡率67%・新規感染の80%が感染経路不明という点から流行制御の困難さが顕著。WHOも懸念を表明しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US 'Explosive Diarrhoea' Outbreak: What's Happening, How Cyclospora Spreads And Should India Be Concerned?
article.articleSummary: Cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to Cyclospora cayetanensis is ongoing across 34 US states, with 1,645 lab-confirmed cases and over 5,100 suspected cases under investigation; more than 140 hospitalizations and no deaths reported as of July 2026. Michigan is the hardest hit, followed by Ohio, Kentucky, West Virginia, New York, and California (linked to travel). Investigations focus on contaminated fresh produce—lettuce, bagged salad, salad greens, cilantro, basil, green onions, and fresh berries—but no single source or brand has been identified, and no nationwide recall issued. Cyclospora is a parasite; transmission typically occurs via contaminated food or water, not person-to-person, with symptoms appearing 2-14 days post-exposure and commonly including watery or explosive diarrhoea, cramps, bloating, nausea, and fatigue. Treatment is TMP-SMX; prevention includes thorough washing of produce and good hand hygiene. The outbreak is currently US-bound; no confirmed risk in India.

triage.headline_ja: 米国での『爆発的下痢』アウトブレイク：何が起きているのか、サイクロスポーラの感染経路、そしてインドは懸念すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 米国34州で発生している季節性のサイクロスポーラ症アウトブレイクであり、死亡例なし・人-人感染なし・対象国（インド等）への波及は確認されていないため、対象国サーベイランスの観点では見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事は米国内アウトブレイクが主題で、インドについては『懸念すべきか』という問いかけのみで実際の発症例は報告されていない。汚染源となる生鮮野菜（レタス、パセリ等）は特定されておらず継続曝露リスクはあるが、季節性・既知の食品媒介疾患であり対象国への直接的影響は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC rebasa ya los umbrales de los 2.000 casos...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already surpassed the 2,000-case threshold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths, with INSP reporting 2,011 cases and 754 deaths as of July 15, 2026. About 753 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized and 366 have recovered; case fatality rate is 37.5% and contact tracing stands at 67.4%. Ituri remains the epicenter, but new cases have emerged in Alto Uélé and Tshopo, while South Kivu (Kivu Sur) shows no new confirmed infections for 47 days. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no internationally approved vaccine or treatment, hampering containment. MSF warns the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented rate: cases have tripled in five weeks and deaths quintupled from 130 to over 750, surpassing half of the 2018–2020 outbreak totals. Surveillance is overwhelmed; Bunia’s Elikiya Treatment Center is near capacity, with late arrivals. MSF reports 57 recoveries and over 110 deaths since response began, urging stronger international action to improve access to care and essential services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、確認症例2,000人、死者750人の閾値を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株エボラが急拡大しており、致死率37.5%、症例が5週間で3倍に増加するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心の高い事案であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株であることが封じ込めを困難にしており、MSFが国際的な対応強化を要請している。Ituriが中心だが、Alto UéléやTshopoにも拡大中で、South Kivuは47日間新規症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Потвърдените случаи на ебола в ДР Конго надхвърлиха 2000; 754 души са починали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo have surpassed 2,000; 754 people have died.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 753 patients currently hospitalized in hospitals and isolation centers. The outbreak spans five provinces, centered in Ituri province in the northeast, near Uganda and South Sudan. Uganda has also reported Ebola infections, including two deaths. In South Kivu, no new infections have been recorded for 47 consecutive days, a cautiously encouraging development. The current wave is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no effective vaccine or proven treatment. Since the start of this month, clinical trials have begun for two antiviral therapies. Transmission remains via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of infected individuals. Health authorities continue surveillance and containment across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ確認症例が2000人を超える、754人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで確認症例2,011人・死亡754人と大規模な流行が継続し、ウガンダにも拡大しており、致死率の高い病原体で有効なワクチン・治療法がないため深刻・異常・国際拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRコンゴ国内では5州に拡大し、致死率の高いBundibugyo株による流行が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 'Kao u horor filmu': Ameba koja jede mozak bi mogla da se proširi po svetu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Like in a Horror Movie: The Brain-Eating Amoeba Could Spread Worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, caused the death of 11-year-old Jordan in Costa Rica after swimming at a hotel’s thermal spring; he developed severe headache, vomiting, confusion, seizures and died seven days post-exposure from primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM), a nearly always fatal brain infection. In India, last year (2025) recorded over 200 cases—the largest global outbreak to date, with fewer than 500 cases historically. The parasite is emerging in new regions, including Slovakia (first case in 2025), Minnesota (USA), and Taiwan (2023) at an indoor surfing facility; a US child died in 2023 after exposure at a splash-pad. Warmer waters from climate change are expanding habitats beyond lakes and rivers, increasing risk for mostly children (average around 12). Since 1962–2023, about 488 cases worldwide with ~97% fatal. Early detection may allow multi-drug treatment, though outcomes remain poor.

triage.headline_ja: 「まるでホラー映画のよう」：脳を食べるアメーバが世界中に拡大する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 致死率ほぼ100%のNaegleria fowleri感染症がインドで過去最多（200例以上）を記録し、従来報告のなかった地域にも拡大傾向が見られるため、異常性・重症度の観点からWPRO基準に複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本症は水系環境からの直接感染で人-人感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、インドでの症例急増（2025年に200例超、史上最大の集団発生）は特筆すべき異常事象であり、続報の注視が必要。他の発生国（コスタリカ、スロバキア、米国、台湾）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Centrafrique: Ebola - Face au risque de propagation de l'épidémie, le pays évalue sa préparation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central African Republic: Ebola - Facing the risk of the outbreak's spread, the country is assessing its preparedness.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts Central African Republic to bolster border preparedness as the outbreak advances in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, notably Ituri province. A health ministry mission to Obo and Mboki in Haut-Mbomou assessed readiness for potential virus importation, presenting findings at a Bangui press conference on 14 July 2026. The evaluation examined health centers’ buildings, equipment and staff, with a call to rapidly reinforce the response: the Obo isolation room and the hospital laboratory will be equipped to improve screening and patient care. A critical constraint is the shortage of qualified personnel—only four qualified health workers among about forty at Obo—with training planned and staff to be dispatched from Bangui. Insecurity and poor road conditions hinder movement; most interventions proceed by air. The UN, WHO and Institut Pasteur will deploy a mobile laboratory, specialists and a regular cargo flight for medicines and supplies.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ共和国：エボラ出血熱－流行拡大のリスクに直面し、同国は備えを評価
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱の流行があり、隣国CARへの越境拡大リスクが指摘され、WHO・国連等国際機関が動員されていることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はCARの備え態勢だが、実際のエボラ流行はDRCイトゥリ州で発生中。CARは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。続報でDRC国内の症例数・拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 2,011
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths as of June 15, according to Reuters via SANA. The outbreak remains ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Kinshasa referenced in the report. Ebola is a viral disease transmitted through direct contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person or animal. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. The update notes the ongoing outbreak but provides no details on infection sources or any imported/exported cases. Counts reflect the June 15 update; the published date 2026-07-15 is used as the current reference date for timing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、確認済みエボラ症例数が2,011人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（2,011症例、754死亡、致死率約37%）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は754/2011で約37.5%と高い。感染源や輸出入症例の詳細は記事に記載なし。首都キンシャサでの感染拡大が言及されている点は都市部での拡大リスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола в ДРК превысило 2000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola fever cases in the DRC has surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Chopo. A total of 366 patients have recovered, while 753 remain in isolation. The response notes the outbreak remains in a persistent transmission phase, with rapid case growth since its start. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, was declared on May 15. In Bunia on July 6, health workers conducted disinfection at an Ebola treatment center, and on July 9 burials continued under prophylaxis measures, as authorities monitor ongoing transmission. Kinshasa reported the updated figures on July 15.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱症例数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州に拡大し、2,011例・754人死亡と大規模かつ持続的な感染が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案である。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%と高く、5州にまたがる持続的な感染拡大が続いている。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で、国際的な支援と監視の継続が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Syifa Hadju Kena Infeksi Bakteri, Kenali Gejala dan Penyebab Penyakit yang Diidap Istri El Rumi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Syifa Hadju Contracted a Bacterial Infection: Know the Symptoms and Causes of the Illness Afflicting El Rumi's Wife.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's actress Syifa Hadju, wife of El Rumi, was hospitalized with a bacterial infection, receiving intravenous fluids as she recovers. TribunSumsel, a South Sumatra-based outlet, reports that her condition is improving under treatment. No specific bacterium or infection site was disclosed. The report highlights an acute bacterial infection requiring hospital admission and IV therapy, with well-wishes from netizens. As of July 15, 2026, her condition is described as gradually improving.

triage.headline_ja: シファ・ハジュ、細菌感染症に罹患 ― エル・ルミの妻が患った病気の症状と原因を知る
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の細菌感染症であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性は認められず、単発の個人健康ニュースに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 有名人の個人的な健康問題に関する芸能ニュースであり、感染症の病原体や感染源も特定されておらず、公衆衛生上のシグナルとは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases top 2,000 in Congo, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo have reached 2,011, with 754 deaths, as government data released overnight mark this as the fastest-growing outbreak on record. About 753 people are in isolation or hospital, and 366 have recovered. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo virus, began May 15 in Ituri's Bunia, with two months elapsed as of July 15. Contact tracing remains challenging, with only 67% coverage of exposed individuals and 80% of new cases arising from unknown transmission chains, according to the WHO. Displacements from armed conflict and mining movements hinder tracing and identification of patient zero. Many fatalities occur at home before care is sought. Health workers have gone on strike in parts of Ituri over pay, with some reporting no compensation since the outbreak began. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus, unlike the Zaire virus; enrollment for a two-treatment study has begun in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が2,000人を突破、死者754人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がコンゴ・イトゥリ州で急速に拡大し、死者754人・確定症例2,011人に達し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、追跡調査の不備、医療従事者ストライキなど深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、接触者追跡カバー率も67%と低い。武力紛争による人口移動が対応を困難にしており、史上最速の拡大速度とされる。WHOのフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Започна клинично изпитване на противовирусен препарат срещу ебола -- OFFNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A clinical trial of an antiviral drug against Ebola has begun — OFFNews
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri among the affected areas. The World Health Organization announced the first clinical trial of the antiviral Obeldesivir in people exposed to the virus to see if it can prevent disease progression, enrolling about 1,000 participants aged 12 and older who will be monitored daily for 21 days. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola. Congolese authorities report more than 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths; the WHO cautions the true outbreak size may be 2–4 times higher, with many new cases outside known transmission chains. Separately in Ituri, another study is testing MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir as potential therapies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に対する抗ウイルス薬の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続しており、感染者1,960人超、死者700人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHOによる新規抗ウイルス薬の臨床試験開始など国際的関心・支援も高い。
triage.notes: 既知の感染連鎖外の新規症例が多く、WHOは実際の流行規模が報告の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘。承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない状況で複数の臨床試験（Obeldesivir、MBP134、レムデシビル）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 2,000 cases, kills 754 in fastest-growing surge
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 15, 2026, with 754 deaths, in the fastest-growing outbreak on record. The spread is driven by the rare Bundibugyo virus strain, with 2,011 total confirmed cases, 753 patients in isolation or hospital care, and 366 recoveries. The outbreak, declared May 15, centers in Ituri and has expanded to the provinces of Tshopo and Haut-Uele, signaling geographic spread beyond the original epicenter. WHO notes about 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, complicating containment, and contact tracing coverage is 67%. Response efforts are hampered by funding shortages, attacks on healthcare facilities, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo. Therapeutic trials for Bundibugyo strain began earlier this month; there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、症例数2,000人超え・死者754人に―史上最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大なエボラ流行であり、地理的拡大・未知の感染連鎖・医療体制崩壊などが確認されているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 希少なBundibugyo株による流行で、感染連鎖の80%が不明という点が封じ込めを困難にしている。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、資金不足、医療施設への攻撃、紛争地域という複合的リスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases top 2,000 in Congo, including 754 deaths - World Byte News
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Congo: 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths reported by government data released overnight on 2026-07-15, marking what authorities call the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. The World Byte News update provides these tallies as the latest count but offers no details on symptoms, transmission chains, laboratory confirmation methods, time since first case, or provincial breakdown within Congo. No information is given about the infection source or any imported or exported cases. The report emphasizes the rapid escalation of the outbreak but lacks methodological details, context, or guidance for containment. This update signals a high-level status check of the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo as of the stated date.

article.articleHeadline: Конго: више од 2.000 заражених, преко 750 преминулих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: more than 2,000 infected, over 750 dead.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 15 July 2026 – Ebola virus disease outbreak has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, according to government and WHO reports cited by AP. About 753 people remain in isolation or in hospital, with 366 recovered. Contact tracing remains a major challenge as exposure to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain remains around 67%. WHO notes that at least 80% of new cases originate from unknown transmission chains, highlighting gaps in detection and containment. Authorities report difficulties due to a shortage of treatment centers and community resistance to strict hygiene measures, complicating efforts to halt transmission. The situation is described as the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record, underscoring the need for expanded clinical capacity and stronger community engagement.

article.articleHeadline: இபோலா உயிரிழப்பு இரட்டிப்பு: உலக சுகாதார நிறுவனம் எச்சரிக்கை, உல‌க‌ம் செய்திகள் - தமிழ் முரசு World News in Tamil, Tamil Murasu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll doubles: WHO warns, World News in Tamil, Tamil Murasu
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has doubled in two weeks, marking the fastest-spreading crisis handled by the WHO. As of July 14, 2,011 infections and 754 confirmed deaths were reported, up from 377 deaths in June. The outbreak has spread from Ituri Province to two additional provinces, surpassing the 2018 episode. Doctors Without Borders estimates an 80% probability of new cases arising beyond direct medical contact, while WHO Emergency Programme Director Chikwe Ihekweazu warned that unreported infections could be up to four times higher. The rising death toll is attributed primarily to delays in detection, isolation, and care, not to greater virulence. The ongoing outbreak highlights gaps in surveillance and rapid response infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数が倍増：WHOが警告、世界ニュース（タミル語）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し死者数が倍増、複数州へ拡大しWHOが警告するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確なためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 2018年のエピソードを上回る規模で、複数州への拡大と未報告感染の可能性が高いことがWHO・国境なき医師団により指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Još jedan Amerikanac zaražen ebolom stigao na liječenje u Njemačku: Trump odmah povukao potez
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American infected with Ebola arrived for treatment in Germany: Trump immediately pulled a move.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been transported to Germany for treatment. The patient arrived overnight in Frankfurt and was taken to University Hospital Frankfurt. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus said the humanitarian worker was in Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern DRC, a focal point of the outbreak declared in May. German authorities say the public risk is low and Germany sought help for its Ebola expertise and the shorter flight from DRC. The patient is a man in his sixties; Samaritan’s Purse confirms he was a warehouse manager in DRC. Earlier, another American infected with Ebola was treated in Berlin’s Charité and recovered. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo strain; no vaccine or proven specific treatment exists. WHO reports over 1,900 cases and more than 700 deaths; transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including high fever, vomiting, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染した別のアメリカ人がドイツで治療のため到着：トランプ氏は即座に対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1900例超、死亡700例超）に関する事案で、WHOが既に発生を宣言しており、国際搬送も発生しているため深刻性・国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はアメリカ人患者のドイツへの搬送を主題としているが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRC・イトゥリ州・ブニアで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、WHOが5月に宣言）。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos de ébola se disparan en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the third-largest and fastest-growing on record. As of July 13, 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 2,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. Case counts have nearly tripled in two months, from about 650 to over 2,000, with deaths rising from ~130 to over 750. Ituri Province accounts for ~90% of cases, with many patients arriving at treatment centers in critical condition. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) calls for an urgent, intensified international response and more resources for surveillance, diagnostics, contact tracing, patient care, and community engagement. MSF operates seven treatment centers and more than 15 isolation units in eastern DRC, noting the outbreak is hampered by conflict, displacement, and other public health emergencies such as cholera and malaria.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し過去3番目の規模となっており、国際的な支援要請も出ているためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 紛争や住民の避難、コレラ・マラリアの同時流行が対応を困難にしており、MSFが国際的な支援強化を要請している。過去最大級のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる流行で症例・死亡者数が急増中。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases top 2,000 in Congo, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola in Congo has reached 2,011 cases and 754 deaths as of 2026-07-15, in the Bundibugyo-virus outbreak that began May 15. About 753 people remain in isolation or hospitals; 366 have recovered. Contact tracing coverage stands at 67%, with at least 80% of new infections arising from unknown transmission chains; authorities have yet to identify patient zero. The outbreak is spreading faster than response efforts can track, with displacements from armed conflict and mining movements complicating contact follow-up in Ituri’s Bunia, the worst-hit province. Many deaths occur in communities without facility-based care. Health workers in Ituri have gone on strike over pay, reporting they have not been paid since onset. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo virus, unlike the Zaire virus (which has a vaccine). Enrollment for two Ebola-treatment studies recently began in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が2,000人を突破、死者754人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模アウトブレイクで、感染経路不明の症例が多数、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、武装紛争による対応阻害や医療従事者のストライキも発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認。武装紛争や鉱山労働者の移動、医療従事者の未払いによるストライキが対応を著しく妨げている。接触者追跡率67%、新規感染の80%以上が感染経路不明で、封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: US to block citizens in Congo from immediate travel home, citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the U.S. blocks American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from returning home on commercial flights, placing them on a 'do-not-board' list for 21 days in a third country under Title 49 as the Ebola outbreak widens across several Congo provinces. Confirmed cases reach 1,926 with 702 deaths, with the virus spreading to areas near Kinshasa. Ebola symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and bleeding, transmitted by direct contact with infected fluids. About two dozen Americans who recently traveled from Congo were awaiting flights home, with the State Department offering support. CDC reports a U.S. humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus; another infected American was treated in Germany (Frankfurt University Hospital). Dr. Daniel Jernigan called the policy unprecedented. The U.S. is funding a controversial quarantine center in Kenya and has pledged hundreds of millions to Ebola response, while questions about responsibility and exposure risk persist.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴ在住の自国民の即時帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数・死者数が急増しキンシャサ近郊にも拡大、米国が異例の渡航制限措置を取るなど国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 感染者数1,926人、死者702人と大規模な流行であり、キンシャサ近郊への拡大、米国の前例のない渡航制限措置、ケニアでの検疫施設への資金提供など国際的対応が進行中。ドイツ・米国での治療例も報告されているが、発生の中心はDRCであるためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Sjoerdsma maakt 4 miljoen euro extra vrij voor bestrijding ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sjoerdsma makes an additional 4 million euros available for the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Netherlands on 2026-07-15 pledged an additional €4 million to combat the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with funds allocated to the World Health Organization (WHO). Development Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma (D66) announced the contribution. WHO figures for the Congo show more than 2,000 Ebola infections and over 750 deaths, a death toll that has doubled in two weeks. The WHO warns the outbreak may be two to four times larger than currently known. Sjoerdsma stated on X that the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda costs lives and places a region with strained health care under pressure, and international support and funding should not lag. The cabinet had previously provided €3 million to fight the virus.

triage.headline_ja: スヨルツマ氏、エボラ対策に追加で400万ユーロを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでの大規模エボラ流行（感染2000人超、死者750人超で2週間で倍増、WHOは実数がさらに大きい可能性を警告）であり、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。オランダは資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Конго пријави 2.011 случаи на ебола, вклучувајќи 754 смртни случаи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reported 2,011 Ebola cases, including 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 2,011 Ebola cases and 754 deaths to date; 753 patients remain in isolation or hospital, with 366 recoveries. Contact tracing covers about 67% of those exposed, hindering containment. The World Health Organization announced the first clinical trial of an antiviral to prevent Bundibugyo ebolavirus infection in contacts of confirmed cases. The EBO-PEP trial tests the oral antiviral obeldesivir in asymptomatic individuals exposed in the prior five days. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said a successful outcome could be a major step in protecting high-risk contacts. No vaccines or treatments are approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Official data show the rare strain has infected more than 1,960 people and killed over 700; the outbreak began 15 May in Ituri, with cases across five provinces and Uganda, though >90% in Ituri. The study will enroll about 1,000 people aged 12+ with direct contact, monitored for 21 days and checked at 42 days. The true scale may be two to four times the official tally due to unlinked transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが2,011件のエボラ症例を報告、うち754人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス)がDRC複数州とウガンダにまたがり拡大中で、致命的かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であり、国際的拡大リスクも認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。接触者追跡率が67%に留まり、実際の感染規模は公式値の2〜4倍の可能性があると指摘されており、封じ込めの困難さが懸念される。WHOによる新規抗ウイルス薬(obeldesivir)の臨床試験開始も重要な進展。

article.articleHeadline: Good Lord, Is Covid-19 Making A Come Back? Andhra Pradesh Remains On High Alert
article.articleSummary: Two Covid-19 deaths and eight additional cases in Andhra Pradesh form a localized cluster, not a new outbreak. The first fatality, a 60-year-old man from Tirupati, died June 28 after transfer to Vellore; he had diabetes and kidney disease, with postmortem RT-PCR positive for SARS-CoV-2. The second death, July 7, involved a 46-year-old man in Kadapa who died from severe breathlessness and pneumonia after extensive lung damage seen on chest CT. Authorities have intensified contact tracing, testing, and surveillance and say the cluster is isolated. Throat and nasal swabs from the deceased and infected individuals have been sent to the National Institute of Virology in Pune for genome sequencing, with results due in a few days. A five-member committee ruled out a completely new subvariant; some experts caution about a potentially more aggressive Omicron lineage. No fresh cases reported in six days; wait-and-watch continues.

triage.headline_ja: またコロナか？ アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州、高度警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID-19による死亡2例・感染8例のクラスターが確認されたが、当局は「孤立したクラスター」と説明し6日間新規症例なし。ゲノム解析結果待ちのため、変異株の可能性を含め続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 死亡例はいずれも基礎疾患（糖尿病・腎疾患等）を有し、当局はクラスターを孤立したものと評価。国立ウイルス学研究所（プネー）でのゲノム解析結果待ちであり、新規変異株の可能性については不明。続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC rebasa ya los umbrales de los 2.000 casos confirmados y los 750 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already surpassed the thresholds of 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak declared in mid-May in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths. The INSP tallies 2,011 cases and 754 deaths, with 753 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 366 recovered. The case fatality rate is 37.5%, and contact tracing stands at 67.4%. Ituri remains the epicenter, though recent cases have appeared in Alto Uélé and Tshopo; South Kivu has seen no new confirmations for 47 days. MSF warns of an unprecedented spread and urges urgent scale-up, noting that the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Since the start, the outbreak has surpassed half the cases of the 2018–2020 epidemic, with cases tripling and deaths quintupled in five weeks. Treatment centers in Mongbwalu and Bunia report capacity strains and late arrivals. UN OCHA says response efforts are being intensified to reach Alto Uélé and Tshopo amid conflict and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、確定症例2,000人・死者750人の閾値を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率37.5%の大規模エボラ流行がIHR基準の複数(重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク)に該当し、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による前例のない拡大が確認されているため。
triage.notes: MSFが前例のない拡大に警鐘を鳴らし、緊急の対応強化を求めている。Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争と住民避難により対応が困難な地域(Alto Uélé、Tshopo)への拡大も報告されている。UN OCHAも対応強化中。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera los 2.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths. The INSP tallies 2,011 cases and 754 fatalities, with 753 hospitalized or in isolation and 366 recovered; case fatality is 37.5%. Ituri remains the epicenter, though North Kivu has had no cases in 47 days. New infections have been reported in Alto Uélé and Tshopo, raising the risk of spread to Kisangani (population about 1.6 million). Doctors Without Borders warns of an unprecedented transmission pace; cases have tripled and deaths quintupled in five weeks. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain lacks a vaccine or approved treatment. MSF reports critically ill patients in Mongbwalu and centers in Bunia. The response includes 11 decentralized labs (up to 250 tests), 22 treatment centers, 7 transit centers, and over 700 beds; 85% of alerts investigated; 80% of contacts traced. Security and community engagement remain essential in North Kivu and Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当。ワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株による前例のない感染拡大速度が報告されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率37.5%、感染者数が5週間で3倍、死者数が5倍に増加という異例のペース。ワクチン・承認された治療法がないブンディブギョ株が原因。キサンガニ（人口約160万人）への拡大リスクが指摘されており、国際的な拡大懸念が高い。MSFが「前例のない伝播速度」と警告し、国境なき医師団を含む国際支援が既に展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bhadoni News: डेंगू से बचाव को 546 ग्राम पंचायतों में चल रहा दवा छिड़काव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bhadoni News: Dengue prevention insecticide spraying being carried out in 546 gram panchayats
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, dengue prevention efforts are underway across 546 gram panchayats in the Gyanpur area of the district. The panchayat raj and health department are conducting anti-larval spraying and shrub clearance, with fogging completed in about 120 villages across six blocks; the remaining 426 villages will undergo fogging soon. Urban areas are being fogged while drains (nalas) are being cleaned as part of vector-control measures. Public awareness campaigns are educating residents on dengue prevention. District Malaria Officer Ram Asare Pal notes fogging has been completed in 120 identified villages. Dengue is transmitted by the Aedes aegypti mosquito, which bites during the day. If dengue symptoms appear, individuals should promptly contact the district hospital; dengue treatment is provided free of charge.

triage.headline_ja: バドーニュース：デングー予防のため546の村パンチャーヤトで薬剤散布実施中
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の発生報告ではなく、季節的な予防・防除活動（薬剤散布、啓発活動）に関する行政の通常業務報告であり、緊急性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例や患者数の急増を報告しておらず、通常の予防的ベクター管理活動の報道であるため、対象国リストへの計上は見送る。

article.articleHeadline: Tay chân miệng ở trẻ em: Những biến chứng cha mẹ không nên chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease in Children: Complications Parents Should Not Take Lightly
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) primarily affects children in Vietnam; most cases resolve in 7–10 days with mild symptoms. It is caused by enteroviruses, especially Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71 (EV71). Transmission occurs via the digestive tract, respiratory secretions, saliva, vesicle fluid, and contaminated objects. Common symptoms include fever, sore throat, poor appetite, mouth ulcers, and vesicular rashes on the palms, soles, knees, or buttocks. Although usually mild, some children develop severe complications affecting the central nervous system and other organs. Urgent care is needed for warning signs such as fever ≥39°C or fever >48 hours, frequent startle responses, tremors, persistent irritability, restlessness, altered consciousness, repeated vomiting, rapid or labored breathing with chest retractions, cyanosis of lips or extremities, cold hands/feet, or unusually rapid heartbeat. Prevention relies on hygiene: handwashing, cleaning toys and surfaces, cooking foods thoroughly, avoiding contact with sick children, and monitoring outbreaks per Ministry of Health guidance in Hanoi, Vietnam (as of 15 July 2026).

triage.headline_ja: 小児の手足口病：親が軽視すべきでない合併症について
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病に関する一般的な啓発・教育記事であり、具体的な集団発生や症例数増加の報告はなく、緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は手足口病（HFMD）に関する一般的な医療情報・啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例数の急増、地域的な流行状況を報告するものではない。EV71は重症化しやすい株として知られるが、本記事は予防・警告サインの教育内容が中心。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: نقص حاد في التمويل لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Acute funding shortage to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, the World Health Organization warns of an acute funding shortfall hindering the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Only about 40% of the $115 million needed to combat the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has been raised. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. Government data report at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. WHO Emergency Health Programme head Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu says the response is at a critical stage and intensified efforts are needed to identify and isolate patients, as cases have spread to two new provinces this week. The true burden could be twice to four times the official figures, underscoring the urgency of sustained international support to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ対策の資金不足が深刻
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)のアウトブレイクが拡大し、感染者1,926名・死者702名、新たに2州へ拡大するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、国際的な資金・支援不足が指摘されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョ株のアウトブレイクであり、資金不足により対応が遅延している点が重大。真の感染規模は公表値の2~4倍の可能性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: El ébola avanza a un ritmo sin precedentes en RD del Congo tras dos meses de epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: Ebola advances at an unprecedented pace in DR Congo two months into the outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo strain is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 15 July 2026, two months after the outbreak was declared. The epidemic, the seventh in DRC and the third-largest and fastest-growing on record, has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo; Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. Bundibugyo Ebola carries a 30–50% fatality rate and has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids. MSF calls for faster, coordinated international action and closer community-based response to identify cases quickly and maintain essential health services amid other emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: MSF:「エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で前例のない速さで拡大」流行開始から2カ月
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で、致死率30-50%、複数州・国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはすでに5月17日にPHEIC宣言済みであり、フルRRA・継続モニタリングが必要。
