article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يخرج عن السيطرة بالكونغو.. والصحة العالمية تحذر : 80% من الإصابات مجهولة المصدر - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola" is out of control in Congo, and the World Health Organization warns: 80% of infections are of unknown origin - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies, with the WHO reporting roughly 80% of new East Congo infections linked to unknown transmission sources. As of 2026-07-15, official data show 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths, including 54 new cases in a single day, concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and other eastern regions. The ongoing outbreak, detected since May, involves a rare Bundibugyo lineage for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment yet. The WHO cautions that security and humanitarian crises hinder surveillance and contact tracing, complicating containment. The African CDC describes the outbreak as the fastest-spreading in Africa to date. In response, Oxford University has launched the first global clinical trial testing a vaccine for Bundibugyo, enrolling 50 volunteers in the UK to evaluate safety and immunogenicity, aiming to curb transmission and prevent spread to other countries.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がコンゴで制御不能に…WHOが警告：感染の80%が感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: 感染源不明例が8割を占め、致死率も高く、ワクチン未承認の稀な系統(Bundibugyo)による急速拡大がアフリカCDCにより指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 英国はOxford大学の臨床試験実施地であり、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo系統は稀でワクチン未承認、致死率約37.5%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: OMS începe primul studiu clinic pentru un antiviral împotriva tulpinii Bundibugyo a virusului Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO begins the first clinical trial of an antiviral against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts WHO to launch the first clinical trial of an antiviral for post-exposure prophylaxis. The trial, named EBO-PEP, tests Obeldesivir, an oral antiviral developed by Gilead Sciences, for people with direct exposure to confirmed Bundibugyo patients. The aim is to prevent disease after exposure; lab studies show activity against filoviruses that cause severe hemorrhagic fever. No vaccine or treatment is approved for Bundibugyro yet. The outbreak, declared in May, mainly affects Ituri province, with confirmed cases also in other RDC regions and in Uganda. Official counts exceed 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths, though WHO says the true number could be two to four times higher. If effective, the antiviral could be a major step in protecting high-risk contacts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルス・ブンディブギョ株に対する初の抗ウイルス薬臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模アウトブレイクが継続中で、感染者1960人超・死者700人超に達し、ウガンダにも波及している国際的公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOによる実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性があるとされ、被害規模は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: لا نملك سوى أقل من نصف التمويل اللازم لمكافحة إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: We have less than half of the funding needed to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, the World Health Organization states that funding for the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is less than half of the $115 million appeal, with about 40% of funds received. The outbreak involves the Ebola virus disease due to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no proven treatment or vaccine. Government data cited by WHO show at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. The response is at a critical point, requiring intensified case finding and isolation as cases spread this week to two further provinces beyond the hardest-hit Ituri region. The WHO cautions that the true number of infections is likely at least double the official tally, possibly more than four times. Donors are urged not to abandon the Democratic Republic of the Congo during this critical phase.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ対策に必要な資金の半分未満しか確保できていない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模アウトブレイクで死者702名、感染1926名に達し、資金不足と対策地域拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 有効な治療法・ワクチンがないブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、感染がイトゥリ州から新たに2州へ拡大。実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍以上と推定され、資金不足により対応が危機的状況にある。

article.articleHeadline: Sjoerdsma maakt 4 miljoen euro extra vrij voor bestrijding ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sjoerdsma frees up an additional €4 million for the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Netherlands allocates €4 million for the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda to the World Health Organization (WHO), announced by Development Cooperation Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma via X. The funding adds to a prior €3 million, bringing Dutch support to €7 million. The DRC has reported over 2,000 Ebola cases and more than 750 deaths, with the death toll doubling over two weeks. The WHO warns the outbreak could be two to four times larger than currently known, prompting renewed international funding. The funds will support WHO-led response efforts in both the DRC and Uganda as healthcare systems come under strain. The allocation aims to accelerate surveillance, case management, and vaccination efforts where applicable.

triage.headline_ja: スヨルドスマ氏、エボラ対策に追加400万ユーロを拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000件超のエボラ症例、750人超の死亡、死者数が2週間で倍増しており、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を警告。国際的資金拠出も発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが、記事本文では具体的な症例数の言及はなくDRCが主題。オランダは支援国であり発生国ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 廣東：6月新冠確診超2.6萬例，流感超27萬例，疾控提醒 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong: June COVID-19 cases exceed 26,000; influenza cases exceed 270,000; disease-control authorities remind.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong reported 2026 June figures: 26,117 new COVID-19 infections (0 deaths), 274,328 influenza cases (1 death), and 70,016 hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) with no deaths. Total statutory infectious diseases reached 429,628 cases, with 129 deaths. Category A had no cases or deaths. Category B accounted for 64,546 cases and 128 deaths, led by COVID-19, hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis, and gonorrhea, comprising about 94.7% of Category B. Category C recorded 365,082 cases and 1 death, top causes: influenza, HFMD, and other infectious diarrhea. Experts note no clear seasonality for SARS-CoV-2; nationwide June new cases were 79,000, with a summer uptick attributed to waning immunity and more indoor exposure. The prevailing Omicron NB.1.8.1 sublineage remains; most infections mild, severe risk in elderly and those with chronic conditions. Preventive guidance emphasizes hygiene, masking in dense settings, ventilation, and timely medical care. Vaccination against HFMD EV71 is advised for 6 months to 5 years; for influenza, protect high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省：6月の新型コロナ確定例2.6万件超、インフルエンザ27万件超、疾病対策当局が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の定例感染症統計報告であり、COVID-19・インフルエンザ・HFMDともに既知の流行パターン内で重症度も低く、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 定例の統計公表記事。専門家はSARS-CoV-2の季節性が明確でないと指摘するが、夏季の免疫低下・室内曝露増加による通常の増加傾向として説明されており、特段のシグナルとは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: La RD Congo supera los 2.000 casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 2,000 Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri epicenter) has reached 2,011 cases and 754 deaths (case fatality 37.5%) as of July 13, with 753 people in isolation and 366 recoveries; contact tracing is 67.4%. The circulating virus is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a strain with 30–50% fatality and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Affected eastern provinces include Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, as well as Tshopo and Haut-Uele; the outbreak has also reached Uganda. Estimates suggest the true burden could be 2–4 times higher than reported, prompting urgent needs for strengthened surveillance, diagnostics, and operational readiness. Healthcare workers in northeast DRC are on strike over unpaid wages, complicating response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行(致死率37.5%)であり、ワクチン未承認株の流行、国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大、医療従事者ストライキ等の管理困難要因が重なりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEICを既に宣言済みであり、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy kịch vì viêm màng não và phù não cấp sau ăn tiết canh lợn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Life-threatening meningitis and acute cerebral edema after eating raw pork blood dish
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis meningitis with cerebral edema in a 45-year-old man from Bac Ninh, Vietnam, after eating a raw pork blood dish. Four days after ingestion he developed high fever, severe headache, nausea, progressing to altered consciousness (Glasgow Coma Scale 9). Acute meningitis diagnosed; he required intubation, mechanical ventilation, antibiotics, and measures to control cerebral edema. After four days of intensive care his condition improved, extubated, and transferred to the Infectious Diseases ward for monitoring. Streptococcus suis is a leading cause of meningitis in Vietnamese adults and can cause septicemia with purpura, coagulopathy, septic shock, and multi-organ failure, with high mortality if treatment is delayed. Many cases occur even when patients deny pork products due to contamination from pork blood mixed to thicken dishes. Public health guidance emphasizes fully cooked foods and seeking medical care if fever or headache after consuming raw foods. Source: National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 生の豚血料理を食べた後、髄膜炎と急性脳浮腫で重篤化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで既知の食品媒介性疾患であるStreptococcus suis感染による単発重症例であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suisは豚肉・豚血料理の生食を介したベトナムで既知の風土病であり、単発症例報告のためシグナルとしての優先度は低い。ヒト-ヒト感染は起こらず、公衆衛生上の緊急性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC and SIMBA integrate Biological Security into the Response to the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda highlights cross-border biosecurity risks and regional health security threats. SIMBA, with GP, WHO, Africa CDC, INTERPOL, and BTWC-aligned approaches, provides a framework to integrate biosecurity into outbreak response and strengthen sustainable national capacities. GP pledges include safe, secure management of Bundibugyo virus–related patient samples across the full lifecycle; facility and equipment security; protection of Ebola treatment centers, laboratories, and sample transport; validated sample inventories, access controls, chain-of-custody, secure cold-chain, and incident reporting with law enforcement. Waste management and inactivation or destruction of residual samples; consolidation of retained samples in secure, quality-assured national repositories or biobanks; avoid decentralized facilities lacking biosafety standards. Ethical research with access/benefit-sharing; safeguards against dual-use; frontline and lab workforce capacity building; multisectoral coordination across public health, security, veterinary, customs, border management, transport, research, and communities; cross-border cooperation with harmonized sample referral and laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCとSIMBAがブンディブギョウイルス病（BVD）アウトブレイク対応に生物学的安全保障を統合
triage.triage_reason: Ebola関連ウイルス（Bundibugyo virus）のアウトブレイクであり、DRC・ウガンダの複数国での発生、国境を越えたバイオセキュリティリスク、地域的健康安全保障の脅威が明記されている。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響）およびWPRO基準（異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ）複数に該当し、国際的な対応枠組みが構築されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダも言及されているが、サマリーの主題・詳細記述はDRCでのアウトブレイク対応に焦点を当てており、ウガンダは「cross-border」文脈での言及に留まっているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo virusはEbola genus内のウイルスであり、深刻な脅威として扱われている。GP（Global Partnership）、WHO、Africa CDC、INTERPOL、BTWC（Biological Weapons Convention）関連機関による多層的な対応枠組みが構築されている点は、国際的対応の必要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Launches First Trial to Prevent Bundibugyo Ebola Infection
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the focus of the WHO’s first clinical trial to prevent infection after exposure. The study, conducted in the DRC where the outbreak is centered and has spread to eastern Congo and into Uganda, tests the experimental antiviral obeldesivir in about 1,000 people aged 12 and older who had close contact with confirmed Ebola patients but are currently asymptomatic. Participants will be monitored to determine whether the drug can stop the disease from developing. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, making this prevention trial a critical step in outbreak control. This initiative reflects urgent international public health efforts to halt transmission among exposed contacts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルス感染予防のための初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダへ拡大しており、承認された治療法・ワクチンがない中でWHOが感染予防のための臨床試験を開始するなど国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急対応が行われているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。エボラは既知の重大疾患であり、承認薬・ワクチンがない中での予防臨床試験開始という国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: MSF urges Ebola response scale-up as Congo outbreak nears 2,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of Sunday, July 12, 2026, making it the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. MSF warns containment and care are not keeping pace, urging rapid expansion of response. The charity runs seven Ebola treatment centers and over 15 isolation units across the country. Ebola causes fever, vomiting, and bleeding and spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids from infected people or animals. The outbreak is in an expansion phase, driven by population movements and delays in treatment, according to the WHO. Gaps in surveillance and care are evident outside urban centers; in Mongbwalu, patients arrive in critical condition with little chance of survival. The U.S. is blocking commercial flights for Americans in Congo; MSF requests more resources for testing, safe burials, and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴのエボラ流行が2,000例に迫る中で対応拡大を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が約1,926例・702人死亡に達し、史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大の流行とされ、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念（米国の渡航制限）も生じているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域ではなく、渡航制限措置の主体として言及されているため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: More health workers go on strike as confirmed Ebola cases in Congo top 2,000, including 754 deaths - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases with 754 deaths as of 15 July 2026. The epicenter is Ituri province, notably Bunia General Hospital and Rwampara General Hospital, where health workers have gone on strike over unpaid salaries and bonuses. Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 753 patients in isolation or hospitals and 366 recoveries; contact tracing coverage stands at 67%. The outbreak began on May 15, and two months in it continues to spread faster than tracking efforts. About 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains; patient zero remains unidentified, and population displacement and mining-related movements hinder follow-up of contacts. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus, unlike Zaire virus. Enrollment for a study of two Ebola treatments recently kicked off in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が2,000人を超え死者754人に、医療従事者のストライキが拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）の大規模アウトブレイクで2,000例超・死者754人、80%が感染経路不明で拡大が追跡を上回っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルスには承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、感染経路の80%が不明。医療従事者のストライキにより対応能力がさらに低下している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de cas confirmés d'Ebola en RDC passe à 2011
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC has reached 2,011.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases, with 754 deaths, authorities in Kinshasa announced on July 15, 2026 (via Reuters). Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, and other bodily fluids of infected individuals, as well as with contaminated surfaces and materials. The report confirms ongoing transmission of Ebola Virus Disease across the country, updating totals to date. There are no further details provided on geographic spread or vaccination status. Public health measures remain critical to interrupt transmission, including safe handling of bodily fluids and stringent infection prevention in both healthcare and community settings.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数が2,011人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例が2,011件、死亡754人と大規模な流行が継続しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%(754/2011)と高く、感染拡大の地理的範囲やワクチン接種状況について詳細が不足しているため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Во ДР Конго регистрирани над 2.000 луѓе заразени со ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, more than 2,000 people infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 754 deaths and 366 recoveries. About 753 people remain in isolation or hospital treatment. Authorities are monitoring five provinces, with the main hotspot in the northeast Ituri province, which borders Uganda and South Sudan. The Information Ministry said no new infections have been recorded in South Kivu in the past 47 days. Ebola is a viral disease that can be life-threatening and spreads through direct contact with blood and secretions of an infected person. The report highlights ongoing transmission across multiple provinces, underscoring the need for continued surveillance and public health measures to control spread and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者2,000人超を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりDRC内で2,000人超の感染、754人の死亡が確認されており、複数州にまたがる継続的な伝播が見られるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の複数州（イトゥリ、南キブ等）における感染拡大に焦点を当てており、ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境隣接国として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生地ではないため対象国リストからは除外。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: More health workers go on strike as confirmed Ebola cases in Congo top 2,000, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri province. By 2026-07-15, the Ministry of Health reports 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 366 recoveries and 753 patients in isolation or hospital. Contact tracing coverage is 67%, and authorities say at least 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains, with patient zero not yet identified. Displacement from armed conflict and mining movements complicate tracing of thousands exposed. Unlike the Zaire Ebola strain, there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus. Enrollment for a study of two possible Ebola therapies has recently kicked off in Ituri. Health workers at Bunia General Hospital have gone on strike over pay, highlighting response challenges at the outbreak’s epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が2000人を超え、死者754人に達する中、医療従事者のストライキがさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブジョ・エボラウイルスの大規模流行が進行中で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、新規症例の80%が感染経路不明という制御困難な状況にあるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ株はザイール株と異なり承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、通常のエボラ対応（rVSV-ZEBOVワクチン等）が適用できない点が特に懸念材料。武力紛争による住民避難や鉱山労働者の移動により接触者追跡が困難化し、感染経路不明症例が80%に達している。医療従事者のストライキも対応能力を著しく低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: РЯЗЪК СКОК: Смъртните случаи от ебола се удвоиха, жертвите са 754!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sharp jump: Ebola deaths have doubled; the death toll stands at 754!
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a severe Ebola outbreak. Confirmed infections have reached 2,011, with 754 deaths since the outbreak began. A total of 753 patients are currently in hospitals or isolation centers under close supervision. Five provinces are under watch, with the northeastern Ituri province remaining the main hotspot near the Uganda and South Sudan borders. Uganda has also reported cases, including two fatalities. In South Kivu, there have been no new cases in 47 days, a cautiously encouraging sign for containment. Transmission continues mainly through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of an infected person. The epidemic remains exceptionally difficult to contain due to the Bundibugyo strain, with no proven vaccine or approved treatment. Since the start of the month, clinical trials for two new antiviral therapies have begun.

triage.headline_ja: 急激な増加：エボラ死者数が倍増、死者は754人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認感染者2,011人、死者754人に達する深刻なエボラ流行であり、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されているため、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよび南スーダンも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。有効なワクチン・治療法が確立されていないBundibugyo株による流行であり、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 2천명 넘어...사망자는 보름만에 2배로
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 2,000... the death toll doubles in two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases, with 2,011 infections and 754 deaths as of July 13, according to the Ministry of Public Health. The case fatality rate rose to 37.5% (from 32% a week earlier), and 366 people have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 67.4%, but officials warn the true spread is larger, with about 80% of new infections outside traced contacts. WHO cautions that many patients never reach care, delaying diagnosis, isolation, and treatment; analyses show roughly 92% of deaths occurred before reaching a treatment facility. North Kivu isolation facilities exceed 120% capacity; Bunia’s treatment centers in Ituri are near full, with wage-related strikes. The outbreak’s true scale may be undercounted. Meanwhile, the United States has started travel restrictions on its citizens leaving DRC, barring boarding on US-bound flights for 21 days, and is preparing a Kenya isolation facility for Americans.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラ確認感染者2000人超え…死者数は半月で倍増
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染者数・死亡者数が急増し致死率も上昇、接触追跡の限界や医療体制の逼迫が確認され、米国が渡航制限を開始するなど国際的な対応も生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCにおける流行は接触追跡外の感染が80%との報告があり、地域拡大・管理不能のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo ya superan los 2 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 13; case fatality 37.5%. About 753 patients are isolated or hospitalized, 366 have recovered; contact tracing 67.4%. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri (epicenter) and has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; this is the third-worst Ebola outbreak on record and the seventeenth in the DRC. Uganda has detected 20 cases, 15 imported from the DRC, including 2 deaths. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱症例数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で致死率37.5%、ウガンダへの国際拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも二次症例が確認されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOはPHEICを5月17日に宣言、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行。

article.articleHeadline: В Великобритании начались клинические испытания первой вакцины против лихорадки Эбола - NEWSru.co.il
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clinical trials of the first Ebola vaccine have begun in the United Kingdom.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Oxford University in the United Kingdom launched the first clinical trials of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, for which no protection had been approved. The Phase I trial enrolls 50 healthy adults aged 18-55 to assess safety and immunogenicity, with evaluation of the immune response against Bundibugyo. The Bundibugyo strain is rarer than the Zaire variant but capable of causing severe disease with high mortality; past outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reported about 40% fatality per the World Health Organization. If Phase I yields favorable results, subsequent larger trials will follow. Researchers argue that vaccines targeting multiple Ebola strains could speed outbreak responses and strengthen health system preparedness for future epidemics, including less common variants.

triage.headline_ja: 英国でエボラ出血熱ワクチンの初の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は英国で実施されるBundibugyo株エボラワクチンの第I相臨床試験に関する内容であり、対象国での実際の感染症アウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験のニュースであり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。過去のウガンダ・DRCでのアウトブレイクは背景情報として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo: l'essai clinique EBO-PEP lancé en RDC et en Ouganda pour protéger les personnes à haut risque
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Bundibugyo: the EBO-PEP clinical trial launched in the DRC and Uganda to protect high-risk individuals.
article.articleSummary: EBO-PEP, a joint effort by INRB (Kinshasa), ANRS MIE/Inserm, and ALIMA, launches the first clinical trial assessing post-exposure prophylaxis for Bundibugyo Ebola virus using the antiviral obeldesivir, in the current outbreak spanning the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The initial sub-study began on July 14, 2026, in Ituri Province (DRC), recruiting adults and children aged 12+ who had direct high-risk contact with a confirmed Ebola case within the prior five days and are symptom-free. Recruitment targets about 1,000 participants near ALIMA-managed PPE centers at Bunia and Rwampara, with daily follow-up for 21 days and a final visit on day 42. A second sub-protocol contemplates compassionate use of remdesivir for children under 12 and for pregnant or lactating women with high-risk exposure. ALIMA coordinates; principal investigators are Pauline Byakika-Kibwika (Uganda MUST), Marie Jaspard (Saint-Antoine/Inserm), and Placide Mbala (INRB). Funding commitments from CDC Africa and regional leaders support rapid deployment if safety and efficacy are demonstrated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョ型：ハイリスク者保護のためEBO-PEP臨床試験がDRCとウガンダで開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）のアウトブレイクがDRCとウガンダの複数州にまたがって進行中であり、国際的拡大と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が既に確認されているため。
triage.notes: 本記事は進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクに対する曝露後予防投与（EBO-PEP）臨床試験開始に関する続報。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無いため verified_locations には含めていない。既存アウトブレイクの継続情報であり、フルRRAでの状況確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: بدء تجربة أول دواء مضاد للفيروسات لعلاج إيبولا لسلالة بونديبوجيو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting the first antiviral drug trial to treat Ebola for the Bundibugyo strain - Youm7
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, researchers have begun enrolling participants in the first antiviral trial for the Ebola Bundibugyo strain, led by Congo’s National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) and France’s Agency for Emerging Infectious Diseases Research. The study tests a post-exposure treatment to reduce infection risk and aims to recruit about 1,000 people aged 12 and older who had high-risk exposure within five days but are asymptomatic. Participants will be monitored daily for 21 days, with a final follow-up on day 42. The antiviral has shown activity against filoviruses, including Bundibugyo Ebola, in preclinical work. The sponsor donated 2,400 bottles and 2,000 vials. Initial funding totals €3.4 million (~$3.87 million) from Global Health Partnership via the EC, plus $1 million from CDC Africa, and about $5 million pledged by South Africa and the DRC. A compassionate-use protocol will provide the drug to children under 12 and pregnant or lactating women at risk. Congo reports 1,963 confirmed cases, including 719 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ株エボラ治療のための初の抗ウイルス薬治験開始 - Youm7
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（1,963例確定、719死亡）に関する重要な続報であり、国際的な資金・支援体制（EC、CDC Africa、南アフリカ）が動員されている点で公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際関与が確認できる。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株流行（DRC・ウガンダ）に対する新規抗ウイルス薬治験開始の報道。ウガンダ・南アフリカ・フランスは治験実施・資金提供国であり対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCの流行状況（1,963例、719死亡）は深刻で継続的国際支援が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Bundibugyo, parte la sperimentazione clinica sui primi possibili trattamenti - Federazione Nazionale degli Ordini dei Biologi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo virus, clinical trials begin for the first potential treatments - National Federation of the Orders of Biologists.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease, one of the Ebola-group viral hemorrhagic fevers, is driving an ongoing epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The PARTNERS trial, promoted by the World Health Organization with Congolese INRB, Belgium’s Institute of Tropical Medicine, and the University of Oxford, evaluates two antivirals—MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir—alone or in combination. The randomized controlled study enrolls patients of all ages with laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo virus infection and requires at least 28 days of follow-up. Currently no treatments are approved for this form of disease. The trial has not demonstrated efficacy yet; its purpose is to generate evidence during the emergency by integrating clinical research with the health response.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルス、初の治療薬候補に関する臨床試験開始 - イタリア生物学者団体連盟
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ属（ブンディブギョウウイルス）による出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、WHO主導の国際共同臨床試験が行われていることから、重篤性・国際的関与ともに高い。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョウウイルス病（エボラ属出血熱）に対する治療薬臨床試験（PARTNERS試験）に関する内容で、DRCでの進行中の流行が背景。ベルギー・英国は研究協力機関であり発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Moms, Waspada DBD Mengintai si Kecil! Lakukan Ini saat Gejalanya Mulai Terdeteksi : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moms, beware: Dengue fever is lurking around your little one! Do this when its symptoms start to appear: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is increasingly common in the Asia-Pacific region, with significant impact on children as schools reopen. In Jakarta, prevention hinges on avoiding mosquito bites, recognizing early dengue symptoms, and knowing when to see a doctor. UNICEF explains that Aedes aegypti mosquitoes bite mainly during the day, with the highest risk about two hours after sunrise and before sunset. Transmission risk rises around homes, schools, workplaces, or routes with standing water, since Aedes aegypti can breed in even tiny amounts of water. Common breeding sites include buckets, discarded tires, puddles, or bottle caps. Most infections cause mild symptoms or none and recover in 1–2 weeks; roughly one in four people develop symptoms. Early recognition and timely medical care are crucial for protecting children during the school year.

triage.headline_ja: ママたち注意：デング熱が子どもたちを狙っています！症状が出始めたらすぐにこれを実行して
triage.triage_reason: デング熱予防・症状に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な増加や特定のアウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のデング熱予防に関する一般啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数増加やアウトブレイクの報告はない。中国の情報は本記事の主題に無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉籠罩民主剛果　世衛：抗疫經費籌不到一半
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola grips the Democratic Republic of the Congo; WHO: less than half of outbreak-response funding has been raised.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with government data reporting at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. The World Health Organization says outbreak response funding is less than half of the US$115 million needed, with about 40% raised to date. WHO emergency response chief Chikwe Ihekweazu, speaking in Geneva, urged donors not to abandon the country during this critical phase, stressing that resources must match the outbreak's scale and that the DRC cannot bear the burden alone. He also warned that the true Ebola case count in DRC is likely at least double, possibly quadruple the official tally, indicating substantial underreporting. The report underscores the ongoing challenge of managing a prolonged, resource-intensive response amid funding gaps.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を席巻、WHO：対策資金は必要額の半分未満しか集まらず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（感染1,926人、死亡702人）が継続し、資金不足や過小報告の懸念もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の継続的流行を主題としている。ウガンダ（Bundibugyo地名）やジュネーブ（WHO本部）は地名として出現するが、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。真の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍と推定され、過小報告の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases top 2,000 in Congo, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of 15 July 2026. The outbreak began May 15, with Ituri province's Bunia identified as the worst-hit area. The WHO notes the outbreak is spreading faster than surveillance can track, with about 80% of new cases arising from unknown transmission chains. Health authorities have yet to identify patient zero. Displacements from armed conflict and mining-related movements hinder contact tracing, complicating containment. A large share of recent deaths occurred in communities without access to health facilities or care. WHO's emergencies chief Dr Chikwe Ihekweazu, returning from Bunia, highlighted ongoing challenges in tracing thousands of contacts and stopping transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が2000人を突破、死者754人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が2000例・754人の死者に達し、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占めるなど制御不能な拡大が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 武力紛争と鉱山関連の人口移動が接触者追跡を妨げており、感染経路の80%が不明のまま拡大している点が特に懸念される。WHO緊急事態責任者が現地入りするなど国際的関与も高い。

article.articleHeadline: تفشى إيبولا يتحول إلى ورقة سياسية.. تحالف نهر الكونغو وحركة 23 مارس يوظفان الوباء لتعزيز نفوذهما في شرق البلاد.. تسجيل 4 إصابات فقط في مناطق سيطرة التحالف.. أكثر من 1900 إصابة و700 وفاة في مناطق الحكومة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has become a political card as the Congo River Alliance and the March 23 Movement exploit the epidemic to bolster their influence in eastern parts of the country; only four infections have been recorded in areas controlled by the Alliance; more than 1,900 infections and 700 deaths in government-controlled areas - Youm7.
article.articleSummary: Two parallel health systems operate in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid the Ebola outbreak: the government and the Congo River Alliance, which includes March 23 Movement and controls parts of North Kivu and South Kivu. Since the outbreak began on May 15, the Alliance has built an largely independent response managing surveillance, contact tracing, labs, and health centers, aiming to project governance. Alliance-held areas report only four infections (one in Goma, three near Bokavu) and declared containment after 21 days without new cases; about 400 contacts were followed, with 98% daily engagement, and 207 samples tested by June 18. In government-controlled areas the outbreak is larger: 1,926 infections and 702 deaths, now reaching Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces. Rwanda has sent six experts and provided equipment and supplies worth $6,891 and $85,467. Goma airport has been closed since the alliance seized it; banking disruptions hinder aid transfer. Experts warn that containment in one zone does not guarantee control of a wider outbreak and caution political use of health crises could undermine response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が政治的カードに転化…コンゴ川同盟とM23運動が東部での影響力強化のために疫病を利用…同盟支配地域では感染4例のみ、政府支配地域では1900例超の感染と700人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1900例超・700人以上の死者を出すエボラ大規模流行が継続し、複数州へ拡大、空港閉鎖や国際支援（ルワンダ）も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ルワンダは支援国として言及されているが発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当しても除外（Rwandaはリスト対象国に含まれない）。政治的対立による保健対応の分断がリスク評価上の重要な複雑要因。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в Конго выходит из-под контроля: Врачи не успевают сдерживать темпы распространения вируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo Out of Control: Doctors Struggle to Contain the Virus's Spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates, with MSF reporting confirmed infections rising from about 650 to nearly 2,000 and deaths from around 130 to over 700 in under five weeks—the fastest and third-largest outbreak on record for the DRC. The epicenters are Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in the east, where armed conflict and population displacements impede response and contact tracing. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccines or specific treatments, exacerbating overwhelmed clinics and resource shortages. Officially, more than 1,960 cases and over 700 deaths have been confirmed; WHO cautions true numbers may be two to four times higher due to limited diagnostics. The virus has crossed borders, with confirmed cases in Uganda and one imported case in France. Since July, trials of potential therapies (remdesivir and MBP134 monoclonal antibody) have begun, and diagnostic capacity has been expanded.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱が制御不能に：医師らはウイルスの拡大速度を抑えきれず
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最速かつ3番目に大きいエボラ流行で、感染者・死者数が急増し、ウガンダ・フランスへの越境例も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダとフランスでの症例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。武力紛争と住民避難が対応を妨げており、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - MSF appelle à une réponse médicale internationale renforcée face à Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - MSF calls for a strengthened international medical response to Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 15, 2026, with 753 patients currently in hospitals or isolation centers. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, has evolved over just two months into the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC. Ituri province in the northeast remains the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo variant-driven outbreak ranks as the third-largest in the DRC's history. MSF (Médecins Sans Frontières) urged an urgent strengthening of the international medical response, saying current resources are insufficient to curb the spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - MSF、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行に対し国際的な医療対応の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定症例2,011人、死亡754人）が発生し、史上3番目の規模かつ最速の拡大速度であり、国際的な医療支援が不足していると専門機関が警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Ituri州が症例の約90%を占める。Bundibugyo変異株による流行で、DRC史上3番目の規模かつ最速の拡大。MSFが国際的な医療対応強化を要請しており、リソース不足が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Indore Shishukunj School Food Poisoning : 150 बच्चों के बीमार होने का खुला राज! स्कूल के पानी में मिला खतरनाक बैक्टीरिया, आइसक्रीम की रिपोर्ट ने भी उड़ाए होश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indore Shishukunj School Food Poisoning: The shocking truth behind 150 children falling ill! Dangerous bacteria found in the school's water, and the ice cream report also left everyone stunned.
article.articleSummary: Indore Shishukunj School in Indore district, Madhya Pradesh, faced a mass food-poisoning event on June 20, with about 150 students developing vomiting and diarrhea. Laboratory findings revealed multiple contamination sources: the school water tested positive for coliform bacteria (the same type implicated in the Bhagirathpura incident); soybean oil and a salted snack sample also failed. Ice cream samples were found to harbor Listeria bacteria, with the ice cream test completely failing. In response, district authorities formed a special investigation team and ordered the school kitchen sealed to prevent further exposure. Food Officer Manish Swami confirmed the findings. The article does not report any fatalities. This incident highlights food safety risks in school canteens and related food items, prompting immediate public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: インドール・シシュクンジ学校の食中毒事件：150人の子供が発症した衝撃の真相！学校の水から危険な細菌検出、アイスクリームの検査結果も衝撃
triage.triage_reason: 単一校内での食中毒事案であり、死亡例なく、地域当局が調理場封鎖など対応済みで国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 食品由来の細菌混入（大腸菌群・リステリア）による学校内食中毒事案。死亡例なし、感染拡大の兆候なし。地元当局により調査・対応が進められている。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai sees rise in dengue, leptospirosis, swine flu this monsoon: How to stay safe
article.articleSummary: Between January and July 14, 2026, Mumbai recorded rising monsoon-related illnesses: malaria 3,681 (up from 3,115), dengue 938 (up from 734), and leptospirosis 157 (up from 136). Swine flu (H1N1) infections nearly tripled to 113 (from 42), while chikungunya declined to 31 (from 179) and COVID-19 to 71 (from 1,049). Health officials attribute the increases to continuous heavy rainfall and waterlogging that boost mosquito breeding and floodwater exposure. The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) issued preventive guidance and expanded prophylaxis for leptospirosis; 90,728 people had received prophylaxis by July 14. Surveillance and vector-control efforts encompassed roughly 10.69 lakh households and 3.68 million people in door-to-door checks; 3,000 construction sites screened; 54,763 workers tested (37 malaria positives). Breeding-site inspections identified 5,341 Anopheles and 22,041 Aedes sites; 66,595 discarded tyres removed; fogging covered 51,937 buildings and 7.95 lakh slum dwellings. Citizens were urged to avoid floodwater, use nets/repellents, boil water, and seek prompt medical care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでこのモンスーン時期にデング熱、レプトスピラ症、豚インフルエンザが増加：安全に過ごす方法
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季節に伴う蚊媒介感染症・水系感染症の症例数増加は例年見られる季節性パターンであり、現地当局（BMC）が予防・媒介動物対策を実施し管理下にある。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ムンバイ市当局（BMC）による季節性サーベイランス報告。マラリア・デング熱・レプトスピラ症・豚インフルエンザの増加は雨季の蚊/水系感染リスク増大によるもので、大規模な媒介動物対策・予防投薬（レプトスピラ予防薬9万人超）が既に実施されている。重症度・死亡率の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak response needs urgent scale-up after two months
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in Ituri province (epicenter, Mongbwalu) caused by Bundibugyo virus has reached >2,000 confirmed cases and >750 deaths as of 12 July, two months after declaration in Bunia. The outbreak is the third largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, with confirmed cases tripling from 650 to ~2,000 in under five weeks and deaths rising from ~130 to >700, surpassing half of 2018-2020 totals. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases. MSF warns that response remains under-resourced and calls for urgent scale-up across surveillance, testing/diagnosis, patient care, survivor support, community engagement, and safe burials, and to bring services closer to communities. MSF runs seven Ebola treatment centres and 15 isolation units (over 430 beds) across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with nearly 1,000 admissions since outbreak began; security and movement restrictions complicate response amid coexistence with other emergencies (cholera, malaria).

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、発生2か月後も対応の緊急拡大が必要
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例2000人超、死者750人超）が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: MSFが監視・検査・患者ケア・安全な埋葬などの対応強化を要請。他の緊急事態（コレラ、マラリア）と同時発生し、治安・移動制限が対応を複雑化させている。国際的な波及の有無については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: More health workers go on strike as confirmed Ebola cases in Congo top 2,000, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases with 754 deaths, per overnight government data, described as the fastest-growing outbreak on record. The epicenter is Bunia, where health workers at Bunia General Hospital went on strike over pay, barricading the entrance as frontline staff report no compensation amid difficult working conditions. The figures indicate sustained transmission and mounting strain on Congo’s health system, with the report noting laboratory-confirmed cases. The article provides no infection source, onset dates, or details on imported/exported cases. The situation underscores the urgent need for continued outbreak containment and ongoing support for healthcare workers at the frontline in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が2,000人を超える中、医療従事者がさらにストライキへ、死者754人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2,011例・754人死亡に達し、史上最速拡大の流行と報じられ、かつ医療従事者ストライキで対応能力が低下しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と管理可能性の懸念が認められる。
triage.notes: 医療従事者のストライキが流行対応能力に影響を及ぼしている点が特に懸念材料。感染源や輸入・輸出症例の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून बना आफत: हरियाणा में डेंगू और मलेरिया के नए मामलों ने बढ़ाई चिंता, 376 लोगों को नोटिस जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon turns into a disaster: In Haryana, new dengue and malaria cases raise concerns, notices issued to 376 people.
article.articleSummary: 3 dengue and 5 malaria cases reported in Rewari district, Haryana, India amid the monsoon. As of July 15, 2026, health teams intensified vector control after dengue larvae were found, issuing notices to 376 residents. 45 Domestic Breeding Checkers will inspect villages, wards, and localities to identify and destroy breeding sites and raise awareness. The authorities will accelerate fogging and larvicidal spraying as needed. Residents are urged to eliminate standing water in old tires, pots, buckets, coolers, and other containers, wear long sleeves, and use mosquito nets at night. Suspected fever, headache, or body pain should be tested promptly at nearby health centers. The response involves coordination between rural panchayats and urban councils to curb transmission and prevent further outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンが災いに:ハリヤナ州でデング熱とマラリアの新規症例が懸念を高め、376人に通知が発行される
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域(ハリヤナ州レワリ県)でのデング熱・マラリアの季節的な少数例（各数件）であり、当局が通常の媒介動物対策を実施している段階で、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の恒例的なデング熱・マラリア発生であり、症例数も少数(デング熱3件、マラリア5件)。地方自治体レベルで対応が完結している。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS lanzó una alerta por contagios desconocidos de ébola tras la muerte de 750 personas en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO issued an alert about unknown Ebola infections after 750 people died in Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-15, the World Health Organization issued an alert over unknown Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has killed more than 750 people and infected over 2,000 since it began in May. About 80% of new infections are not linked to existing transmission chains, driving rapid community spread as many patients die at home, hindering isolation and contact tracing. Africa CDC calls this the continent’s fastest-growing outbreak. In Bunia, authorities expanded hospital capacity and boosted diagnostics from one lab to fourteen. Response is impeded by funding shortages, attacks on health facilities, public mistrust, and a health-worker strike. The outbreak is confirmed to be Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with cases in three Congolese provinces and spillover into Uganda. Last week, experimental treatments entered clinical trials, but experts say they are not yet sufficient to halt the spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴでのエボラ感染急増を受け警戒宣言、死者750人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が急拡大し死者750人超、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占め、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。資金不足、医療施設への攻撃、住民の不信、医療従事者ストライキが対応を阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo DR nuo Ebolos karštligės mirus 754 žmonėms, streikuoja daugiau medikų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: 754 people have died from Ebola virus disease, more healthcare workers are on strike.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces an Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri province, centered in Bunia. The death toll stands at 754, with 753 patients still isolated or treated and 366 recoveries. Transmission is rapid; WHO says at least 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains. The outbreak began May 15 and is spreading faster than authorities can trace contacts, hindered by armed conflict and mining-related population movement, and the absence of a confirmed 'zero' patient. Many deaths occur in communities that never reach health facilities. Healthcare workers across Ituri are on strike after labor disputes at Bunia hospital, barricading the entrance and alleging no compensation despite hard conditions. There are no licensed vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo virus, unlike the Zaire variant which has a vaccine and has driven most recent outbreaks in DR Congo. Ituri has begun enrolling a trial for two possible treatments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルス病で754人死亡、医療従事者のストライキが拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が続き、致死者754人・感染経路不明が8割・治療薬未承認・医療従事者ストライキという複合的な危機的状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・承認済み治療薬が存在せず、武装紛争や鉱山関連の人口移動が接触者追跡を困難にしている。医療従事者のストライキが対応能力をさらに低下させるリスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid 19 News: Symptoms Shift to Milder Forms But Vigilance Urged
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, COVID-19 cases in India show mild, flu-like infections amid the monsoon, with loss of taste/smell now rare. Common symptoms: sore throat, runny nose, low-grade fever, headache, body aches. Despite milder presentations, transmission remains a threat to high-risk individuals; regional increases include active cases in Bangalore and new cases in Mumbai. Andhra Pradesh reports eight active cases and two deaths in patients with severe comorbidities, sparking rapid-response teams and isolation wards; surveillance is also active in Banswara and Kota. North and south spikes, including Karnataka, reflect seasonal patterns. Authorities urge vaccination records checks, digital vaccine certificates, and updated vaccines; testing for persistent respiratory symptoms is advised, with masks in poorly ventilated spaces during peak monsoon. Long Covid affects brain fog, fatigue, palpitations, autonomic dysfunction in 60-70% of sufferers; management emphasizes sequencing and protecting vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19最新情報：症状は軽症化傾向も警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19増加で症状は軽症化しているが、高齢者・基礎疾患患者での死亡例もあり、モンスーン期の季節的変動として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: インド国内の季節性COVID-19動向に関する記事。重症例・死亡例は基礎疾患を有する患者に限定的で、当局は既存の対応体制（サーベイランス、ワクチン接種推奨、マスク着用呼びかけ）で対応中。新規変異株や国際的拡大の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases pass 2000 in Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo virus) in Ituri, centered on Bunia, has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of 15 July 2026. About 753 patients remain in isolation or hospital, with 366 recovered. The outbreak began 15 May and is the fastest-growing on record, continuing to outpace response efforts. Roughly 80% of new cases come from unknown transmission chains, and contact tracing coverage stands at 67%. Authorities have yet to identify patient zero. Displacements from conflict and mining movements hinder tracing of thousands who contacted infected individuals. Unlike Zaire ebolavirus, which has a vaccine, there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus. Health workers at Bunia General Hospital went on strike over pay, and enrolment for a study of two potential treatments began in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、確定症例数が2000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例2,011人・死者754人に達し、史上最速の拡大速度で新規感染の80%が感染経路不明という深刻かつ制御困難な状況であり、ワクチン・治療法未承認のため国際的関心・支援ニーズも極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスにはワクチン・承認治療薬が存在せず、紛争・鉱山労働者の移動により接触者追跡が困難。医療従事者のストライキも発生しており、対応能力の逼迫が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alarmı büyüyor! Vaka sayısı 2 bini geçti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alarm grows! Case count surpasses 2,000.
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (declared May 15) continues to worsen. Confirmed Ebola cases have reached 2,011, with 754 deaths and 366 recoveries. About 753 people remain in isolation; contact tracing and quarantine efforts are ongoing. The Ituri province remains the most affected, with persistent transmission, while Haut-Uele has reported new cases, signaling spread to additional regions. Authorities describe the outbreak as still in a continuous-transmission phase and emphasize the need to strengthen surveillance, expand diagnostic capacity, and widen field operations. Rapid case finding, early diagnosis, and isolation are identified as the most critical steps to curb the epidemic's trajectory.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報拡大！症例数が2,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が2,000例超・死者754名に達し、複数州に拡大する継続的な伝播フェーズにあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: IturiおよびHaut-Uele州で継続的な症例増加が報告されており、致死率も高い（約37%）。既存のDRCエボラ流行の悪化を示すシグナルであり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل أكثر من 2000 حالة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo records more than 2,000 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 2,000 Ebola virus disease cases with 754 deaths in the ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak that began May 15, described by authorities as the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. Health ministry data show 753 patients are in isolation or hospital and 366 have recovered to date; tracing challenges persist, with only 67% coverage. In Bunia, health-care workers at Bunia General Hospital began a strike on Wednesday in protest over pay, with the entrance to the facility closed as frontline staff decry lack of compensation despite difficult working conditions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ症例2,000人以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・死者754人に達する進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行があり、当局は「記録上最速の拡大」と表明。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡のカバー率が67%と低く、ヒト-ヒト感染継続のリスクが高い。またBunia総合病院での医療従事者ストライキが対応能力に影響する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Сдерживать вспышку Эболы в ДРК становится все сложнее -- MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Containing the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is becoming increasingly difficult — MSF.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak containment for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is becoming increasingly difficult as transmission accelerates, according to Trish Newport, MSF’s head of emergencies. MSF warns the international community is still chasing the outbreak rather than getting ahead of it, with more people infected and more families losing loved ones, complicating control efforts. In less than five weeks, confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC surged from 650 to nearly 2,000, while deaths rose from about 130 to over 700. MSF characterizes this as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history and the third-largest by scale. The organization calls for more decisive, better-coordinated international action to stem transmission and support affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ流行、封じ込めがますます困難に―国境なき医師団（MSF）
triage.triage_reason: エボラの急速な拡大（5週間未満で症例数が3倍増、死亡者数も急増）と国際社会による対応不足がMSFにより指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: MSFはDRC史上最速の拡大速度、かつ規模で3番目に大きいエボラ流行と評価。国際的な対応強化が急務とされており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Crece la huelga de trabajadores de salud en Congo mientras el brote de ébola supera los 2.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health workers' strike grows in Congo as the Ebola outbreak surpasses 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: By July 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, marking the fastest-growing surge, government data show. Health workers at Bunia General Hospital in Ituri have gone on strike over unpaid wages, while frontline staff block entry to the facility. Of note, 753 people remain in isolation or hospitalized and 366 have recovered. Contact tracing coverage is about 67% of exposed individuals. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus since May 15, continues to spread faster than tracing can keep pace, with WHO reporting about 80% of new cases from unknown transmission chains and the patient zero still unidentified. Lacking vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo, response is hampered, unlike Zaire ebolavirus where vaccines exist. A two-treatment study recently began enrollment in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が2000例を超える中、医療従事者のストライキが拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2,000例超・死者754人に達し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認の株であること、接触追跡が追いついておらず80%が未知の感染経路であるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirusに対するワクチン・承認された治療法が存在せず、対応が困難な状況。医療従事者のストライキが対応能力にさらに悪影響を及ぼしている。

article.articleHeadline: بدء تجربة أول دواء مضاد للفيروسات لعلاج إيبولا لسلالة بونديبوجيو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First antiviral drug trial to treat Ebola for the Bundibugyo strain begins
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, researchers in the Democratic Republic of Congo launched the first antiviral drug trial to treat Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with transmission continuing into Uganda. The study, led by the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) in Congo in collaboration with the French National Agency for Infectious Diseases, will enroll about 1,000 participants aged 12 years and older who have been exposed to Ebola within the previous five days but are asymptomatic. Daily follow-up lasts 21 days, with a final assessment on day 42. The antiviral, donated by an American company, comes with 2,400 bottles and 2,000 vials for the trial. Funding totals €3.4 million from the Global Health Partnership supported by the European Commission, plus $1 million from Africa CDC. The Congo outbreak has 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルス病治療のための初の抗ウイルス薬治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが1,963症例・719死亡に達し、ウガンダへの伝播も報告されている。国際的な治験実施・資金支援も行われており、フルRRAの対象とすべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国・フランスは治験の資金提供・協力機関であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - July 15, 2026
article.articleSummary: Two common drugs may offer short-term relief of long-COVID fatigue, addressing a healthcare gap for about 1%–5% of adults worldwide. In the United States, COVID-19 activity is uneven: as of July 8, 2026, 11 states show rising infections, 18 declining, and 21 unchanged; the NB.1.8.1 'Nimbus' subvariant now dominates, accounting for 43% of June cases, with wastewater signaling high viral levels in the South and West. In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak persists amid underfunding; WHO says cases are likely undercounted and many transmissions occur through unknown chains. By July 8, 2026, 1,792 cases and 625 deaths were confirmed, with about 12,000 contacts identified and ~79% followed. Gilead is launching an Ebola post-exposure prophylaxis trial; a second American has been infected, with some reports placing the death toll over 700. Long-COVID may cause ocular symptoms (up to 35%) and is linked to ongoing inflammation and nerve damage.

triage.headline_ja: Balloon Juice - 疫病・パンデミック最新情報 - 2026年7月15日
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが資金不足の中で拡大し、感染連鎖の多くが不明であること、米国内での感染例が報告されていることから、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 米国のCOVID-19動向やLong-COVIDに関する記述も含まれるが、これらは既知の継続的状況であり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。DRCのエボラアウトブレイクは資金不足・症例過小報告・不明な感染連鎖・米国人感染例の存在から継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: आंध्र प्रदेश में कोविड से 2 मौतें, 8 नए मामले मिले: क्या फिर लौट रहा है कोरोना? जानें स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने क्या कहा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two COVID-19 deaths in Andhra Pradesh, eight new cases detected: Is the coronavirus returning again? Find out what the health department said.
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths and eight new infections were reported in Andhra Pradesh, India, with Kadapa district most affected. The deceased include a patient who died on June 28 after post-mortem RT-PCR confirmed COVID-19 and a 46-year-old man who died on July 7 from severe dyspnea and pneumonia, with chest CT showing extensive lung damage. The eight confirmed cases comprise five from Kadapa and three contacts; all are under observation. Health officials say these are sporadic cases, not a new wave or outbreak, and no new cases were reported in six days. Virus sequencing is underway: samples from the patients and fatalities have been sent to the National Institute of Virology in Pune to identify the variant, with Omicron sub-variant suspected but not yet confirmed. Authorities emphasize vigilance, especially for older adults, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals, and urge testing for fever, cough, sore throat, or breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州でコロナウイルスによる死亡2例、新規感染8例確認：コロナは再び流行しているのか？保健当局の見解
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な死亡・感染例が報告されているが、保健当局は新たな流行ではないとしており、変異株の特定調査中のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はアンドラ・プラデーシュ州（Kadapa県）における散発的なCOVID-19症例に関する報道で、保健当局は新規流行ではないと説明。変異株（オミクロン亜系統疑い）の特定のためNIVプネーでシーケンス解析中であり、結果次第で評価を更新する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Cases Rising Again in India | Doctors Warn: Don't Ignore These Symptoms
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising again in India as of 2026-07-15, with Hyderabad noting a gradual nationwide increase. Doctors warn many symptoms resemble common viral fevers, risking delayed testing. Predominant symptoms include fever, persistent dry cough, and severe body aches; fatigue, sore throat, and loss of smell or taste are also reported. Individuals experiencing these signs should isolate and get a COVID-19 test promptly rather than self-medicating. Senior citizens and people with underlying conditions such as diabetes and heart disease are at higher risk of severe illness and should exercise extra caution. Preventive measures remain essential: masks in crowded places, regular hand hygiene, and social distancing where possible. Authorities urge the public to seek medical advice if symptoms develop and to follow official guidelines, while avoiding misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: インドで新型コロナウイルス感染症の症例が再び増加中 | 医師らが警告：これらの症状を見逃さないで
triage.triage_reason: インドで新型コロナ症例の緩やかな増加が報告されているが、重症度や規模に関する具体的データが乏しく、既知の疾患であるため現時点ではフルRRAの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり季節的増加の可能性がある。具体的な症例数・重症度データが不足しているため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يشتد في الكونغو.. ومنظمة الصحة تحذر من نقص التمويل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola intensifies in the Congo, and the World Health Organization warns of funding shortfalls
article.articleSummary: Global health officials warn that funding shortfalls threaten the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, with the Bundibugyo strain, for which no proven treatment or widely available vaccine exists. The World Health Organization reports the response has received only about 40% of a $115 million appeal, hindering containment efforts. Government data list at least 1,926 cases and 702 deaths, though WHO cautions the true tally may be higher due to surveillance challenges. In recent days, cases have spread to two additional provinces beyond Ituri, heightening the need for rapid testing, isolation, and contact tracing to curb community transmission. WHO official Chikwe Ihekweazu urged international donors not to abandon the response, noting obstacles such as weak resources, limited access, community mistrust, and deaths outside health facilities, which complicate transmission tracking.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染拡大…WHOが資金不足を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州を中心にエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が複数州へ拡大し、致死率が高く（1,926症例中702死亡）、資金不足により対応が阻害されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 有効な治療法・広く利用可能なワクチンがないブンディブギョ株であり、コミュニティの不信感や医療施設外での死亡など監視上の課題も指摘されている。資金不足（必要額の約40%のみ確保）が対応の障害となっている点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊7.9万例，多款抗病毒药销量骤增
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: June sees 79,000 new COVID-19 cases; sales of several antiviral drugs surge.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 in China recorded 79,000 new COVID-19 cases, 130 severe cases and 1 death, with fever clinic visits rising from 58,000 on June 1 to 65,000 by June 30. Influenza-like illness positivity rose from 2.9% to 6.4% in weeks 23–26. The dominant Omicron NB.1.8.1 lineage and sublineages remain; no evidence of a new variant of public health concern. Public demand for respiratory products surged: July 6–13 COVID-related medications up 32% week-on-week; influenza drugs also climbed, led by the Pearl River Delta, Yangtze River Delta, and Central China; Wuhan, Xiamen and Kunming >40% weekly growth. JD.com: COVID drug sales nearly 6× prior month; self-test kits doubled; Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Shanghai influenza drugs up >50%. Alibaba Health reports near 100% rise in COVID-drug searches; three mainstream oral antivirals driving demand. Public health guidance emphasizes hygiene, ventilation, testing, and evidence-based treatment; high-risk groups should seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ新規感染確定7.9万例、複数の抗ウイルス薬の販売が急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の感染者増加および薬剤需要の急増が見られるが、新規変異株や重症化率の異常上昇は確認されておらず、既知の流行パターンの範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既存優勢株NB.1.8.1の継続流行であり、新たな懸念変異株の証拠はないと明記されている。死亡者数・重症例数は限定的で、医薬品需要増は季節性流行に対する消費者行動の反映とみられる。米国（New York等）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事主題はすべて中国国内の状況であるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Artsen staken werk in door ebola geteisterd Oost-Congo, aantal vastgestelde overlijdens in twee weken verdubbeld
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors strike in Ebola-stricken eastern Congo; number of confirmed deaths in two weeks has doubled.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo around Bunia worsened as healthcare workers strike over overtime pay, blocking hospital access. By 15 July 2026, deaths have doubled in two weeks—from 377 on 28 June to 754—while confirmed cases exceed 2,000; the World Health Organization cautions the true burden may be 2–4 times higher. Approximately 753 Ebola patients are in home isolation or hospital; 366 have recovered. In at least 80% of new infections, a patient zero cannot be identified. The outbreak is believed to have originated near Mongbwalu, about 75 km from Bunia. Containment is hindered by hundreds of gold miners continuing to work in the eastern mines, complicating surveillance and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らがストライキ、エボラ被害の東コンゴで死者数が2週間で倍増
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者数・症例数が急増し、医療従事者のストライキで対応体制が崩壊、感染経路不明例が多数あるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ管理困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 医療従事者のストライキによる医療アクセス遮断、感染源不明例が80%以上、金鉱山労働者による接触追跡の困難さなど、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。WHOも実際の被害規模はより大きい可能性を指摘している。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. أكثر من ألفي إصابة "إيبولا" و754 وفاة في أسرع تفش للمرض - شفق نيوز | آخر الأخبار العاجلة في العراق وكوردستان والعالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo... More than 2,000 Ebola infections and 754 deaths in the fastest outbreak of the disease - Shafaq News | The latest breaking news in Iraq, Kurdistan and the world
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo escalates to the fastest-spreading wave to date, driven by the Bundibugyo lineage and starting May 15, 2026. Counts exceed 2,000 infections with 754 deaths; about 753 cases remain in isolation or hospital, and 366 have recovered. The health sector is strained as staff at Bonia General Hospital strike over delayed wages, effectively blocking access. Contact tracing coverage is limited (about 67%), hindering containment, while the World Health Organization reports that at least 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains. Despite expanded response efforts, transmission continues to accelerate, indicating ongoing, widespread transmission across affected areas in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ...最速のエボラ流行で2000人以上感染、754人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当し、感染者2000人超・死亡754人という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と、史上最速の流行拡大という異常性、80%が感染経路不明という国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統によるエボラ流行で、コンタクトトレーシングのカバー率が約67%と低く、新規感染の80%以上が不明な感染経路によるとWHOが報告。医療従事者のストライキにより医療アクセスが阻害されている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les soignants menacent de grève, l'OMS alerte sur la contamination
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Healthcare workers threaten to strike, WHO warns about contamination.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached about 2,000 confirmed cases with over 700 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. As of July 12, 727 patients are enrolled in Ebola treatment centers across five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele—centered in Ituri at the Rwampara facility. The World Health Organization says the outbreak could be two to four times larger than official counts. Frontline health workers report unpaid salaries since May 15; at Rwampara they burned tires and threatened a general strike after a 48-hour ultimatum for wages and bonuses. So far, 112 health workers have been infected, 35 have died. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment; two treatments are in a clinical trial. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; cross-border spillover remains a concern. International donors pledged about $1.5 billion to support the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：医療従事者がストライキを警告、WHOが感染拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 確定約2000例・死亡700超の大規模エボラ流行で、医療従事者感染・給与未払いによるストライキ懸念、ウガンダへの越境例も報告されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例（20例、死亡2）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘しており、状況は流動的で継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 國內腸病毒持續升溫 大魔王腸病毒71型結合多價疫苗拚完整防護
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic enterovirus infections continue to rise as the formidable Enterovirus 71 multivalent-conjugate vaccine aims for complete protection.
article.articleSummary: Enteroviruses remain a key infant health threat, with EV71 capable of severe CNS complications and death; vaccination is recommended. In Taiwan, week 27 outpatient visits reached 7,308, down 5% from 7,694 due to typhoon-related clinic closures, but overall enterovirus activity is rising. Coxsackie A6 is the most common serotype, followed by Coxsackie A4 and EV-D68. This year there have been six severe enterovirus infections, including one death, comprising four EV-D68, one CVA4, and one CVA16. Nearby, Vietnam reports about 55,000 cases from December last year to June this year, EV71-predominant with ongoing severe and fatal cases in Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces; Hong Kong shows fluctuations. Despite EV71 vaccines, other serotypes drive HFMD and herpangina, with manifestations including widespread rash, oral ulcers, dehydration, peeling skin, and nail shedding. Multi-valent EV vaccines offer broader protection; domestic biotech firms are developing second-generation vaccines leveraging the EV71 platform, with PIC/S GMP facilities and CMC capabilities, pursuing TFDA/CDE advisory guidance to facilitate clinical design, quality development, and regulatory pathways for commercialization to strengthen protection in Taiwan and internationally.

triage.headline_ja: 国内エンテロウイルス感染が持続的に増加、強敵エンテロウイルス71型は多価ワクチンで完全な防御を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・ベトナムでのエンテロウイルス(EV71等)流行は季節性のものであり異常性は低いが、ベトナムでの重症・死亡例の継続と大規模症例数(約55,000例)は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾におけるエンテロウイルス流行状況とワクチン開発だが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナムでの重症・死亡例継続の記述があるため含めた。香港も言及されているが対象国外。季節性のエンテロウイルス/HFMD流行であり、例年発生するため異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : les prestataires de la riposte contre Ebola haussent le ton pour réclamer le paiement de leurs rémunérations - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Ebola response service providers raise their voices to demand payment of their remuneration - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri's Bunia, Ebola virus disease response service providers under Bunia's sub-coordination protested at the Bunia General Referral Hospital over unpaid remuneration for staff mobilized in the Ebola response. They say payments remain pending despite assurances from the Health Minister during a Bunia visit, with some paid and many not, and no official explanation for the discrepancy. The action follows a similar protest in the Rwampara health zone, where a memorandum was delivered to the Health Inspector General accusing non-payment of allowances. They warn that ongoing non-payment could impair field teams and the effectiveness of Ebola containment efforts, and they have yet to receive an official response from health authorities as of 2026-07-15.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:エボラ対応従事者が報酬未払いを訴え声を上げる - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: DRCの現行エボラ対応において、対応要員への報酬未払いを巡る抗議行動が発生しており、対応能力・封じ込め効果への悪影響が懸念されるため、社会的・政治的関心と管理可能性の観点からフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラの新規症例や感染拡大そのものではなく、対応要員への報酬未払いを巡る抗議活動が主題。しかし報酬未払いが続けば現地の対応チームの機能低下・封じ込め効果の低下につながる恐れがあり、既存のエボラ対応の実効性に関するリスクとして注視が必要。ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなく除外した。

article.articleHeadline: मधुबनी में 1.77 लाख लोगों की टीबी जांच में 2947 मरीज मिले, 14 अगस्त तक चलेगा अभियान - bihar health mission tb screening campaign 2947 patients found
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Madhubani, TB screening of 177,000 people detected 2,947 TB cases; the campaign will run until August 14 - Bihar Health Mission TB Screening Campaign 2,947 Patients Found.
article.articleSummary: Madhubani district, Bihar, under the TB-Free India campaign, has screened over 177,000 people, identifying 2,947 presumptive TB cases. Special screening will run in 279 villages until August 14. The state government issued directions to run the campaign in mission mode. Confirmatory testing for presumptive cases will be done with CBNAAT and TruNat. The rollout emphasizes screening, radiology, testing, treatment, and real-time reporting on the Nikshay portal. High-risk groups include urban slums, Dalit and tribal hostels, prisons, old age homes, orphanages, juvenile homes, severely malnourished children, pregnant women, people over 60, diabetes and HIV patients; microplans will be prepared district-wide with micro-screens. AI-powered ultra-portable X-ray machines will be used, targeting about 100 X-rays per machine daily. Household contacts of pulmonary TB patients will be screened; preventive treatment provided if no active TB. Khushi e-sangini chatbot will be installed for patients and families. Daily progress due by 10 AM.

triage.headline_ja: マドゥバニで17万7000人のTBスクリーニングにより2947人の患者を発見、キャンペーンは8月14日まで実施
triage.triage_reason: 既存の国家的TB対策キャンペーンの通常の進捗報告であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や新興感染症のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事はビハール州の既存の国家的TB撲滅プログラムの実施状況を報告するもの。新規の異常事象ではないためDISMISS判定。

article.articleHeadline: Adinkes Papua Selatan perkuat pencegahan kasus HIV/AIDS, TBC, malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Papua Health Office strengthens prevention of HIV/AIDS, TB, and malaria.
article.articleSummary: South Papua Province's health authorities, through Adinkes South Papua (Papsel), are intensifying prevention and control of HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis (TB), and malaria in Merauke Regency. Nelson Sasari, Senior Expert Staff to the South Papua Governor for Economic, Financial, Development, and Development Affairs, said in a press release that prevention and control are direct assignments from the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Home Affairs. Globally, an estimated 1.3 million people are infected with HIV, 10.7 million with TB, and 282 malaria cases annually. In South Papua, estimated local burdens include 4,606 TB cases, 292 HIV cases, 220 AIDS cases, and 180,582 malaria-positive cases. The initiative aims to achieve disease elimination by 2030 and promotes sustained, systematic prevention and healthy living.

triage.headline_ja: 南パプア保健局、HIV/AIDS・結核・マラリアの予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病（HIV、結核、マラリア）に対する行政の通常の予防強化策の報道であり、突発的な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既存の慢性感染症対策に関する行政広報であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。地域の疾病負担データは継続的な曝露の指標として言及されているが、緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Doğrulanan Ebola Vakaları 2 Bin 11'e Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola Cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose to 2,011.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths in an ongoing outbreak. Kinshasa authorities, cited via SANA and Reuters, provided the latest counts, indicating continued transmission within the country. Ebola spreads through direct contact with the body fluids of an infected person or animal. Common symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. The article does not provide details on outbreak hotspots or imported/exported cases. This update underscores Ebola’s persistent public health challenge in the DRC and the need for sustained surveillance, prompt diagnosis, isolation of cases, and supportive care to reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が2,011人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2,011例・754人死亡と大規模継続的に拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%と高く、継続的なヒト-ヒト感染が示唆される。アウトブレイクのホットスポットや輸出入例の詳細は不明。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ilmuwan Oxford Mulai Kembangkan Vaksin Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford scientists begin to develop an Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Oxford scientists advance the Ebola vaccine against Bundibugyo to Phase 1 trials, 57 days after the outbreak was declared. The ChAdOx1 BDBV candidate will enroll 50 adults aged 18–55 in Oxford, UK, to assess safety and immunogenicity; vaccination is expected within weeks pending regulatory approval. Serum Institute of India (Pune) has produced about 620,000 doses for emergency use and supplied 4,000 for the Phase 1 study. The vaccine, developed by Oxford Vaccine Group and the Pandemic Sciences Institute, uses the chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform (ChAdOx) as in the COVID-19 Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine, which has saved millions in its first year. CEPI notes this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is the largest by case numbers to date, the third largest on record, with rising cases. An $8.6 million CEPI–Oxford–Serum Institute partnership aims to accelerate development and enable Uganda-based studies with the Uganda Virus Research Institute and LSHTM Uganda Unit, awaiting regulatory approvals.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォードの科学者、エボラワクチンの開発を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブジョ株)の史上最大規模とされる流行に対しワクチン開発が進行中であり、国際的な拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 実際のエボラ流行地はウガンダであり、対象国リストには含まれない。インド（プネー、Serum Institute）はワクチン製造拠点として言及されているのみで、疾病自体の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。
