article.articleHeadline: 2025 च्या तुलनेत 2026 मध्ये मुंबईत साथीच्या आजारांमध्ये वाढ; समोर आली आकडेवारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in infectious diseases in Mumbai in 2026 compared to 2025; figures released.
article.articleSummary: Mumbai’s BMC Health Department’s 1 June–14 July 2026 surveillance shows rising infectious disease numbers versus 2025. In Mumbai, malaria (malarial fever) rose to 3,681 cases in 2026 from 3,115 in 2025; dengue increased to 938 from 734; leptospirosis to 157 from 136. H1N1 climbed to 113 from 42. Chikungunya decreased to 31 from 179. Gastroenteritis fell to 3,866 from 4,831; COVID-19 dropped to 71 from 1,049. The report emphasizes preventive guidance for residents, including eliminating standing water, removing old tires and containers, sleeping under mosquito nets, using repellents, avoiding walking in stagnant floodwaters, wearing boots when necessary, and practicing hand hygiene and boiled water during monsoon. High-risk groups should take extra precautions for COVID-19 and influenza. The data highlight Mumbai as an area of shifting but persistent infectious disease activity during the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年と比較して2026年のムンバイで感染症が増加；統計データが公表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の感染症（マラリア、デング熱、レプトスピラ症、H1N1）の増加が報告されているが、通常のモンスーン季節変動の範囲内であり、深刻な公衆衛生危機や異常事態を示す明確な証拠はない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節における例年の感染症サーベイランス報告であり、複数疾患（マラリア、デング熱、レプトスピラ症等）の増加が見られるが、チクングニア熱やCOVID-19は減少している。BMC保健局による定例的な統計発表で、危機的状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lékaři bez hranic žádají větší podporu proti ebole v Kongu. Vyžádala si už 754 životů
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders are calling for greater support in the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ebola outbreak has already claimed 754 lives.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola cases caused by the Bundibugyo strain have reached 2011 confirmed cases with 754 deaths. Over two months, the outbreak has become the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola hotspot, outpacing health-system response. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that delays in scaling up care cost lives, as many patients arrive in critical condition. The organization calls for intensified international support to strengthen treatment, testing, contact tracing, and community engagement. In Mongbwalu, daily fatalities underscore resource gaps. MSF operates seven Ebola treatment centers and more than 15 isolation units, assisting authorities with surveillance, healthcare worker training, and basic health services. There is currently no approved vaccine or antiviral for Bundibugyo, unlike the Zaire strain responsible for most previous Congo outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対策への支援拡大を要請。死者はすでに754人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が急拡大し、2011例・754人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、有効なワクチン・治療薬が存在しない異常事態であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が未承認であり、通常のZaire株流行とは異なる対応の難しさが指摘されている。国際的な支援拡大の緊急性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Зика и Денга връхлитат европейските туристи, скок на смъртоносни вируси от комари в екзотични дестинации
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zika and Dengue strike European tourists, a spike in deadly mosquito-borne viruses in exotic destinations.
article.articleSummary: UKHSA warns of rising mosquito-borne diseases among European travelers in 2026. From January to June 2026, eight Zika cases were reported in the UK, four linked to Indonesia. Imported Dengue in England totaled 137 cases in the first half of 2026, with Southeast Asia and South Asia as the main sources; Thailand accounts for 27 cases and the Maldives 19. Chikungunya records 59 cases Jan–Jun, Sri Lanka the most frequent travel destination (18). Malaria cases reach 557 across England, Wales and Northern Ireland in Jan–May 2026. Enteric fever (typhoid and paratyphoid) stands at 287. Symptoms: Dengue resembles flu; Chikungunya causes fever and joint pain; Zika is usually mild but dangerous in pregnancy; malaria can be fatal. Precautions include insect repellent, protective clothing, bed nets, vaccines and malaria prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: ジカ熱とデング熱が欧州旅行者を襲う、エキゾチックな渡航先で蚊媒介性ウイルスが急増
triage.triage_reason: 英国UKHSAによる渡航者向け輸入症例の定期報告であり、既知の蚊媒介感染症・マラリア・腸チフスの季節的な統計情報にとどまる。異常な事象や新たな流行の兆候はなく、対象国側での公衆衛生上の緊急性も確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は英国内の輸入症例統計（渡航者向け注意喚起）が主題であり、発生国側（インドネシア、タイなど）における流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。モルディブ、スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: L'épidémie d'Ebola se propage à un rythme alarmant
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: The Ebola outbreak is spreading at an alarming rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri epicentre) caused by Bundibugyo strain has surged to nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths as of July 12, two months after declaration. Ituri accounts for ~90% of cases, with Mongbwalu and Bunia showing critical strain on resources; Bunia’s Ebola Treatment Center Elikiya (90 beds) operates near full capacity, patients arriving in dire condition due to late diagnosis. The outbreak is the third-largest and fastest-growing in DRC history, with cases tripling from about 650 to 2,000 in five weeks and deaths quintupled from ~130 to >700. MSF runs seven Ebola Treatment Centers and 15 isolation units across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo (capacity >430 beds). From outbreak start to July 14, MSF admitted 968 patients (357 confirmed) and aided 116 survivors, while reinforcing surveillance, community outreach, testing, patient care, and safe burials amid limited access and ongoing conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱の流行が驚異的なペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大のエボラ流行で、致死率も高く国際的拡大・対応能力の限界が懸念されるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 致死率約35%と高く、紛争地域でのアクセス制限が対応を困難にしている。MSFなど国際機関が既に大規模支援を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 2011 cas cumulés confirmés d'Ebola pour les trois provinces - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: More than 2011 cumulative confirmed Ebola cases in the three provinces - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 2011 cumulative laboratory-confirmed cases across three eastern provinces and one northeastern province. The epidemiological bulletin records 754 cumulative deaths, 366 recoveries, and 753 patients in isolation or hospital care, yielding a global case-fatality rate of 37.5% and 67.4% contact follow-up across 42 health zones in five affected provinces. Ituri Province accounts for wide spread with 25 of 36 health zones affected, including Bunia, Drodro, Gety, Komanda, and Tchomia; Nord-Kivu lists 11 zones (Beni, Butembo, Goma, Katwa, Oicha, Mabalako, Musienene); Sud-Kivu reports Miti-Murhesa as the sole zone. INRB notes Haut-Uele having 14 confirmed cases from 22 June–13 July, including 13 deaths and 1 recovering case (8 in Wamba, 3 in Pawa, 2 in Boma Mangbetu, 1 in Isiro). Coordination is strengthening with ministerial presence in Bunia and Kisangani; a WHO-National joint mission in Beni; two Kisangani cases undergoing rapid investigation; no change to the number of affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: 3州で累計2011件のエボラ確定症例 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ）にわたり拡大し、累計2011症例・754死亡（致死率37.5%）と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、WHOとの合同ミッションも展開されている。
triage.notes: 複数州（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ）にまたがる大規模アウトブレイクであり、キサンガニでも新規症例確認中。WHOと国家合同ミッションが展開されており、継続的な監視・フルRRAが必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ബുൻഡി ബ്യൂഗോ എബോള: മനുഷ്യരിലുള്ള പരീക്ഷണത്തിന് ഓക്‌സ്ഫഡ്-സിറം ഇൻസ്റ്റിറ്റ്യൂട്ട് വാക്‌സിൻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo ebolavirus: Oxford-Serum Institute vaccine for human trials
article.articleSummary: ChAdOx1 BDBV, a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has begun first-in-human trials. It is developed by Oxford University in collaboration with the Serum Institute of India (SII) using the same viral-vector platform as the COVID-19 vaccine, with involvement from Oxford’s Pandemic Sciences Institute. With no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, this step is pivotal for Africa’s outbreak response. The phase I trial in healthy volunteers will assess safety and immunogenicity, and began 57 days after the outbreak declaration. SII provided about 4,000 doses for the study; if successful, large-scale production is planned and SII’s capacity could enable tens of millions of doses, with over 620,000 doses reserved for future studies or emergency use. The effort seeks to prepare for future Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス：オックスフォード・セラム研究所がヒト臨床試験用ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン臨床試験に関する記事であり、既存の公衆衛生対応の強化を示すシグナルである。ただし、現在の発生状況に関する詳細（症例数、死亡者数、地理的拡大の動向）が不足しており、疾患の重症度や流行の管理可能性の判定に不確実性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はセラム研究所インド（SII）がワクチン開発に参加していることを示しており、臨床試験がインドで実施される可能性が高い。発生地域に「アフリカ」と記載されているが、具体的な国が特定されていない。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスはウガンダを中心に発生しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。現在の患者数、重症度、死亡率などの具体的な疫学データが不足しており、フルRRA実施前に続報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lekári bez hraníc žiadajú väčšiu podporu proti silnejúcej epidémii eboly v Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders call for greater support against the escalating Ebola epidemic in Congo.
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 754 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the Bundibugyo strain driving the current outbreak. Two months in, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) says it is the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola epicenter in the country. Every delay costs lives as health facilities struggle to expand capacity, find new cases, and implement prevention and surveillance. MSF calls for increased international support to bolster clinical care, testing, contact tracing, and community engagement amid an overwhelmed health system and scarce resources. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, unlike the Zaire lineage responsible for many prior Congolese outbreaks. An intensified, adequately funded medical response is urgently needed to prevent the outbreak from spiraling into a crisis beyond local control.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴで拡大するエボラ流行への支援強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,011例・754人死亡と大規模なエボラ流行(ブンディブギョ株)が発生しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ医療体制が逼迫しているため、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際支援が必要な事案。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は致死率が高く、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないため、通常のザイール株流行より対応が困難とMSFが指摘。致死率は約37.5%（754/2011）。

article.articleHeadline: Kaithal DC visits Saujma as Hepatitis-A, Typhoid outbreak infects 47; orders water supply overhaul - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Saujma village in Kaithal district reports 47 infections from Hepatitis-A and typhoid. Of 109 blood samples, 35 are positive for Hepatitis-A and 12 for typhoid; a 12-year-old girl died (PGI confirmation pending), while her 6-year-old brother is recovering in Civil Hospital. Deputy Commissioner Aparajita has deployed 24-hour medical teams, ambulance services, and temporary camps offering free consultations and diagnostics for Hepatitis A/E, typhoid, scrub typhus, leptospirosis and liver function. She inspected water infrastructure, ordering replacement of the narrow canal pipeline and a feasibility study to draw drinking water from the Bhakra canal; the non-functional RO plant should be operational soon. About 1,500 households were inspected for contamination, with officials urged to regularise illegal connections and monitor the system continually.

triage.headline_ja: カイタル郡副長官がサウジマ村を視察、A型肝炎・腸チフスの集団感染で47人感染 - 上水道の全面改修を指示
triage.triage_reason: 村レベルの水系感染症集団発生（47例、死亡1名）で地方当局が対応中だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 水質汚染（老朽化した水道管、非稼働のRO浄水設備）が原因とみられ、地方当局（郡副長官）が水道インフラの是正措置を実施中。国レベル・国際レベルの対応は報告されておらず、局所的な公衆衛生事案と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh tăng tốc khám sức khỏe toàn dân, chủ động phòng chống dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh Province accelerates health checkups for the entire population, proactively preventing and controlling disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, in early 2026 intensified free health screenings, with over 609,000 residents checked by July 15, 2026, reaching 45.63% of the annual target. Dengue cases total 163 with two outbreaks accounting for 103 cases; hand, foot, and mouth disease 97; measles 12; meningococcal disease 1; pertussis 4; mumps 338; chickenpox 127; diarrhea 407; imported malaria 5; influenza 4,173. Hypertension and diabetes care continue under a family medicine model. Expanded immunization program vaccination coverage for children under 1 year in the first half of 2026 exceeded 46.5%. Bed occupancy reached 117%. Collaboration with Hanoi Medical University doctors provides on-site support and training. Sixteen communes/wards conducted periodic health checks and 28 communes/wards conducted screening. The province aims to expand high-tech services and achieve 100% population health screening in 2026, with strengthened early outbreak surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省、全住民健康診断を加速化し、疾病の予防・制御に積極的に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: 複数疾患の症例数が報告されているが、いずれも例年範囲内の通常の公衆衛生活動報告であり、異常な増加や国際的拡大リスクを示す記述はない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム・ハティン省の定期健康診断・予防接種プログラムの進捗報告であり、特定の疾病アウトブレイクの異常事態を報じるものではない。複数疾患（デング熱、麻疹、髄膜炎菌感染症、百日咳、流行性耳下腺炎、水痘、マラリア、インフルエンザ等）の通常サーベイランスデータが含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 2000 حالة وسط تحديات الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 2,000 cases amid containment challenges.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 2,000 cases, with 754 deaths, per latest government data, marking the fastest-spreading outbreak to date. Confirmed cases reach 2,011, with 366 recoveries and 753 currently in isolation or hospital. The Bundibugyo strain has driven transmission since May 15, and 54 new infections were detected Monday across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu, with cross-border concerns reaching Uganda. Containment is hampered by difficult contact tracing, with only about 67% of contacts followed. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri, a mineral-rich northeast province, amid five affected provinces overall. The WHO warns the outbreak could be up to four times larger than official counts and notes a funding shortfall, with only ~40% of requested funds received, urging intensified international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が2000人を超え、封じ込めに課題
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2000例超・754人死亡と急拡大し、国境を越えたウガンダへの懸念や資金不足による対応能力の限界が指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境懸念が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。WHOは実際の感染者数が公式発表の最大4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、資金不足（要請額の約40%のみ充足）も深刻な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André e Diadema tem novos casos de mpox e região soma quatro registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André and Diadema report new mpox cases, and the region totals four cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in the Grande ABC, São Paulo, totals four confirmed cases in 2026—Santo André with three, Diadema with one (woman, 50–54). Santo André reported nine suspected cases this year, with three confirmations and six exclusions; Diadema’s patient profile was not publicly disclosed. Last year the region had 27 mpox notifications. In 2022, São Paulo state recorded 4,283 mpox confirmations and 3 deaths, with Grande ABC totaling 220 cases and no fatalities; the first regional case in 2022 was a 36-year-old Santo André resident who had returned from Europe. State data for 2026 show 149 mpox cases in São Paulo and 356 in Brazil. Experts say the outbreak is not more aggressive than four years ago; transmission is mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, with fever, headache, myalgias, back pain, apathy, and lymphadenopathy as possible symptoms. Most cases are self-limiting; severe cases may require medications not routinely available in Brazil, but imported by SUS when needed. Virus is expected to clear after recovery.

triage.headline_ja: サントアンドレとジアデマでmpoxの新規症例が報告され、地域の累計は4例に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州グランデABC地域でのmpox症例は2022年から継続する既知の流行状況の一部であり、専門家も「4年前より深刻化していない」と評価。重症例も少なく、国内(SUS)で対応可能なため新規シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 2022年以降ブラジルで継続的に報告されているmpoxの地域内サーベイランス更新記事。症例数は少なく(地域4例、州149例、国356例)、専門家も過去より深刻化していないと評価。既存の流行として管理されており、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: COVID Cases Reported In Few Parts Of India, Doctors Asked Not To Panic
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections are locally increasing in parts of India as of July 15, 2026, with a few deaths reported in Andhra Pradesh. The rise is regional, not national, and severe case admissions remain low. Andhra Pradesh has bolstered hospital readiness, testing, and surveillance, while other cities and states report similar upticks. Most infections present with flu-like or respiratory symptoms, and expanded testing for SARS-CoV-2 is expected to reveal more cases. Temporary spikes may arise from weather changes, travel, festivals, gatherings, and potential new variants. Authorities say there is no signal of a large new wave, and comparisons to past surges are unfavourable. Dr. Anurag Agarwal of Ashoka University urges public calm, noting the virus persists and sewage surveillance shows no major public health threat at this time.

triage.headline_ja: インドの一部地域でCOVID感染例が報告、医師はパニックにならないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インド国内の一部地域でCOVID感染者数の局地的増加が報告されているが、重症例・入院は少なく、当局も大規模な新たな波の兆候はないとしている。継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はアンドラプラデシュ州を含むインド国内の局地的なCOVID増加を報告。深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクの異常性は示されておらず、当局も落ち着いた対応を呼びかけている。新変異株の出現や重症化率の変化など続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño ameaça elevar doenças e lotar unidades de Saúde em MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño threatens to increase disease incidence and overwhelm health facilities in Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: El Niño intensification is forecast to persist into early 2027, driving higher temperatures, drought, and smoke in Mato Grosso, Brazil, with initial impacts seen in Várzea Grande as respiratory complaints surge—primarily influenza-like illness, allergic reactions, and worsening chronic lung disease. The climate conditions may expand circulation of respiratory infections, arboviruses (dengue, Zika, chikungunya, malaria), and waterborne diseases (cholera), increasing demand on the public health system with more consultations, tests, medications, and hospitalizations, especially among children, the elderly, and those with chronic illnesses. PAHO issued alerts for Latin America on climate-related health risks; air quality concerns stem from wildfires and smoke amid low humidity, elevating asthma, bronchitis, rhinitis, and cardiovascular admissions. Preventive actions include influenza vaccination (available at 25 basic health units in Várzea Grande for priority groups), hydration, nasal saline lavage, humidification, reducing dust and smoke exposure, cleaning with damp cloths, and eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがマットグロッソ州の疾病増加と医療機関の逼迫を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、エルニーニョによる気候変動が今後複数の感染症（インフルエンザ、デング熱、コレラ等）のリスクを高めるという予測的な公衆衛生アラート記事のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・マットグロッソ州における気候変動(エルニーニョ)に伴う複数疾患（呼吸器感染症、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱等のアルボウイルス、コレラ、マラリア）の増加予測と予防策を報じる一般的な公衆衛生アラートであり、特定のアウトブレイクの確定報告ではない。PAHOのラテンアメリカ向け気候関連健康リスク警告にも言及。

article.articleHeadline: Garhwa school reopens 17 days after food poisoning incident | Ranchi News
article.articleSummary: Garhwa district, Karondhi: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) reopened 17 days after closure prompted by a food-poisoning incident that left 71 hostel students ill on June 26, allegedly from contaminated drinking water. As of July 15, 2026, the reopening was preceded by meetings where district education officer Jaggarnath Lohra assured renewed focus on student safety, food quality, drinking water and other essential facilities. District program officer Kuldeep Aggarwal, Kharondhi block program officer Bipin Bihari Gupta, and other education department officials also conferred with guardians, public representatives and villagers to seek suggestions for ensuring smooth functioning of the residential school. The report notes the incident and subsequent safety measures, with no fatalities mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: ガルワ県の学校、食中毒事件から17日後に再開 | ランチーニュース
triage.triage_reason: 汚染水による食中毒（感染症ではなく食品衛生事案）で、死亡者なく既に収束・再開しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 感染症ではなく食中毒（汚染飲料水）事案であり、学校は既に再開済みで死亡者なし。感染症危機管理の対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का कहर! संक्रमितों का आंकड़ा 2000 के पार, 754 मरीजों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Congo! The number of infected has crossed 2,000; 754 patients have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surged: 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. Approximately 753 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation, with 366 recovered. Contact tracing has identified only 67% of contacts, and at least 80% of new cases involve unknown transmission chains, hindering containment. The first case, Patient Zero, has not been identified. Ongoing armed conflict and displacement, along with mobility in mining areas, impede locating contacts. In Ituri Province, health workers are on strike over unpaid salaries, with many reporting non-payment since the outbreak began. There is no approved vaccine or effective treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet, though two candidate drugs are being tested in Ituri and patient enrollment has started. The situation represents the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak observed in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが猛威！感染者数2000人を突破、754人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染者数が2000人を超え754人が死亡、同国史上最速の感染拡大とされ、接触追跡率67%・伝播経路不明80%など制御困難な状況が続いておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 武力紛争や医療従事者のストライキにより対応が困難化しており、ワクチン・治療薬も未承認。国際的な支援ニーズが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 2 dead as COVID-19 resurfaces in Andhra Pradesh: Doctor urges caution, not panic
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, Kadapa district in Andhra Pradesh reported two COVID-19 deaths and eight new cases, prompting questions about a wave. Experts say there is no evidence of a nationwide resurgence; the cases appear as a localised cluster rather than widespread transmission; COVID-19 becomes endemic. Immunity wanes, the virus mutates, and increased testing reveals infections that might otherwise go unnoticed. High-risk groups include adults 65+, people with diabetes, heart disease, chronic lung disease, kidney disorders, cancer, immunocompromised individuals, and pregnant women, who remain at greater risk of severe illness. Symptoms resemble other viral infections (fever, cough, sore throat, fatigue); distinguishing signs can include loss of taste or smell, persistent high fever, and shortness of breath. Seek care if symptoms persist beyond 3–5 days, worsen, or involve breathlessness, chest pain, confusion, dehydration, or oxygen saturation below 94%. Maintain precautions and vaccination; India emphasizes surveillance and genomic sequencing for early detection.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID-19再燃、2人死亡：医師は注意を呼びかけつつパニックは不要と発言
triage.triage_reason: 専門家がクレードルクラスターであり全国的な再流行の兆候はないと明言しており、COVID-19は既に風土病化した既知の疾患であるため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内の事象と判断される。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に地域的流行病として扱われており、専門家がクラスター発生であり全国的な波ではないと明言。死者2名・新規8例は局所的でIHR/WPRO基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana detects over 25,600 new TB cases through AI-driven screening campaign
article.articleSummary: Haryana reports 25,666 new TB cases in the first 104 days of the 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Campaign Phase-II, launched March 24, 2026 (World TB Day). AI-driven Active Case Finding with handheld X-ray machines and the CATB app that analyzes cough sounds enabled rapid screening in remote areas, aided by Vulnerability Mapping identifying 2,111 high-risk villages and urban wards. From March 24 to July 5, 2026, the campaign conducted 3,914 health camps (2,854 in high-risk areas), screened 473,197 people, performed 225,321 chest X-rays, and completed about 125,000 NAAT tests, diagnosing 25,666 TB patients. Support measures included 23,962 Poshan Kits for nutrition, 2,635 Ni-kshay Mitras, and 65 Ni-kshay Vahans mobile units delivering screening and diagnostics in underserved areas. Public representatives and Ayushman Arogya Shivirs participation facilitated awareness, testing uptake, and integrated health check-ups across Haryana.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州、AI活用スクリーニングキャンペーンで25,600件超の新規結核症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する政府主導の能動的症例発見キャンペーンの成果報告であり、異常事態や国際的拡大リスクはなく、通常の公衆衛生活動の一環である。
triage.notes: これは結核撲滅に向けたインド政府の既存キャンペーン（TB Mukt Bharat）の進捗報告記事であり、新興感染症の発生や異常な流行を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 流感活動水平上升　上月逾27萬人發病1死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza activity on the rise; over 270,000 people became ill last month, one death.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province, China, reported in June 2026 that statutory infectious disease cases reached about 430,000 with 129 deaths, with influenza activity rising and the dominant circulating strain being influenza B (Victoria lineage). COVID-19 infections numbered about 26,000, up from 2,979 in May. Influenza cases exceeded 274,000 last month, with 1 influenza-related death. Over the past three months influenza activity has climbed (April ~71,000; May ~140,000; June continuing the rise). Category B diseases ranked top by cases: COVID-19, Hepatitis B, Syphilis, Tuberculosis, and Gonorrhea, collectively >94% of Category B reports. Category C reported about 365,000 cases with 1 death; the leading three were Influenza, Hand-Foot-Mouth Disease, and Other Infectious Diarrheal Diseases, making up ~99% of Category C. Authorities warn that the summer transmission season is underway with ongoing influenza activity.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ活動が上昇、先月27万人超が発病、1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19の増加傾向を報告する定例サーベイランス情報であり、異常な公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められないが、動向として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 定例の法定感染症サーベイランス報告であり、季節性インフルエンザとCOVID-19の増加が主な内容。パニックや異常事態を示す記述はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo crosses 2,000 cases, 754 deaths confirmed by authorities
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak: confirmed infections have reached 2,011 with 754 deaths, according to government data released overnight and as of 2026-07-15. The current caseload includes 753 patients in isolation or receiving treatment and 366 recoveries. Authorities say this is the fastest-growing outbreak on record, while response efforts are hampered by payment-related strikes by some health workers. No details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection source, or imported/exported cases are provided in the article. The data reflect ongoing transmission within the Democratic Republic of Congo, with continued demands for public health measures to curb spread. Ongoing case management and surveillance are continuing within the country. The report underscores heightened risk to surrounding regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、症例数2,000件超、死者754人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（2,011症例、死亡754人）で致死率が高く、史上最速の拡大とされ、医療従事者ストライキで対応能力にも懸念があるため、フルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 医療従事者の給与未払いによるストライキが対応を妨げているとの報道あり。周辺地域への波及リスクが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de dois mil casos de Ébola confirmados e 754 mortes na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 Ebola cases confirmed and 754 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 754 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 15 July 2026, with 753 patients in isolation or hospital and 366 recoveries. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in May in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan and has also reached Uganda (20 cases, 15 imported from the DRC, 2 deaths). About 80% of new cases stem from unknown transmission chains, and contact-tracing coverage is around 67%. MSF describes the spread as unprecedented and urges stronger international action to broaden access to care and essential health services. No identified patient zero; ongoing conflict and mining-related population movement hamper surveillance. There are no vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo. The WHO classifies the event as a PHEIC and warns the outbreak could be 2–4 times larger than official estimates. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhages.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱2,000例以上確認、死者754人
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC認定済みの大規模エボラ流行で、致死率・国際拡大(ウガンダへの越境)・ワクチン/治療薬不在など複数のIHR基準に該当するため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはPHEICと認定し、実際の症例数は公式推定の2-4倍の可能性を警告。80%の新規症例が感染経路不明で、紛争や人口移動が監視を妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من تفشي الإيبولا بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at the fastest rate on record. In Bunia, Ituri Province—the epicenter—nearly 2,000 lab-confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been reported across five provinces as of July 11, marking the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. WHO officials said the pace of new infections has surged, with over 80 confirmed cases in a 24-hour period in recent days. A large share of recently reported deaths occurred in communities before seeking care, signaling delayed treatment. Despite improvements in diagnostics and contact tracing, roughly 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, indicating transmission from unknown chains that hinder containment. The Congo declared the seventeenth Ebola outbreak on May 15, and WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模なエボラアウトブレイクであり、致死率・拡大速度・感染経路不明の症例割合の高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されている史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行。感染経路不明の症例が約80%を占め、封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Is Andhra Pradesh Seeing a New COVID-19 Wave?
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19-related deaths and fresh infections in Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa district raise questions about a potential wave, but experts say SARS-CoV-2 remains endemic with no evidence of widespread transmission or a new highly transmissible variant. Eight active cases are reported, mostly in Kadapa, with infections described as mild or asymptomatic. Authorities activated a 24x7 district control room, intensified surveillance, tested symptomatic individuals, and instructed hospitals to maintain isolation wards while samples are collected to identify the virus variant. The guidance emphasizes vigilance over alarm, reflecting ongoing circulation and occasional infections as immunity wanes. While neighboring Odisha increases vigilance ahead of cross-border travel, Andhra Pradesh stresses targeted measures to detect additional cases early and protect vulnerable groups. Practical precautions include staying home when unwell, masking in crowded indoor spaces, and seeking care if symptoms worsen. As of 2026-07-15.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデーシュ州で新たなCOVID-19の波が発生しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な死亡例・感染例が報告されているが、専門家は流行性の高い新変異株の証拠はなく、地域内での常在的循環と評価しており、現時点で緊急性は低い。今後の変異株同定結果や感染拡大の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 隣接するオディシャ州でも警戒が強化されているが、これは越境旅行を見据えた予防的措置であり、感染事例が確認されているわけではないためverified_locationsはインドのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من اتساع تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو وتقدّر الإصابات بأضعاف المعلن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the widening Ebola outbreak in Congo and estimates infections to be several times higher than reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo widens; the World Health Organization warns that infections may be up to four times higher than reported. Latest official data show more than 1,960 people infected and over 700 killed since the outbreak was first detected two months ago. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO Emergency Programme Executive Director, told reporters in Geneva that WHO models estimate the true scale of the outbreak to be at least twofold to fourfold the number of identified cases. As of July 15, 2026, health authorities are monitoring an expanding transmission and maintaining surveillance, with the possibility of further undetected cases. The report underscores substantial under-detection and the potential for rapid spread, maintaining international attention on this Ebola outbreak in the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラ流行拡大に警鐘、感染者数は公表の数倍に上ると推定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大し、死亡者700人超、感染者は公表数の2〜4倍と推定されるなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、WHOが国際的な関心を持って対応しているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenèveとSwitzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO本部所在地であり実際の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。致死率は公表データで約35%と高く、WHOによる過少検出の指摘は流行規模の深刻さを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число смертей от лихорадки Эбола удвоилось за две недели
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of deaths from Ebola virus disease has doubled in two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has doubled in two weeks, with the WHO warning the outbreak is outpacing response. By July 14, the National Institute of Public Health reported 2,011 infections and 754 confirmed deaths, and the outbreak has spread to two additional provinces. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, with about 90% of cases concentrated in Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, and Nyakunde, as transmission continues amid limited hospital capacity. WHO officials say the true scale could be at least two to four times higher than official counts. Anne Ansia, a WHO representative in DR Congo, noted the situation has not stabilized and hospital beds remain severely limited. Some estimates suggest up to 65% of infected individuals could reach international travel networks from Congo and Uganda, underscoring cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が2週間で倍増
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がイトゥリ州を中心に拡大し、死者数が2週間で倍増、WHOが対応の遅れと国境を越えた拡散リスクを警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ルワンダへの越境リスクにも言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは実際の感染規模が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak much larger than official figures, WHO says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa is far larger than official figures: the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province and neighboring North Kivu and South Kivu) is the main focus, with 20 confirmed cases in Uganda, and almost 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths reported. WHO emergencies director says the true scale is at least two to four times detected, with many unrecorded cases. The outbreak is underfunded, with less than half of the $115 million needed in the first six months. Many new cases die in communities before reaching health facilities; hospital care improves survival via intravenous fluids and oxygen. The Bundibugyo strain, first identified in Uganda, has no cure or vaccine. US travel rules tightened: citizens in DR Congo cannot fly commercial back home and must spend 21 days in a third country; some non-citizens who recently visited DRC, Uganda or South Sudan are barred from US travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は公式統計よりもはるかに大規模、WHOが発表

triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認、米国が渡航制限を発動しているが、ウガンダ・米国・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。資金不足（必要額の半分未満）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة عمون : وزارة الصحة في الكونغو: تسجيل أكثر من 2000 حالة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ammon News: Congo's Ministry of Health: More than 2,000 Ebola cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ministry of Health reports more than 2,000 Ebola cases and 754 deaths, in what authorities call the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. Data released overnight show 753 people remain in isolation or hospital, while 366 have recovered. Health workers at Bunia General Hospital began a strike on Wednesday, joining other frontline staff, who blocked hospital access to protest wages and lack of compensation while operating in difficult conditions. Contact tracing remains challenging, with only about 67% of exposed individuals traced. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has been ongoing since May 15 of the previous year. After two months, transmission continues to outpace authorities’ tracing despite expanded response measures. The World Health Organization said at least 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: アンモンニュース：コンゴ保健省、エボラ症例2000件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000例超・死亡754例のエボラ流行が「史上最速の拡大」とされ、接触追跡率67%・感染経路不明80%など制御困難な状況にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行。医療従事者のストライキが発生し対応体制に支障。WHOは新規感染の80%が感染経路不明と発表しており、国際的な拡大・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Médicos sin Fronteras alerta por propagación "sin precedentes" del...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of unprecedented spread of the ...
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Doctors Without Borders reports an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths; 753 patients are in isolation or hospitalized and 366 have recovered. The case fatality rate is 37.5% and contact tracing stands at 67.4%. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for most new cases, while South Kivu has had no new infections for 47 days; new cases have appeared in Alto Uélé and Tshopo. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no internationally approved vaccine or treatment, hindering containment. MSF warns of unprecedented spread, noting treatment centers in Mongbwalu and Bunia (Elikiya) are near capacity and patients arrive critically ill. Since MSF began responding, 57 patients have recovered, while more than 110 have died. The outbreak has surpassed half of the 2018–2020 crisis in cases and tripled in five weeks, prompting urgent calls for stronger international support to expand Ebola care and essential health services.

article.articleHeadline: Ученые впервые проверят вакцину против редкого и смертельно опасного штамма Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists will test a vaccine against a rare and deadly Ebola strain for the first time.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University has begun the first-in-human trial of a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola strain, marking the first time immunity against this variant is being tested. The Phase 1 study enrolls 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 to assess safety and immunogenicity, with progression to a larger cohort if results are favorable. Bundibugyo, less common than the Zaire strain, has caused severe illness with mortality around 40% in previous outbreaks. Past Ebola outbreaks linked to Bundibugyo occurred in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Researchers hope that vaccines covering multiple strains will enable faster, better-prepared responses to future Ebolavirus outbreaks and help mitigate rare-strain epidemics.

triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・治験に関する研究ニュースであり、現在DRCやウガンダでエボラのアウトブレイクが発生しているという情報ではない。過去の流行歴史の文脈で言及されているのみのため、対象国の現行イベントとしては該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana detects over 25,600 new TB cases - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: TB in Haryana, India, detected 25,666 new patients during March 24–July 5, 2026, as part of the World TB Day launch and the 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Campaign (Phase-II), leveraging active case finding and AI-driven screening. The program deployed AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines and the CATB mobile app to analyze cough sounds, supported by Vulnerability Mapping identifying 2,111 high-risk villages and urban wards. From March 24 to July 5, 2026, 3,914 health camps were held (2,854 in high-risk areas). Screening reached 4,73,197 people, with 2,25,321 chest X-rays and 1.25 lakh NAAT tests, enabling TB diagnosis. Additional outcomes include distribution of 23,962 Poshan Kits for patient nutrition, and 2,635 Ni-kshay Mitras providing nutritional and social support. TB screening integrated with Ayushman Arogya Shivirs for broader health checks.

triage.notes: 結核はインドの風土病であり、本記事は政府主導の積極的症例発見・AI活用スクリーニングキャンペーンの成果報告。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود: احتواء تفشي فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو يزداد صعوبة - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Containing the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is getting harder - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is growing harder to contain, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF). The outbreak emerged after reports of unusual deaths in early May in the area northwest of Bunia, capital of Ituri province. The virus has spread across Ituri as well as North Kivu and South Kivu, with about 20 cases reported in neighboring Uganda. MSF warns the outbreak remains a true Public Health Emergency of International Concern, despite extensive response efforts. The Bundibugyo strain presents diagnostic, treatment, and vaccine challenges due to severe diagnostic-tool shortages and lack of approved therapies or vaccines for that strain. WHO has indicated the outbreak could be up to four times larger than official counts. Official data show more than 1,960 cases and over 700 deaths since discovery about two months ago; WHO emergency programme head Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu noted models suggest two-to-four times higher.

article.articleHeadline: China sends experts to Africa Ebola response platform
article.articleSummary: China sends two public health experts to Uganda to join the Joint Africa CDC-WHO AFRO Continental Incident Management Support Team aiding the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The platform, based at the Infectious Diseases Institute at Makerere University in Kampala, became fully operational on June 29. An Zhijie will join the coordination and governance group to track epidemiology, assess cross-border transmission risks, and evaluate control measures; Wang Huanyu will work in the laboratory pillar to scale up local testing, improve sample transport, and analyze site workload and positivity to guide supplies. As of the latest data, DRC has 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths since the May 15 declaration, with the outbreak spreading to two more areas across five regions; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and one death. China has previously dispatched two teams totaling 10 experts.

article.articleHeadline: कैथल में हेपेटाइटिस-A संक्रमण के बीच राहत, 36 सैंपलों की रिपोर्ट आई नेगेटिव...जांच में सामने आई चौंकाने वाली लापरवाही
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Relief amid Hepatitis A infection in Kathal as 36 samples test negative... shocking negligence revealed in the investigation.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A outbreak in Sajuma village, Kathal (near Jaipal Rasoolpur), shows no new cases as of 2026-07-15 after 36 samples tested negative. Investigations implicate unsafe drinking-water connections (50+ sites) and poor pipework allowing sewage and rainwater infiltration. A submersible bore near a local pond (johar) is cited as a potential contamination source; residents petition connecting village reservoirs to the Bhakra Canal for clean water. Six water samples were potable with adequate chlorine, while authorities repair unsafe connections and enhance testing. Health teams operate 24/7 with ambulances and free camps offering Hepatitis A and E testing, scrub typhus, leptospirosis, typhoid, liver-function tests, plus medicines, ORS packets, and chlorine tablets. Three dedicated teams are addressing unsafe connections and ongoing monitoring to prevent further transmission.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health care workers' strike in the DRC; more than 2,000 Ebola cases reported | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, Bunia) is driven by Bundibugyo virus. As of 2026-07-15, 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths; 753 patients remain in isolation or hospital, with 366 recovered. Contact tracing coverage is 67%, and about 80% of new cases come from unknown transmission chains; no patient zero has been identified. The epidemic, now two months after first appearance, is spreading faster than health authorities can track, with conflict and mining activity hindering case finding and contact tracing. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo! 754 people have died, healthcare workers went on strike due to payment issues.
article.articleSummary: 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province with Bunia as a focal point. The Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) strain has caused 754 deaths; 366 recoveries; 753 currently in isolation or hospitalized. About 67% of exposed contacts have been traced, and more than 80% of new cases stem from undetermined transmission chains, underscoring surveillance challenges amid population displacement from conflict and mining activity. Health workers in Bunia General Hospital and elsewhere have gone on strike over pay, blocking hospital entrances and citing unpaid compensation. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo virus, unlike the Zaire virus for which a vaccine exists; two potential treatments are being tested in Ituri as part of a long-awaited trial. No identified patient zero yet, and two months after first cases, the outbreak continues to spread rapidly.

article.articleHeadline: В Ат-Башы строителям дороги Китай-Кыргызстан-Узбекистан рассказали о чуме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In At-Bashy, the road builders on the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan road were told about the plague.
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, anti-epidemic specialists from the At-Bashy district anti-plague department conducted an informational briefing for foreign workers at the Arpa pasture involved in the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway project. Chinese workers from Bureau 2 and Bureau 5 were given on-site guidance about plague—its early signs and its threat to humans—transmission pathways (through rodents and fleas, and by airborne droplets), and preventive hygiene measures. To ensure comprehension, leaflets were distributed in Chinese. The outreach is part of ongoing preventive efforts to safeguard against highly dangerous infections and maintain epidemiological stability in the region, the department said. The railway project, led by CJSC China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway, is a joint venture with 51% Chinese ownership and 24.5% each for Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan, costing about $4.7 billion and described as Central Asia’s largest capital project in 2025. A Bishkek office opened in September 2024.

article.articleHeadline: What Is The Bundibugyo Ebola Strain? DR Congo Outbreak Explained
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, driven by the uncommon Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 fatalities, per the Health Ministry. AP reports 2,011 confirmed infections, 366 recovered, and 753 in treatment or isolation. WHO says 80% of new infections arise from unidentified transmission channels, hindering containment, with contact tracing at 67%. Probable cases have been detected in Haut-Uele and Tshopo, indicating spread beyond the Ituri epicentre. Challenges include funding shortages, attacks on medical facilities, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict. Earlier this month, therapy trials for Bundibugyo started, but there is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for this strain. Ebola virus disease, in the Orthoebolavirus genus, is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever.

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Epidemia de Ébola ''cada vez mais difícil de conter'' - 2.011 casos confirmados e 754 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola epidemic 'increasingly difficult to contain' - 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is expanding at an unprecedented pace, with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. MSF warns transmission is accelerating; 753 people are in isolation or hospitalized and 366 have recovered. Contact tracing covers over 100 million people, but only 67% of exposed individuals are tracked. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has been active since May, and WHO notes more than 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains. Case fatality is about 30–50%, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment. WHO rates the sub-Saharan Africa risk as high and global risk as low. The outbreak likely began circulating in Ituri about two months before WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17. This is the third-worst Ebola outbreak and the 17th in the DRC; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhaging.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行「封じ込めがますます困難」-確定2,011症例、死亡754人
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率が高く、感染経路不明な症例が8割を超えるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念が高い事案。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを宣言済み、Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行でDRC史上第3位の規模。接触者追跡率67%と不十分で、感染拡大が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला ने मचाया कहर, 754 संक्रमितों की मौत, WHO ने कहा- यह प्रकोप तेजी से फैल रहा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola wreaks havoc in Congo; 754 infected have died, WHO says the outbreak is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating rapidly. A rare strain has circulated since May, with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths; 366 people have recovered. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization says about 80% of new cases in eastern DRC arise from unknown transmission chains. The outbreak affects five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Shopo. As of July 15, 2026, 763 patients are in hospitals or isolation centers, with 95% of beds occupied. Contact tracing has identified about 67% of contacts. The index case (patient zero) remains unidentified. The outbreak began around May 15 and is described as Africa’s fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date, challenging containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが猛威、感染者754人死亡、WHOは流行が急速に拡大していると発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し、致死率高く未知の感染経路が80%を占めるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: アフリカ史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行で、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがなく、感染経路の80%が不明という点でヒトーヒト感染制御の困難さが顕著。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : des agents engagés dans la riposte en grève à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: outbreak responders on strike in Bunia
article.articleSummary: Ebola responders in Ituri province’s capital Bunia are on strike on July 15, 2026, demanding payment of their response bonuses. Early morning barricades and fires were set outside Bunia General Referral Hospital as workers pressed for prompt disbursement. An engaged responder said they are doing their best to save lives amid a deadly disease, but although payment arrangements exist, nothing has materialized on the ground. Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba had visited Bunia about two weeks earlier and said payments would be made via bank cards. The report notes ongoing Ebola outbreak response in Ituri, but provides no case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or information about infection sources. The strike underscores funding and payment issues as a potential constraint on outbreak response capacity in the region.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でのエボラ対応:ブニアで対応要員がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応中に、対応要員による給与未払い抗議のストライキが発生しており、アウトブレイク対応能力への深刻な支障が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数・死亡数などの疫学情報を含まず、対応要員の給与未払いによるストライキとその対応能力への影響に焦点を当てている。エボラ自体の発生規模については既存アウトブレイクの継続として扱われており、続報で症例動向の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola cases surpass 2,000 as more health workers begin strike
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or treatment. As of 2026-07-15, confirmed cases reached 2,011 and deaths 754. The outbreak began on May 15 and is centered in Ituri province, notably Bunia General Hospital, where health workers are striking over unpaid wages and perilous conditions, disrupting services. Dozens at Rwampara General Hospital also protested over months of nonpayment. The World Health Organization and MSF label this the third largest and fastest growing Ebola outbreak on record, with WHO warning the official death toll could be 2–4 times higher than reported. A first clinical trial to test an antiviral for post-exposure prevention in exposed contacts launched on Tuesday, signaling potential progress in containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ症例数が2,000人を突破、さらなる医療従事者がストライキ開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株）がDRCで急拡大し史上3番目の規模となっており、医療従事者のストライキによる対応能力低下も加わり公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念が高い事案。
triage.notes: WHOはワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による史上3番目・最速拡大のアウトブレイクと警告。医療従事者のストライキにより対応能力がさらに低下しており、致死数は報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 台风洪涝灾害过后需警惕疾病感染风险！中疾控发布两点提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant about the risk of infectious diseases after typhoon-induced floods and waterlogging! China CDC issues two reminders.
article.articleSummary: After typhoon-induced floods and waterlogging in China, the China CDC warns of increased infectious-disease risk as floodwaters carry microbes from sewage, feces, and animal carcasses. Critical precautions include: drink only disinfected, boiled, or bottled water; avoid spoiled, moldy, or flood-contaminated foods; wash fruits and vegetables with clean water and keep raw and cooked foods separate to prevent enteric infections. Post-flood cleaning should remove mud, standing water, garbage, and animal remains; disinfect households and dining ware; maintain ventilation and dryness; check doors and screens, and use nets, mosquito coils, or repellents to prevent bites. In schistosomiasis-endemic areas, anyone with fever or diarrhea of unknown origin after flood exposure should seek prompt medical care. The guidance emphasizes prevention, environmental hygiene, and timely medical evaluation to curb outbreaks in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 台風による洪水災害後は感染症リスクに警戒を!中国疾病予防管理センターが2つの注意点を発表
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、台風・洪水後の一般的な公衆衛生上の注意喚起（予防的ガイダンス）であり、具体的な症例数や異常事態の発生は確認されない。
triage.notes: 本記事は住血吸虫症を含む複数の感染症リスクに関する一般的な予防啓発であり、具体的な発生・流行の報告ではない。中国疾病予防管理センターによる季節的・定型的な注意喚起と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le PAM distribue des vivres à 7525 ménages à Mongbwalu pour réduire les risques de propagation de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the WFP distributes food to 7,525 households in Mongbwalu to reduce the risk of the Ebola outbreak spreading.
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, the World Food Programme distributed food to 7,525 households in Mongbwalu, a rural commune in Djugu territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to curb the 17th Ebola outbreak and limit transmission. Mongbwalu is a major hotspot, with the area classified as IPC 3+—a humanitarian-food insecurity crisis. Each household receives a 30‑day ration designed from technical assessments: 72 kg of rice, 21.6 kg of beans, 5.4 litres of oil, and 0.9 kg of salt. The operation is staged to avoid crowding, with 1,000 households served in the first group and others in subsequent waves. Beneficiaries were identified through PAM surveys, and all Mongbwalu households are deemed high-risk due to active Ebola circulation. The assistance could be renewed next month depending on resource availability.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ:世界食糧計画(WFP)がエボラ流行の拡大リスク軽減のためモングワルの7,525世帯に食料を配布
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中の第17次エボラ流行における活発な感染継続が確認されており、公衆衛生上重大な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事は食料配布支援に関する内容だが、DRCイツリ州モングワルにおける第17次エボラ流行の活発な感染継続とIPC3+レベルの食料危機を示しており、既知のアウトブレイクの継続的リスクとしてPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : entre doute et réalité, la perception d'Ebola reste contrastée dans la population - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: between doubt and reality, the population's perception of Ebola remains mixed - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is the province's first Ebola outbreak since the 2015 demarcation, officially declared on 15 May 2026. As of 29 June, four laboratory-confirmed cases and two deaths have been recorded across three health zones. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC over five decades and the fourth to affect the Greater Ituri region, after outbreaks in Isiro (Haut-Uele), Likati (Bas-Uele), and Ituri (2018–2020 and 2026). Vox-pop interviews show mixed perceptions: some residents acknowledge Ebola as real, citing a deceased neighbor from Bunia and a patient transferred to Cinquantenaire Hospital, and report preventive measures such as handwashing and reduced physical contact; others doubt its existence, hindering adherence. Handwashing facilities remain sparse in markets, churches, and public venues, though some individuals use hand sanitizer and practice distancing, pledging to alert authorities if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州:エボラに対する住民の認識、疑念と現実の間で分かれる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ツショポ州で確認され死亡例も出ているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、同州初の発生かつヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高い重大感染症のため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既に公式発表済みのエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）に関する住民認識調査。DRCで17回目、Greater Ituri地域で4回目の発生であり、感染症としての重大性からPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 泰國旅遊注意！2026台灣首例「茲卡病毒」境外移入，出現紅疹、發燒症狀別只當登革熱！ | 柯夢波丹
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand travel advisory! Taiwan's first imported Zika virus case in 2026, presenting with rash and fever—don't mistake it for dengue fever!
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first confirmed Zika virus infection in 2026. On July 14, the Taiwan CDC announced a travel-associated case: a man in his 30s who recently returned from Thailand developed fever, dizziness, and a rash; the infection is not locally transmitted. As of July 13, Taiwan has 1 confirmed Zika case this year, with all cases since 2016 being imported, predominantly from Southeast Asia (about 81%). Zika is mainly spread by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes; sexual transmission and mother-to-child transmission are possible. Incubation is 3–14 days; typical symptoms include fever, rash, arthralgia, and conjunctivitis, though about 80% of infections are asymptomatic. Thailand has reported 76 Zika cases through week 28 of 2026, indicating low-level transmission with sporadic cases. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral; management is supportive. Returned travelers should avoid unprotected sex for 3 months (men) or 2 months (women), use condoms if partners are pregnant, maintain mosquito protection for at least 3 weeks, and defer blood donation for 1 month. Seek medical care if symptoms arise and note travel history.

triage.headline_ja: タイ旅行に注意！2026年台湾初のジカウイルス感染症例が確認、発疹・発熱の症状はデング熱と誤診しないように
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での輸入症例は例年発生している定型的な事象で重症度も低いが、タイ国内での散発的なジカウイルス伝播が継続している点は経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイでは2026年第28週までに76例のジカウイルス感染例が報告されており、低レベルながら継続的な伝播が示唆される。台湾の症例自体は輸入例であり、2016年以降の全症例が海外渡航歴を伴う。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns the DRC Ebola Outbreak May Be Four Times Bigger Than Reported
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus—one of the fastest-growing Ebola epidemics. As of 15 July 2026, WHO says true infections may be two to four times higher than 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported. Ituri Province bears the majority; outbreak spread to Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Uganda reports imported and secondary cases; France recorded one imported case in a healthcare worker returning from DRC. More than 10,000 contacts monitored; treatment centers in affected areas nearing saturation. Bundibugyo virus is rare; no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment exists. Transmission requires direct contact with blood or body fluids; infectious after symptom onset, with early symptoms mimicking malaria. A clinical trial is under way to identify treatments; over 1,200 treatment doses available. About 400 CDC personnel are aiding; funding about 40% of US$115 million secured. US risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは報告の4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,926件・死亡702件のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が急拡大し、ウガンダ・フランスへの国際的な症例波及、治療施設の逼迫、ワクチン未承認など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダで輸入・二次感染例、フランスで医療従事者の輸入症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは真の感染者数が報告の2〜4倍に達する可能性を警告しており、治療センターの飽和や資金不足（必要額の約40%のみ確保）など管理面での懸念も大きい。

article.articleHeadline: "أطباء بلا حدود" تدق ناقوس الخطر: "إيبولا" ينتشر بسرعة تفوق قدرة الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders sounds the alarm: "Ebola" is spreading at a rate that outpaces the ability to respond.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with containment hampered by insecurity as MSF notes the outbreak was detected after unusual deaths in early May in a region northwest of Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province. The virus has spread across Ituri as well as North Kivu and South Kivu, with 20 cases reported in neighboring Uganda. MSF warns the outbreak remains a genuine public health emergency, highlighting the Bundibugyo strain's particular challenges due to limited diagnostic tools and the lack of approved treatments or vaccines. The World Health Organization cautions that the outbreak's size could be up to four times the official figures, with models suggesting many infections are not yet captured. Official counts exceed 1,960 cases and 700 deaths since discovery about two months ago, with many new infections from unknown transmission chains, complicating control.

triage.headline_ja: 「国境なき医師団」が警鐘を鳴らす：「エボラ」が対応能力を上回る速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大を続け、隣国ウガンダにも波及し、死者700人・症例1960人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威となっており、IHR基準の複数該当が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダへの感染拡大にも言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは公式集計の最大4倍の規模である可能性を指摘しており、実際の被害規模は不明確。

article.articleHeadline: Sénégal: L'OMS lance les essais cliniques d'un traitement préventif du virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Senegal: WHO launches clinical trials of a preventive treatment for the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: WHO has launched the first clinical trial of a post-exposure preventive Ebola treatment, named EBO-PEP, using obeldesivir, to curb transmission of the Ebola Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The study will enroll about 1,000 adults and youths over 12 who had direct exposure in the previous five days to a confirmed case, the body of an infected person, or a contaminated needle. If effective, this prophylaxis could accelerate prevention among high-risk contacts. The trial aims to evaluate post-exposure prophylaxis efficacy in outbreak conditions. As of July 13, the DRC reported 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases across five provinces, with 753 in isolation or hospital, 366 recovered, and 754 deaths (CFR 37.5%). Twelve thousand four hundred thirty contacts were followed (67.4% vs 95% target). There were 205 deaths among confirmed cases in the period, about 68% outside treatment facilities; 114 health workers infected, 36 dead.

triage.headline_ja: セネガル：WHOがエボラウイルスの予防的治療の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例2,011例、死亡754例（致死率37.5%）に達する進行中のエボラ流行があり、医療従事者への感染や国際的な治療試験実施など公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダでの臨床試験を報じているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行状況（2,011症例、754死亡、医療従事者114名感染・36名死亡）は深刻であり継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 2 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has surpassed 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases with at least 754 deaths as of 15 July 2026. Originating in May 2026, it is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history, concentrated largely in Ituri province, with Uganda also affected. The Bundibugyo strain is rare and has no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Challenges include security issues, unpaid health workers leading to strikes, and gaps in contact tracing, which hinder containment. About 80% of new cases in some heavily affected areas cannot be linked to known transmission chains, raising concerns of widespread community transmission. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. Early phase data (as of 16 May) reported 8 lab-confirmed, 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数が2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言済みで死亡者754名、致死率が高く、ワクチン・治療法未承認、伝播経路不明な症例が80%と地域拡大リスクが極めて高いため、IHR・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが主たる発生国であるためverified_locationsに含めた。WHOはすでに2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo rebasa ya los umbrales de los 2.000 casos confirmados y los 750 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has already surpassed the thresholds of 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths. INSP reports 2,011 cases and 754 fatalities, with 753 in isolation or hospitalized and 366 recovered; case fatality rate about 37.5% and contact tracing at 67.4%. Ituri remains the epicenter, though Haut-Uélé and Tshopo now report cases, and South Kivu has shown no new infections for 47 days. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns the transmission pace is unprecedented and that containment is under-resourced; Bundibugyo Ebola lacks a licensed vaccine or internationally approved treatment. The outbreak has exceeded half the total cases seen during 2018–2020, with cases tripling and deaths quintupled in five weeks. MSF notes overwhelmed Ebola treatment centers in Mongbwalu and Bunia (Elikiya) and calls for faster, scaled-up international support amid conflict and displacement; OCHA says response efforts are being intensified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、確認症例2,000人・死者750人の閾値を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な伝播速度、複数州への拡大）し、ワクチン・治療薬の未整備や国際支援要請もあることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: MSFは伝播速度が前例のないものであり、対応が資源不足の状態にあると警告。承認されたワクチンや治療薬がないBundibugyo型エボラであること、紛争・避難民状況下での対応困難さも重大なリスク要因。2018-2020年流行の総症例数の半分を既に超えており、5週間で症例数が3倍、死者数が5倍に増加している点は極めて深刻。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: O que é gripe aviária? Conheça sintomas, riscos para humanos e o agro | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is avian influenza? Learn the symptoms, risks for humans and agriculture | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) re-emerged since 2020, spreading among wild birds, farms across Europe, Americas, Asia and Oceania, Australia and New Zealand. Human risk remains low; cases are rare and linked to intense contact with infected birds or contaminated environments, with no sustained human-to-human transmission, and cooked poultry is not shown to transmit the virus. Migratory waterfowl are the main reservoirs; farm spread occurs through contact with infected birds, feces, secretions, water, feed, equipment, vehicles, or contaminated materials. In poultry, sudden death is characteristic; other signs include respiratory symptoms, reduced egg production, and swollen, purplish combs or wattles, plus leg hemorrhages. Protocols require isolation, culling, disinfection, and enhanced surveillance, and can trigger import suspensions on poultry products. Brazil detections began in 2023 in wild birds; in May 2025 a farm in Montenegro, Rio Grande do Sul, confirmed H5N1, triggering culling, decontamination, monitoring, and later lifting export restrictions as surveillance stayed clear.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザとは？症状、人体および農業へのリスクを解説 | CNNブラジル
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はH5N1鳥インフルエンザに関する一般的な解説記事であり、新規の発生事例や人への感染報告ではない。ブラジルの過去（2025年5月）の事例も収束済みで輸出制限も解除済みとされている。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザ全般の解説であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは低いと明記。ブラジルの過去の農場発生（2025年5月、リオグランデ・ド・スル州）は既に対応済み・監視継続で輸出制限解除済み。新規シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Kao u horor filmu': Ameba koja jede mozak bi mogla da se proširi po svetu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Like in a horror movie': The brain-eating amoeba could spread around the world.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba causing primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM), spreads through nasal passages after swimming in warm freshwater. An 11-year-old boy, Jordan Smelski, died in Costa Rica seven and a half days after swimming, following headaches, vomiting, hallucinations and seizures. Globally, India reported over 200 PAM cases last year—the largest outbreak on record—with continued new cases, expanding concern beyond traditional lakes. From 1962–2023, about 488 cases were documented worldwide with around 97% mortality. Notable recent signals include Slovakia’s first case in 2025; cases in Minnesota, Taiwan (2023); and a US child who died after exposure at a contaminated pool surface. Climate warming may increase activity and extend habitats to Europe and East Asia. Children around age 12 are especially vulnerable. Early multi-drug regimens with anti-edema therapy can help, but survivors remain rare; the Kerala outbreak highlights shifting distribution.

triage.headline_ja: 「まるでホラー映画」：脳を食べるアメーバが世界中に広がる可能性
triage.triage_reason: Naegleria fowleri（脳食いアメーバ）に関する複数国の既知症例をまとめた解説記事であり、新規の緊急アウトブレイクという明確なシグナルではないが、インドでの記録的規模のアウトブレイクや地理的拡大の兆候があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はNaegleria fowleriに関する複数国（コスタリカ、インド、スロバキア、米国ミネソタ、台湾）の既知症例をまとめたレビュー記事。対象国リストの中ではインド（ケララ州での200例超のアウトブレイク）のみが明確に主題として言及されている。中国（上海）は発生地域リストにあるが記事本文中に具体的言及がないため除外。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。人-人感染はなく、散発的な淡水曝露による感染であるため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、気候変動による地理的拡大の懸念が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC, deux mois après : l'épidémie se propage à un rythme alarmant.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC, two months after: the outbreak is spreading at an alarming rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, two months in, is the third-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak. By July 12, confirmed cases nearly tripled from 650 to about 2,000, and deaths rose from 130 to more than 700, surpassing half the cases of the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak. Ituri province accounts for roughly 90% of confirmed cases. MSF calls for stronger national and international action across all fronts—community engagement, surveillance, testing and diagnosis, patient care, survivor support, and safe burials—while maintaining access to other essential health services. MSF runs seven Ebola Treatment Centers and more than 15 isolation units across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo, with capacity over 430 beds. Since the start, MSF admitted 968 patients (357 confirmed) and discharged 116 survivors. In Mongbwalu, the Ebola Treatment Center reports patients arriving in critical state; Bunia's Elikiya center (90 beds) is near full capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、発生から2ヶ月:感染拡大が警戒すべき速度で進行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、症例・死者数が急増する大規模流行であるため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirusによる流行で、2018-2020年流行の半数を超える症例数に達しており、過去最大級・最速拡大の流行の一つ。MSFが国際支援の強化を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Rohtak to launch 'Dry Friday' drive to curb dengue - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Rohtak district in Haryana will launch a 'Dry Friday Every Week' campaign to curb dengue, malaria and chikungunya as the monsoon begins. Starting Friday, July 17, government departments, Urban Local Bodies, Panchayati Raj, and educational institutions are instructed to empty and clean water storage containers, desert coolers, flower pots, and other stagnation points to cut mosquito breeding sites. Resident Welfare Associations are urged to participate, alongside intensified anti-larval operations and surveillance in high-risk areas. District officials emphasize sustained community involvement and proactive case finding to strengthen vector-borne disease control. The drive sits within broader efforts to improve public health infrastructure, with ongoing construction of new Sub-Health Centres, Block Public Health Units, residential quarters for health personnel, and a new OPD Block at Sub-Divisional Hospital, Kalanaur; and upgrades to Civil Hospital, Rohtak. Separately, emphasis remains on National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme with uninterrupted treatment and nutritional support for TB patients.

triage.headline_ja: ロータクでデング熱抑制のため「ドライフライデー」運動を開始
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季の通常の予防的公衆衛生キャンペーンであり、異常な流行や重大な公衆衛生影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: この記事はデング・マラリア・チクングニアの季節的予防対策（媒介蚊対策キャンペーン）についての報道であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: सबसे तेजी से फैलने वाला वायरस बना इबोला, 750 लोगों की मौत; वैज्ञानिक भी नहीं समझ पा रहे आखिर हो क्या रहा है
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus has become the fastest-spreading virus; 750 people have died; scientists can't understand what is happening.
article.articleSummary: In Congo, the Ebola outbreak has become the fastest-spreading in history, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths as of July 15, 2026. The World Health Organization says about 80% of new infections cannot be traced to a known source, and the virus has spread to two additional provinces, including the major city of Kisangani. Frontline workers at two large health centers remain unpaid and have gone on strike, signaling potential collapse of an already fragile health system in a remote area grappling with infrastructure gaps and misinformation that Ebola is fake. No approved vaccine or definitive cure exists for this variant, though two new treatments are under study. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids (vomit, blood, semen) of an infected person and by touching contaminated surfaces; zoonotic spillover from animals initiates infections.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが史上最速で拡大する感染症に、死者750人に。科学者も状況を把握できず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が過去最速で拡大し、2000例超・750人超の死亡、80%が感染経路不明、医療従事者ストライキで保健システム崩壊の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない変異株であり、感染源不明例が80%に上る点、医療従事者のストライキによる医療崩壊リスクが特に懸念される。続報でWHOの公式声明・国際対応状況の確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: कोविड, H1N1 आणि इन्फ्लूएंझा A च्या रुग्णांमध्ये वाढ; डॉक्टरांचा सल्ला काय?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19, H1N1, and Influenza A cases; what is the doctors' advice?
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Mumbai and several cities report rising cases of Influenza A, COVID-19, and H1N1 during the monsoon. A prominent singer tested positive for COVID-19, and Mumbai hospitals report increased positives for H1N1 and COVID-19; doctors warn of a seasonal spike in respiratory viruses. Dr. Anita Mathai of Fortis Hospital Mulund notes that monsoon conditions boost transmission of influenza A, COVID-19, and H1N1; Dr. Pradeep Bajad of Amrita Hospital Faridabad warns of a 'viral cocktail' with three viruses concurrently active. Because symptoms overlap (fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue, nasal congestion, shortness of breath), laboratory testing is advised for moderate/severe cases and high-risk individuals. Antibiotics are not effective against viral infections. High-risk groups (elderly over 60, diabetes, cardiovascular, lung, kidney, liver disease, cancer, transplant recipients, immunosuppressed) should seek prompt medical care. Preventive measures: vaccination, masks, hand hygiene, ventilation, and home rest when sick.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ、H1N1、インフルエンザAの患者が増加；医師のアドバイスは？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、H1N1、インフルエンザA）の通常の季節的増加に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節における既知の呼吸器ウイルス（COVID-19、H1N1、インフルエンザA）の季節的増加についての医師の注意喚起記事。新規性・異常性なし。有名歌手のCOVID陽性は話題性はあるが公衆衛生上の重大な懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : aucun nouveau cas d'Ebola depuis 47 jours (Rapport)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: no new Ebola case in 47 days (Report).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains active in the Democratic Republic of Congo across five provinces, with 42 health zones affected as of July 14, 2026. Cumulative confirmed cases reach 2,011; 753 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, 366 have recovered, and 754 deaths have been recorded (case fatality 37.5%; contact follow-up 67.4%). Ituri concentrates 27 of 31 new cases and all community deaths reported that day, with sustained transmission in the Djugu–Irumu corridor (notably Bunia, Lita, Nizi, Rwampara). Affected provinces and zones include Haut-Uele (Wamba); Ituri (Aru, Aungba, Bambu, Bunia, Damas, Drodro, Gety, Kilo, Komanda, Lita, Logo, Mambasa, Mangala, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Nyankunde, Rimba, Rwampara, Tchomia, Kambala, Nia-Nia, Fataki, Mandima, Lolwa, Boga, Ariwara); Nord-Kivu (Beni, Butembo, Goma, Kalunguta, Katwa, Kyondo, Oicha, Masereka, Vuhovi, Mabalako, Musienene); Sud-Kivu (Miti-Murhesa); Tshopo (Makiso-Kisangani, Lubunga, Mangobo). Sud-Kivu reports 47 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases as of July 12, 2026, but residual surveillance remains pending an official end-of-outbreak declaration.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州:47日間新規エボラ症例なし(報告)
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国5州にまたがる大規模エボラ流行が継続中(累計2,011例、死亡754例、致死率37.5%)であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 南キブ州では47日間新規症例なしだが、イツリ州(Djugu-Irumu回廊)を中心に他州で活発な伝播が継続しており、流行終息宣言には至っていない。地域を跨ぐ持続的な人-人感染が確認されているため国際的拡大リスクを高く評価した。
