article.articleHeadline: Campinas registra 20ª morte por gripe em 2026; são 247 casos confirmados da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas records 20th death from influenza in 2026; there are 247 confirmed cases of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil reports 247 confirmed influenza-related Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases and 20 deaths in 2026. Three June fatalities involved adults with preexisting conditions: a 69-year-old vaccinated man (died 7 June 2026), an 82-year-old vaccinated man (died 12 June 2026), and an 85-year-old unvaccinated woman (died 28 June 2026). Health authorities note ongoing circulation of influenza A (H1N1) and H3N2, plus influenza B, with vaccines available to anyone from 6 months old at 69 health centers; no appointment needed. Since 28 March, Campinas has administered 318,032 flu vaccine doses; as of 1 June, eligibility expanded to all residents aged 6 months and up. Prioritized groups: elderly 124,775 (55.78% coverage), children 6 months–<6 years 31,548 (46.17%), pregnant 5,928 (68.94%). In 2025, 561 SARI cases and 69 deaths, 54 unvaccinated. Preventive measures include handwashing, ventilation, hydration, healthy diet, and masking when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス市、2026年のインフルエンザによる死者20人目を記録；確定症例数は247例
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる通常の流行状況の報告であり、ワクチン接種体制も整っていることから、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1、H3N2、B型）の通常の流行報告。高齢者・基礎疾患保有者を中心とした死亡例であり、地方自治体のワクチン接種プログラムも機能している。前年（2025年）と比較しても大きな異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths double in one week as outbreak surpasses 2,000 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 confirmed deaths, with a 37% case fatality rate—the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak reported by WHO. The epidemic, centered in Ituri, has spread into two additional provinces. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; a clinical trial to improve treatment commenced in early July. Health officials warn the true number of infections may be 2–4 times higher than reported, since about 80% of newly identified cases occur outside monitored contact lists. Imported/exported cases include an American humanitarian worker infected in the DRC, with another patient evacuated to Germany (Dr. Peter Stafford) and a transfer to Frankfurt; the US has restricted official travel to the DRC. Economic projections warn of up to $1 billion GDP loss in DRC, potentially $3.6 billion continent-wide if spread continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者数が1週間で倍増、感染確認例が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで急速に拡大するエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが2000例・致死率37%に達し、国際的な感染拡大(ドイツ・米国への波及)と渡航制限が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国は感染者の輸送先/渡航制限国であり、実際の発生地はDRCのため対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ワクチン・治療法未承認、致死率37%、報告数の2-4倍の可能性ありなど重大な公衆衛生リスクが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يهدد شرق الكونغو: 702 وفاة و80% من الإصابات مجهولة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threatens eastern Congo: 702 deaths and 80% of infections unknown.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bunia, Ituri Province) reaches 1,926 cases and 702 deaths across three provinces as of 15 July 2026, with confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. Health authorities report a rare Ebola strain with no approved treatment or vaccine, making this the continent's fastest-spreading outbreak according to Africa CDC. About 80% of new infections occur in transmission chains that are unknown, hindering effective isolation and contact tracing; many fatalities have occurred in communities without access to health facilities. The combination of unknown transmission links and limited therapeutics underscores rapid propagation and containment challenges, with ongoing cross-border concerns to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ東部を脅かす：死者702人、感染の80%が原因不明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で治療薬・ワクチンのない希少株エボラが急速拡大し、死者702人・症例1926人に達し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。感染の80%が伝播経路不明で、承認された治療法・ワクチンがない希少株である点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Mangel an Ressourcen: Wie Kongo gegen den Ebola-Ausbruch kämpft
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shortage of Resources: How Congo Is Fighting the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri with Bunia as a focal point, expands rapidly: over 2,000 confirmed infections and 754 deaths across 42 of 117 health zones in three provinces; 20 confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda (two deaths). The Bundibugyo variant lacks licensed vaccine or targeted therapy. Resource shortages hinder response: hospital staff in Ituri's Rwampara district strike after nearly two months without pay; PPE scarce; terrain and security constraints impede access. Contact tracing is weak: 70–80% of new Bunia cases are not on contact lists, suggesting the true size could be 2–4 times official estimates. Donor funding cuts reduce food aid from the WFP and other NGOs, affecting isolation compliance; clinics close or operate with limited staff. Myths complicate actions; authorities urge community cooperation to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: 資源不足:コンゴはいかにしてエボラ流行と闘っているか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例超・死亡754例のエボラ流行が拡大し、隣国ウガンダにも波及。ワクチン未承認の変異株、資源不足、接触者追跡の脆弱性から過小評価の疑いがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびルワンダは記事に言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。接触者追跡の脆弱性(70-80%が未把握)から実際の症例数は公式発表の2-4倍の可能性があり、状況は依然として深刻化中。

article.articleHeadline: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Inter/ RDC : l'OMS alerte sur la progression de l'épidémie d'Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ivory Coast-AIP/ Inter/ DR Congo: WHO warns about the progression of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of unprecedented acceleration of Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 700 deaths among nearly 2,000 confirmed cases across five provinces as of July 11. The epicenter is Bunia, Ituri Province, with the outbreak expanding recently to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. In a Geneva briefing after a mission to Ituri, Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu said more than 80 new cases were confirmed in 24 hours, the fastest growth seen in an Ebola outbreak. About 80% of new infections stem from transmission chains not yet identified, hindering response operations. Experts estimate the true number of infections could be two to four times higher than reported due to detection and surveillance challenges. WHO calls for an intensive, sustained response in the primary epicenter while strengthening surveillance of population movements to prevent new transmission foci.

triage.headline_ja: コートジボワール-AIP/インター/DRC:WHOがブンディブギョ・エボラ流行の拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が5州に拡大し、感染連鎖の80%が未特定で、WHOが「前例のない加速」と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ジュネーブ(スイス)はWHO記者会見の開催地であり発生地ではないため除外。約2,000症例中700人超死亡、致死率約35%と極めて高く、新規感染の80%が感染経路不明という点でヒト-ヒト感染の制御が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: "أطباء بلا حدود" تدعو لتوسيع نطاق الاستجابة لـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders calls for expanding the scope of the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is outpacing containment efforts, urging an urgent expansion of containment and care measures. Official data show 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths in under five weeks, making this the third-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date. MSF runs seven treatment centers and over 15 isolation units in the DRC. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. MSF’s Trish Newport emphasizes that delays cost lives and calls for greater international coordination to improve patient care. The outbreak is spreading into non-urban areas with limited support and surveillance. A White House official says the administration plans to bar U.S. citizens in Congo from returning on commercial flights.

triage.headline_ja: 「国境なき医師団」がエボラ対応の拡大を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5週間未満に1926症例・702死亡という過去最速級のエボラ流行が発生し、米国が渡航制限を検討するなど国際的な関心と対応拡大の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 米国は流行発生国ではなく渡航制限措置の主体であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。致死率約36%、過去最速の流行拡大速度という点で極めて深刻な事案。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود تحذر: تفشي إيبولا في الكونجو يتسارع والوفيات ترتفع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating and deaths are rising.
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported as of Sunday. Described as the third-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date, transmission continues, fueled by population movement and delays in seeking care. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is responsible. MSF operates seven treatment centers and more than 15 isolation units across the country, but communities outside major towns face dire gaps in medical support and weak surveillance systems. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, and both internal and external bleeding, arising from direct contact with bodily fluids. Calls to widen the response and care, and to bolster international coordination, are urgent. The White House is considering restricting commercial air travel for U.S. citizens in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団が警告：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行が加速し、死者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926例・702人死亡の大規模流行が加速中であり、米国が渡航制限を検討するなど国際的関心も高いため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域として記載されているが、実際の流行地はDRCのみ。米国は渡航制限検討の主体として言及されているに過ぎないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया पर वार, 1 लाख जांच से खुली हकीकत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: War on Malaria: Truth Revealed by 100,000 Tests.
article.articleSummary: Jamshedpur, East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand, India reports intensified malaria control from 29 June to 12 July 2026 with surveillance, testing, treatment, Indoor Residual Spraying (IRS) and awareness campaigns. A total of 104,459 people were tested across community and urban health facilities and district hospital: 96,478 rapid diagnostic tests and 7,981 slides. Malaria positives reached 1,895 (1,491 P. falciparum, 353 P. vivax, 51 mixed infections), overall positivity 1.96%. Testing hotspots: Potka (24,657), Musabani (15,150), Ghatsila (12,121), Dumaria (11,060). Infections recorded: Potka 667; Dumaria 427; Musabani 344; Ghatsila 212; Sadar Hospital positivity 14.36%. Urban Mango had zero cases; Urban Birsa Nagar reported two. Six deaths (four cerebral malaria, two mixed infections) are under medical review. Officials urge prompt fever testing within 24 hours, avoiding stagnant water, using nets, and full cooperation with IRS and surveys.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアとの戦い：10万件の検査で明らかになった実態
triage.triage_reason: ジャールカンド州における季節性マラリアの通常のサーベイランス・対策活動の報告であり、風土病としての予想範囲内の事象だが、死亡例や高い陽性率がみられるため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアはジャールカンド州の風土病であり、記事は地方保健当局による既存のサーベイランス・対策プログラム（IRS、検査、啓発活動）の実施結果報告。6人の死亡例（脳性マラリア4例、混合感染2例）は医学的レビュー中とされ、地域レベルでの対応能力の範囲内と考えられるが、陽性率や重症例の推移について続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Caucaia realiza mutirão contra a dengue no bairro Parque das Nações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caucaia conducts a dengue-control drive in the Parque das Nações neighborhood.
article.articleSummary: Caucaia conducts a dengue-control mutirão in the Parque das Nações neighborhood to combat Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The Prefeitura de Caucaia launches a task force on Friday, July 17, starting at 8:00 at Escola Brasileirinho, with cleaning, mowing, and lime-wash activities. Technical visits will identify intervention areas, alongside educational outreach and distribution of pamphlets. Teams will mobilize Primary Health Care professionals and reinforce mosquito-control brigades in public buildings. The operation involves multiple city agencies: Health (SMS), Infrastructure (Seinfra), Social Development (SDS), Education (SME), the Caucaia Institute of Environment (IMAC), Patrimony, and Communications. Acting Health Secretary Thiciany Castro stresses that arbovirus control requires community engagement and small actions like removing standing water and allowing health agents access. Recommendations include keeping yards clean, sealing water tanks, clearing gutters, and ensuring containers have no standing water.

triage.headline_ja: カウカイア市、パルケ・ダス・ナソンイス地区でデング熱対策の一斉活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地域デング熱予防活動であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例の報告はなく、日常的な公衆衛生対策の範疇である。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体レベルの予防活動の告知であり、症例数や感染拡大状況についての言及はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri :une campagne de sensibilisation contre la maladie Ebola organisée à Tchomia - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: an awareness campaign against Ebola virus disease organized in Tchomia - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) awareness campaign organized in Tchomia, Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. On July 15, 2026, the Waso Foundation led outreach to reinforce prevention and counter misinformation about EVD and to cut transmission. Messages emphasize regular handwashing, disinfectants, hygiene, and avoiding touching eyes, nose, or mouth with unwashed hands; residents are urged not to keep the sick at home but to seek care promptly, as early treatment improves outcomes and protects others. Campaign visits covered the Church of the 20th CECA in Nana, the Nana port, the Nyamusasi IDP site, the Papa Jimmy salted fish depot, and the Kilimandjaro parking area at the market entrance. Interactive Q&A sessions addressed concerns and dispelled myths. Organizers plan to extend the awareness drive to other localities within the Tchomia rural health zone to strengthen community vigilance against EVD.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：チョミアでエボラウイルス病に関する啓発キャンペーンが実施される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラに関する啓発活動を報じるのみで、実際の症例発生や感染拡大の情報は含まれていないため、フルRRAに進めるだけの根拠は乏しいが、DRCでのエボラ関連動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はNGO（Waso Foundation）による啓発キャンペーンの報告であり、実際の症例数や発生確認情報は記載されていない。エボラは高致死性・流行性のある疾患であるため、地域での継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de síndrome respiratória aguda grave aumentam durante inverno no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases increase during winter in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) cases are rising during winter in the Rio de Janeiro region through September 22, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin, with high incidence but no clear growth trend. The report stresses vaccination as essential, especially for high‑risk groups, and outlines preventive measures such as covering the mouth when coughing and frequent handwashing. A frontline worker, a gas station attendant, notes personal protection from influenza after vaccination: "When I took the vaccine, I did not have the flu." The piece frames this as a seasonal burden of acute respiratory illness rather than a specific outbreak, urging continued influenza vaccination and basic infection‑control practices during winter. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロで冬季に重症急性呼吸器症候群の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器疾患増加であり、Fiocruzの定期報告に基づく通常の冬季傾向で明確な増加傾向もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ・SARS様疾患の通常の冬季増加とワクチン接種の呼びかけを主題としており、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Runaway Ebola Outbreak in Congo Hits 2,000+ Cases and Rising
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with cases tripling in under five weeks, making it the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. MSF warns containment is being outpaced and urges intensified international action; the World Health Organization notes the true scale may exceed official counts due to population movement and treatment delays. The May-declared global health emergency remains in effect. Across Africa, about 15,000 people have died from Ebola over the past 50 years, while the DRC’s deadliest outbreak (2018–2020) caused nearly 2,300 deaths. Travel measures are tightening: the United States requires citizens in the DRC to avoid returning on commercial flights and to spend at least 21 days in a third country; non-citizens who recently visited DRC, Uganda or South Sudan are barred from entering the U.S.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の制御不能な流行が2000例超に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCおよびウガンダでエボラ症例が急増（5週間で3倍増）し、WHOがグローバル公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言、米国が渡航制限を実施するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国も記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。史上3番目の規模・最速の拡大速度を持つエボラ流行であり、既にWHOによるPHEIC宣言と米国の渡航制限が発動済みのため即時のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: موارد ابولا در جمهوری کنگو از ۲۰۰۰ نفر گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Republic of the Congo surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases, now at 2,011, with 366 recoveries, 753 in isolation, and 754 deaths. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haute-Uele, and Tshopo—with Ituri remaining the epicenter and ongoing intense transmission. Emergence of new cases in Haute-Uele indicates geographic spread, signaling the urgent need to strengthen surveillance, diagnostic capacity, and operational preparedness. The outbreak remains in a sustained transmission phase, characterized by rapid case growth since its start. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が2000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し2000例超・死亡754例と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、地理的拡大と持続的伝播が続いているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%(754/2011)と高く、Haute-Ueleへの新規拡大が確認されており継続的な監視が必要。North Kivu, Haute-Ueleは対象国リストのADM1詳細だが国名として203312に集約。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : dans le Haut-Uélé, la mobilité minière et le déni accélèrent la propagation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In Haut-Uélé, mining-related mobility and denial accelerate the spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Haut-Uele now among five affected provinces (Ituri as epicenter, plus Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo). By July 13, 2026, the outbreak encompassed 37 health zones nationwide, recording 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. In Haut-Uele, mining- and trade-driven mobility around Nyanza and the Wamba Territory is a key transmission driver, complicating containment beyond urban Isiro where outreach is easier. A second barrier is social denial of the virus, including refusal to be tested, to undergo temperature checks, or to follow handwashing protocols. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Since early July, Bunia has hosted two experimental treatments; the response hinges on convincing mining communities of the danger amid limited health-system capacity. Dr. Steve Ahuka has been named field manager by the national Task Force.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:オートウエレ州で鉱業関連の人の移動と否認が感染拡大を加速
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5州37保健地域に拡大中のエボラ流行（確定2,011例、死亡754例）で、承認されたワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が原因であり、鉱業関連の人の移動と社会的否認により制御が困難化している。IHR基準の複数該当が明確。
triage.notes: 致死率は約37.5%（754/2011）と高い。承認ワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、鉱業・貿易関連の人の移動と地域住民の否認的態度が拡大要因として指摘されている。ケニアが発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事本文はDRC国内の流行についてのみ言及しており除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plus de 2.000 cas recensés en RDC, "rythme sans précédent" selon MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 2,000 cases recorded in the DRC, "unprecedented pace" according to MSF.
article.articleSummary: More than 2,000 Ebola cases, including 754 deaths, have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since the outbreak began, spanning five provinces with Ituri accounting for the majority. MSF warns the epidemic is advancing at an unprecedented pace: under five weeks, confirmed cases nearly tripled and deaths more than quintupled. The Bundibugyo variant may be two to four times larger than official counts, according to the WHO. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment yet for Bundibugyo, but the first clinical trial evaluating an antiviral post-exposure prophylaxis, obeldesivir (EBO-PEP), began on Tuesday in contacts of confirmed cases. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri; cases have appeared in five provinces and neighboring Uganda, though more than 90% remain in Ituri. Transmission is by close contact and bodily fluids; many cases die before reaching care; 80% of new cases are not on contact lists.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人以上の症例、MSFは「前例のないペース」と警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCで5州に拡大し、隣国ウガンダにも波及、症例数が急増しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ致死率高く(754/2000超)、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大が続いている点でリスク非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: 9個月大男嬰感染甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎和休克　情況危殆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 9-month-old male infant infected with influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia and shock in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a 9-month-old male infant with Influenza A, complicated by severe pneumonia and shock, currently in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Tuen Mun Hospital. Preliminary investigation shows he had not received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine. Symptoms began Monday with fever and cough; respiratory status deteriorated, with rapid breathing, loss of consciousness and cardiac arrest; he was resuscitated and admitted to PICU. Lab testing of a respiratory sample is positive for Influenza A, confirming the diagnosis. Household contacts are asymptomatic. Since late June, Hong Kong’s influenza season has begun and activity is rising, with a peak expected in coming weeks. Health authorities advise seeking prompt medical care for fever and respiratory symptoms, especially for children, the elderly, and those with chronic conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 生後9ヶ月の男児がA型インフルエンザに感染し、重症肺炎とショックを併発、危篤状態
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザ流行が始まった中、未接種の乳児1例が重症化した個別症例であり、現時点でクラスターや異常な拡大は確認されていないが、流行期の重症化動向として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は香港における個別重症例の報道であり、季節性インフルエンザの流行拡大局面での重症化事例として、今後の症例数・重症例の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ponad 2 tysiące zarażonych gorączką krwotoczną. Ebola zabiła już niemal 800 osób
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 infected with hemorrhagic fever. Ebola has already killed nearly 800 people.
article.articleSummary: On 15 July the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 2,011 confirmed Ebola infections and 754 deaths in its 17th outbreak since 1976, driven by the Bundibugyo strain lacking approved vaccine or therapy. Since May the epidemic has spread to Ituri, North Kivu and Upper Uele, with 54 new cases reported Monday; Uganda partially affected. The World Health Organization cautions the true scale may be 2-4 times higher than official counts, noting that about 80% of new confirmed cases involve people outside established contact lists. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo, though clinical trials of a promising therapy began last week. Health authorities warn that the outbreak is outpacing response capacities.

triage.headline_ja: 出血熱感染者2000人超。エボラで既に約800人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が拡大し、致死率も高く、ウガンダにも波及しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも一部影響を受けているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOは実際の感染規模が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘しており、対応能力を超えている状況。

article.articleHeadline: 9個月大男B染甲流命危　送院一度失心跳留醫PICU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 9-month-old male B infected with influenza A in critical condition; after being taken to hospital, his heart briefly stopped and he was admitted to the PICU.
article.articleSummary: A nine-month-old male infant in Hong Kong is critically ill with influenza A infection complicated by severe pneumonia and shock. On arrival at Tuen Mun Hospital, the child briefly lost consciousness and suffered a cardiac arrest but was resuscitated and admitted to the hospital’s Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU). Respiratory samples collected on July 14 confirmed influenza A. The patient had not received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine, and home contacts are currently asymptomatic. This single-case report comes as Hong Kong enters its influenza season, with health authorities noting rising influenza activity since late June and expecting further increases in the coming weeks. The case underscores the potential severity of influenza A in infants and the continued importance of vaccination and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 生後9ヶ月の男児がA型インフルエンザに感染し重体、搬送後に心停止しPICUに入院
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザ流行期に発生した重症の単発小児例であり、流行の異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 香港の季節性インフルエンザ流行期における単一重症例の報道であり、地元当局はワクチン接種の重要性を強調しているのみで、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念や国際的関心の高まりは確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus respiratórios e tempo seco acendem alerta para a saúde da população em Palmas e Araguaína - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory viruses and the dry season raise a public health alert in Palmas and Araguaína - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleSummary: Brazil reported 35,540 hospitalised cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) with identified respiratory viruses through Week 21, 2026, per the Ministry of Health. Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), influenza, and rhinovirus have been predominant. In Tocantins, RSV detection rose, especially among infants, young children, the elderly, and those with chronic diseases. The trend coincides with the dry season advancing in Palmas and other Tocantins towns, characterized by heat, less rain, and lower humidity. Dry weather does not cause flu or colds, but can dry airways and worsen symptoms in rhinitis, sinusitis, asthma, and bronchitis, and crowded, poorly ventilated spaces facilitate transmission. Alarm signs include breathing difficulty, wheeze, extreme fatigue, blue lips, persistent fever, dehydration, or deteriorating condition, needing medical evaluation. Common symptoms start like a cold (runny nose, cough, low fever) and may progress rapidly in vulnerable groups. Preventive measures: hydration, ventilation, hand hygiene, vaccination; avoid self-medication; antibiotics and certain syrups should be used only under professional guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器ウイルスと乾季がパルマスおよびアラグアイナの住民の健康に警鐘を鳴らす - コネクサォン・トカンチンス - ニュースポータル
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のRSV・インフルエンザ流行に関する通常の公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の呼吸器感染症流行（RSV、インフルエンザ）に関する定例的な公衆衛生情報であり、乾季による症状悪化への注意喚起が主目的。特段の異常事態やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: Especialista apresenta estratégias de prevenção à influenza suína no SBSS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Specialist presents strategies for preventing swine influenza at SBSS.
article.articleSummary: Swine influenza will be a focal point at the 18th Simpósio Brasil Sul de Suinocultura (SBSS) in Chapecó, Santa Catarina, Brazil, where veterinary specialist Ricardo Yuiti Nagae will present "Influenza in Focus: Impacts and Control Alternatives" on August 12 at 16:00, during the Health Panel - Respiratory Health at the Centro de Cultura e Eventos Plínio Arlindo de Nes. The talk addresses the major challenges of influenza in production systems, its animal health and economic consequences for pig production, and outlines prevention strategies and control options to reduce losses and strengthen herd health programs. Nagae, a Seara/JBS Health Animal Specialist for swine, holds a doctorate in Veterinary Sciences with emphasis in Swine Health and Pathology from UFRGS, with extensive experience in production, health management, and sanitary programs. The event also hosts the concurrent 17th Brasil Sul Pig Fair and a broad industry program for knowledge exchange.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がSBSSで豚インフルエンザ予防戦略を発表
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生ではなく、養豚業界向けシンポジウムでの豚インフルエンザ予防に関する講演告知であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、養豚業界シンポジウムでの講演内容の紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में एआई से तपेदिक के 25,600 से अधिक नए मामलों का पता लगाया गया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Haryana, more than 25,600 new cases of tuberculosis were detected by AI.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Haryana, India, saw significant AI-assisted progress during the 100-day second phase of the 'TB Free India Campaign'. From March 24 (World TB Day) to July 5, 2026, AI-enabled active case finding identified 25,666 new TB patients. The initiative leverages AI-based chest X-ray units to deliver rapid results, including in remote areas. During the period, 3,914 health camps were organized, 2,854 of which targeted high-risk villages and urban wards. A total of 473,197 individuals were screened, with 225,321 chest X-rays and 125,000 NAAT tests contributing to confirmed cases. The government distributed 23,962 nutrition kits to patients to support treatment adherence. The program focuses on early detection and timely treatment to curb transmission, demonstrating a shift from passive to proactive screening in Haryana.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州でAIにより25,600件以上の新規結核症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: AIを活用した積極的症例発見キャンペーンによる既知疾患（結核）の検出数増加であり、異常な流行や新興感染症ではなく、既存の公衆衛生プログラムの成果報告である。
triage.notes: これは新規アウトブレイクではなく、既存の国家結核対策プログラム（TB Free India Campaign）の進捗報告記事である。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 'Results of ASF vaccine trials still under close scrutiny' | Carmel Pedroza and Ada Pelonia
article.articleSummary: ASF vaccine trials in Cebu City remain under a controlled government program; the anti-ASF vaccine exists but is not licensed for commercial distribution and is overseen by the Bureau of Animal Industry. FDA approval is needed, requiring trial data on safety and efficacy. Ongoing results show antibodies in vaccinated pigs decline after about five months, and viral fragments were detected in urinary and intestinal tracts, raising environmental contamination concerns with biosecurity. The vaccine is therefore not yet recommended for widespread commercial use, especially among backyard and smallholder farms. There is no commercially available anti-ASF vaccine in the Philippines; rollout will continue under national guidelines with selected areas and participants, pending further data. Separately, BAI reports highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 in Pangasinan backyard poultry; initial case confirmed May 22 (ADDRL), with additional nearby cases. Measures include culling, disposal, cleaning/disinfection, movement control, and intensified monitoring. Properly cooked poultry and eggs are safe.

triage.headline_ja: ASFワクチン試験の結果、引き続き精査中
triage.triage_reason: ASFワクチン試験および家禽におけるH5N1発生は継続的な動物衛生上の課題だが、ヒトへの感染例は報告されておらず、既存の管理体制下にあるためフルRRAには進まないが動向を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はASFワクチン開発の進捗（環境中へのウイルス断片検出等のバイオセキュリティ懸念）と、パンガシナン州の裏庭養鶏場でのH5N1発生（5月22日確認）について報告しているが、いずれもヒト感染例の言及はなく、動物衛生当局による通常の管理措置（殺処分、消毒、移動制限、監視強化）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak tops 2,000 cases in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) surpasses 2,000 cases with 754 deaths. WHO warns true burden may be 2–4 times higher than official figures. Five provinces are affected; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. The first antiviral trial, EBO-PEP, evaluating obeldesivir in exposed individuals, has begun. MSF warns the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with cases tripling in under five weeks and deaths more than fivefold, already exceeding half the cases of the 2018–2020 epidemic. WHO emergencies chief Chikwe Ihekweazu notes 80% of new infections are not on known contact lists and many deaths occur before health facilities are reached. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri province, an area where armed groups frequently carry out deadly attacks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の発生が2,000症例を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が2,000例超・死者754人と急拡大し、WHOも真の症例数はより多いと警告。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、5州に拡大、感染経路不明例が80%と、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性が高くフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、EBO-PEP試験（obeldesivir）が開始された点、武装勢力の活動地域での対応困難も含めリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ölümcül virüs durmuyor: Kongo'da Ebola alarmı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus shows no signs of stopping: Ebola alarm in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with confirmed cases surpassing 2,000 and 754 deaths. Health authorities report 2,011 confirmed cases since the May 15 outbreak declaration, 366 recoveries, and 753 people currently in isolation. The epicenter remains Ituri Province, where transmission stays intense, while Haut-Uele Province has reported new cases, indicating geographic spread. The situation calls for immediate strengthening of surveillance, diagnostic capacity, and operational preparedness to contain spread. The response notes the ongoing ‘continuous transmission’ phase, underscoring the urgency for enhanced public health measures to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 死のウイルスは止まらない：コンゴでエボラ警報
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例2,011例、死亡754例と大規模な流行が継続し、地理的拡大も見られるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州が震源地で、オートウエレ州にも新規症例が報告され地理的拡大が進行中。継続的な感染伝播フェーズにあり、サーベイランス・診断能力・対応体制の強化が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Muertes por ébola se duplican en dos semanas mientras el brote se acelera en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths from Ebola double in two weeks as the outbreak accelerates in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, described by WHO as the fastest-growing outbreak the agency has faced. As of July 15, 2026, the country reports 2,011 cases and 754 confirmed deaths, up from 377 deaths on June 28, with epicenter in Ituri and spread to two additional provinces. The true scale may be 2–4 times the official tally, since about 80% of new infections occur outside tracked contact lists. The crude fatality rate has risen to 37% (from 32% a week earlier) due to delays in diagnosis, isolation, and access to care, not increased virulence; around 92% of the 430 deaths analyzed occurred before patients reached treatment centers. Early detection and rapid treatment are emphasized. More than 240 people have fled treatment or isolation centers, including 100 in the last month, underscoring retention challenges. The outbreak already exceeds half the total cases of Congo’s 2018–2020 outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が加速、2週間で死者数が倍増
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「直面した中で最も急速に拡大する流行」と評価し、死者数が2週間で倍増、致死率も上昇するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 実際の感染規模は公式報告の2〜4倍の可能性があり、追跡外での感染が約80%を占める点、治療センターからの逃亡者が240人超に上る点は流行制御の困難さを示唆する重要情報。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情失控破2千例　譚德塞世衛警告：實際恐高出數倍 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Ebola outbreak spiraling out of control, surpassing 2,000 cases; Tedros warns WHO: the actual numbers could be several times higher.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a severe Ebola outbreak with over 2,000 cases and 754 deaths. WHO warns actual infections could be two to four times higher, as the outbreak spreads across five provinces in central and eastern DR Congo. MSF reports unprecedented expansion and urges urgent scaling of medical relief; in less than five weeks, cases have tripled and deaths more than quintupled, surpassing half of the total cases from the 2018–2020 outbreak. Chikwe Ihekweazu of WHO notes that about 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, indicating transmission through unknown chains and many patients dying before seeking care. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus; no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. An EBO-PEP trial was launched to evaluate obeldesivir (Gilead) for protection of contacts. It began May 15 in Ituri province, a northeastern region with mineral wealth and armed conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が制御不能に、2000例超え　テドロス事務局長「実際の数は数倍に上る恐れ」とWHO警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000例超・754人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大し、致死性ウイルスに対するワクチン・治療法未承認かつ80%が感染経路不明であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接警告を発しており、MSFも緊急支援拡大を要請。過去(2018-2020年)の流行と比較しても急速な拡大を見せており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plus de 2.000 cas recensés en RDC, "rythme sans précédent" selon MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 2,000 cases recorded in the DRC, "unprecedented pace" according to MSF.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo variant has surpassed 2,000 cases with 754 deaths reported as of July 15, 2026, across five provinces, with Ituri province bearing the majority. Health authorities warn the epidemic is spreading at an unprecedented pace; MSF notes case confirmations have tripled in under five weeks and deaths more than quintupled. The World Health Organization cautions that Bundibugyo may be 2–4 times higher than official counts due to under-detection. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. On July 2026, a clinical trial (EBO-PEP) started to evaluate post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir in contacts of confirmed cases. The outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri, has reached five DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda, though over 90% of cases remain in Ituri; about 80% of new infections have unknown transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人以上の症例、MSFによれば「前例のないペース」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブジョ株)がDRC5州とウガンダに拡大し、2000例超・死者754人、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく感染経路不明例が多いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、80%が感染経路不明という点で流行制御の困難さが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola na África: surto no Congo chega a 2 mil casos e 754 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: outbreak in Congo reaches 2,000 cases and 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of July 13, with a case-fatality rate of 37.5%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. Currently, 753 patients are in isolation or hospitalized and 366 have recovered. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, with 20 confirmed cases there (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths. WHO classifies the regional risk as high in Sub-Saharan Africa and low globally; it was declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever and hemorrhagic symptoms. Past major outbreaks include West Africa (2014–2016) and East DRC (2018–2020).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ:コンゴでの流行が2000症例、754人の死亡に達する
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行がウガンダへ越境し、致死率37.5%と深刻。IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Maricá reforça conscientização e prevenção às hepatites virais no Julho Amarelo | Maricá | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maricá reinforces awareness and prevention of viral hepatitis during Yellow July | Maricá | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Maricá intensifies awareness and prevention of viral hepatitis during Yellow July, expanding information access, rapid testing, and preventive measures across the city. The program began July 9 with an educational talk at Ambulatório Péricles Siqueira, covering major hepatitis virus types, transmission routes, symptoms, and the importance of testing. Health officials emphasize that early diagnosis improves treatment outcomes and reduces complications. A continuing action took place on July 15 at Praça Orlando de Barros Pimentel, Centro, offering rapid hepatitis testing, population guidance, and condom distribution. In Maricá, hepatitis testing is available year-round at all Family Health Units (USFs) and at the Specialized Care Service (SAE) in Araçatiba, with tests available on demand without prior scheduling. Hepatitis awareness and prevention efforts target the liver impact of these infections, underscoring access to health services and timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: マリカ市、イエロージュリー（黄色い7月）でウイルス性肝炎の啓発と予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: これはブラジル・マリカ市における恒例の啓発キャンペーン（Yellow July）に関する報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常な感染症事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は肝炎予防啓発キャンペーンの通常運用に関する内容であり、具体的な症例数増加やアウトブレイクの言及はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベント自体がシグナルに該当しないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : En RD-Congo, comment vivre sa foi sous la menace du virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: In the DRC, how to live out one's faith under the threat of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in the northeastern Ituri province city of Bunia. The piece focuses on how faith communities respond as the virus threatens daily life, opening with worship at Notre-Dame-de-Grâce-Mudzi-Maria Cathedral in Bunia. It documents the social and spiritual impact of the outbreak on residents and religious leaders, illustrating how chants and communal rituals continue under the shadow of Ebola. No specific case counts or laboratory-confirmed details are provided in the excerpt, but the narrative frames faith as a coping mechanism and a source of guidance amid fear and public health measures. Location: Bunia, Ituri, DR Congo. The article underscores the intersection of religion, community resilience, and outbreak dynamics in the context of the Ebola threat.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国で、ウイルスの脅威下で信仰をどう生きるか
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行という重篤な感染症の継続的発生に関する報道であり、WPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当し、社会的関心も示されているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は宗教・社会的側面に焦点を当てており、症例数や新規感染拡大に関する具体的なデータは含まれていない。既存のエボラ流行状況の続報として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19: क्या देश में फिर लौट रहा है कोरोना? बढ़ते मामलों के बीच जानिए डॉक्टरों की सलाह और बचाव के जरूरी उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Is the coronavirus returning to the country again? Learn doctors' advice and the essential precautions amid rising cases.
article.articleSummary: Localized COVID-19 upticks in Andhra Pradesh and other Indian cities signal no national crisis; SARS-CoV-2 is now endemic, circulating like influenza. The current rise is described as temporary and locally concentrated, driven by seasonal changes, travel, festivals, social events, and the emergence of new variants. Most infections are mild, aided by vaccination and prior infections forming immunity that lowers the risk of severe disease. Common symptoms include fever, sore throat, cough, fatigue, runny nose, and body aches; testing is prompted by respiratory symptoms. High‑risk groups—older adults, pregnant women, and those with diabetes, heart or lung conditions, or weakened immunity—should wear masks in crowded areas and maintain hand hygiene, and seek medical advice if symptoms worsen (shortness of breath, high fever, chest pain). No lockdowns are currently needed; health systems emphasize vigilance and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：コロナウイルスは再び国内に戻ってきているのか？ 感染者増加の中での医師のアドバイスと必要な予防策
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19はインドで既にエンディミック化しており、記事も局所的・一時的な増加でパニック不要と強調している。重症度や異常性の指標もなく、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はアンドラプラデシュ州を含むインド国内の局所的なCOVID-19増加についての一般向け医療アドバイス記事であり、危機的状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rapid increase in influenza A cases, how to avoid it?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid increase in influenza A cases, how to avoid it?.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Mumbai, India, amid renewed COVID-19 activity in parts of the country. Health experts report an unusual surge and urge precautions, including masks in crowded settings. Doctors note that while monsoon and winter seasons typically drive influenza A transmission, this year's numbers are higher. Influenza A spreads via droplets from coughing or sneezing; symptoms overlap with COVID‑19, including sudden fever, body aches, sore throat, dry cough, headache, and fatigue. Most healthy individuals recover in about 5–7 days, but older adults, pregnant women, young children, and people with diabetes, asthma, heart disease, or weakened immunity are at greater risk for pneumonia and complications. Contributing factors include travel, crowded indoor environments, and changes in weather. Prevention: regular handwashing, covering coughs or sneezes, mask use in public, good ventilation at home and work, and seasonal influenza vaccination for high‑risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型症例が急増、その予防法とは？
triage.triage_reason: インド・ムンバイでインフルエンザA型症例が「異常な急増」と報告されており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性、流行しやすさ、持続的曝露）に該当し、社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザAの季節的増加とCOVID-19活動の再燃を報告しているが、重症度や国際的拡大の明確な証拠はなく、季節性要因も指摘されている。続報でのデータ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola cases surpass 2,000 as more health workers begin strike - British Caribbean News
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak in the Ituri region has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The epicentre around Bunia, including Bunia General Hospital, saw healthcare workers strike over unpaid wages and unsafe conditions, joining prior walkouts at nearby facilities such as Rwampara General Hospital. Médecins Sans Frontières notes this outbreak is the third largest and fastest growing on record. The World Health Organization warned the official death toll may be two to four times higher than reported. The outbreak began on 15 May and is caused by Bundibugyo virus (BVD), for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. A first antiviral post-exposure prevention trial was launched on Tuesday to test protection for exposed high-risk contacts, signaling potential progress if effective.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ症例が2,000人を超え、さらに多くの医療従事者がストライキを開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョウイルス)の大規模流行(2,011症例、754死亡)で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、医療従事者ストライキによる対応能力低下も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の死者数が報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を警告しており、過小報告のリスクが高い。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョウイルスによる史上3番目に大きく最速拡大の流行であり、医療従事者ストライキが対応能力をさらに低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS anuncia el primer ensayo de un antiviral contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces the first trial of an antiviral against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-15, the World Health Organization announced the first clinical trial to evaluate an antiviral for Ebola exposure. The EBO-PEP study tests obeldesivir, an oral antiviral developed by Gilead Sciences, as post-exposure prophylaxis in people who have had direct contact with confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The trial aims to enroll about 1,000 participants aged 12 years and older who were exposed within the past five days but are asymptomatic. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for this Bundibugyo variant. The outbreak, centered in Ituri Province with spillover into neighboring Uganda, has infected more than 1,960 people and caused more than 700 deaths. If effective in high-risk exposed individuals, the treatment could represent an important advance in preventing disease progression.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスに対する初の抗ウイルス薬治験を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは1,960人以上の感染、700人以上の死亡を伴い、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されている重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへのスピルオーバーが報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ株には現在承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、WHOによる治験（EBO-PEP）が進行中である点も高リスク性を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: En République démocratique du Congo, l'épidémie progresse à un " rythme sans précédent " selon MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epidemic is progressing at an unprecedented pace according to MSF.
article.articleSummary: Over 2,000 Ebola cases and 754 deaths have been recorded across five provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, health authorities reported on 15 July 2026. Since the outbreak began, the numbers have surged rapidly, with the confirmed case count tripling in less than five weeks. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that the epidemic is progressing at an unprecedented pace, signaling swift and broad transmission within the DRC. The report underscores the mounting burden on local health systems as authorities strive to scale up surveillance, diagnostic capacity, and response measures in affected areas. The article provides the aggregate figures and growth rate, without detailing symptoms, laboratory confirmation protocols, or infection sources beyond the overall totals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、MSFによれば流行は「前例のないペースで」拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州で2000例超・死者754人と急拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: MSFが前例のない拡大速度と警告しており、5週間未満で症例数が3倍に増加。致死率(754/2000超)も高水準であり、詳細なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns now 'not the time to drop the ball' as Ebola cases surge
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of July 11, with nearly 2,000 infections and 700 deaths overall. Five provinces are affected, concentrated in Ituri (about 95% of new cases) and recently spreading to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Declared two months ago, it is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. More than 80 new infections were confirmed, with roughly 80% arising from unknown transmission chains not linked to monitored contacts. Many deaths occur before patients reach health facilities, suggesting the true scale could be 2–4 times higher. There is no approved treatment for Bundibugyo; several experimental therapies are in trials. Early supportive care improves survival, and WHO calls for sustained international cooperation to identify cases sooner and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ感染急増を受け『今は手を緩める時ではない』と警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブジョ株)の大規模流行が継続中で死亡者700人超、5州に拡大し不明感染経路が多いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 承認された治療法がなく、約80%の感染経路が不明であることから、地域拡大・国際協力の必要性が高い。第3位規模の史上大規模流行として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai remains major dengue, malaria hotspot; 'peak' yet to arrive, doctors caution
article.articleSummary: Mumbai remains the dengue and malaria hotspot in Maharashtra during the monsoon, with peak transmission not yet reached. Jan 1–Jul 14, 2026: Maharashtra reports 3,115 dengue and 3,498 malaria cases; three dengue deaths recorded as of July 7. Mumbai accounts for about 30% of state dengue (938 cases) and the majority of malaria infections (3,681 cases), including 575 Plasmodium falciparum cases and 187 imported malaria. The city also recorded 28 chikungunya cases. Statewide, malaria totals 5,459 (down from 7,443 in 2025); dengue 3,115; chikungunya 648. Health officials warn that intermittent rainfall sustains stagnant water and mosquito breeding, urging residents to eliminate water in containers, pots, coolers, and other household items. Pune Municipal Corporation dengue is 354; Gadchiroli district has the highest malaria burden (673 cases).

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイはデング熱・マラリアの主要流行地であり続ける、ピークはまだ到来していないと医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期における例年通りの季節性デング熱・マラリア発生報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マハラシュトラ州・ムンバイにおける季節性のデング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの発生状況報告。前年比でマラリア症例数は減少しており、地域の公衆衛生当局が通常のモンスーン対策（水たまり除去等）を呼びかける内容。国際的な懸念事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Fact Check: क्या आंध्र प्रदेश में आ रही है कोरोना की नई लहर? कडप्पा में 2 मौतों के बाद स्वास्थ्य विभाग का बड़ा स्पष्टीकरण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fact Check: Is there a new wave of COVID-19 coming to Andhra Pradesh? After two deaths in Kadapa, the health department issued a major clarification.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 deaths in YSR Kadappa district, Andhra Pradesh: two fatalities and eight active cases as of late June 2026. The first case, a 60-year-old man from Rajampet, died in a Vellore hospital on 28 June 2026; the second, a 46-year-old Kadappa resident, died after severe lung infection. Eight active cases are currently reported, mostly mild or asymptomatic and in home isolation. A 24x7 district control room has been established, and samples are being sent to NIV Pune for genome sequencing to identify the viral variant. Experts say this is not a new wave; no surge in other districts or hospitalizations. Clusters likely reflect endemic, seasonal immunity waning, not a large outbreak. Odisha has heightened vigilance near Jagannath Rath Yatra as a precaution. High-risk groups include elderly, diabetics, heart/kidney disease patients, immunocompromised individuals, and pregnant women; no lockdown is advised.

triage.headline_ja: ファクトチェック：アンドラプラデーシュ州で新型コロナの新たな波が来ているのか？カダパ県で2人死亡後、保健当局が大きな見解を発表
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデーシュ州カダパ県でCOVID-19による死亡2例・軽症例8例が報告されたが、専門家は「新しい波ではない」と否定しており、他地域への拡大や重症化の急増は見られない。ただしゲノム解析結果待ちのため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 2000 حالة إصابة بإيبولا فى الكونغو الديمقراطية بينهم 754 حالة وفاة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 Ebola infection cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 754 deaths - Youm7.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, per official government data as of 15 July 2026. About 753 people remain in isolation or receiving hospital treatment, while 366 have recovered. Authorities describe the outbreak as the fastest on record. Contact tracing faces major challenges, with only about 67% coverage of those exposed, amid the spread of the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain since 15 May 2026. The World Health Organization notes that at least 80% of new infections originate from transmission chains that are unknown, underscoring surveillance and response gaps in the Congo outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Medical charity urges Ebola response scale-up in DR Congo as confirmed cases jump above 2,000
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths (case fatality rate 37.5%), with the outbreak declared May 15. It has reached five provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Tshopo—and 41 health zones; the WHO reports 42 health zones in the past week, signaling rapid expansion and transmission chains that remain largely unknown. The epidemic is the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record over two months. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) calls for a scaled-up response, demanding stronger international action and increased resources across surveillance, testing and diagnosis, community engagement, dignified burials, and care. Africa CDC has launched the first clinical trial of post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir in Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応の拡大を要請 確定症例数2,000人超え
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州41〜42保健地区に拡大し、確定症例2,000人超・致死率37.5%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大の流行で国際的拡大リスクも高いため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内での流行拡大が主題。Ugandaは臨床試験実施国として言及されているが、感染発生地としては明記されておらず対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Shenaz Treasury's monsoon food poisoning prompts expert warning
article.articleSummary: Shenaz Treasury, a former VJ and content creator, reports recurrent monsoon food poisoning in Mumbai. Doctors warn Rainy-season conditions—high humidity, fluctuating temperatures, and contaminated water—facilitate growth of bacteria such as E. coli and Salmonella and various viruses. Water used for drinking, cleaning vegetables, or preparing food can raise infection risk. Street food, raw salads, cut fruits, and undercooked meat or seafood elevate exposure during the rains. Typical symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal cramps, fever, and dehydration, appearing within hours to days after consuming contaminated fare. Prevention emphasizes freshly prepared, well-cooked meals, safe or boiled water, rigorous hand hygiene, and avoiding foods left at room temperature. Most cases are mild and managed with hydration and rest; seek prompt care for persistent vomiting, severe diarrhea, blood in stools, high fever, or dehydration, especially in children, older adults, or immunocompromised individuals. Mumbai doctors Lad and Zanwar provided guidance.

triage.headline_ja: シェナーズ・トレジャリーの季節性食中毒、専門家が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 著名人の個人的な食中毒経験に基づく一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季の食品衛生に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例クラスターの報告ではないため対象国のverified_locationsも該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Risiko Makan Telur Setengah Matang, Awas Ada Diare!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of eating undercooked eggs, beware of diarrhea!
article.articleSummary: Indonesia warns that undercooked eggs can carry Salmonella, causing salmonellosis. Eggs may be contaminated before reaching consumers; eating partially cooked or raw eggs risks foodborne illness. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal cramps, fever, chills, and malaise, typically starting 12–36 hours after ingestion and lasting several days to a week. Vulnerable groups—children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with weakened immune systems or chronic diseases—should avoid raw or undercooked eggs unless pasteurized. Pasteurized eggs, heated to kill bacteria without fully cooking, are safer for recipes needing raw eggs. Practical advice: choose clean, crack-free shells; refrigerate; cook until both white and yolk are firm; use pasteurized eggs for raw preparations; wash hands and utensils after handling raw eggs. Despite benefits, avoiding undercooked eggs protects public health in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 半熟卵を食べるリスク、下痢に注意！
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、一般的な食品安全に関する啓発記事であり、異常事象や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイクではなく、生・半熟卵によるサルモネラ症リスクに関する一般的な健康啓発情報である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Race for Bundibugyo vaccine underway | CNBC Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has intensified and spread to additional provinces. As of 15 July 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. Oxford University has begun the first human trial of a vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, while researchers in the DRC are testing Gilead Sciences' experimental antiviral as a post-exposure treatment. The rapid vaccine and therapeutic developments reflect an urgent race to contain the outbreak. Dr. Francis Ohanyido, Director-General of the West African Institute of Public Health, discusses the implications and response. Ongoing coordination between academic, industry, and public health entities is underway to advance these interventions.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo passes 2,000 cases and 750 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, per government data. The outbreak began May 15, with Bunia General Hospital at the epicenter; hospital workers have staged a pay-related strike. It is the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, with cases tripling in under five weeks. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak remains in an expansion phase driven by population movements and treatment delays. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, and symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo, complicating containment. A vaccine targeting Bundibugyo is under development and set for a UK trial—Oxford University plans a safety/immune response study in 50 healthy adults (18–55), pending regulatory approval and upcoming vaccinations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行、症例数2,000人、死者750人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が史上3番目の規模かつ最速の拡大速度で、死亡率が高く、承認されたワクチン・治療法もないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 英国オックスフォード大学でのワクチン臨床試験は英国内の活動であり、感染発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、封じ込めが困難な点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se alastra pela República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Spreads Across the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported more than 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths across five provinces, with the outbreak spreading into new areas at an unprecedented pace. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the surge demands an urgent reinforcement of the medical response. In under five weeks, confirmed cases have tripled and deaths quintupled, with the tally approaching half of totals from the 2018–2020 DRC Ebola epidemic. The World Health Organization notes about 80% of new infections are not linked to known contact lists, arising from unknown transmission chains and often following deaths before reaching a health facility. The Bundibugyo variant may be 2–4 times higher than official estimates. There are no vaccines or treatments for this variant yet, though the first antiviral efficacy trial began on Tuesday.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で拡大

triage.notes: MSFやWHOが緊急対応強化を要請しており、既知の2018-2020年流行に迫る規模。ワクチン・治療薬未整備のBundibugyo株が関与し、実際の症例数は公式発表の2-4倍の可能性がある点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: 9個月大男嬰甲流併發嚴重肺炎和休克 情況危殆 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 9-month-old boy with influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia and shock, in critical condition
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Hong Kong’s Center for Health Protection reports a severe influenza A case in a 9‑month‑old boy. He developed fever and cough on 13 July; by 13–14 July he deteriorated with rapid breathing, loss of consciousness, and cardiac arrest, was resuscitated, and admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Tuen Mun Hospital. Respiratory samples on 14 July tested positive for influenza A, with a clinical diagnosis of influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia and shock; the infant remains critically ill. The patient was not vaccinated with the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine; home contacts are currently asymptomatic. The center will continue investigation. Hong Kong entered the influenza season at the end of June 2026, with rising activity; surveillance suggests further increases over the coming weeks before a peak. Keywords: influenza A, severe pneumonia, shock, pediatric, Hong Kong, vaccination status, critical condition.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 2,000, with 754 deaths, as the outbreak continues. The Health Ministry reports five provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo. Currently, 753 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and in North Kivu bed occupancy has exceeded 120%, stretching treatment capacity. The report indicates the outbreak is expanding and calls for intensified surveillance and testing, alongside strengthened containment efforts in neighboring provinces to curb further spread.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak: confirmed cases rise to 2,011, with 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 754 deaths linked to a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Ituri province, centered on Bunia. The outbreak began May 15 and has spread rapidly, with 80% of new infections linked to unknown transmission chains. About 753 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, and 366 have recovered; high-risk contacts are being tracked at roughly 67%. Armed conflict and mining-driven population movement complicate tracing, and many community deaths occur without hospital care. There is currently no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo; by contrast, Zaire ebolavirus vaccines exist. Healthcare workers in Ituri have staged strikes after unpaid salaries, further hindering response. A clinical trial evaluating two potential Ebola therapies is underway in Ituri.

article.articleHeadline: MSF: El ébola avanza a un ritmo sin precedentes en RD del Congo tras dos meses de epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: Ebola advances at an unprecedented pace in the DRC after two months of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Two months after the Ebola outbreak was declared in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, MSF reports an unprecedented spread, making it the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Government data show 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with the epicenter still in Ituri and dissemination to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The outbreak has also reached Uganda, recording 20 confirmed cases, 15 imported from the DRC and two deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, with a case-fatality rate of 30–50%, and there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO designated the event a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic symptoms. MSF calls for faster, community-centered response amid conflict, displacement, and other concurrent health emergencies like cholera and malaria.
