article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : l'épidémie d'Ebola fait chuter les déplacements vers l'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Ebola outbreak reduces travel to Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ituri province is the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak, with 753 confirmed deaths as of July 15, 2026. Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo, reports a sharp collapse in travel to Ituri along the Nia-Nia–Kisangani axis, with transporters carrying cargo or only a few passengers. Merchants and travellers bound for the west still pause there, but passenger and cargo flows have plummeted, and earnings for drivers and motorcycle taxis have eroded (two-passenger limit on motorbike taxis; losses exceeding 100,000 FC per trip reported). Four confirmed Ebola cases in Kisangani are imported from Nia-Nia, highlighting cross-border transmission risk. The Ituri health zone remains the outbreak’s focus, and the health minister visited Kisangani last Sunday as surveillance and response efforts intensify amid ongoing transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ流行によりイトゥリへの移動が急減
triage.triage_reason: 第17次エボラ流行が継続中で753人の死亡が確認され、イトゥリからキサンガニへの越境感染事例も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: イトゥリ保健区が流行の震源地であり、キサンガニで確認された4例はニアニア由来の輸入例。保健大臣の視察が報告されており、政府の関心も高い。経済活動（輸送業）への影響も顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Jovem morto por influenza terá velório nesta quarta-feira em Santo André
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young man who died of influenza will have a wake this Wednesday in Santo André.
article.articleSummary: One 13-year-old boy, Lucas Perez Maia, died in Santo André, Brazil, from complications of influenza. The fatal illness occurred on Tuesday, July 14, 2026. Lucas was a member of Clube Atlético Aramaçan. A wake is scheduled for Wednesday, July 15, 2026, from 9:30 to 13:30 at Nossa Senhora do Carmo Cemetery (Curuçá) on Rua Coréia in Parque das Nações, Santo André. He would have turned 14 on August 28. The Clube Atlético Aramaçan issued a condolence notice, expressing support for his family, friends, and associates. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, symptoms, or potential infection source, nor any mention of an ongoing outbreak. No other cases are reported in the piece.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザで死亡した若者、サント・アンドレで水曜日に通夜
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個別死亡事例の報道であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザによる個別死亡事例の地域報道。アウトブレイクや異常な流行を示唆する記述なし。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa On Ebola Alert As Hospitals Prepare for Outbreak
article.articleSummary: South Africa has placed 36 hospitals on standby and tightened screening at ports of entry as Ebola outbreaks spread in Africa, including the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with no confirmed cases in the country. Health Minister Dr Aaron Motsoaledi said 24 public and 12 private hospitals are prepared to isolate and treat suspected Ebola patients if needed. Ebola carries a case fatality rate of about one-third to 50% and spreads only through direct contact with the blood or bodily fluids of an infected person or contaminated objects, not through the air. Core symptoms include severe fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding. To reduce imported risk, port health officials and the Border Management Authority screen travelers; the National Institute for Communicable Diseases remains on high alert. Early detection, surveillance, and hygiene are emphasized, with guidance to seek care after travel or exposure. Experts caution funeral practices can pose transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ、エボラ警戒態勢へ 病院がアウトブレイクに備える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが周辺国へ拡大する懸念があり、IHR基準の複数項目（重篤性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南アフリカの警戒対応だが、実際のエボラ発生国はDRC（およびウガンダ、対象国リスト外）であり、南アフリカ自体には確定症例なし。DRCのアウトブレイク状況が今後のRRAで確認されるべき。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Viral Cocktail : पावसाळ्यात 'व्हायरल कॉकटेल'चा धोका; कोविड, H1N1 आणि इन्फ्लूएंझा 'ए'ची लक्षणे दिसल्यास करू नका दुर्लक्ष
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Cocktail: The risk of a 'viral cocktail' during the monsoon season; do not ignore if you notice symptoms of COVID, H1N1, and Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, Mumbai and several other cities report concurrent circulation of COVID-19, H1N1, and Influenza A during the monsoon, dubbed a 'viral cocktail.' The three viruses cause largely similar symptoms: fever with persistent cough, sore throat, body aches and headache, fatigue, shortness of breath, and, in some cases, diarrhea. Most infections are mild, but high-risk groups require special caution: people over 60; those with diabetes, heart, lung, kidney, or liver diseases; cancer patients or organ transplant recipients; and individuals on immunosuppressive medications. Advice: do not self-medicate with antibiotics; seek medical advice if symptoms persist beyond 48 hours and get tested when indicated. Preventive measures include masking in crowded places, regular handwashing, good ventilation, and complete vaccination. Early diagnosis and proper treatment can mitigate risk.

triage.headline_ja: Viral Cocktail：モンスーン期に「ウイルスカクテル」のリスク；コロナ、H1N1、インフルエンザAの症状を見逃さないで
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19・H1N1・インフルエンザA同時流行に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、重症化や異常な拡大を示す具体的データがなく、既知の季節性疾患の注意喚起にとどまる。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に見られる季節性ウイルスの同時流行に関する健康啓発記事で、具体的な症例数・死亡数の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Laguna confirma primeiro caso de dengue contraído na cidade em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Laguna confirms first locally acquired dengue case in the city in 2026
article.articleSummary: Autochthonous dengue confirmed in Laguna, Santa Catarina, Brazil, as of July 15, 2026, marking the first locally transmitted dengue case within the municipality in 2026. The infection occurred in Laguna, signaling circulation of the dengue virus in southern Santa Catarina. Health authorities report intensified epidemiological surveillance, expanded Aedes aegypti control measures, and public guidance urging residents to eliminate mosquito breeding sites. There is no mention of deaths or imported cases; focus remains on local transmission risk and vector management. The confirmation triggers heightened vigilance for dengue symptoms such as fever, headache, muscle and joint pains, and rash, and underscores the need for community participation in eliminating standing water and reporting suspected cases to health services. Ongoing monitoring will assess spread within the region.

triage.headline_ja: ラグーナ市、2026年市内初の自然感染デング熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部で単発の自然感染デング熱症例が確認されたのみで、重症例や死亡例の報告はなく、地域内での通常の監視・媒介動物対策の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで季節性・地域流行性が高く、単発の初発症例確認は通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。続報で症例数急増や重症化があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: حالات الإصابة بإيبولا تتجاوز 2000 - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola cases exceed 2,000 - Al-Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo total 2,011 with 754 deaths, according to overnight government data, described as the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. Health workers at Bunia General Hospital, the region’s largest medical facility, went on strike, blocking access amid unpaid wages and difficult working conditions. Frontline staff and others erected barriers at the hospital entrance. The World Health Organization reports more than 100 health workers infected since the outbreak began. Congo’s health ministry data indicate 753 people remain in isolation or hospital, with 366 recovered. Contact tracing remains challenging, with a case-contact coverage rate of 67%. The article does not specify the infection source or any imported/exported cases. As of July 15, 2026, the situation highlights ongoing transmission and healthcare system strain in the outbreak epicenter, Bunia, and broader Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ感染者数が2000人を超える - アル・シュルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数が2,000人、死者754人に達し「史上最速拡大」とされる大規模アウトブレイクであり、医療従事者感染や病院ストライキによる医療体制崩壊も発生しているため、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威としてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 医療従事者100人以上が感染し、賃金未払いによるストライキで病院機能に支障。接触者追跡カバー率67%と不十分であり、さらなる拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: चांदीपुरा वायरस के खतरे के खिलाफ AMC मुस्तैद, अहमदाबाद में सघन निगरानी शुरू, आखिर क्या है यह वायरस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AMC on alert against Chandipura virus threat, intensified surveillance started in Ahmedabad — what is this virus?
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad, India — Facing Chandipura virus (CHPV) threats and dengue during the monsoon, the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC) has launched 'Operation Monsoon' citywide. Health teams are intensifying surveillance, larva destruction, fogging, and fever monitoring; CHPV-specific squads have been formed at the state level. With CHPV cases already reported in the state, authorities are prioritizing pediatric health, keeping doctors on alert and requiring prompt reporting of suspected cases. Field teams are inspecting water-logged areas and common breeding sites—coolers, overhead tanks, pots, old tires, construction sites—and applying anti-larval measures as needed. The initiative also covers schools, anganwadis, hospitals, parks, and markets. Fever surveillance for dengue and malaria is heightened, with daily data collection and testing during the monsoon. CHPV is a rare but deadly virus, transmitted mainly by sandflies; it can progress to coma or death within 24–48 hours and is not person-to-person.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルスの脅威に対しAMCが警戒態勢、アーメダバードで集中監視を開始――このウイルスとは何か
triage.triage_reason: 希少だが致死性の高いチャンディプラウイルスの発生に加え、デング熱・マラリアの監視も強化されており、行政が緊急対応（Operation Monsoon）を開始するなど社会的・行政的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 記事はチャンディプラウイルス（CHPV）、デング熱、マラリアの3疾患に関するモンスーン期の予防的監視強化を報じているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載はなく、severity（重症度）の評価は不明。CHPVはヒト-ヒト感染しないため国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情確診增至2011例　累計754死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: confirmed cases rise to 2,011, with 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) has reached 2,011 confirmed cases with 754 deaths as of July 15, 2026. About 753 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, with 366 recoveries. Roughly 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, and high-risk contact tracing is only 67%. Since May 15, the Bundibugyo strain has driven the outbreak, spreading rapidly while authorities have not yet identified the first case. Ongoing conflict-driven displacement and mining-related population movement hinder tracing of thousands of contacts. Health workers in Ituri have staged strikes over unpaid wages, hindering response efforts. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola; vaccines exist for the Zaire strain. A clinical trial recruiting in Ituri is evaluating two potential therapies. WHO officials note many newly reported deaths occurred in communities, with patients never reaching medical facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ疫情、確診2,011例に増加　累計死亡754人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行し、感染連鎖不明な症例が8割、追跡不十分、ワクチン・治療薬未承認など制御困難な状況が複数のIHR・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、紛争による人口移動・保健従事者のストライキが対応を阻害している。国際的な支援・介入が急務と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: En el Congo, avanza brote de Ébola sin control: OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, Ebola outbreak advances out of control: WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) advances out of control, with Bunia in Ituri province heavily affected. WHO emergency chief Chikwe Ihekweazu warns deaths are occurring in communities before reaching health centers, and about 80% of new cases are not on contact lists, indicating undetected transmission chains. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus is driving the outbreak, which began in May and has no approved treatment or vaccine. Africa CDC notes it as Africa’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. As of Monday, at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths are reported across three Congolese provinces, with confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. The CDC also confirms a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Ebola, with no further details provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の制御不能な拡大が報告され、感染者1,926人・死者702人、ウガンダへの越境や未承認治療薬のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行拡大等、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認例やアメリカ人感染者の報告もあり、国際的拡大の懸念が高い。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 2 mil casos confirmados de ébola, entre ellos 754 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases, including 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 2,011 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths as of July 13, with a case fatality rate of 37.5%. About 753 patients are in isolation/hospitalization and 366 have recovered. The outbreak, centered in Ituri with spillovers to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele, began May 15 and has become the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. The Bundibugyo strain has a 30–50% fatality rate and currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. WHO regards global risk as low but notes higher risk in sub-Saharan Africa; it declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. MSF warns control measures are lagging, while INSP calls for immediate reinforcement of surveillance, diagnosis, and operational readiness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確認症例2,000件超え、うち死者754人
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、致死率も高く複数州に拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。Bundibugyo株で致死率30-50%、ワクチン・特効薬なし。Ituriを中心に北キブ、南キブ、Tshopo、Haut-Ueleに拡大し、史上3番目に大きく最速で拡大するエボラアウトブレイクとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie Ebola en RDC : Plus de 2000 Cas et Progression Inédite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: More than 2,000 cases and unprecedented progression.
article.articleSummary: Over 2,000 Ebola cases and 754 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo in less than five weeks, driven by the Bundibugyo variant. The northeast Ituri province is hardest hit, with spread to five provinces and cross-border cases into Uganda. The World Health Organization estimates the true caseload could be 2–4 times higher than official counts, as many cases remain unidentified and 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains. Deaths often occur before patients reach health facilities, indicating delays in detection and care. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; MSF warns of unprecedented spread into new zones. The EBO-PEP trial is evaluating post-exposure prophylaxis with oral obeldesivir among contacts of confirmed cases. Declared May 15; transmission occurs via close contact and body fluids; urgent, coordinated public health action is essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行：2,000人超の症例と前例のない拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が5週間で2,000例超・754人死亡と急拡大し、ウガンダへの越境例も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない変異株であり、80%が未知の感染経路とされる点は特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Médecins Sans Frontières appelle à renforcer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: MSF calls to strengthen the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak fast outpaces response; 2,011 confirmed cases, 754 deaths (case fatality 37.5%) since May 15 declaration. The Bundibugyo-virus Ebola strain has spread to 41 health zones across five provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. World Health Organization reports 42 health zones affected (up from 36). MSF warns transmission is accelerating into new areas; calls for strengthened response: community engagement, surveillance, testing and diagnosis, proper management of burials. WHO notes most new cases from unknown transmission chains; outbreak could be 2-4 times higher than official figures. Africa CDC has launched the first clinical trial of post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir in DRC and Uganda. MSF urges rapid resource mobilization across all Ebola-control activities.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:国境なき医師団(MSF)がエボラ対応の強化を訴える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行(2,011症例、致死率37.5%)が拡大中で、未知の感染経路による新規症例が多く、WHO・Africa CDC・MSFが対応強化を要請しているため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はUgandaにも言及しているが、これはAfrica CDCによる臨床試験の実施地としてであり、アウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: deux mois après l'annonce d'une 17e épidémie d'Ebola, un virus qui progresse plus vite que la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: two months after the announcement of the 17th Ebola outbreak, a virus that is progressing faster than the response.
article.articleSummary: Two months after the 17th Ebola outbreak was officially declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading faster than the response. Originating in Mongbwalu, Djugu, Ituri, first symptoms appeared on 24 April; eight of thirteen samples were positive for an Ebolavirus non-Zaïre, with sequencing on 15 May confirming Bundibugyo. By 13 July, the outbreak reached 2,011 cases and 754 deaths (case fatality 37.5%), and MSF called it the fastest-growing and third-largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Ituri remains the main hotspot (about 89.9% of cases, 83.7% of deaths), with Bunia, Mongbwalu, Rwampara, Nizi and Nyankunde most affected. Nord-Kivu has 182 cases; Haut-Uélé reports 14 cases (seven reclassified as imported from Nia-Nia; all died in community); Tshopo/Kisangani has four cases. Response delays and incomplete contact tracing (67.4% of contacts seen nationwide) hinder containment, as movement through a regional hub at Bunia rekindles transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:第17次エボラ流行発表から2カ月、対応より速く進行するウイルス
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCで2,011症例・754死亡（致死率37.5%）に達し、対応を上回る速度で拡大しており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Rwandaは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及されておらず、DRC国内の地域（Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo/Kisangani）が主題であるため除外。既存の第17次流行の進行拡大に関する続報記事。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde realiza no sábado (dia 18) mais uma ação especial de vacinação contra a Gripe - Diário de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health to hold another special influenza vaccination campaign on Saturday the 18th - Diário de Notícias
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination drive in Marília, Brazil, on Saturday, July 18, offers free influenza vaccines to residents aged 6 months and older to boost coverage and reduce severe respiratory illness during peak viral circulation. Three vaccination posts will operate from 11:00 to 17:00: South zone at Supermercado São Francisco (Durval de Menezes, 510); North zone at Supermercado São Francisco (João Caliman, 459); East zone at Esmeralda Shopping (Av. das Esmeraldas, 701). While open to all, priority groups—older adults 60+, children 6 months to under 6 years, pregnant and postpartum women, and people with chronic conditions—are emphasized. Since campaign start, 51,968 doses have been administered, with 26,891 in the target groups, yielding 41.61% coverage of that cohort. Officials urge residents to use the free, safe vaccine to prevent complications and limit transmission; emphasize ventilation, masking, and hand hygiene to reduce spread.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、18日(土)にインフルエンザ特別予防接種キャンペーンを実施 - Diário de Notícias
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの広報記事であり、感染症の異常発生や集団発生を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola | Se propaga rápidamente en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | Spreads rapidly in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) escalates with more than 2,000 confirmed infections and 754 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments, drives rapid spread to new regions, with most new cases arising from unknown transmission chains. In less than five weeks, confirmed cases have tripled and deaths quintupled, now representing over half of the totals seen in the 2018–2020 outbreak. About 80% of new patients were not in identified contacts, and many died before receiving care. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri province and has since reached other DR Congo regions and some cases in neighboring Uganda. In response, WHO and MSF have launched EBO-PEP, a clinical trial to test obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis for exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱｜コンゴで急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、感染者数・死者数が急増し国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例言及があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが主発生国として確認された。WHO・MSFによるEBO-PEP臨床試験開始など国際対応が既に進行中。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Human vaccine trials begin for latest Ebola strain
article.articleSummary: EBOLA virus disease outbreak in DR Congo and parts of Uganda reaches nearly 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths since mid-May, with two additional northeastern DR Congo provinces reporting new cases and one death. The Bundibugyo strain is spreading with no known vaccine or treatment. Oxford University began first-in-human trials of a vaccine against Bundibugyo, enrolling 50 healthy adults in Oxford, UK. Health officials warn the true scale could be two to four times higher than official counts, and the outbreak is considered potentially the biggest Ebola outbreak on record. Containment is hampered by misinformation, ongoing conflict near affected communities, and shortages caused by Western aid cuts. Researchers are racing to stop transmission while monitoring affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 最新エボラ株に対するヒトワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで感染者約2000人、死者700人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、記録上最大規模になる可能性が指摘され、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。英国（オックスフォード）はワクチン治験実施地であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CHP probes severe influenza A case in nine‑month‑old
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infection in a nine‑month‑old boy in Hong Kong is being investigated as a severe paediatric case. The patient developed lethargy and reduced feeding on 13 July, then fever and cough on 14 July, followed by shortness of breath, loss of consciousness and cardiac arrest. After resuscitation, he was admitted to paediatric ICU at Tuen Mun Hospital; a respiratory specimen collected on 14 July tested positive for influenza A. Clinicians diagnose influenza A with severe pneumonia and shock; the child remains in critical condition. He had not received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine; household contacts are currently asymptomatic. The CHP notes Hong Kong's influenza season began in late June with rising activity and expected increases before the peak. Public health guidance urges prompt care for fever and respiratory symptoms, masks for high-risk individuals and in crowded settings, and continued masking amid influenza season and heightened COVID-19 activity.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心、生後9か月児の重症インフルエンザA感染例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 個別の重症小児例であり、季節性インフルエンザ流行の一環として説明可能。ヒト-ヒト感染拡大や集団発生の証拠は現時点でなく、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 香港での季節性インフルエンザ流行期における重症小児例。家庭内接触者は無症状で、現時点でクラスター化の兆候はない。CHPによる継続的なモニタリングが実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak Tops 2,000 Cases as Health Workers Strike Over Unpaid Wages
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of 2026-07-15, centered in Ituri province. Bunia General Hospital staff blocked the entrance in a strike over unpaid wages and poor working conditions, continuing protests after earlier walkouts at Rwampara General Hospital where workers were unpaid for months. Doctors Without Borders says this outbreak is the third largest and fastest-growing Ebola event on record, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, for which there is currently no vaccine or approved treatment. The World Health Organization warns the official death toll could be two to four times higher than reported. A first clinical trial testing an antiviral drug to prevent infection in exposed high-risk contacts has launched, which, if effective, could mark a major step forward in Ebola BVD prevention.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ出血熱の症例数が2,000人を突破する中、医療従事者が未払い賃金を巡りストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011人の確定症例・754人の死亡者を記録し、史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大のエボラ流行とされ、ワクチン・治療薬もない中で医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を低下させている深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda（Kigali Province等）が含まれているが、記事サマリー本文ではルワンダでの発生や感染拡大について言及がなく、Ituri州（DRC）が主題であるためDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。WHOは実際の死亡者数が報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola cases may be four times official tally, WHO says
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared 15 May in Ituri (northeastern Congo), has infected more than 1,960 people and killed over 700 as of 15 July 2026, with cases detected in five DRC provinces and in Uganda. WHO modelling suggests true scale is at least 2-4 times official tallies, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-growing in a month. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with no approved vaccine or treatment. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri; many deaths occur at home without healthcare. Response capacity now exceeds 700 treatment beds; laboratories expanded; contact follow-up near 80%. In recent days, over 80 cases were confirmed in a single day, seen as a sign of maturation. The US barred return flights for U.S. citizens from DRC and restricted entry for travelers from DRC/Uganda/South Sudan, 21 days in a third country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例数は公式集計の4倍に上る可能性、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）が史上3番目の規模かつ最速の拡大速度で、ウガンダへの越境や米国の渡航制限を伴うため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダへの症例波及と米国の渡航制限措置に言及しているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・米国は含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主な発生国として明確に特定される。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta que ébola se propaga como un incendio; se duplican muertes en 2 semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that Ebola is spreading like wildfire; deaths have doubled in two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating. As of 15 July 2026, 2,011 cases and 754 confirmed deaths have been reported, up from 377 deaths at the end of June. The outbreak has spread from Ituri to two additional provinces, marking the fastest growth the WHO emergency program has faced. WHO emergency chief Chikwe Ihekweazu warned the true scale could be 2–4 times higher than official counts, likening the situation to a wildfire. About 80% of new infections occur outside routine monitoring. MSF notes the outbreak already surpasses half of the total cases from the 2018 epidemic. The case fatality rate is 37%, driven by delays in diagnosis, isolation, and access to care; roughly 92% of deaths occur before reaching a treatment center. Fear and distrust have driven over 240 people to flee isolation or treatment facilities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラは山火事のように広がっていると警告；2週間で死者数が倍増
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例・死亡者数が急増し、複数州へ拡大、致死率37%と深刻。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、WHOも緊急警告を発している。
triage.notes: WHO緊急プログラム史上最速の拡大とされ、実際の症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性が指摘されている。MSFは既に2018年流行の総症例数の半分を超えたと報告。隔離・治療拒否による逃亡も発生し、地域社会の不信感が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : accélération de la transformation digitale au service de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Accelerating digital transformation to support the response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, sees accelerated digital transformation to bolster the outbreak response. Kinshasa-based ANICNS (Agence nationale de l'ingénierie clinique et du numérique de la santé) leads the effort, digitalizing the health system to strengthen Ebola virus disease (MVE) surveillance. The National Border Hygiene Programme (PNHF) has trained teams to use a point-of-entry screening app, enabling real-time, faster, more reliable, and secure data collection. Two new CNAM health-insurance centers are now operational: Bunia Cité Health Reference Center and Rwampara Health Reference Center (Rwampara health zone). For health information, call 151; to report a health alert, dial *151# → Menu 1 → Menu 1. The Santé RDC app is available on Google Play and App Store to access digital health services and contribute to a more effective response. ANICNS coordinates nationwide digital healthization, manages the CSU digital system, biometric CNAM cards, and equipment maintenance under the Ministry of Public Health.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：対応強化に向けたデジタル化の加速 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、疾患自体の重篤性・ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性・保健当局の高い関与から、継続監視及びフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事本体は既存のエボラ対応におけるデジタル化推進（国境衛生プログラム、健康保険センター開設等）を扱う運用報告であり、新規症例数や感染拡大の疫学的詳細は含まれていない。ルワンダ（Kigali）やキンシャサは発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題はイツリ州（Bunia、Rwampara）のアウトブレイク対応であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : les besoins en dispositifs de lavage de mains sollicités à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: needs for handwashing facilities requested in Isiro - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has been officially declared in Isiro, in Haut-Uélé province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. At the central Kinkole market, Isiro, market chief Fatou Abia urged authorities to install handwashing facilities and supply water containers to enable barrier measures to curb transmission. She has taken to the market loudspeaker to raise awareness among traders and visitors; she notes the municipal authorities have not yet provided necessary equipment to support safe practices. Abia called on the Isiro mayor to assist by procuring suitable receptacles capable of holding ample water for handwashing. She warned that Ebola is here and it kills and urged adherence to hygiene and protective protocols to halt the spread. The Kinkole market is described as Isiro’s most populous trading hub.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ:イジロで手洗い設備の必要性が求められる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北東部イジロでエボラ出血熱の公式発生が宣言されており、致死率の高い感染症であり国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項であるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は市場における手洗い設備不足の懸念を伝えるローカル報道であり、公式な症例数・死亡者数などの詳細情報が本文になし。エボラという疾患特性上、フルRRAが必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: US to block citizens in Congo from immediate travel home, citing Ebola - Inside Metros
article.articleSummary: US blocks American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from immediate travel home on commercial flights under Title 49, placing them on a do-not-board list until they spend at least 21 days in a third country. The restriction accompanies a widening Ebola outbreak in DRC, with confirmed cases rising to 1,926 and 702 deaths, as the disease has spread to a number of provinces. Ebola transmits through direct contact with bodily fluids from infected people or animals, causing symptoms such as high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. Officials noted that about two dozen Americans were set to board flights when the measures were announced.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラを理由にコンゴの米国市民の即時帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ感染者1,926人・死亡702人と拡大が続き、米国が渡航制限措置を講じるなど国際的な影響が明確であるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでのエボラ拡大が主題であり、渡航制限措置は国際的懸念の高まりを示す。

article.articleHeadline: রথযাত্রা লোকারণ্য মহা ধুমধাম... উৎসবের ভিড়ে কোভিড রুখতে বড় পদক্ষেপ ওড়িশা সরকারের
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rath Yatra, a sea of people, grand spectacle... Odisha government's major step to curb COVID-19 amid festival crowds
article.articleSummary: Odisha tightens COVID-19 precautions ahead of Rath Yatra as neighboring states report rising cases. With mass crowds in Puri, authorities boost district surveillance, hospital readiness, and testing under a high-level meeting led by Health and Family Welfare Minister Mukesh Mahaling. Hospitals across levels, including community and primary centers, are urged to stay vigilant; the state asserts adequate health infrastructure. WHO no longer designates COVID-19 as a global public health emergency, but mass gatherings, long travel, and inter-state/international attendees heighten transmission risk. High-risk groups include people aged 60+, those with diabetes, heart or chronic lung disease, cancer or immunocompromised status, and pregnant women. Before Rath Yatra, seek medical advice for fever, cough, sore throat, or shortness of breath. Vaccination/booster is advised if due. General precautions: hand hygiene, masks in crowds or enclosed spaces, cover coughs, stay hydrated, avoid heavy exertion.

triage.headline_ja: ラート・ヤトラ、人々の海、盛大な祭典...祭りの群衆の中でコロナ感染阻止へ、オディシャ州政府の重要措置
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患(COVID-19)で大規模イベント前の予防的サーベイランス強化に関する記事であり、深刻な公衆衛生インパクトや異常性は明確でないが、大規模集会によるリスク増大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 近隣州で感染者増加との言及があるが具体的な数値や重症度データは記事に含まれていない。ラート・ヤトラという大規模宗教行事前の予防的措置に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πρωτοφανής ρυθμός εξάπλωσης στο Κονγκό - 754 νεκροί, πάνω από 2.000 κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Unprecedented rate of spread in the Congo - 754 dead, over 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus shows an unprecedented spread, with more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths across five provinces, 90%+ of infections concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast. Uganda has also recorded cases. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in the DRC following multiple deaths in Ituri, a mineral-rich area where armed groups operate. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak size could be two to four times higher than official counts. There is no vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo, but the first clinical trial assessing an antiviral drug began yesterday. Medecins Sans Frontieres urges urgent expansion of the medical response as the epidemic spreads to new areas, with trajectories surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak in pace.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴで前例のない拡大速度 - 死者754人、感染者2000人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が2018-2020年流行を上回るペースで拡大し、死者754人・感染者2000人超、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOは公式集計の2〜4倍の規模の可能性を警告しており、ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しない状況で臨床試験が開始されたばかりである。武装勢力が活動する鉱物資源地帯での対応の困難さも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: MSF pede que resposta ao Ebola seja ampliada; surto no Congo se aproxima dos 2.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF calls for the Ebola response to be expanded; Congo outbreak nears 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of Sunday, tripling in under five weeks and ranking as the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, per MSF. MSF operates seven Ebola treatment centers and more than 15 isolation units across the country. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, with symptoms including high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. MSF emergency-response lead Trish Newport urged intensified international action to improve care, noting geographic spread and inadequate rural support amid an overwhelmed surveillance system. WHO says the outbreak remains in expansion, driven by population movement and treatment delays. The U.S. government is restricting commercial travel to the United States for Americans in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、エボラ対応の拡大を要請；コンゴの流行は2,000症例に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ流行が急拡大し、史上3番目の大規模・最速拡大の流行とされ、致死率も高く、米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的影響が既に発生しているためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 米国はBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はコンゴでの流行であり、米国は渡航制限措置の対象として言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : une réunion d'orientation en faveur des chefs coutumiers - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: a briefing session for traditional chiefs - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompted a briefing in Bunia on 15 July 2026 where military governor General-major Gaby Kasongo Mulumba instructed traditional chiefs to intensify community sensitization and support response teams. Chiefs are emphasized as frontline state representatives crucial for governance, security and public health, with a mandate to mobilize communities for adherence to preventive measures, acceptance of health interventions, and safe burials. Local leaders, including André Kataloho Takumara and Innocent Madukadala, pledged increased collaboration with government and residents. Bahema-Sud sector reported six Ebola deaths and over 200 contact and suspect cases. The effort aligns with a provincial strategy to engage 40 chiefdoms, six sectors, 292 groupings, and 4,213 villages, strengthening community surveillance and expediting health interventions in areas such as Yedi.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱：伝統的首長への説明会議 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱による死者6名、接触者・疑い例200名超が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクを伴う既知の重大疾患のアウトブレイクであるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChad（Borkou Region）が含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ対応に限定されており、Chadは無関係のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Sees 28 Per Cent Surge In Dengue Cases, 18 Pc Rise In Malaria Until Mid-July; BMC Intensifies Monsoon Disease Control
article.articleSummary: Mumbai’s monsoon disease surveillance (Jan 1–Jul 14, 2026) shows dengue rising 27.8% to 938 cases (vs 734 in 2025) and malaria up 18.2% to 3,681 (from 3,115). Leptospirosis up 15.4% to 157; chikungunya down 82.7% to 31; gastroenteritis down 20% to 3,866; COVID-19 down over 93% to 71; H1N1 up nearly threefold to 113. The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation intensified vector-control: 10.69 lakh houses surveyed, 36.81 lakh residents covered; 100,472 blood samples collected; 96 health camps; leptospirosis prophylaxis to 90,728. Site inspections: 3,000 construction sites; 54,763 workers screened; 37 positives treated. Anti-mosquito actions identified 5,341 Anopheles and 22,041 Aedes breeding spots; removed 66,595 discarded tyres; fogging of 51,937 buildings and 7.94 lakh slum structures. Advisory urges eliminating water stagnation, avoiding tyres/containers, nets, repellents, and prompt medical care for fever; leptospirosis precautions after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでデング熱症例が28%急増、マラリアも18%増加(7月中旬まで) — BMCがモンスーン期の感染症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期における例年の感染症サーベイランス報告であり、デング熱・マラリア等の増加は季節性の範囲内で異常性は認められない。行政機関による通常の対策強化が報じられているのみで、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に報告される季節性感染症動向のルーティン記事。ムンバイ市当局（BMC）が既に大規模な媒介動物対策・監視活動を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia del ébola se extiende a un ritmo 'sin precedentes y en nuevas zonas', advierte MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is spreading at an 'unprecedented' rate and into new areas, warns MSF.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded over 2,000 Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 754 deaths in a rapidly spreading outbreak across five provinces, including Ituri. The epidemic is expanding at an unprecedented pace and into new areas, with confirmed cases tripling in less than five weeks and deaths quintupled. WHO notes that about 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, reflecting transmission chains outside surveillance, and many patients die before reaching care. The Bundibugyo variant is driving transmission; WHO estimates cases may be two to four times higher than official counts. There are no vaccines or treatments specific for Bundibugyo yet, but the first clinical trial (EBO-PEP) began to test post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir among contacts. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri, with some cases in Uganda. MSF urges strengthening the medical response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、MSFが「前例のない速さで新たな地域に拡大」と警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・死者754人のエボラ流行が5州に急拡大し、感染者の8割が接触歴不明でヒト-ヒト感染チェーンが把握困難な状況。ウガンダにも症例が及び国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株による流行で特異的なワクチン・治療薬が未確立であり、臨床試験(EBO-PEP)が開始されたばかりの段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : leaders religieux appelés à devenir des acteurs de première ligne - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Religious leaders urged to become frontline actors - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, religious leaders from CECA-20 in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, were urged to become frontline actors in community Ebola prevention during a training in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province in North-East DRC. CECA-20 legal representative Rev. Pastor Jean-Pierre Kokole Idringi said the session focused on the leaders' role in frontline prevention and on building community resilience and risk communication for the current Ebola outbreak. He noted the church has developed a capacity-building and risk-engagement program to prevent Ebola in Ituri, with leaders prepared to act as community relay points, spreading harmonized prevention messages and safeguarding communities. The article reports no specific case or death counts, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ出血熱:宗教指導者に最前線での対応が呼びかけられる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、疾患の重篤性と拡大リスクから継続的なモニタリングが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事自体は宗教指導者を対象とした地域コミュニティ啓発活動の報告であり、新規症例数や死亡者数などの具体的疫学データは含まれていないが、『current Ebola outbreak』との記述から進行中のアウトブレイクであることが示唆される。継続監視のためPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha Intensifies COVID-19 Surveillance Before Jagannath Rath Yatra Begins: What You Should Keep In Mind
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Odisha has intensified COVID-19 surveillance ahead of the Jagannath Rath Yatra in Puri, beginning July 16, amid rising cases in neighboring Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. Health authorities have stepped up disease monitoring, hospital preparedness, and infection-control protocols, with Health and Family Welfare Minister Mukesh Mahaling chairing a high-level review. Officials warn large congregations, long journeys, and close contact raise respiratory-virus transmission risk, though there is no panic. The state emphasises extra precautions for people 60+, those with diabetes, heart or lung disease, cancer patients, immunocompromised individuals, and pregnant women. Practical measures include wearing masks in crowded or poorly ventilated areas, hand hygiene, staying hydrated, avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, testing if fever/cough develops, and keeping up with vaccination or boosters if eligible. District hospitals, CHCs, and PHCs are on high alert.

triage.headline_ja: ジャガンナート・ラート・ヤートラ開始前にオディシャ州がCOVID-19サーベイランスを強化：知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 大規模宗教行事前の予防的サーベイランス強化に関する記事であり、具体的な症例数・重症度・異常な感染動向の記載がなく、現時点では通常の警戒対応に留まるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は近隣州（アンドラプラデシュ、タミルナードゥ）での感染増加を背景とした予防的措置であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・重症度データは示されていない。大規模巡礼行事（Rath Yatra）による人流集中がヒト-ヒト感染リスクを高める可能性があるため、継続的な情報収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Invité Afrique Midi - Ebola en RDC: "L'épidémie va plus vite que la riposte"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guest on Africa Midi - Ebola in the DRC: "The outbreak is outpacing the response."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues to advance in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with response actors warning that the epidemic is outpacing containment efforts and that transmission chains remain difficult to interrupt. The report notes that new clinical trials have been launched to improve prevention and treatment options. Rodrigue Alitanou, Director of Operations at ALIMA (The Alliance for International Medical Action), is the Africa Midi guest, discussing the current state of the field response and the trajectory of research. The interview highlights ongoing challenges on the ground and provides updates on clinical research underway aimed at strengthening outbreak control and patient care, amid the expanding Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ・ミディ ゲスト - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱:「流行は対応より速く進んでいる」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で拡大しており、対応がそれに追いついていないとの専門家証言があり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う事案として評価される。
triage.notes: 感染者数・死亡者数など具体的疫学データは記事中に記載なし。ALIMAによる現地対応と臨床試験進行中との言及あり。続報でのRRA実施が望ましい。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: SBSS 2026 debate influenza suína e estratégias de controle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SBSS 2026 debates swine influenza and control strategies
article.articleSummary: Swine influenza and control strategies will be discussed at SBSS 2026, the 18th SB Sul de Suinocultura, in Chapecó, Santa Catarina, Brazil, August 11–13, 2026, at Centro de Cultura e Eventos Plínio Arlindo de Nes. A highlight is 'Influenza in Focus: Impacts and Control Alternatives' by Dr. Ricardo Yuiti Nagae on August 12 at 16:00 in the Sanidade – Respiratory Health panel. The talk covers influenza dynamics, its impact on swine health and performance, and prevention and control measures for inclusion in farm sanitation programs. Nagae—PhD, UFRGS, corporate animal health specialist at Seara/JBS—leads the discussion. The program also addresses eradicating Mycoplasma hyopneumoniae, gilt acclimation, immunonutrition, mycotoxins, precision feeding, environment, sanitary management, and team qualification. Parallel, the 17th Brasil Sul Pig Fair gathers industry players. Registration is via Nucleovet; second batch until July 30: R$750 professionals, R$450 students; Pig Fair only R$100.

triage.headline_ja: SBSS 2026、豚インフルエンザとその対策戦略について議論
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生報告ではなく、養豚業界の学会・展示会における豚インフルエンザ対策に関する講演案内であり、公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で開催される養豚関連学会（SBSS2026）の告知であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: COVID cases increasing in parts of India, is this a warning sign? What all we know so far? Important updates you must know
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising locally in parts of India, with Andhra Pradesh reporting a small uptick and a few related deaths; other states report modest increases, but there is no nationwide surge. SARS-CoV-2 is now considered endemic, continuing to circulate with occasional spikes. Short-term drivers include weather changes, increased travel, festivals, and new variants. Most infections are mild—fever, sore throat, cough, fatigue, runny nose, body aches—and vaccination plus prior infections protect against severe disease. India’s healthcare system is better prepared with enhanced surveillance and testing. High-risk groups (older adults, pregnant women, and people with diabetes, heart or lung disease, or weakened immunity) should exercise precautions and seek care if symptoms worsen. No panic or return to strict restrictions is advised; monitor symptoms and follow basic safety measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドの一部でCOVID症例が増加、これは警戒サインか？現時点で分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既に流行病（endemic）として扱われており、一部地域で軽度の増加が見られるのみで全国的な急増はなく、医療体制も対応可能とされているため、シグナルとして拾う必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19が既にエンデミック化していることを前提に、季節的な小規模増加を報じる一般的な健康情報記事であり、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se expande sin control en el este del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads out of control in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: MSF reports the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is expanding at an unprecedented pace two months after official declaration, with Ituri as the epicenter and spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; the outbreak has crossed the border into Uganda. DRC authorities tally 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. Uganda has 20 cases, 15 imported from the DRC, and 2 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with a case-fatality rate of about 30–50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO assesses high risk of further spread in sub-Saharan Africa, low global risk. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, and in two months it has become the third-largest and fastest-growing. MSF urges faster, community-centered response and stronger international cooperation to improve care and surveillance amid conflict and other health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ東部で制御不能に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）が複数該当し、DRCからウガンダへの越境拡大と多数の死者を伴う大規模アウトブレイクであるため、フルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC国内では第17回目のエボラ流行で、既に2,011例・754死亡と過去最大級・最速拡大の規模。国際協力強化が求められている。
