article.articleHeadline: Mumbai monsoon health alert: Dengue, malaria, and leptospirosis cases rise in 2026, BMC data shows
article.articleSummary: Mumbai's monsoon health report from the BMC for January 1–July 14, 2026 shows rising monsoon-related illnesses compared with the same period in 2025. Malaria cases climbed 18.2% to 3,681 (from 3,115), dengue rose 27.8% to 938 (from 734), and leptospirosis increased 15.4% to 157 (from 136). H1N1 infections nearly tripled, from 42 in 2025 to 113 in 2026—the sharpest rise among the listed diseases. The BMC attributed the leptospirosis uptick to continuous heavy rainfall and waterlogging across several parts of Mumbai. The data cover the January 1 to July 14 window, highlighting widening monsoon-related disease burden in the city.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ、モンスーン健康警報：2026年にデング熱、マラリア、レプトスピラ症の症例が増加、BMCデータが示す
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のモンスーン関連疾患の増加を報告する定例的な公衆衛生データであり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低いが、H1N1の急増など継続的な監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 毎年のモンスーン季節における既知の疾患（デング熱、マラリア、レプトスピラ症、H1N1）の症例数増加を報告する行政データであり、BMC（ムンバイ市当局）が既に把握・対応している。H1N1症例が42から113へ増加した点は注視すべきだが、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Débordés par l'épidémie d'Ebola, 9 postes de santé de Djugu ferment
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overwhelmed by the Ebola outbreak, nine health posts in Djugu close.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in Djugu territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with nine of twelve health posts in the Héritage health area of Limani groupement closed due to the surge in cases. Local clinics remain overwhelmed by daily patient inflows, leading to suspended services and urgent calls for emergency deployment of response teams and essential medical inputs. Community resistance, including denial of preventive measures in the Djatsi and Pitsi sectors, is accelerating transmission. Walendu Djatsi sector chief Justin Gudza Kiza warns the crisis is grave and has already claimed more than one hundred lives, a figure not yet confirmed by authorities. Thousands lack access to basic health care as authorities await a large-scale intervention to prevent a public health catastrophe in Limani.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行により圧迫され、ジュグ地域の保健所9カ所が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ジュグ地域でエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し、100人以上の死者報告と保健医療体制の崩壊が起きており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにギリシャ・ウクライナの地名が含まれているが、記事内容とは無関係でジオタグ誤りと判断し除外した。死者数（100人超）は当局未確認情報である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Journal de l'Afrique - L'épidémie d'Ebola largement sous-évaluée selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Journal of Africa - The Ebola outbreak is largely underestimated according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) may be undercounted by a factor of two to four, according to the World Health Organization. The latest official figures released by Congolese authorities show 1,963 confirmed or suspected cases and 719 deaths. At the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center, among the hardest-hit sites in Ituri, healthcare workers report poor working conditions and unpaid salaries. The discrepancy highlighted by the WHO underscores possible underestimation of the outbreak's scale and ongoing challenges in patient care, health-system response, and resource constraints in the region. Dated July 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの記事 - WHOによるとエボラ出血熱の流行は大幅に過小評価されている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについて、WHOが症例数が2〜4倍過小評価されている可能性を指摘しており、死者719人・症例1963件と規模が大きく、医療体制の逼迫も報告されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが公式発表数値の過小評価を指摘しており、実際の感染規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。医療従事者の未払い賃金や労働環境の悪化も報告されており、対応能力の低下が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Περισσότερα από 2000 κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό, - Πρωτοφανής ο ρυθμός εξάπλωσης, λένε οι Γιατροί Χωρίς Σύνορα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 Ebola cases in DR Congo — Unprecedented rate of spread, say Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: More than 2,000 Ebola cases, with 754 deaths, have been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo since the outbreak began, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain at an unprecedented rate. WHO warns the true burden could be 2–4 times higher than official counts. Five DR Congo provinces have reported cases, with 90%+ in Ituri province in the northeast; the outbreak has also reached neighboring Uganda. The epidemic was declared on 15 May following multiple fatalities in Ituri, a mineral-rich region plagued by armed violence. No vaccine or approved therapy exists for Bundibugyo Ebola, though the first clinical trial evaluating an antiviral drug began yesterday. MSF is calling for urgent expansion of the medical response as the outbreak’s spread accelerates, already surpassing half the cases of the 2018–2020 Congo outbreak according to latest tallies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染2000人超 — 国境なき医師団「前例のない拡大速度」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2000例超・754人死亡と大規模化し、周辺国ウガンダにも拡大、致死率も高くIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めず。ワクチン・治療薬未承認で致死率が高く、武装勢力による治安悪化地域での対応が困難な点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: पूर्वी सिंहभूम: पोटका में ब्रेन मलेरिया के बाद सांपों का आतंक, डसने से 14 साल के युवक की मौत - potka snake bites teen dies village head survives krait attack
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Singhbhum: In Potka, snakes terrorize after cerebral malaria; a 14-year-old boy dies from snake bites.
article.articleSummary: Rain in Potka block, East Singhbhum district, India, has amplified danger from venomous snakes amid ongoing cerebral malaria concerns. In the past week, villagers and a local leader were bitten by a 'chito' snake, including Gram Pradhan Mrigendra Nath Bhakt; a 14-year-old Jamda resident, Raj Khandwal, died after a bite by the same species. Family members brought the bucket-contained snake to Potka Community Health Centre for species identification, and clinicians initiated prompt treatment. Bhakt recovered enough to be discharged on Wednesday evening after monitoring. Dr. Sukant Seat, the acting in-charge, urged bite victims to seek hospital care immediately rather than relying on traditional practices, and to exercise heightened caution during the monsoon. The area faces ongoing cerebral malaria risk and rising snake activity around fields, scrub, and homes, fueling public concern.

triage.headline_ja: 東シンハブム県ポトカ：脳マラリア懸念の中、毒蛇被害拡大―14歳少年が蛇咬傷で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は毒蛇咬傷による死亡事例であり、マラリアは背景情報として言及されているのみで、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は蛇咬傷による死亡事例が主題であり、マラリアに関する具体的な症例数・流行状況の記載はない。感染症シグナルとしての評価対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 夏日高发！不痛不痒"小黑痂"，小心元凶是这种虫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer peak! A painless, non-itchy "little black crust"—the culprit is this type of insect.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi), transmitted by chigger mites, caused a lab-confirmed case in Nanjing, China. A 32-year-old man developed a week-long fever up to 40C, followed by a painless, non-itchy rash. A hidden eschar—the size of a fly on the scrotal area—led to targeted testing, with Orientia tsutsugamushi IgM positive. After treatment, fever subsided the next day, rash faded by day four, and the eschar gradually detached. The report emphasizes that scrub typhus can mimic viral illness; the concealed eschar is a key diagnostic clue on thorough skin examination. Transmission involves rodents as reservoirs and chigger mite bites, with a 5–20 day incubation. Prevention focuses on clearing grass and debris around living areas, wearing long sleeves and pants outdoors, and washing promptly afterward, especially in axilla, groin, and other skin folds.

triage.headline_ja: 夏に多発！痛くも痒くもない「小さな黒いかさぶた」に注意、その正体はこの虫
triage.triage_reason: 個別の単発症例報告であり、既知の風土病でヒト-ヒト感染もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: つつが虫病はダニ媒介性の風土病で、中国南京での単一症例報告。健康啓発・予防情報を目的とした一般記事であり、アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sorocaba registra queda de 99% nos casos de dengue | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorocaba records a 99% drop in dengue cases | TVS+.
article.articleSummary: Sorocaba, Brazil, recorded a 99% reduction in dengue cases by end-May 2026, with 62 confirmed infections and zero deaths in the period, compared with 13,151 cases and 22 deaths during the interval in 2025. The decline is attributed to ongoing prevention, vector-control of Aedes aegypti breeding sites, and public education. Zoonoses teams conduct citywide house visits; agents are uniformed and identifiable, and residents can verify authorization with the zoonoses service before entry. Hundreds of thousands of properties have been inspected and materials that could collect water removed, reducing mosquito habitats. Public health guidance emphasizes eliminating water-holding containers, keeping yards clean, and cooperating with visits. Symptoms include high fever, headache, eye pain, nausea, fatigue, joint pain, and a red rash; seek medical care for severe signs such as abdominal pain, vomiting, dizziness, bleeding, or confusion. Dengue vaccination is available at health units for campaign groups; prevention should continue year-round.

triage.headline_ja: ソロカバ市、デング熱症例が99%減少 | TVS+
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱症例の大幅な減少と対策の成功を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数減少・死亡ゼロという好転を報告する内容であり、リスク評価の対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Dva měsíce od vypuknutí epidemie se ebola dál šíří nevídanou rychlostí. Reakci je třeba okamžitě posílit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Two months since the outbreak of the epidemic, Ebola continues to spread at an unprecedented pace. The response must be strengthened immediately.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province (Bunia), has surged: confirmed cases have tripled from 650 to over 2,000 in about five weeks, and deaths from roughly 130 to about 750. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, the third largest and fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic to date. MSF is calling for immediate, stronger international support to scale up testing, contact tracing, and care access; delays risk more deaths. Bunia’s Elikiya Ebola Treatment Center (90 beds) is routinely full; patients often arrive in critical condition. MSF operates seven treatment centers and more than 15 isolation units across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo (capacity >430 beds), assisting MOH. Since onset, MSF has treated 968 patients (357 confirmed), with 116 survivors after specialized care, and more than 2,200 staff involved.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ流行から2カ月、前例のない速さで感染拡大が続く。対応の即時強化が必要
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)による大規模流行が急拡大しており、症例・死亡者数が数週間で急増し国際支援が要請されている。IHR基準を複数満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: MSFが国際支援の緊急強化を要請。イツリ州が症例の約90%を占め、致死率も高い。過去3番目に大きく最も急速に拡大したエボラ流行とされる。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية قد يكون أكبر بـ4 أضعاف من الأرقام الرسمية المعلنة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be four times larger than the officially disclosed figures.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be four times larger than officially disclosed figures, a statement associated with the July 15, 2026 report. The claim points to potential underreporting of Ebola virus disease cases and deaths, though the article provides no specific counts. The location is the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the disease identified as Ebola virus disease. The text does not include dates of onset, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or details about imported or exported cases. The report emphasizes a gap between official tallies and the outbreak’s true scale as observed by the WHO, illustrating challenges in surveillance and data verification in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は公式発表の4倍規模の可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ流行の過小報告（公式値の4倍の可能性）を指摘しており、重篤な感染症の実態把握不備は国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示唆するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数・発症日等の詳細情報は記事中に記載なし。WHOによる過小報告の指摘という定性的情報のみだが、エボラという疾患の重篤性とWHOの公式声明という性質からPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mongbwalu : PAM lance une distribution de vivres aux cas contacts - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mongbwalu: WFP launches a food distribution for contacts of cases - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts a World Food Programme food-distribution to contacts of Ebola cases and to Ebola survivors. On 15 July 2026, rations including rice, semolina, beans, oil and other staples are being distributed across all neighborhoods of Mongbwalu and in Pluto. The aid targets individuals identified as contacts by surveillance teams and those who have survived Ebola; if someone in an avenue died from Ebola, their contacts are direct beneficiaries. Survivors are also eligible, and the program is not intended for the general population. Some eligible people refused registration, a stance that health authorities say could complicate the response and deprive households of assistance.

triage.headline_ja: モングバルのエボラ:WFPが接触者への食料配給を開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州モングバルでエボラ出血熱の症例・接触者が確認されており、公衆衛生対応（食料支援・接触者追跡）が展開中であることから、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があり、フルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にQueenslandやAustraliaが含まれているが、記事内容とは無関係でBluedotの地域付与誤りと判断し除外した。実際の発生地はDRCイトゥリ州モングバルである。一部対象者が登録を拒否しており、接触者追跡・支援活動に支障が出る可能性がある点は今後の続報で注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Justiça manda União eliminar focos de dengue em barcos abandonados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Justice orders the federal government to eliminate dengue hotspots in abandoned boats.
article.articleSummary: Federal court in Mato Grosso do Sul orders the federal government to eliminate dengue hotspots linked to Aedes aegypti breeding sites on four abandoned boats on the Rio Paraguai near Porto Geral de Corumbá. Within 48 hours the Union must apply larvicides, seal openings, and cover water-accumulating areas; within five days drain holds and eradicate breeding sites on La Barca Pantaneira, La Barca, Corumbi News, and Riomar under maritime guidance. A 30-day deadline requires a technical plan for vessel removal with schedule and environmental protections; removal to begin within 90 days after court approval, with monthly progress reports. Ibama must provide within 30 days information on the Corumbá-Ladário Area Plan and notify IMASul and Semadesc to implement measures. MPF-led action cites public health risks, with Corumbá as a chikungunya hotspot and 17 deaths in 2025. The case seeks R$100,000 collective damages; funds would go to the Diffuse Rights Fund.

triage.headline_ja: 司法当局、放置船舶のデング熱発生源除去を連邦政府に命令
triage.triage_reason: 既存の対策（司法命令による蚊対策）に関する行政・法的措置の記事であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクの急増を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・蚊媒介性疾患対策のための行政訴訟に関するもの。2025年に17人のチクングニア熱による死亡例やコルンバでの流行地域指摘があるが、本記事の主眼は既存の公衆衛生対策の実施命令であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Sorocaba confirma oitavo caso de raiva em morcego em 2026 e mobiliza ações da Zoonoses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorocaba confirms eighth case of rabies in a bat in 2026 and mobilizes Zoonoses actions.
article.articleSummary: Sorocaba, Brazil — The Municipal Health Secretariat confirms the eighth rabies case in animals in 2026, a bat found July 2 in Vila Hortência and confirmed positive on July 13. Zoonoses teams launched a preventive 500-meter block around the site, visiting homes to educate residents about bat habits, rabies risks, and steps if an animal is abnormal. They inspect properties for roosting sites and conduct active surveillance for contact with dogs, cats, or people, while assessing domestic animals’ vaccination status and reinforcing vaccines if contact with bats is suspected. For human exposure, residents are referred for antirabies treatment. The measure aims to lower transmission risk by identifying exposures and implementing protections for people and animals. Do not touch bats found on the ground or during the day; contact municipal Zoonoses for proper evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: ソロカバ、2026年8月時点でコウモリの狂犬病8例目を確認し、動物衛生局が対策を動員
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病はブラジルで年間を通じて散発的に確認される風土病であり、本件も自治体の通常の予防的サーベイランス対応の範囲内で、人への感染や重症例は報告されていない。
triage.notes: コウモリの狂犬病は南米で地方風土病的に発生しており、本件は自治体による標準的な予防措置（500m圏内の家庭訪問、動物ワクチン確認、曝露者への予防的治療紹介）に留まる。人での確定症例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: OMS avertizează asupra unei epidemii fără precedent. Ebola are un ritm record de răspândire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of an unprecedented epidemic. Ebola is spreading at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo escalates rapidly, with confirmed cases exceeding 2,000 and deaths reaching 754 across five provinces. MSF reports the outbreak has tripled in under five weeks, and fatalities have risen at least fivefold, warning of unprecedented spread into new areas and urging urgent scaling of the medical response. More than half of the total documented in 2018–2020 RDC outbreak already surpassed; about 90% of current cases are in Ituri Province, where conflict hampers intervention; Uganda has also reported cases. WHO estimates the Bundibugyo variant could be two to four times larger than official figures. About 80% of new cases are not linked to known contact lists, complicating tracing. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo; WHO launched EBO-PEP to test obeldesivir for contacts of confirmed cases. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが前例のない流行を警告。エボラ出血熱が記録的な速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例が2000人・死者754人を超え、5週間で3倍に急増するなど前例のない拡大を見せており、ウガンダへの越境例も報告されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo変異株はワクチン・治療薬未承認であり、MSFが緊急対応拡大を求めている。

article.articleHeadline: RaillyNews - Ebola Cases Surpass 2000 in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) surpasses 2,000 confirmed cases and 750+ deaths since May. The Ituri region is the epicenter with high transmission, with potential spillover into Haut-Uele, challenging containment. The government and international partners have implemented quarantine and isolation, rapid case-finding, and rigorous contact tracing, with 753 contacts under active surveillance. Ebola's incubation spans 2–21 days, underscoring the need for prompt testing and isolation of suspected cases; vaccination campaigns have targeted high-risk groups, healthcare workers, and contacts, delivered within days of identification. Mobile laboratories equipped with real-time PCR enable swift laboratory confirmation; supportive care and antiviral therapeutics are standard, while monoclonal antibody therapies remain under evaluation. Global support from WHO, CDC, MSF, and others funds vaccination and healthcare worker training. Continued vigilance, community engagement, and strengthened surveillance are essential to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ症例数が2000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2000症例、750人以上の死亡と大規模なアウトブレイクとなっており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的な支援・関心が高い。
triage.notes: ItiuriとHaut-Ueleの両州がDRC国内のため、国レベルでのverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados zera novos casos confirmados de chikungunya, mas mantém alerta de epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados records zero new confirmed Chikungunya cases, but remains on epidemic alert.
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, records zero new confirmed chikungunya cases in the first week of July, but logs 86 suspected notifications, down from the peak of 1,209 notifications and 672 confirmed in the 12th epidemiological week across urban areas and indigenous Bororó and Jaguapiru villages. The outbreak remains classified as epidemic; authorities urge continued removal of standing water. Since onset, Dourados has 10,101 notifications, 4,908 laboratory-confirmed chikungunya cases and 17 deaths, including 12 among indigenous residents of Bororó and Jaguapiru. Currently, 517 cases are under investigation. Dengue, also transmitted by Aedes aegypti, reports 132 confirmed cases in the first semester with no deaths; the 20–29-year age group accounts for 27 cases. The dengue situation is described as under control by local health officials.

triage.headline_ja: ドウラードス市、新規確定チクングニア症例ゼロを記録するも、エピデミック警戒は継続
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドウラードス市でチクングニア熱の累計死亡17名・確定4,908例の epidemic 状態が続くが、直近は新規確定例ゼロで減少傾向にあり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの継続的な流行状況報告で、新規症例は減少傾向。先住民コミュニティ（Bororó、Jaguapiru）で死亡例が集中している点は注視が必要。デング熱は同地域で管理下にあるとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : l'association des chauffeurs envisage sensibiliser contre Ebola sur les RN 3 et 4 - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: The Drivers' Association Plans to Raise Awareness About Ebola on RN 3 and RN 4 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kisangani's Drivers Association (ACCO) plans Ebola awareness at parking areas PK 24 on Route Nationale 3 and PK 23 on RN3 in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo province in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as of July 15, 2026. ACCO intends to implement Ebola barrier measures contained in a provincial governor's decree, aiming to sensitize travelers since the transport sector is highly exposed to Ebola infection. Passengers arriving from affected zones enter Kisangani, where ACCO operates parking facilities citywide. The plan includes installing handwashing stations on public buses and enforcing distancing inside vehicles. ACCO post chiefs at the parking sites are instructed to enforce the hierarchy’s dispositions. Members are urged to acknowledge that Ebola is present and to take barrier measures seriously to prevent secondary transmission; coordination with authorities is requested to materialize the project.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ：運転手協会がRN3号線・RN4号線でのエボラ啓発活動を計画 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCコンゴ・チョポ州キサンガニで進行中とみられるエボラ流行に対し、州知事令に基づく防疫措置が運輸業界で実施される内容であり、既存流行の継続・拡大懸念を示すシグナルとして評価する。
triage.notes: 記事は運転手協会による啓発活動の計画に関するものだが、その背景にキサンガニ（チョポ州）でのエボラ流行が既に存在し、州知事令による防疫対応が取られていることが示唆される。流行の規模・症例数など詳細情報は本文に含まれず不明であり、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 2,000
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 cases, spanning five provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. So far, 366 patients have recovered, while 753 remain in isolation. Transmission remains intense in Ituri, the main hotspot, with new cases in Haut-Uele indicating geographic spread and a need to strengthen surveillance, diagnostics and operational preparedness. The outbreak is in a phase of sustained transmission with a rapid rise in cases since its declaration on May 15. The World Health Organization has warned that the true scale could be two to four times higher than official figures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）し、WHOも実数がさらに多い可能性を警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 5州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、チョポ）にまたがる持続的な伝播が確認されており、WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる流行で、5月15日の宣言以降急速に拡大している。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka COVID-19 Alert: Tumakuru Sets Up 5 Border Checkposts After Deaths In Andhra Pradesh
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths in Andhra Pradesh have prompted a high alert in Tumakuru district, Karnataka. Five border screening checkposts have been established in Pavagada taluk to monitor travellers entering from Andhra Pradesh, at locations including Rajavanti, Nagalamadike, Arasikere, TN Pete, with a fifth site pending designation. Health workers, police and revenue department personnel are deployed to enforce screening and raise awareness in border villages. Pavagada Tahsildar has instructed Panchayat Development Officers to vigilantly monitor arrivals and educate residents on precautions. The measures follow an emergency meeting chaired by the Tumakuru District Collector with Tahsildars and senior health officials. Officials urge residents not to panic but to cooperate with screenings to prevent spread of COVID-19 from Andhra Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州、アンドラプラデシュ州での死亡を受けCOVID-19警戒、トゥムクルに5つの国境検問所を設置
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19自体は既知の疾患であり新規性は低いが、州境での検問所設置など地域行政の対応が見られるため、続報の規模拡大有無を注視する。
triage.notes: アンドラプラデシュ州での2件の死亡例の詳細（年齢、基礎疾患、変異株の有無等）が不明。地方レベルの対応であり、国レベルでの深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威という証拠は現時点でない。

article.articleHeadline: وزارة الصحة في الكونغو الديمقراطية: تجاوز حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا بالبلاد 2000 حالة من بينها 754 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ministry of Health: Ebola virus infection cases in the country have surpassed 2,000, including 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ministry of Health reports Ebola virus infections in the country have surpassed 2,000, with 754 deaths. This indicates an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC with substantial mortality. The brief report does not provide regional breakdowns, dates of laboratory confirmation, sources of infection, or vaccination details, nor does it mention imported or exported cases. The figures highlight a significant public health burden and the need for continued surveillance, rapid case management, and transmission interruption within affected provinces. Information is confined to the ministry's update and reflects the current status of the outbreak in mid-July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国保健省:国内のエボラ出血熱感染者数が2000人を超え、うち754人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで2000症例・754死亡という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、致死率も高く国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 地域別内訳、検査確定日、感染源、ワクチン接種状況、輸入・輸出症例の有無など詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 2.000 cas d'Ebola recensés en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 Ebola cases recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths across five provinces, according to health authorities. The Bundibugyo variant, which began on May 15, is spreading at an unprecedented pace: MSF says confirmed cases have tripled and deaths quintupled in under five weeks, the fastest progression in a month among Ebola outbreaks, prompting urgent calls for stronger medical response. The WHO cautions the outbreak may be 2-4 times larger than official counts, noting 80% of new cases are not on known contact lists and arise from unknown transmission chains. Many new cases involve people who died before reaching care. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo yet, but a clinical trial (EBO-PEP) started to test post-exposure antiviral obeldesivir for contacts of confirmed cases. The oral drug, developed by Gilead, aims to evaluate efficacy against this filovirus variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱、2,000例以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が5州にまたがり急速に拡大し、致死数754人、感染経路不明の症例が80%に達するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHOは公式集計の2-4倍規模である可能性を指摘。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、EBO-PEP臨床試験(オベルデシビル)が開始された段階。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 2000 κρούσματα έχουν καταγραφεί στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 2,000 cases have been recorded in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has surpassed 2,000 cases and 754 deaths, with five provinces affected and Uganda reporting cases as well. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri province, a northeast region where about 90% of cases occur amid ongoing violence. WHO estimates the true scale may be 2–4 times higher than official counts. Doctors Without Borders warns the epidemic is spreading to new areas at an unprecedented pace, with confirmed cases tripling and deaths more than quintuple in less than five weeks. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo; however, the first clinical trial evaluating an antiviral drug has begun. The majority of cases remain concentrated in Ituri, pointing to concentrated transmission within this mineral-rich frontier region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で2000人以上の症例が記録されている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000人超の症例・754人の死亡が確認され、ウガンダへの越境拡大、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、MSFが「前例のない速さで拡大」と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、紛争地域での対応の困難さも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Με "πρωτοφανή ρυθμό" εξαπλώνεται η επιδημία Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Ebola outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is driven by the Bundibugyo strain and spreading at an unprecedented rate. Since the outbreak began in mid-May, health authorities have logged over 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with MSF noting a rapid rise compared with the 2018-2020 epidemic. The World Health Organization says the Bundibugyo strain could exceed official estimates by 2 to 4 times. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri Province, a mineral-rich northeastern region where armed groups have repeatedly perpetrated massacres. Cases have been reported across five provinces and in Uganda, but more than 90% of infections are in Ituri. There is no vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo yet; a first antiviral drug clinical trial began on July 14, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行が「前例のない速さ」で拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱が2000例超・754人死亡と急拡大し、複数州とウガンダにも拡大、ワクチン・治療薬未承認という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染の90%以上はイトゥリ州に集中。武装勢力の存在により対応が困難な地域であることも懸念材料。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases in Mumbai in first six months nearly treble to 113
article.articleSummary: Jan–mid-July 2026, Mumbai reports 113 H1N1 cases, up from 41 in the same period last year, with the majority mild but heightened severity among residents over 60 and those with comorbidities; some patients require ventilator support. Malaria cases rise to 3,681; dengue to 938; leptospirosis to 157, all during the monsoon-linked period. Weather is erratic, with high temperatures and humidity facilitating viral transmission, and BMC notes no monthly breakdown. Experts warn chikungunya season is underway and cite joint pain, fever and vomiting, with several suspected leptospirosis cases. Malaria and dengue are now seen year-round due to climate variation and construction activity. A notable severe vivax malaria case involved a 19-year-old patient who developed hospital-acquired gram-negative sepsis followed by Guillain-Barré syndrome; data drawn from BMC health department.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでH1N1感染例が上半期にほぼ3倍増、113件に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性・モンスーン関連の疾患増加（H1N1、マラリア、デング熱、レプトスピラ症）で一部重症例もあるが、インド・ムンバイの例年的傾向で国際的異常性は低い。続報注視が妥当。
triage.notes: モンスーン期における複数の媒介動物・水系感染症（H1N1、マラリア、デング熱、レプトスピラ症、チクングニア熱）の同時増加を報告。BMC（ムンバイ市当局）がデータを管理しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。高齢者・基礎疾患保有者での重症化事例（人工呼吸器使用、GBS発症）が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: Falsche Person erschossen, bayerische Lederhosen, 2000 Ebolafälle - das Wichtigste des Tages
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wrong person shot, Bavarian lederhosen, 2,000 Ebola cases — the top story of the day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains active, with more than 2,000 cases reported. As of July 15, 2026, 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded, including 754 deaths; 753 patients are currently in treatment in hospitals and isolation centers. Five provinces are affected, with Ituri Province in the northeast as the outbreak’s center; Ituri borders Uganda and South Sudan. Uganda has reported Ebola cases, including two fatalities. In South Kivu Province there have been no new cases for 47 days, an encouraging sign. Health authorities are pursuing cross-border surveillance and outbreak response, though the article does not detail infection sources or laboratory methods beyond case counts. The update underscores ongoing transmission in the DRC and regional cross-border risk, prompting continued vigilance through July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 誤射事件、バイエルンの革ズボン、エボラ症例2000件 — 本日の主要ニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,011例・754人死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダへの越境例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率約37%と非常に高く、continuous surveillance が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, l'allarme di MSF: "L'epidemia corre più veloce della risposta, servono risorse urgenti"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, MSF's warning: "The epidemic is outpacing the response; urgent resources are needed."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (epicenter Ituri, with cases in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo) driven by Bundibugyo virus has expanded rapidly two months after declaration, reaching nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths as of July 12, 2026. It is the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in DRC history; cases have tripled from 650 to about 2,000 in less than five weeks, deaths from ~130 to >700. Ituri accounts for roughly 90% of cases, with Bunia’s Elikiya treatment center (90 beds) near full capacity. MSF warns the response is outpacing resources and urges urgent, coordinated international action: enhance community engagement, epidemiological surveillance, testing/diagnosis, patient care, survivor support, and safe/dignified burials, while ensuring other essential health services. MSF operates over 15 isolation units (capacity >430 beds) across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo; since onset, they have admitted 968 patients (357 confirmed) and aided 116 survivors, in partnership with the Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱、MSFが警鐘：「流行は対応より速く進行、緊急の資源が必要」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目の規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、死者700人超・確定症例約2000人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な緊急支援も要請されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSFがリソース不足と国際的な連携強化の緊急性を訴えており、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : MSF alerte sur l'accélération de l'épidémie d'Ebola et réclame une riposte renforcée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: MSF warns of the acceleration of the Ebola outbreak and calls for a strengthened response.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus has nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths, the third-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola surge to date. In two months since declaration, cases rose from about 650 to ~2,000 and deaths from ~130 to >700. Ituri province accounts for roughly 90% of cases, with Mongbwalu and Bunia’s Ebola Treatment Centre Elikiya operating near capacity (90 beds). MSF notes patients arriving critically ill and reports 57 survivors and more than 110 deaths at the Bunia center since intervention began. Seven ETCs and over 15 isolation units (more than 430 beds) span Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo; 968 admissions, including 357 confirmed, and 116 survivors. MSF calls for intensified surveillance, testing, early diagnosis, survivor follow-up, community engagement, and safer burials, with cholera and malaria persisting amid the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:MSF、エボラ流行の加速に警鐘を鳴らし、対応強化を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）の大規模流行が急拡大しており、確認症例約2000人・死者700人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大リスクや対応能力の限界も示唆されるためフルRRAへ進める。

article.articleHeadline: Över 2 000 fall av ebola bekräftas i Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 Ebola cases confirmed in Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Ebola in Kongo-Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has over 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The true toll is likely much higher, with the World Health Organization warning the outbreak could be two to four times the confirmed figure. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) reports that the Bundibugyo Ebola variant is spreading faster than in any prior outbreak; in under five weeks, confirmed cases have tripled while deaths have more than quintupled. The report underscores rapid transmission and the urgent need for intensified surveillance and outbreak-response efforts, though it provides no details on infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.notes: WHOは確認症例数が実際の2〜4倍に達する可能性を警告。感染源や輸入・輸出症例の詳細は記事内で不明。

article.articleHeadline: EpData.- (MAPA) El brote de ébola en RDC rebasa ya los umbrales de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EpData.- (MAPA) The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already surpassed the thresholds of....
article.articleSummary: By 15 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed thresholds with 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths. Declared in mid-May in eastern DRC, the outbreak’s status is illustrated on a map accompanying EpData’s report (via Europa Press). The brief provides no details on transmission, laboratory confirmation, symptoms, or control measures. The reported figures indicate sustained Ebola transmission and a rising toll in the affected region, signaling ongoing public-health concern and the need for continued surveillance and response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Published 15 July 2026, per EpData as reported.

triage.headline_ja: EpData.-（地図）コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、確認症例2000人・死者750人の閾値を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2000症例・750死亡と大規模化しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は感染経路・検査確認・症状・対策等の詳細を欠くが、症例数・死亡数の規模からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。致死率は約37.5%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يجتاح الكونغو.. ومنظمة دولية تحذر العالم: الاحتواء يزداد صعوبة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and an international organization warns the world: containment is becoming more difficult.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported Ebola cases exceeding 2,000 with 754 deaths. The outbreak is affecting five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Transmission remains at a very high rate in Ituri, while new cases in Haut-Uele signal geographic expansion and a need to strengthen surveillance, diagnostics, and operational readiness. The World Health Organization cautions that the outbreak could be four times larger than official counts, highlighting substantial under-detection. Doctors Without Borders notes that containment is becoming more difficult. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases. The situation underscores the necessity for intensified cross-border collaboration and sustained public health measures to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を席巻…国際機関が世界に警告：封じ込めがますます困難に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し2,000人超の症例・754人の死亡と重篤で、WHOが過小報告と封じ込め困難を警告しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOは公式集計の4倍の規模の可能性を指摘、国境なき医師団も封じ込めの困難を報告。地理的拡大（Haut-Uele）とサーベイランス強化の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Plus de 2.000 cas recensés, la maladie se propage à un rythme " sans précédent "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 2,000 cases recorded, the disease is spreading at an unprecedented rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo variant has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths across five provinces since it began on May 15. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) calls the spread unprecedented, noting case counts tripled in under five weeks and deaths quintupled, urging a rapid scale-up of the medical response. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak could be two to four times higher than official figures, with about 80% of new cases not on known contact lists and emerging from unknown transmission chains. Many newly reported patients died before accessing health facilities. Officials describe this as the fastest-progressing Ebola outbreak managed, already surpassing half of the total cases recorded during the 2018–2020 RDC epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:2,000人以上の症例を記録、「前例のない」速さで感染が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が5州にまたがり急速に拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が8割に上るなど国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: MSFおよびWHOが前例のない速さでの拡大と報告不足の可能性を指摘しており、2018-2020年流行を上回るペースであることから緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo affects over 2,000 people, 754 dead; WHO raises alarm over rapid spread
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports over 2,000 Ebola cases and 754 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo variant. Infections span five provinces, with Ituri in the northeast bearing the vast majority and cases also in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak was declared on 15 May after deaths in Ituri, a mineral-rich region with armed groups. Doctors Without Borders says the virus is spreading at unprecedented speed; confirmed cases have tripled and deaths more than fivefold in under five weeks. The World Health Organization cautions that real figures could be two to four times higher than official data. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyro, though a first antiviral trial against this strain has begun.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、2,000人以上に影響、死者754人；WHOが急速な拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が5州に拡大し、隣国ウガンダにも波及。WHOが異例の速さでの感染拡大に警鐘を鳴らしており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、抗ウイルス薬の初の臨床試験が開始された段階で、公衆衛生上のリスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Mogi alerta sobre risco de sarampo e reforça vacinação na cidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mogi City Hall warns about the measles risk and reinforces vaccination in the city.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk reinforced in Mogi das Cruzes, São Paulo, as seven measles cases have been confirmed in 2026, concentrated in the capital and Guarulhos; Brazil totals eight. Although Mogi has had no cases since 2012, proximity raises outbreak risk among unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated people. Measles is a highly contagious airborne virus that can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, or death. The Measles-Mumps-Rubella vaccine (MMR) is free at all Basic Health Units; schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months. For 0–29 years, two doses; 30–59 years, one dose; health workers must have two doses. Travelers should verify vaccination at least 15 days before international trips; returnees should seek care if fever, rash, cough, runny nose, or conjunctivitis appear. Brazil regained PAHO elimination in 2024, but importations and waning coverage keep reintroduction risk. Mogi coverage for 1-year-olds is 89.6% on first dose and 72.1% on second, below 95% target.

triage.headline_ja: モジ市庁、麻疹リスクを警告し市内でのワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が散発的に増加しているが、重症例や死亡の報告はなく、地域限定的な公衆衛生対応にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年にPAHOの麻疹排除認定を再取得したが、輸入例やワクチン接種率低下により再興リスクが指摘されている。現時点では国内対応で管理可能な規模。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果民主共和国伊波拉疫情恶化 累计逾2000病例754人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens, with more than 2,000 cases and 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens, with more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The World Health Organization warns the true infection count may be 2 to 4 times higher than official figures. Data from the DRC Ministry of Health show the outbreak has spread to five provinces nationwide. The current strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer Ebola virus type for which there is no approved vaccine or proven treatment. Nevertheless, the WHO reports that the first antiviral drug clinical trial for Bundibugyo began on July 14. The situation underscores ongoing severity, limited therapeutic options for this strain, and the urgent need for strengthened containment, surveillance, and international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が悪化、症例数2000人超・死者754人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州に拡大し2000例超・死者754人、承認済みワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数が公式数値の2〜4倍に上る可能性を警告。稀なBundibugyo株で承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、初の抗ウイルス薬臨床試験が7月14日に開始された。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 2000 حالة بينها 754 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 2,000, with 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 2,000 cases with 754 deaths. The Ministry of Health reports over 2,000 infections and 754 fatalities, amid a rapid spread attributed to a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization notes that 80% of new infections in eastern DRC occur via transmission chains that cannot be traced, signaling untracked community transmission. The Africa CDC warns this is the fastest Ebola outbreak on the continent; reports from Bunia in Ituri Province highlight many recent deaths occurring in communities without access to care, hindering isolation and contact tracing. By Monday, at least 1,926 people had been infected in three provinces with 702 deaths; confirmed cases have also emerged in neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が2000人を超え、死者754人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000人超・死者754人という深刻な規模のエボラ流行が発生し、追跡不能な感染連鎖によりウガンダへも拡大していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも確認例があるとされるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。稀なブンディブギョ株による急速な流行で、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Περισσότερα από 2000 κρούσματα έχουν καταγραφεί στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 2,000 cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths since its start, according to health authorities. The outbreak, declared on May 15 in Ituri province in the northeast, is spreading at an unprecedented pace and reaching new areas, with MSF warning of rapid expansion. The World Health Organization says the actual size could be two to four times higher than official figures. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine and no approved therapy yet. A first clinical trial to evaluate an antiviral drug began yesterday. Cases have been confirmed in five DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda, though roughly 90% or more of infections remain concentrated in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人以上の症例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(2000症例超・754死亡)で複数州及び隣国ウガンダへの拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: ウガンダも症例確認地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療法が未承認のBundibugyo株であり、WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘している点も重大性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola vakası sayısı 2 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 2,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 753 patients under treatment, according to the DRC Ministry of Health. Declared May 15, the outbreak has spread to five eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele; South Kivu has had no new confirmed cases since May 26. Health workers infected total 114, with 36 deaths. The World Health Organization warns this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date, noting about 80% of new cases are not on contact lists, suggesting undetected transmission chains and a true case count potentially 2–4 times higher than official figures. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain; background recalls Ebola’s 1976 origins near the Ebola River and the 2014–2017 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱患者数が2000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数・死亡者数が急増し、複数州へ拡大、WHOが過去最速の増加ペースと警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says $115 million Ebola response is barely half-funded as cases quietly multiply
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, outbreaks of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo have reached Ituri province with 1,926 infections and 702 deaths, though experts say true case counts are two to four times higher. The virus currently has no approved treatments or vaccines, so containment relies on surveillance, contact tracing, and outreach. The outbreak has spread to two additional provinces this week, expanding the challenge for local diagnostic and isolation centers. WHO is appealing for an emergency $115 million fund; only 40% has been raised, leaving a shortfall of about $69 million. If not closed, the funding gap could severely undermine field operations. WHO Director Chikwe Ihekweazu urged international donors to fund immediately, noting the long-term nature of the response and that the DRC cannot bear this alone.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによる1億1500万ドルのエボラ対応資金はほぼ半分しか集まっておらず、感染者は静かに増加していると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）の大規模流行が継続し、致死率が高く、複数州への拡大とワクチン・治療薬未承認という状況が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと資金不足による対応能力の低下が懸念されるためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 感染者数1,926人、死亡702人（致死率約36%）。実際の症例数は報告の2〜4倍との専門家見解あり。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブジョ株であり、資金不足が対応の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: More health workers strike in Ituri province, at the heart of Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Health workers in Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Congo, intensified a strike over unpaid salaries amid the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus. As of Wednesday, 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths are recorded in Congo. There are 753 patients in isolation or hospital, with 366 recoveries. Contact tracing remains challenging, with only 67% of exposed contacts followed. The outbreak began May 15; two months in, it continues to spread faster than response efforts can track, with at least 80% of new cases from unknown transmission chains, according to the WHO. Workers barricaded Bunia General Hospital after two-and-a-half months without pay; a similar protest occurred Monday in nearby Rwampara. Residents note frontline staff dedication amid pay delays, as the outbreak strains Ituri and surrounding towns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱発生の中心地イトゥリ州で、医療従事者のストライキがさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011例・754人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、接触者追跡率が67%にとどまり新規感染の80%が感染経路不明という制御困難な状況に加え、医療従事者のストライキが対応をさらに悪化させているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda（Kigali Province）が含まれるが、記事内では実際の症例発生には言及されておらず、地理的近接性による情報と考えられるため verified_locations には含めない。医療従事者への未払い給与によるストライキが感染対応能力をさらに低下させている点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se alastra pela República Democrática do Congo, que soma 754 mortes, em ritmo 'sem precedentes'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has reached 754 deaths at an unprecedented pace.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-15, Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 2,000 cases and 754 deaths reported. Health authorities describe the outbreak as unprecedented in pace and geographic spread, with MSF warning transmission is advancing into new areas. In under five weeks, confirmed cases have tripled and deaths quintupled, and the outbreak has surpassed half of the total cases seen during the 2018–2020 DRC Ebola epidemic. The WHO emergency operations director, Chikwe Ihekweazu, noted that about 80% of new cases are not in known contact lists and arise from undetected transmission chains, highlighting substantial challenges for containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国全土に拡大、死者754人に達し「前例のない」ペースで進行
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで前例のないペースで拡大し、2000例超・死者754人に達し、80%が未知の感染経路であるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: WHO緊急事態対応責任者が言及するなど国際機関の関与が既に見られ、封じ込めの困難さが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: पोटका में इलाज की लापरवाही ने ली 12 साल की बच्ची की जान; 5 वर्षीय छोटा भाई ब्रेन मलेरिया की चपेट में, MGM रेफर - potka child dies brother battles brain malaria in mgm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Negligence in treatment in Potka claims the life of a 12-year-old girl; the five-year-old brother is battling cerebral malaria, referred to MGM.
article.articleSummary: 12-year-old Anita Sardar died in Nararda village, Potka Block, after not receiving timely treatment, while her five-year-old brother Ajay Sardar is severely ill with cerebral malaria and has been referred to MGM Hospital for advanced care. Acting Chief Medical Officer Dr. Sukant Seat stated that delays in diagnosis and treatment contributed to Anita’s death. A special malaria screening campaign conducted July 7–9 in the village found no positive cases, and Ajay’s family members tested negative; Anita had been staying at her maternal grandfather's home in Dumaria, so malaria testing could not be conducted on July 9. Following Ajay’s positive brain malaria result, health authorities urged residents to seek prompt free testing for fever, body pains, chills, or malaria symptoms and to complete the full treatment course to prevent further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ポトカで治療の遅れにより12歳の少女が死亡、5歳の弟は脳マラリアと闘い、MGM病院へ搬送
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州の一村落における個別の死亡例・重症例であり、マラリアは同地域の風土病であるため異常性は低く、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの当該地域における既知の風土病であり、本記事は地域スクリーニングキャンペーンの結果と個別診療の遅れに関する局所的な報道である。国際的シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Le Point ISOS - "Hantavirus dans une croisière hollandaise : priorité absolue. Ebola dans cinq provinces du Congo : silence"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Le Point ISOS - "Hantavirus aboard a Dutch cruise ship: top priority. Ebola in five provinces of the Congo: silence"
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus aboard a Dutch cruise ship Columbus, originating from Argentina, caused 15 total cases with three deaths (the index patient, his wife, and a crew member) before treatment. Transmission occurred in the ship’s closed environment and required close, prolonged contact; the virus is not airborne and there is no vaccine, only supportive care. Public health authorities, led by WHO/CDC, defined the incubation period, conducted contact tracing, and organized quarantines; subsequent cases were treated in specialized facilities. The incident highlighted the effectiveness of SARS-era lessons in cross-border management, with the WHO Director-General visiting the Canary Islands to destigmatize passengers. Media amplification contributed to a perceived crisis beyond epidemiology. Ebola in five provinces of Congo is described as not controlled, with population mobility driving cross-border spread, marking a shift from the earlier village-centered pattern seen in 2014 outbreaks in Guinea and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: Le Point ISOS - 「オランダのクルーズ船内のハンタウイルス：最優先事項。コンゴ5州のエボラ：沈黙」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の5州でエボラが制御不能な状態にあり、人口移動による国境を越えた拡大が懸念されている。従来の村落型流行パターンからの変化という異常性と、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はハンタウイルス（クルーズ船、アルゼンチン発、カナリア諸島寄港）とDRCのエボラの対比にあるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。記事タイトルが示唆する通り、エボラへの社会的関心の低さ（メディアの沈黙）自体が問題視されており、実際のリスクは高いと考えられる。ハンタウイルス関連国（アルゼンチン、スペイン、シエラレオネ、ギニア）は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: देशात चांदीपुरा व्हायरसची दहशत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic over Chandipura virus in the country.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus panic spreads in Gujarat, India, adjacent to Maharashtra. In recent weeks, the virus has killed three children and left four more under treatment; eight suspected cases await lab results. All affected are under 10 years old, prompting parental fear. Gujarat’s health department has launched controls, aided by the Indian Medical Association; pediatricians have been urged to stay vigilant. Doctors are instructed to admit suspected cases immediately and provide oxygen and ventilator support as needed, with severe cases from small facilities referred to larger hospitals. In 2024 Gujarat reported 61 Chandipura virus infections; vector-control measures—fogging, larviciding, and public awareness—were implemented, after which officials claimed no new cases. Chandipura virus was first identified in Chandipur village, Nagpur district, Maharashtra, and is transmitted by mosquitoes, sandflies, and midges; fever with flu-like symptoms and possible acute encephalitis are noted. Parents should protect children from vectors and seek prompt care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: 国内でチャンディプラウイルスへの恐怖が広がる
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州で子ども3人が死亡し複数の疑い症例が出ているチャンディプラウイルス（脳炎）の流行で、重症度が高く社会的関心も高まっているため。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはグジャラート州で毎年季節的に発生が報告されている既知の疾患であり、2024年にも61例の報告がある。今回は子ども3名の死亡と複数の疑い例が出ており、地域保健当局による媒介動物対策と医療体制強化が行われている。バングラデシュは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく、除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde SP passa a recomendar dose zero contra o sarampo em São Bernardo do Campo; entenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Health Department begins recommending zero-dose against measles in São Bernardo do Campo; understand.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, the São Paulo State Health Department has issued a zero-dose of the measles vaccine for children aged 6 months to 11 months 29 days in São Bernardo do Campo, with similar eligibility in São Paulo city and Guarulhos due to suspected measles cases. The aim is to extend protection to infants under 1 year, the group most vulnerable to severe outcomes. The zero-dose does not replace routine immunization; after this dose, children should follow the standard schedule: first MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) at 12 months and a second dose at 15 months (preferably the MMRV vaccine). Routine targets also apply to older age groups: 5–29 years require two MMR doses; 30–59 years require one dose; health workers two doses. The measure may be used in outbreak containment blocks around suspected or confirmed cases, with vaccination guidance available at vacina100duvidas.sp.gov.br.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州保健局、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポで麻疹に対する「ゼロ回目接種」を推奨開始
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹疑い例増加を受けた予防的な追加接種措置であり、確定症例数・重症度等の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州（サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ、サンパウロ市、グアルーリョス）における麻疹疑い例に対するワクチン接種強化策を報じている。確定症例数・入院・死亡等の重症度情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Panvel Sees Surge In Infectious Diseases After Rains Ease; 286 Dengue, Malaria And Diarrhoea Cases Reported In First Week Of July
article.articleSummary: Panvel Municipal Corporation (PMC), Navi Mumbai, reports a surge in dengue, malaria, and diarrhoeal illnesses as heavy rains subside and humid conditions return. In the first week of July 2026, PMC recorded 286 cases. Malaria: 43 cases in June from 12,664 blood samples; nine new cases in the first week of July from 1,873 samples. Dengue: 16 cases in June from 486 samples; 12 cases in the first week of July from 94 samples, indicating a rising infection rate. Diarrhoea: 543 June cases; 265 fresh cases in the first week of July. Officials cite muddy water and stagnation as breeding drivers. Measures include fever surveillance, blood testing, focal surveys, anti-larval spraying, release of guppy/gambusia fish, fogging, inspections, builder notices, public awareness, and coordination with private hospitals and labs. Citizens urged to drink boiled/purified water and seek care for fever or diarrhoea.

triage.headline_ja: パンヴェルで雨季後に感染症が急増、7月第1週にデング熱・マラリア・下痢症合計286件を報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の雨季後に典型的に見られるデング熱・マラリア・下痢症の増加であり、地元自治体が通常の対策（防疫・啓発等）で対応しておりIHR基準・社会的関心のいずれも高くない。
triage.notes: 季節性・地域限定的な媒介動物感染症の増加で、自治体レベルで既に監視・防除措置が実施されている。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、外部支援の必要性も示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, salgono a 2 mila i casi confermati. Msf: "Numero triplicato in meno di cinque settimane"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: confirmed cases rise to 2,000. MSF: "The number has tripled in less than five weeks."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with the World Health Organization warning the outbreak could be two to four times larger than official tallies. MSF says cases have tripled in under five weeks and deaths have quadrupled, as the outbreak spreads to five provinces with no vaccine for Bundibugyo; an antiviral trial began yesterday. WHO emergency chief Chikwe Ihekweazu noted that 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, with many transmission chains unknown and patients dying before reaching care. In late June, France reported a first Ebola case in a humanitarian medic returning from Congo. UNICEF says 2.95 million children under 18 in 31 health zones are at risk; in Ituri, Ebola has left over 130 orphans. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths; one child is positive, 19 others under quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱、確定症例が2,000人に増加。国境なき医師団：「5週間足らずで症例数が3倍に」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確定症例が2,000人・死者754人に達し、5州に拡大、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占め、フランス・ウガンダへの越境例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）やフランスへの越境例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株にはワクチンがなく、抗ウイルス薬治験が開始されたばかりで、状況は依然拡大傾向にある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola mata ao menos 754 no Congo; país tem mais de 2 mil casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills at least 754 in Congo; the country has more than 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo records over 2,000 Ebola cases and at least 754 deaths, with the outbreak spanning five provinces. The World Health Organization cautions the epidemic may be two to four times higher than official figures. MSF reports rapid escalation: confirmed cases have tripled in under five weeks and deaths more than quintupled; the organization notes the outbreak already exceeds half the case count of the 2018–2020 surge. Chikwe Ihekweazu, MSF emergencies head, warns that about 80% of new cases are not on contact lists and stem from unknown transmission chains, and many diagnoses involve people who died before reaching a health facility. There are no vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain, but the first antiviral treatment trial was conducted yesterday, according to the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が少なくとも754人死亡、感染者数は2000人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、死亡者数・感染者数ともに深刻で、ワクチン未対応株のため国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: MSFはWHO公式統計より実際の症例数が2〜4倍多い可能性を指摘。80%の新規感染者が接触者リスト外であり、感染経路不明のヒト-ヒト感染が急速に拡大している。Bundibugyo株にはワクチンがなく、抗ウイルス薬治験が開始されたばかりで管理が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 2.000 casos confirmados de ébola, entre ellos 754 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses the 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases, including 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reached 2,011 with 754 deaths as of July 13, 2026, according to a bulletin from the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media. The case fatality rate stands at 37.5%. The outbreak, declared on May 15 in the eastern part of the country, has persisted with sustained transmission in the region. The report compiles laboratory-confirmed cases monitored by national authorities through mid-July, underscoring the ongoing severity of the outbreak in eastern DRC and the continued need for public health measures and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が2,000件を突破、うち754人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで、致死率37.5%と高く、確定症例2,000件超と継続的な人-人感染が示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたアウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率が高く、国際的な支援や封じ込め対策の継続が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Zorgmedewerkers in door ebola geteisterd Oost-Congo leggen werk neer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers in Ebola-stricken eastern Congo resign.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, Bunia hospital) triggers renewed staff strikes over unpaid salaries and blocked access. Some workers say they have received no pay since the outbreak began on May 15. MSF warns the outbreak is spreading faster than authorities can track, calling for stronger containment. Official figures show confirmed Ebola cases exceeding 2,000 in under five weeks, with 754 deaths—doubling since June 28—making it the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, per MSF. WHO estimates the true burden could be two to four times higher, with more than 100 health workers infected since the start. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus. Population movement due to conflict and mining complicates contact tracing, with many deaths occurring in communities without hospital care. The Netherlands adds 4 million euros in funding to support response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が蔓延する東コンゴの医療従事者がストライキ・離職
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で希少なブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行（症例2,000超、死亡754人）が急速拡大しており、医療従事者感染や人道支援ニーズも高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: オランダは資金支援国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。紛争・鉱山労働による人口移動が接触者追跡を困難にしており、国際的拡大リスクは今後の続報で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratik Kongo Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola vakası 2 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-15, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths in an outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The epicenter is Ituri province in the east, with five provinces affected and spillover into Uganda. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. Health workers accounted for 114 infections and 36 deaths. The World Health Organization cautions that true case totals may be 2–4 times higher than official counts, with about 80% of new cases not on contact lists, sustaining undetected transmission chains. The outbreak began after it was declared on May 15; experts believe broader circulation occurred earlier. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated materials, not through the air. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, kidney/liver dysfunction, and sometimes bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率高く死者754名、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、ウガンダへの越境拡大と医療従事者感染が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへのスピルオーバーが報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、未検出の感染連鎖が継続している懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: 女孩发烧3天以为感冒 确诊脑炎 初期症状极具迷惑性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl with a fever for three days thought she had a cold; diagnosed with encephalitis; early symptoms were highly deceptive.
article.articleSummary: 12-year-old Xinxin in Zhengzhou, China, presented with three days of fever up to 40°C, sore throat, and marked lethargy. In the pediatric clinic of Zhengzhou People’s Hospital, involuntary movements of the hands, feet, and mouth prompted suspicion of encephalitis. EEG and MRI confirmed a diagnosis of viral encephalitis. After multidisciplinary treatment, Xinxin recovered and was discharged. The case underscores that pediatric viral encephalitis can mimic common colds in early stages, delaying treatment. Children’s developing immune systems and partially intact blood-brain barrier allow viruses—such as enteroviruses, herpesviruses, influenza, or mumps virus—to invade the central nervous system via respiratory or digestive routes, causing inflammation and edema of brain tissue. Parents should note fever with abnormal behavior, poor appetite, irritability, lethargy, and later signs like seizures or paralysis warrant urgent evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱3日間で風邪と思ったら脳炎と診断、初期症状は非常に紛らわしい
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児患者の個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報がない。教育的な啓発記事に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の小児ウイルス性脳炎の症例報告であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクの情報は含まれていない。疾患名にMumps、Influenzaが挙げられているが、これは脳炎の原因ウイルス例としての一般的言及であり、実際の感染確定病原体ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω από 2.000 κρούσματα Έμπολα έχουν καταγραφεί στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 Ebola cases have been recorded in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, the fastest-growing outbreak on record, according to government data. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, a mineral-rich area where armed groups have committed massacres. Cases have spread to five DRC provinces and to Uganda, but over 90% of infections remain in Ituri. The outbreak was declared on May 15. MSF notes unprecedented spread, with confirmed cases tripling and deaths more than quintupled in under five weeks, and cautions the total could be two to four times official estimates. There is currently no vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo; however, the WHO announced the first antiviral drug trial to assess effectiveness began yesterday.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人を超えるエボラ感染例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、複数州およびウガンダにも拡散。ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ致死率が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染地域として言及されているが、記事の主題はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブンディブギョ株の致死率の高さとMSFによる過小報告懸念、抗ウイルス薬治験開始の情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: इस अफ्रीकी देश में इबोला का तांडवः सबसे तेजी से फैलने वाला बना वायरस, अब तक 754 लोगों की मौ'त
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In this African country, Ebola wreaks havoc: the fastest-spreading virus, with 754 deaths so far.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola linked to Bundibugyo virus has rapidly spread since the first case on May 15 in Ituri province’s Bunia area. Cumulative figures show 2,011 laboratory-confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 753 patients still in isolation or hospital care and 366 recovered. Contact tracing remains a major challenge, and the World Health Organization says at least 80 percent of new infections arise from chains with no information. Several recently fatal cases involved individuals who never reached health facilities for treatment. Authorities warn this variant is highly dangerous, with no approved vaccine or definitive treatment available. The outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading in the country, with ongoing community transmission; health workers in Ituri report strikes and unpaid salaries, complicating response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: この アフリカの国でエボラが猛威、最も急速に拡大するウイルスに―これまでに754人死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ・ウイルス関連)の大規模流行が発生し、2,011例確認・754人死亡、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、接触者追跡困難で市中感染が継続しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 医療従事者のストライキ・未払い賃金が対応能力を阻害しており、外部支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Centro de Massaranduba concentra 50 focos do mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Massaranduba Center concentrates 50 dengue mosquito breeding sites.
article.articleSummary: Massaranduba Center reports 50 Aedes aegypti breeding sites and one confirmed dengue case, based on dengue bulletin updated in the first week of July 2026. The affected area is the Center of Massaranduba. Residents are urged to perform weekly inspections of yards, lots, and containers that can hold water to curb mosquito breeding. Dengue symptoms include sudden high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, body and joint pains, red skin rashes, nausea, and vomiting. Suspected dengue cases should seek medical care promptly and avoid self-medication. Reports of standing water locations can be submitted to Epidemiological Surveillance via phone or WhatsApp at (47) 3379-8511. The update signals ongoing dengue transmission risk in the municipality, underscoring vector control and community engagement as critical prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: マサランドゥバ中心部でデング熱を媒介する蚊の発生地50カ所が集中
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体レベルでの蚊の発生地報告と1件の確定症例のみであり、ブラジルでは日常的な公衆衛生活動の一環で、深刻性・異常性・国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は自治体レベルでの蚊対策啓発活動を報じるルーティン記事。確定症例は1件のみで、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: इस अफ्रीकी देश में इबोला का तांडवः सबसे तेजी से फैलने वाला बना वायरस, अब तक 754 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In this African country, Ebola's havoc: the fastest-spreading virus, with 754 deaths so far.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province around Bunia, has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, government data released Tuesday night show. Of the total, 753 are in isolation or hospital, and 366 have recovered. The outbreak, attributed to the Bundibugyo virus, began around May 15, with two months elapsed since the first case as transmission accelerates. WHO emergencies chief Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu said at least 80% of new infections arise from chains with unknown links, and many deaths occurred among people who never sought care at health facilities. Health workers in Ituri, including Bunia, have staged strikes over wages, complicating response efforts. The report highlights ongoing challenges in contact tracing and identifying exposed individuals amid the rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: この アフリカの国でエボラが猛威を振るう:最速拡大のウイルスとなり、これまでに754人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で2,011症例・754人死亡と大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の流行が進行中で、感染経路不明な連鎖が80%を占め医療従事者ストライキも重なり対応が困難な状況であり、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: WHO幹部が感染連鎖の追跡困難と医療アクセスの問題を指摘しており、致死率も高い（754/2011≈37.5%）。医療従事者ストライキが対応をさらに複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is spreading faster in eastern Congo than it can be tracked, as deaths pass 700
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo is accelerating beyond surveillance capacity. WHO says about 80% of new cases cannot be traced to known contacts, indicating transmission through unidentified chains. As of July 13, 2026, confirmed cases reach 1,926 across three provinces, with 702 deaths, and cases have been documented in neighboring Uganda. Much transmission occurs outside formal healthcare settings, with many dying in the community without treatment, hindering isolation and contact tracing and raising the risk of further spread. Despite some expansion of medical infrastructure—Bunia treatment capacity up to 800 beds and labs increasing from 1 to 14 facilities—challenges persist: unpaid healthcare workers, funding gaps, security threats, armed conflict, and community hesitancy. The outbreak was declared May 15; a U.S. citizen employed by a humanitarian organization tested positive on July 11, marking the first international personnel case. Authorities call it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ出血熱が追跡不能な速度で拡大、死者700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（症例1926件、死者702人）が追跡能力を超えて拡大し、ウガンダへの越境や国際人道支援者への感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例波及が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国際人道支援者（米国籍）の感染も報告されており、国際的関心の高まりが予想される。

article.articleHeadline: Példátlan léptékben terjed az afrikai ebola-járvány, a kétezret is meghaladta a fertőzöttek száma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Ebola outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented scale, with the number of infections exceeding two thousand.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed infections with 754 deaths as of July 12, according to WHO via MSF. The official counts may understate the outbreak's true size. Since May, WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with geographic spread accelerating as health facilities and surveillance collapse, and communities outside cities receiving inadequate care. Contact tracing is chaotic; WHO's emergencies chief said 80% of new cases were not on known contact lists, arising from unknown transmission chains. The year’s 17th Ebola outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus strain, for which vaccines are still under development. A first clinical trial of an antiviral drug developed by Gilead Sciences began this week, showing promising preclinical results, per Medical Xpress.

triage.headline_ja: 前例のない規模で拡大するアフリカのエボラ流行、感染者数が2000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率が高く感染経路不明の症例が80%に上るなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを宣言済み。バンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイクでワクチンは未開発、抗ウイルス薬の治験が開始されたばかりであり、フルRRAによる継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: ابتلای ۲۰۰۰ نفر به ایبولا در کنگو؛ سازمان پزشکان بدون مرز خواستار اقدامات فوری شد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,000 people infected with Ebola in Congo; Doctors Without Borders calls for urgent action.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of Sunday, July 12, 2026, marking the third fastest outbreak on record. The current surge is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals. Patients typically present with high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. MSF, operating seven treatment centers and more than 15 isolation units in Congo, warns that every day of delay costs lives and is urging urgent, coordinated international action to contain the outbreak and expand care. WHO attributes continued spread to population movement and delays in starting treatment. Communities outside urban centers face limited access to care and an overwhelmed surveillance system; MSF calls for increased surveillance, laboratory capacity, and safe, dignified burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者2,000人に達し、国境なき医師団が緊急対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例1,926人・死者702人（史上3番目に速い流行）という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHOやMSFが国際的な緊急対応を要請しているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約36%と非常に高く、Bundibugyo株による流行。都市部以外での医療アクセス制限とサーベイランス体制の逼迫が指摘されており、国際的な支援拡大が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza sin freno y complica la respuesta humanitaria en áreas aisladas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances unchecked and complicates the humanitarian response in isolated areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in DRC’s Ituri province, caused by Bundibugyo, has advanced unchecked two months after the outbreak was declared, becoming the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in the country since 1976. More than 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths have been reported; WHO notes about 80% of transmissions are from unknown chains. MSF warns containment is slipping as Mongbwalu treats many critically ill patients after delays, and Bunia’s Elikiya center operates near capacity, delaying diagnosis and isolation. The outbreak has reached Alto Uélé and Tshopo provinces, including Kisangani, raising risk of spread to dense populations. WHO estimates actual cases may be 2–4 times higher than reported. Labs can process up to 250; treatment and transit centers offer >700 beds. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment; funding needs US$518 million, with under US$100 million received. Peacekeeping and security improvements are essential for containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が制御不能な拡大を続け、孤立地域での人道対応を困難にしている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011例・754人死亡と大規模かつ拡大中のエボラ流行であり、伝播経路の8割が不明で密集地域への拡大リスクもあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 1976年以来3番目に大きく最も急速に拡大しているエボラ流行。ワクチン・特効薬未承認、資金不足（必要額5.18億ドルに対し1億ドル未満）、治安維持の必要性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS advierte que el brote de ébola en el Congo podría ser hasta cuatro veces mayor que las cifras oficiales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in Congo could be up to four times larger than official figures.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared May 15; WHO PHEIC May 17.
