As of July 13, 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths; 727 patients hospitalized in treatment centers on July 12. Ituri province accounts for 91.3% of cases and 84% of deaths (case fatality rate 30.9% as of July 1), with spread to five eastern provinces including Tshopo and Haut-Uele. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths, with no new infections since June 21. No licensed vaccine or specific therapy; a July 2 clinical trial assesses MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir. Health workers at Rwampara center report 112 infections and 35 deaths. International partners have mobilized about $1.5 billion. WHO notes the true outbreak size could be 2–4 times higher than detected due to home deaths; US restricts returning travelers from the DRC to 21 days outside.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は公式統計の4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ出血熱流行で、致死率約31%、複数州への拡大、国際的な人的・資金支援が動員されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。実際の流行規模は自宅死亡等により検出数の2〜4倍に達する可能性があるとWHOが警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Guarulhos reforça prevenção e convoca população a atualizar a vacina contra o sarampo - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarulhos Health Department reinforces prevention and calls on the population to update their measles vaccination - Click Guarulhos
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak response in Guarulhos, Brazil: after the first confirmed measles case this year, the municipal Health Department intensified surveillance, outbreak-blocking vaccination, active case finding, contact monitoring, and a Vila Galvão vaccination sweep to update residents’ immunization status. Measles is highly contagious and airborne; early symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a red rash, with possible pneumonia, encephalitis, and death, especially in young children and the immunocompromised. Vaccination is the primary defense. Free MMR vaccine is available at all Guarulhos UBS. Schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; 12 months–29 years without vaccination proof should receive two doses; adults 30–59 without prior vaccination receive one dose. A temporary dose zero is suggested for babies 6–11 months. Individuals should seek care for fever with rash and present vaccination cards; higher coverage protects those who cannot be vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: グアルーリョス保健局、予防を強化し住民に麻疹ワクチン接種の更新を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・グアルーリョスで今年最初の麻疹確定例が報告され、当局が予防接種強化などの対応を開始しているが、現時点では単発例であり重症例・死亡例の報告はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例を受けた地方自治体による予防接種強化・アウトブレイク阻止対策の報道であり、重症化や地域拡大の情報はない。麻疹は高い感染力を持つため、ワクチン未接種者への拡大リスクは残る。続報での症例数増加や重症化情報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Không chủ quan trước nguy cơ dịch bệnh Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't be complacent about the risk of Ebola entering.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk entering Vietnam remains low, but Thanh Hoa Health Department intensifies surveillance at the international Na Meo Border Gate and Nghi Son Port. No Ebola cases in Vietnam to date. The MOH has urged authorities to remain vigilant at borders, communities, and healthcare facilities to quickly detect, isolate, and manage suspected cases. Thanh Hoa CDC's International Health Quarantine Division conducts routine health surveillance of people, vehicles, goods, and seafarers; tracks travel history from outbreak areas; and updates measures according to WHO guidance and MOH directives. Preparedness includes stocking equipment, disinfectants, PPE, and training for handling suspected cases, with ongoing multi-agency coordination with border guards, customs, and port authorities. Travelers from outbreak regions should monitor health for 21 days and seek care if fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, diarrhea, vomiting, or hemorrhagic signs occur. Early detection and rapid response are emphasized to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の侵入リスクに対し、油断しないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内でのエボラ症例は確認されておらず、記事は国境監視強化などの予防的対応を報じるのみで、実際の感染症イベントの発生は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム国内でのエボラ症例発生を報じているのではなく、国境における予防的サーベイランス強化を伝えるものであり、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: MGM अस्‍पताल में पैर रखने की जगह नहीं: इन 6 लक्षणों को न करें नजरअंदाज, खुद से दवा लेना पड़ सकता है भारी - jamshedpur mgm hospital overwhelmed by seasonal disease surge
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MGM Hospital has no room to spare: Do not ignore these six symptoms; self-medicating could prove costly - Jamshedpur MGM Hospital overwhelmed by seasonal disease surge.
article.articleSummary: Jamshedpur’s MGM Medical College Hospital is overwhelmed by a monsoon-driven surge in seasonal illnesses. In five days, 6,610 patients were treated, with Medicine the busiest; by Wednesday 4 pm, 290 new patients were in the Medicine OPD. Beds are full; care is on stretchers, wheelchairs, or floors. Besides viral fever, suspected Dengue, Malaria, Diarrhea, and Jaundice cases are rising. IMA Jamshedpur president Dr. G.C. Majhi cited weather shifts, waterlogging, and mosquito proliferation as drivers. Doctors warn against self-medication: unadvised drugs can mask serious infections, reduce antibiotic efficacy, and risk liver or kidney damage or adverse reactions, especially in children, the elderly, and pregnant women. Six warning symptoms require urgent testing: fever >3 days; recurrent chills; severe headache and eye pain; severe body/muscle/joint pain with jaundice; vomiting/diarrhea with weakness or dizziness; and rashes or bleeding. Preventive tips include boiled water, eliminating standing water, mosquito protection, and good hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: MGM病院に足の踏み場もない：この6つの症状を見逃すな、自己判断での服薬は危険 - ジャムシェドプルMGM病院、季節性疾患の急増で圧倒される
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季節性のデング熱・マラリア等の患者急増で医療機関が逼迫しているが、インド国内の地域的・季節的な現象であり国際的拡大の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 毎年のモンスーン季節に見られる典型的な感染症（デング熱・マラリア）の増加であり、地域の医療逼迫が主な論点。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases soar past 2,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of July 16, 2026, with 753 people in isolation or hospital and 366 recovered. The epicenter in Ituri has expanded into two additional provinces. Health authorities warn the true scale may be 2–4 times higher than official counts, as 80% of new infections occur outside known contact lists; contact tracing coverage stands at 67%. Onset began May 15; patient zero remains unidentified. Displacement from conflict and mining movements hinder tracing. Bunia's treatment capacity nears 800 beds; lab capacity has increased from 1 to 14 labs. Funding gaps, attacks on health centers, ongoing eastern conflict, and mistrust impede response. Health workers at Bunia General Hospital struck over pay, later agreeing to resume work if paid within 72 hours.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数が2000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例2,011例・死亡754例と大規模な流行で、感染範囲が複数州に拡大し接触者追跡の網から漏れる感染が8割に達するなど制御不能なリスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 紛争地域での人口移動・鉱山労働者の移動が接触者追跡を困難にしており、実際の症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性が指摘されている。医療従事者のストライキなど対応能力にも懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള കുതിച്ചുയരുന്നു; രോഗബാധിതർ 2,000 കടന്നു, 754 മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surges in Congo; cases surpass 2,000, with 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola surges in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, 2026. Currently, 753 patients remain hospitalized in isolation wards; 366 have recovered. The World Health Organization notes that more than 80% of newly reported cases have unknown infection sources, hampering containment. Contact tracing remains a major challenge, and only about 67% of at‑risk individuals are under surveillance. The epicenter is Ituri province, but the virus has spread to five provinces, including Tshopo and Haut-Uele, with two additional unnamed provinces affected. The rapid transmission outpaces health workers’ response, highlighting the urgent need for strengthened surveillance and tracing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急増、感染者2,000人超、死者754人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模に拡大し（2,011症例、754死亡）、5州に拡大、感染経路不明の症例が8割超と封じ込めが困難な状況であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOも接触者追跡の課題（サーベイランス下67%）を指摘しており、封じ込めの遅れが懸念される。5州に拡大中で、さらなる拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: US says Americans returning from Congo must wait 21 days, citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Americans returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo must spend 21 days in a third country before entering the United States, under a CDC update dated July 14, 2026, with similar restrictions on some travelers from Uganda and South Sudan. The policy extends a prior order restricting direct U.S. entry for non-citizens from those countries and allows case-by-case humanitarian or law-enforcement exemptions. The change has drawn criticism from former CDC official Dr. Daniel Jernigan, who called it unprecedented and warned it might shift public-health responsibility abroad and prompt concealment of exposures. No U.S. cases have been linked to the ongoing outbreak, and risk remains low. Congo’s outbreak has >1,900 confirmed Ebola cases and >700 deaths, all linked to the Bundibugyo strain, with transmission centered in DRC; U.S. airport screening continues for some travelers from the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者にエボラ出血熱を理由に21日間の待機を義務付け
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,900例超・700人超の死亡を伴う大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、米国が渡航制限（21日間の第三国待機）を課すなど国際的な懸念が顕在化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 米国内での感染例は報告されていないが、CDCによる渡航制限措置が導入されたことが本記事の主眼であり、DRCでの流行拡大とその国際的影響が焦点。ウガンダ・南スーダンも言及されているが対象国リストには含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 80 Percent of New Ebola Cases in Eastern Congo Coming From Unknown Vectors: WHO
article.articleSummary: 80 percent of new Ebola cases in eastern Congo are from unknown transmission chains, WHO said July 14, as Ebola deaths exceed 700. As of July 13, Congo reported 1,926 infections and 702 deaths, with cases also confirmed in neighboring Uganda. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu noted many recent deaths occurred in communities before reaching care, preventing isolation and contact tracing. Bunia in Ituri province remains among the worst-hit areas; treatment capacity there is rising toward 800 beds and laboratory capacity has expanded from 1 to 14 labs. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is described by WHO and MSF as the fastest-growing on the continent and the third largest in two months, driven by population movements. On July 11, CDC reported an American working in Congo contracted Bundibugyo virus; CDC says risk to the U.S. is low with no confirmed U.S. cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部の新規エボラ症例の80%が不明な感染経路によるもの:WHO
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）の大規模流行が進行中で、死者700人超・感染経路不明の症例が8割を占め、ウガンダへの越境例や米国人感染者も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよび米国での関連症例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。感染経路不明の症例が多く、コミュニティ内での死亡が接触者追跡を妨げているため、今後の拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri-Ebola : à Bunia, les agents de la riposte accentuent la pression pour obtenir leurs primes, la situation épidémiologique elle ne cesse de s'aggraver
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri-Ebola: in Bunia, the response teams intensify pressure to obtain their bonuses, while the epidemiological situation continues to deteriorate.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 July 2026, Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, sees its epicenter in Bunia as response teams intensify pressure to obtain risk allowances amid weeks of arrears. In Bunia, at the Ebola Treatment Center, hygienists, surveillance officers, and outreach workers protested, claiming they work daily exposing themselves to the virus without pay, threatening surveillance, patient care, and safe burials. Similar protests have occurred at the General Reference Hospital of Bunia and at Rwampara Hospital. The protests come as Ituri remains the epicenter of the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, with the official count recording 753 confirmed deaths. The outbreak now affects five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. Recurrent disruptions to response activities raise concerns about surveillance, case management, and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ・エボラ：ブニアで対応要員が手当支給を求めて圧力を強める中、疫学的状況は悪化の一途をたどる
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行が5州に拡大し累計753人の死亡が報告される中、対応要員への未払いによる抗議活動がサーベイランスや症例管理、安全な埋葬活動に支障をきたしており、封じ込め能力の低下により状況悪化のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する続報。対応要員への手当未払いによる抗議活動が、サーベイランス・症例管理・安全な埋葬などの対応活動を妨げており、5州（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ、ツショポ、オートウエレ）に拡大している点でリスクが増大している。

article.articleHeadline: سلالة جديدة.. الكونغو الديمقراطية تواجه صعوبة في احتواء وباء إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new strain... The Democratic Republic of the Congo faces difficulty in containing the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Published 15 July 2026: Ebola resurfaces in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, fueling a fresh outbreak. Health teams enforce strict measures to prevent transmission from corpses and urge rapid case reporting and public trust. A survivor physician, Kahindo Méri, describes social ostracism after infection linked to her child, and relief from psychological support during treatment. Field crews base care on fluids and antibiotics after careful assessment; the first child recovered and was discharged. Experts warn the Bundibugyo strain now driving spread, with symptoms starting milder—fever, sore throat, general pain—causing diagnostic delays; mortality for Bundibugyo runs around 35%, lower than the Zaïre strain’s 70%. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne. Travelers to affected areas should wear protective clothing and observe 21 days of quarantine on return; some countries, including the US, have travel restrictions. WHO says 80% of new infections occur outside contact lists.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな系統... コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行封じ込めに苦慮
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の新たな流行が発生し、症状が軽度で診断が遅れやすいため封じ込めが困難となっている。複数国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的関心も高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国は渡航制限を課している国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ブンディブギョ株は致死率約35%とザイール株（70%）より低いが、初期症状が軽微で診断遅延を招き、封じ込めを困難にしている点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo top 2,000 as health workers strike over unpaid wages
article.articleSummary: 2,011 Ebola infections and 754 deaths reported in DR Congo, marking Congo's outbreak as the fastest-growing since May 15. As of 2026-07-15, the outbreak has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases. Bunia General Hospital staff began a strike over unpaid wages, with frontline workers barricading the entrance amid the crisis; WHO notes over 100 health workers infected since May. 753 patients remain in isolation or hospital care; 366 have recovered. Contact tracing covers 67% of exposed individuals and is hindered by conflict-driven displacement and mining-related movement. About 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains; authorities have not identified the first patient. The response is constrained by funding shortages, attacks on health centers, insecurity, community mistrust, and absence of approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo strain. A clinical trial of two potential therapies is underway in Ituri province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が2,000人を超え、医療従事者が未払い賃金を巡りストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・死者754人の急拡大するエボラ流行があり、未承認ワクチン・治療薬、医療従事者ストライキ、80%が感染経路不明という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、紛争・鉱山関連の人口移動による接触追跡困難（67%カバー、80%が感染経路不明）が国際的拡大リスクを高めている。医療従事者のストライキが対応能力をさらに低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Trial of potential Ebola antiviral underway, says WH
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola strain is involved as WHO confirms the first human trial of an antiviral for outbreak control. The EBO-PEP trial tests obeldesivir, an oral antiviral developed by Gilead Sciences, as post-exposure prophylaxis for individuals who have been in contact with confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases. Conducted in humans, the trial aims to determine whether early post-exposure treatment can prevent progression to Ebola virus disease. The World Health Organization director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the launch on X, stating that if effective among high-risk contacts after exposure, it could mark a major step forward in preventing secondary cases. While the drug has shown efficacy in pre-clinical models against filoviruses, results from this trial are pending. The program reflects ongoing efforts to expand medical countermeasures for Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 健康:潜在的なエボラ抗ウイルス薬の治験が開始、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラの発生が続いており、WHOが曝露後予防の治験を開始したことは、アウトブレイクが現在進行中であることを示す。エボラは公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がXで治験開始を発表しており、国際的な注目度が高い。エボラのアウトブレイクは継続中とみられ、感染者数・死亡者数等の詳細情報は本記事には含まれていないため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Malária avança com início do verão amazônico e SEMSA faz alerta para quem frequenta balneários e igarapés - Portal Zukka Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria advances with the onset of the Amazonian summer, and SEMSA warns those who frequent bathing spots and igarapés - Portal Zukka Brasil.
article.articleSummary: Malaria risk rises in Manaus, Brazil, as the Amazonian summer begins, with increased use of bathing spots, igarapés, and rural sites. The Manaus City Hall, via the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semsa), reports Anopheles mosquitoes thriving during river recession, elevating cases from June through September. Manaus has recorded 3,284 malaria cases from January through June this year. The municipal network operates 55 diagnostic points in urban and rural areas to enable rapid testing and early treatment. Malaria is curable but can become severe if diagnosis and treatment are delayed or interrupted. Public health guidance emphasizes personal protection: repellents, long-sleeved clothing, bed nets, and avoiding exposure in forests, rivers, and igarapés during peak mosquito activity at dawn and late afternoon. Semsa maintains vector surveillance and control in high-risk zones and urges vigilance for symptoms such as fever, chills, headaches, and malaise.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンの夏の始まりとともにマラリアが拡大、SEMSAが行楽地・イガラペー利用者に警告 - Portal Zukka Brasil
triage.triage_reason: マナウスで季節性のマラリア増加が報告されているが、地域の風土病として毎年見られる季節変動であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。地方自治体は既存の監視・対応体制で対処中。
triage.notes: 季節性のマラリア流行に関する地方自治体の公衆衛生広報記事であり、既存の監視体制で管理可能とされている。特段の異常事態や急増は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ليبيا توسع قيود المواشي لاحتواء الحمى القلاعية وحماية الثروة الوطنية الحيوانية - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Libya expands livestock restrictions to contain foot-and-mouth disease and protect the national livestock wealth - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease triggers a swift, nationwide preventive response in Libya as confirmed infections and suspected cases rise across western, eastern, and southern regions. Western Libya closes livestock markets and tightens movement controls: Mislatah district; Tarhouna’s Sidi al-Said market suspended; Qasr al-Akhiyar restricted; Sirte and Tripoli bolster surveillance and restrict transfers. In the east, markets in Sluq and Qmines are shut; Tobruk and Shahat curb livestock movement and market activity; Derna urges herd isolation after suspected cases in Qandula and Marawa in the Green Mountain. In the south, Ojla and Ubari close markets with 10–20 day movement limits; Tosh market is halted. Ongoing field surveillance, sampling, and laboratory testing accompany these measures to curb spread. Officials cite vaccination campaign irregularities and limited resources, underscoring a need to reinforce vaccination, monitoring, and rapid response to protect livestock and food security.

triage.headline_ja: リビア、口蹄疫封じ込めと国家畜産資源保護のため家畜移動制限を拡大 - Libya News 24
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾病であり人間への感染リスクはほぼない。また発生国であるリビアは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、本SOPの対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜の口蹄疫であり、発生国リビアは評価対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれない。発生地域データに含まれるPhilippines・Boliviaの地名は座標データのノイズであり、記事本文には一切言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв лихорадки Эбола в Конго превысило 750 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in Congo has surpassed 750 people.
article.articleSummary: By July 15, 2026, the Ebola fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with case counts tripling in under five weeks. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. New infections have been detected in Chopo and Upper Uele provinces, where there had been no prior cases in this epidemic, while Ituri and North Kivu—where the outbreak began—remain in the acute phase of transmission. There are no vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet, though the WHO has launched clinical trials of new therapies. The situation is further hampered by ongoing armed conflict in the DRC. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and warns of a funding shortfall to respond.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱による死者数が750人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で、症例数が5週間未満で3倍に急増し、新たな地域への拡大や武力紛争による対応困難も報告されているため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチン・特効薬未確立のBundibugyo型エボラで、資金不足と武力紛争により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 九個月大男嬰感染甲型流感 併發嚴重肺炎及休克 現於深切治療部留醫 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine-month-old male infant infected with influenza A, complicated by severe pneumonia and shock, currently in the ICU.
article.articleSummary: Nine-month-old male infant in Hong Kong has Influenza A, with severe pneumonia and shock, in the Paediatric Intensive Care Unit at Tuen Mun Hospital. On July 13 his condition worsened; by July 14 fever and cough preceded rapid deterioration including respiratory distress, loss of consciousness, and cardiac arrest, with successful resuscitation. Preliminary investigations indicate he has not received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine; household contacts are asymptomatic. Since late June, Hong Kong has entered the influenza season and activity is rising, with further increases expected in weeks. The Centre for Health Protection urges vigilance: high-risk groups (children, the elderly, and those with chronic illnesses) should seek prompt care for fever and respiratory symptoms. Public should maintain hygiene, wear masks in crowded places, and seek urgent care if signs worsen; mask use on public transport is advised, and absence from work or school may be considered if symptomatic. COVID-19 activity is also rising.

triage.headline_ja: 生後9ヶ月の男児がA型インフルエンザに感染、重症肺炎とショックを併発し集中治療室に入院
triage.triage_reason: 香港での季節性インフルエンザ流行期における重症小児例の単発報告であり、家庭内接触者は無症状で人-人感染拡大の証拠はないが、季節性インフルエンザ活動の上昇傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港衛生防護中心（CHP）が季節性インフルエンザ活動の上昇とCOVID-19活動の上昇についても注意喚起しているが、本事例は個別の重症例であり、地域的なアウトブレイクや異常な株の報告ではない。今後の症例数増加やクラスター発生の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Περισσότερα από 2.000 κρούσματα και 754 νεκροί στο Κονγκό από την αρχή της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 2,000 cases and 754 deaths in the Congo since the start of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has exceeded 2,000 cases and 754 deaths since it began in mid-May 2026. As of 15 July 2026, MSF reports unprecedented spread and WHO cautions that official counts may underestimate true numbers by two to four times. The outbreak started May 15 in Ituri province, a mineral-rich, violence-plagued northeastern region, and has reached five provinces, with neighboring Uganda also reporting cases; about 90% of confirmed cases are in Ituri. There is no vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo, though the first clinical trial evaluating an antiviral drug began recently. The epidemic has already surpassed half the total cases of the 2018–2020 Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Laboratory confirmation remains essential for tracking the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴで2,000人以上の感染者、754人の死者が発生—流行開始以来
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がDRC5州に拡大し、2000例超・死者754人、ウガンダにも越境。ワクチン・承認治療薬がなく、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が明確なため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告があるが、記事の主題はDRCであり対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。MSFは公式集計が実際の2〜4倍過小評価の可能性を指摘。ワクチン・承認治療薬なし、初の抗ウイルス薬臨床試験開始との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Une épidémie d'Ebola d'une ampleur inédite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola Outbreak of Unprecedented Scale.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, has outpaced official counts. Declared May 15 in Ituri near the South Sudan and Uganda borders, it has spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, with Uganda reporting 20 cases. The disease has over 700 deaths among ~2,000 cases; transmission is by close contact and bodily fluids. WHO projections indicate the outbreak could be two to four times the reported total, though case detection is improving. Many infections die at home without care, highlighting the need for earlier detection, rapid contact tracing, and trusted facilities; over 90% of cases are detected in Ituri. 700 beds and 14 laboratories are in place. The EBO-PEP trial of obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis began, enrolling ~1,000 asymptomatic contacts aged 12+ near Bunia and Rwampara, Ituri, with 21- and 42-day follow-ups. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 前例のない規模のエボラ出血熱流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が公式集計を大きく上回る規模と推定され、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ルワンダ、スーダンも発生地域として挙がっているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはケース数が報告の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、致死率も高く、EBO-PEP治験（曝露後予防）が開始されるなど国際的介入が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Sorocaba confirma oitavo caso de raiva em morcego e intensifica bloqueio na Vila Hortência | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorocaba confirms eighth rabies case in a bat and tightens the cordon in Vila Hortência | TVS+.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Sorocaba: the eighth bat rabies case in 2026 confirmed. The bat was found in Vila Hortência on July 2, and laboratory confirmation was announced on July 13. Public health teams from Zoonoses implemented a 500-meter containment zone around the site, conducting door-to-door visits, distributing information, inspecting potential bat roosts, and checking vaccination status for dogs and cats. If contact with a bat is identified, authorities provide booster vaccination for pets and, when necessary, post-exposure anti-rabies care for humans. Residents are advised not to touch bats, especially those on the ground or behaving unusually, and to report them for removal. The measures aim to block transmission and rapidly identify human and animal exposures, with ongoing surveillance for further exposures in Sorocaba’s Vila Hortência district.

triage.headline_ja: ソロカバでコウモリの狂犬病8例目を確認、ヴィラ・オルテンシアの封鎖を強化
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病の局地的発生であり、人間感染例の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応（封鎖・監視・予防接種）で管理されているため、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（Zoonoses部門）による通常の狂犬病サーベイランス・対応活動の一環であり、地域保健当局が独自に対応可能なレベルの事案。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола распространяется быстрее, чем ее успевают отслеживать
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading faster than it can be tracked.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern region is spreading faster than health services can identify new infections, with deaths surpassing 700. The World Health Organization reports about 80% of new cases are linked to unknown transmission chains, meaning most patients are not under medical surveillance or listed among known contacts. The outbreak, caused by a rare Ebola strain, has persisted since May, and there are no approved treatments or vaccines for this variant. Africa CDC notes this is the fastest-spreading outbreak on the African continent to date, and experts warn that the situation remains highly challenging despite expanded counter-epidemic measures. The article provides no information on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、追跡が追いつかないほど拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し、80%が未知の感染経路によるもので死者700人超と深刻。ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ国際的拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOおよびAfrica CDCが言及するアフリカ大陸史上最速の感染拡大例であり、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない稀な株による流行のため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: നിയമ വിരുദ്ധ കൊതുക് അഗർബത്തികൾ ഡെങ്കുവിനേക്കാൾ അപകടകരം: 70 ശതമാനം ഡോക്ടർമാരും മുന്നറിയിപ്പു നൽകുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Illegal mosquito coils and agarbathis are more dangerous than dengue fever: 70 percent of doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: Illegal chemical-containing mosquito coils and agarbathis sold without regulatory approval are linked to serious respiratory problems, according to 70% of doctors in a public health study by the Home Insect Control Association. A Kantar survey across 12 Indian cities (1264 households, 405 doctors) found that 95% of households did not report dengue- or malaria-like illnesses in the past year. The mosquito coil/incense market is about ₹2000 crore, with 85% of products illicit, lacking government approval and labeling. Unverified coils are sold in local shops and drugstores; consumers should verify the CIR registration number and required disclosures. While these products deter mosquitoes, the resulting smoke poses a continuing inhalation risk, cautions a Mumbai hospital’s critical-care director.}

triage.headline_ja: 違法な蚊取り線香・お香がデング熱より危険:70%の医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は違法な蚊取り線香・お香製品による呼吸器への健康被害に関する消費者向け注意喚起であり、デング熱・マラリアの実際の流行や症例急増を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・マラリア自体の発生状況ではなく、規制外蚊取り製品の健康リスクに関する消費者向け報道。むしろ調査では95%の世帯がデング熱・マラリア様症状を報告していないと記載されており、感染症の異常な流行を示唆する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dangerous tick-borne viruses can outsmart the human immune system
article.articleSummary: Five brand-new human-infecting tick-borne viruses identified in the last decade include three in China, one in Japan, and one in California. The best-known is Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus, which kills more than one-third of those it infects. A standout among the newly described viruses is Pacific Coast tick nairovirus, found in ticks in California and responsible for the strongest suppression of human immune alarms observed to date. All of these viruses encode an OTU protein that removes host warning signals, undermining ubiquitin and ISG15–mediated responses at multiple steps. About 60% of California ticks carried Pacific Coast tick nairovirus, and the same ticks transmit Rocky Mountain spotted fever. The virus could be circulating undetected in people, potentially causing mild flu-like symptoms. Computer-based predictions of threat level were about 50% accurate overall, 82% for a well-studied virus.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なマダニ媒介ウイルスがヒトの免疫システムを出し抜く可能性
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントの報告ではなく、過去10年間に発見された新規マダニ媒介ウイルスに関する科学的レビュー記事であり、現時点で公衆衛生上の緊急事態や具体的な症例報告は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発見された5種のマダニ媒介ウイルス（中国3種、日本1種、カリフォルニア1種）に関する科学研究の解説であり、実際の集団感染や健康被害の報告ではない。潜在的な将来リスクとして続報の可能性はあるが、現時点でのトリアージ対象イベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: "About 45 people contract HIV every day in Ghana": President of AIDS network says
article.articleSummary: Ghana records about 45 new HIV infections daily, per the Ghana HIV and AIDS Network (GHANET). Women account for roughly 68.5% of new infections and men 31.5%. GHANET President Ernest Amoabeng Ortsin ties the higher female share to factors including antenatal HIV testing and protection for the child, while noting many men do not seek hospital care. He also cites data suggesting most Ghanaian men have seven to nine sexual partners annually, which facilitates unprotected transmission. He underscores the need for intensified awareness, prevention, and support. Social media reactions call for renewed national campaigns and broader PrEP/PEP awareness, plus stronger action from the National AIDS Commission to curb rising infections.

triage.headline_ja: 「ガーナでは毎日約45人がHIVに感染」とAIDSネットワーク代表が発言
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の流行性感染症であり、本記事は既存の統計・啓発活動に関する内容で、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: HIVは慢性的な既知の感染症であり、EBS（イベントベースサーベイランス）における新興・再興感染症の急性シグナルとは性質が異なるため見送りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചവരുടെ എണ്ണം 2000 കടന്നു; 754 മരണം | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-confirmed cases in Congo surpass 2,000; 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: From Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola infections are rising daily, with confirmed cases exceeding 2,000 and deaths at 754. The outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading in history, even as health workers strike amid ongoing response challenges. The Congo Ministry of Health reports about 753 people hospitalized and 366 recovered. Contact tracing delays impede identifying exposures, with 80% of newly reported cases not yet linked to known contacts, according to WHO assessments. Notably, investigators have not identified patient zero, complicating containment. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, officially confirmed on May 15. While vaccines and treatments exist for prior Congo outbreaks caused by Zaire ebolavirus, there is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, underscoring the mounting public health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定患者数が2000人を突破、死者754人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、感染者2000人超・死者754人、接触者追跡が困難で承認ワクチンも存在しないため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirusによる流行で、既存のZaire株用ワクチンが効果を持たない可能性があり、封じ込めが困難。患者ゼロ未特定、医療従事者のストライキも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 2.000 casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths (case fatality rate 37.5%), according to the latest government bulletin through July 13. Of the cases, 753 are in isolation or hospitalized and 366 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 67.4%. The eastern provinces affected are Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, plus Tshopo (central-north) and Haut-Uele (northeast). Authorities report ongoing strengthening of surveillance, patient care, and contact follow-up as infections rise. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) warns that new cases in Haut-Uele indicate geographic spread, requiring immediate reinforcement of surveillance, diagnostics, and operational readiness. The outbreak was declared in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が2,000例の壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で2,000例を超え、致死率37.5%と高く、複数州への地理的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Haut-Uele州への新規拡大が報告されており、地理的拡散の懸念が強い。北キブ州の言及があるが対象国リストに個別項目はなくDRC全体として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 '에볼라 확진자' 2천 명 돌파... 국제사회 대응 강화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 2,000 Ebola-confirmed cases... International community steps up its response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases, with 754 deaths and 366 recoveries since the outbreak began in May. Health authorities say the spread is unprecedentedly rapid. The World Health Organization warns of potential broader regional impact if containment lapses. Médecins Sans Frontières urges urgent expansion of testing, patient care, survivor support, and safe burial practices, noting lives are lost with delays. WHO reports about 750 isolation and treatment beds across 25 facilities, with 100 more beds to be added this week. The international community, including the U.S. CDC, is supporting in-country and global partners with case finding, specimen collection, contact tracing, and community outreach to curb transmission. MSF Emergency Program Director Trish Newport stresses the need to escalate response immediately.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ「エボラ確定患者」2千人突破…国際社会が対応強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2000例を超え、死亡者数も多く、WHOが地域拡大の可能性を警告するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、米国はCDCによる支援国として言及されているのみのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: AI-backed screening drive helps Haryana detect over 25k TB cases
article.articleSummary: AI-backed screening in Haryana identified 25,666 new tuberculosis patients during the first 104 days of the Centre's Phase II 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Campaign. Launched March 24 (World TB Day), the program shifts from passive to proactive case finding, deploying AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines for rapid screening in remote areas and the AI-powered CATB app that analyzes cough sounds to flag people needing testing. Vulnerability mapping targeted 2,111 high-risk villages and urban wards, enabling 3,914 health camps (2,854 in high-risk sites). From March 24 to July 5, about 4.73 lakh individuals were screened, with over 225,000 chest X-rays and 125,000 NAATs performed, resulting in 25,666 TB detections. Patient support included 23,962 Poshan Kits, 2,635 new Ni-kshay Mitras, and 65 Ni-kshay Vahan mobile units. Screening was integrated with Ayushman Arogya Shivirs for TB alongside other diseases.

triage.headline_ja: AI活用のスクリーニング活動により、ハリヤナ州で25,000人超の結核患者を発見
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムによる積極的症例発見の成果を報じる内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 結核撲滅を目指す政府主導の既存プログラム（TB Mukt Bharat Campaign）の成果報告記事であり、突発的な感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites se mantêm como desafios no país; Norte concentra 72% dos casos do tipo D - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis remains a challenge in the country; the North accounts for 72% of type D cases - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a persistent hepatitis challenge. From 2012–2024, hepatitis C totaled 245,338 cases nationwide, with 19,343 in the most recent year and Tocantins recording 59. The North region accounts for 72% of hepatitis D cases reported nationally between 2000–2024, and hepatitis B is notably frequent in some Northern localities. Hepatitis A, B, C and D can be asymptomatic for years; when symptoms occur, patients may have fatigue, fever, nausea, abdominal pain, jaundice, dark urine or pale stools. Diagnosis relies mainly on blood tests to detect exposure, active infection and viral load. Treatments vary: Hepatitis A is self-limited; Hepatitis B may require antivirals for chronic disease; Hepatitis C is highly curable with direct-acting antivirals; Hepatitis D requires HBV co-management; Hepatitis E is usually self-limited. Prevention focuses on vaccination (HBV protects against D) and hygiene; HBV vaccination is in SUS; A vaccines are available, with A&B vaccines in private clinics.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける肝炎の課題は続く;D型肝炎症例の72%が北部に集中
triage.triage_reason: 長期的な統計データに基づく一般的な公衆衛生報告であり、急性の異常発生や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 2000-2024年の長期統計データに基づく地域保健レポートであり、突発的なアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: САЩ обявиха, че изискват американците, връщащи се от ДР Конго, да изчакат 21 дни в трета страна заради епидемията от ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States announced that it requires Americans returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to quarantine for 21 days in a third country due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: US requires Americans returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to quarantine 21 days in a third country before entering the United States due to the Ebola outbreak. The rule also covers some travelers from Uganda and South Sudan; others will undergo airport screening. CDC updates note possible humanitarian or law-enforcement exemptions. Previously, non-citizens could not enter the US directly from these three countries, with the same 21-day stay in another country mandated. Americans may enter through select airports with health checks for travel routes, temperature, and symptoms. The DRC outbreak, linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, has over 1,900 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths, with no vaccine or specific treatment available for this strain. There are no confirmed US cases, and overall risk to the US population and travelers remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行によりコンゴ民主共和国から帰国するアメリカ人に対し、第三国での21日間の待機を義務付けると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行は1,900例以上・死者700人超と深刻で、ワクチン・特異的治療法もなく、米国が渡航制限措置を導入するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 米国の渡航制限措置に関する記事だが、根本イベントはDRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行。ウガンダ・南スーダンも一部規制対象だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・特異的治療薬がない株である点が特に深刻。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 2000 حالة وسط تحديات الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 2,000 amid containment challenges.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases, with 754 deaths, according to government data, marking the fastest-spreading outbreak in the country’s history. The data show 2,011 confirmed infections and 754 deaths, with 753 people still in isolation or hospital and 366 recovered. The outbreak began on May 15 and has expanded, including 54 new cases reported on Monday in Ituri, North Kivu, and neighboring regions, and Uganda. Health authorities note that 80% of new infections are from unknown transmission chains, and only about 67% of contacts are being traced. WHO cautions the true scale could be up to four times higher than official counts. Funding shortfalls impede response, with WHO citing roughly 40% of required funding; MSF urges broader international coordination. Strikes by staff at Bunia General Hospital further challenge containment, with over 100 healthcare workers infected since the start.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が2000人を超え、封じ込めに課題
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大のエボラ流行が2000例・754人死亡に達し、ウガンダへの越境拡大、感染経路不明の症例が8割、資金不足・医療従事者感染など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も報じられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の最大4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、資金不足・医療従事者のストライキなど対応の困難さも顕著。

article.articleHeadline: تفشٍ مقلق لـ"إيبولا".. أكثر من ألفي إصابة ومئات الوفيات في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An alarming Ebola outbreak: more than 2,000 cases and hundreds of deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe. By July 15, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 753 patients in isolation or treatment and 366 recoveries. Officials say this is the fastest outbreak wave seen in the country. Containment faces major hurdles: only 67% of exposed individuals have been traced, and about 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, hindering response efforts. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has been circulating since mid-May. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or body fluids of infected or deceased people, or via contaminated surfaces. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, headache, and muscle pain, potentially progressing to bleeding. Response efforts, led with WHO and partners, emphasize intensified epidemiologic investigations, contact tracing, vaccination, and therapeutics.

triage.headline_ja: 憂慮すべきエボラの流行:コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人以上が感染、数百人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大しており、感染者追跡率の低さと不明感染経路の多さから国際的拡大リスクが高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡率67%、新規感染の80%が不明感染経路という点から、封じ込めが困難な状況であり、今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。WHOおよびパートナーが対応中。

article.articleHeadline: 115 children fall ill, 12 hospitalised after eating water balls in Rajasthan village
article.articleSummary: In Polai Khurd village, Kota district, Rajasthan, 115 children fell ill after consuming pani-patasi (water balls), with 12 admitted to the Community Health Centre in Simliya and others treated at a village medical camp. Symptoms included vomiting, diarrhoea, and stomach pain, with illness onset reported from Tuesday night. Health officials dispatched two medical teams and 108 ambulance services; a special medical camp was established as door-to-door surveys by ANMs and ASHAs sought additional cases. Most patients are stable. The pani-patasi vendor is reportedly from nearby Sholi village. The Food Safety Department collected samples of ingredients, chutneys, and water; source water samples were sent for laboratory analysis. Laboratory results are pending, and findings will guide action against those responsible and future prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州の村で水団子を食べた115人の子供が体調不良、12人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 単一の食品(pani-patasi)による局所的な食中毒事案であり、人-人感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低く、患者の多くは安定している。
triage.notes: 食品安全当局が原因食品・水の検体を採取し検査中。感染症というより食中毒(食品汚染)事案であり、EBSのシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Περισσότερα από 2.000 κρούσματα και 754 νεκροί από τον Έμπολα | Ειδήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: More than 2,000 cases and 754 deaths from Ebola | News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, declared May 15 in Ituri province, a northeastern, mineral-rich region affected by armed violence. As of July 15, 2026, confirmed cases exceed 2,000 with 754 deaths. MSF warns of an unprecedented spread; WHO notes that Bundibugyo strain case counts could be underreported by 2–4 times. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, though the first clinical trial evaluating an antiviral drug began recently. The outbreak has already surpassed half the total cases of the 2018–2020 DRC Ebola outbreak within under five weeks. Cases are in five DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda, with 90%+ of infections still concentrated in Ituri. Cross-border transmission underscores ongoing regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ出血熱の感染者2,000人超、死者754人|ニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死性の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が急拡大し、既に2018-2020年流行の半数を上回る規模に達しており、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事本文にウガンダでの症例が言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC国内では5州に拡大し、Ituri州が90%以上を占める。ワクチン・承認治療薬なし、臨床試験開始段階。

article.articleHeadline: "Nie dagewesenes Tempo": Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo wird immer schlimmer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Unprecedented Pace": Ebola epidemic in the Congo is getting worse.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 2,000 registered cases with 754 deaths, according to health authorities; the WHO cautions figures may be two to four times higher. First declared on May 15, the outbreak now spans five provinces, with Doctors Without Borders warning of unprecedented spread into new regions. In less than five weeks, confirmed cases have tripled and deaths more than quintupled, underscoring severe transmission. About half as many cases as the 2018–2020 outbreak have been recorded so far. Roughly 80 percent of new cases are not on contact lists, indicating unknown transmission routes; many deaths occur outside medical facilities. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, and funerals involving corpses pose high risk. The virus is the Bundibugyo variant (identified in 2007), for which there is no licensed vaccine or therapy. A clinical trial of the antiviral Obeldesivir by Gilead began on Tuesday.

triage.headline_ja: 「前例のないペース」：コンゴのエボラ流行がさらに悪化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が5州に拡大し、死者754人・症例2000人超と急増、80%が接触者リスト外で感染経路不明のため、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株で承認ワクチン・治療薬なし。80%の新規症例が接触者リスト外であり、感染経路不明の拡大が懸念される。GileadのObeldesivir臨床試験が開始。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo registra mais de 2 mil casos de ebola e 754 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 2,000 Ebola cases and 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an Ebola outbreak of unprecedented spread, with over 2,000 cases and 754 deaths as of July 15, 2026. The Bundibugyo variant drives the surge, spreading to new areas since April. WHO notes 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts and arise from unknown transmission chains, with many patients dying before reaching health facilities. MSF calls for urgent scaling up of the response; in under five weeks, confirmed cases reportedly tripled and deaths quintupled, and the outbreak has surpassed half of the total cases from the 2018-2020 epidemic. No vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo, but the WHO now reports the first antiviral clinical trial began on July 14, 2026. Origins remain unclear, complicating containment and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例2000人超、死者754人を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の未曾有の拡大で死者754人、致死率も高く、80%が感染経路不明で国際的拡大リスクが高いため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行で、感染経路不明の症例が多数を占め、封じ込めが困難。MSFが対応強化を要請しており、WHOも初の抗ウイルス薬臨床試験を開始した状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Ebola Response Underfunded as DRC Cases Surge
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-15, Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and four other provinces) exceed 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, and WHO has received roughly 40 percent of the 115 million dollar appeal to fight the outbreak. True mortality could be 2–4 times the official count due to deaths occurring before patients reach facilities. Doctors Without Borders notes the virus spreading into new territory, with cases tripling and deaths more than fivefold in under five weeks, and the outbreak already surpassing half the caseload of the 2018–2020 epidemic. About 80 percent of new infections cannot be traced to known contacts, indicating invisible transmission chains. A clinical trial of obeldesivir for post-exposure protection began, developed by Gilead, though not yet proven in humans against Bundibugyo. Outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri, where armed groups hinder tracing and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのエボラ対応、資金不足の中でDRCの感染例が急増
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法未承認）がDRC東部で2,000例超・死者754人に急増し、80%が感染経路不明で武装勢力が対策を妨げているため、IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際支援ニーズが明確。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、実際の死亡数は公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性が指摘されている。武装勢力による接触者追跡・ワクチン接種の妨害、80%の感染経路不明という点から見えない伝播チェーンの存在が強く疑われ、2018-2020年流行の半数規模に既に到達している点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Coltan et Ébola : La RDC saignée à blanc, le monde ferme les yeux - Cameroun24.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coltan and Ebola: The DRC bled dry, the world turns a blind eye
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC is torn between M23 control of 15–30% of global coltan from Rubaya, North Kivu, financing its illegal administration since 2024, and a parallel Ebola outbreak in the west. M23, formed in 2012 by army defectors, renewed hostilities in 2021, and has captured over 100 localities including Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu capitals. Rwanda’s involvement remains disputed; US officials and the UN Security Council call for withdrawal of Rwandan forces per Resolution 2773. The Ebola crisis has over 2,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and 754 deaths, a fatality rate around 23.4%, with a funding gap of $70 million toward a $115 million need. Since July 2, three antiviral drugs are being tested as treatments; vaccines are not yet available. The international community faces a critical response to both resource-driven conflict and a severe health emergency, with thousands of Congolese lives at stake.

triage.headline_ja: コルタンとエボラ：搾取されるDRC、目を背ける世界
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例2,000人超、死者754人（致死率23.4%）に上る深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、資金不足と紛争が対応を困難にしているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC西部でのエボラ流行（症例2,000件超、死亡754人、致死率23.4%、資金不足70百万ドル）を報じている。ルワンダ・ブルンジは紛争関連の文脈で言及されているが、エボラ感染事例としては確認されていないため対象国から除外。

article.articleHeadline: More health workers strike as Ebola cases in Congo exceed 2,000, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has climbed to 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, according to government data released overnight, making it the fastest-growing outbreak on record. The surge centers on the Bunia region, with Bunia General Hospital described as the epicenter. Health workers at Bunia General Hospital went on strike Wednesday over pay, barricading the entrance as frontline staff protest wage delays while continuing to work under difficult conditions. The strike highlights ongoing strains in the response as authorities contend with an escalating outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ症例が2,000人を超え、死者754人に達する中、医療従事者のストライキが拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し2000症例・754死亡と深刻化しており、医療従事者のストライキも重なり対応体制に懸念があるため、IHR・WPRO双方の基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最速の増加スピードとされるアウトブレイクであり、医療従事者ストライキによる対応能力低下も懸念材料。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Launches Trial for New Ebola Treatment
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, researchers launched a clinical trial testing the experimental antiviral obeldesivir as post-exposure treatment for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus amid an ongoing outbreak. Approximately 1,000 participants aged 12 and older with high-risk exposure to confirmed cases but asymptomatic will be enrolled and monitored for 21 days, with a day-42 follow-up to assess effectiveness and safety. The study is led by Congolese and French research institutions with backing from ALIMA and Doctors Without Borders. Separately, compassionate-use protocols will provide remdesivir to exposed children under 12 and to pregnant or breastfeeding women.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、新規エボラ治療薬の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関する事案であり、重症度が高く公衆衛生上深刻な影響があるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイツリ州で進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対する治療薬（obeldesivir/remdesivir）の臨床試験開始に関する内容。フランスは研究協力機関としての関与のみで、発生国には該当しない。既存のアウトブレイク継続中であり、国際機関（ALIMA、MSF）が支援していることから管理可能性の懸念も存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak disrupts US-backed minerals talks, sources say
article.articleSummary: Mid-May Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has infected 2,011 and killed 754, according to government data. The crisis disrupts travel and delays a U.S.-backed critical minerals partnership aimed at reducing China’s influence over Congo’s copper, cobalt and other energy-transition minerals. Quarantine requirements and health concerns have prompted postponements; the U.S. Embassy in Kinshasa on July 11 urged Americans not to travel and warned exposed travelers could face up to 21 days of quarantine at their own expense. Washington says it is working to contain Ebola while pursuing the minerals deal, noting progress on the Lobito Corridor and Kinshasa’s commitment to facilitating U.S. investment. Some meetings shifted to Paris/Brussels, and a July project review was canceled due to travel constraints. Congo remains the world’s top cobalt producer and second-largest copper supplier.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、米国支援の鉱物交渉に混乱
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011人感染・754人死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、渡航制限や隔離措置など国際的な影響も生じているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブリュッセル・パリ・米国・中国は会議開催地や交渉相手国として言及されているのみで、実際の流行発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。致死率(約37%)が高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma mais três mortes por gripe e total de óbitos chega a 20
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms three more influenza deaths, bringing the death toll to 20.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports three more deaths from Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) caused by influenza in 2026, lifting the year’s toll to 20 deaths and 247 cases. Victims: two men aged 69 and 82, and a woman 85, all with comorbidities; two were vaccinated. Since March 28, the city has administered 318,032 flu vaccine doses, with coverage among elderly at 55.78%, children 6 months–<6 years at 46.17%, and pregnant women at 68.94%. The vaccine protects against influenza A (H1N1, H3N2) and influenza B and may be given with other vaccines. Free vaccination is available at 69 health centers for anyone six months or older, without appointment. In 2025, Campinas recorded 561 SRAG flu cases and 69 deaths, 54 of them in unvaccinated individuals. Public health measures to reduce transmission are advised.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナス市でインフルエンザによる死者がさらに3人確認され、死亡者数は20人に達した
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる死亡例の定例報告であり、高齢者・基礎疾患保有者が中心で、ワクチン接種状況も含め例年の傾向の範囲内と考えられるため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A型H1N1・H3N2、B型）による毎年の流行報告。死亡者は高齢者・基礎疾患保有者が中心で、ワクチン接種キャンペーンも実施されており、異常な増加や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim Arboviroses: 27ª Semana Epidemiológica registra 17 notificações de dengue e um de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arboviral Diseases Bulletin: 27th Epidemiological Week records 17 dengue cases and one chikungunya case
article.articleSummary: As of 5–11 July 2026 (27th epidemiological week), the municipality reported 17 dengue probable cases and 1 chikungunya case; no Zika. Dengue cases are all under investigation. Dengue’s neighborhood distribution: Cruzeiro and Patagônia (3 each); Jatobá and Guarani (2 each); Alto do Boa Vista, Ayrton Senna, Baixão de Veredinha, Centro, Jurema, Santa Marta, and São João da Vitória (1 each). Cumulatively in 2026, there are 819 dengue notifications: 629 probable, 21 confirmed, 190 discarded, 130 under investigation, and 478 inconclusive. For chikungunya, 64 notifications year-to-date: 58 probable, 1 confirmed, 57 under investigation. One Zika notification progressed to confirmed; no deaths reported from arboviruses. Compared with 27th week of 2025, dengue probable cases fell 43%. Prevention emphasizes Aedes aegypti control; water tanks closed, eliminate standing-water containers, clean gutters and yards; contact Centro de Controle de Endemias at (77) 3229-3151 for more information.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス感染症速報:2026年第27疫学週でデング熱17件、チクングニア熱1件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体の定例疫学週報であり、前年同期比でデング熱症例数は減少傾向、死亡例なし、特段の異常性や社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 地域の風土病対策部署（Centro de Controle de Endemias）が発表した定例モニタリング報告。前年同期比でデング熱症例数は43%減少しており、流行拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: SA company plans Ebola treatment trial, and vaccines enter human trials - Juta MedicalBrief
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda and South Sudan spur urgent trials. Xylomed Pharmaceuticals plans a phase 3B, double-blind trial of an oral Ebola therapeutic to halt viral replication, with sites in DRC, Uganda and South Sudan; budget about €35 million; potential use in children as young as two; aims to determine efficacy before regulatory submission, aided by partnerships with SA, Botswana and European universities. Separately, Oxford University begins the first human trial of a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BD-Ebov) in 50 healthy adults in Oxford; Serum Institute has produced ~620,000 doses and supplied 4,000 investigational doses; CEPI may invest up to $8.6 million; WHO prioritised BD-Ebov and the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine, with Uganda studies via MRC/UVRI and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit. Ebola outbreaks can involve around 10,000 people with fatality rates up to 70%; more than 700 deaths reported so far.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカの企業がエボラ治療薬の治験を計画、ワクチンはヒト試験段階へ - Juta MedicalBrief
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンで進行中のエボラ流行(致死率最大70%、700人超の死亡)に対し、複数の治療薬・ワクチン開発が進んでおり、深刻性と国際的拡大の両基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの治療薬・ワクチン開発を主題とするが、DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでの現行アウトブレイク(死亡700人超、致死率最大70%)に言及。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当し、Uganda・South Sudanはリスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo registra mais de 2 mil casos de ebola e 754 mortes em surto sem precedentes - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo records more than 2,000 Ebola cases and 754 deaths in an unprecedented outbreak - Metro 1
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths in an unprecedented outbreak spreading across five provinces as of July 15, 2026. MSF says the surge is rapid: in under five weeks, cases have tripled and deaths quintupled. The World Health Organization notes around 80% of new infections are not linked to known transmission chains, complicating contact tracing, with many patients dying before reaching health facilities. The outbreak involves a Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, and WHO estimates true infections may be two to four times higher than official counts. No vaccines or approved treatments exist for this variant, though WHO has initiated the first clinical trial to assess an antiviral’s efficacy. Cases have been reported in five provinces, highlighting the need for reinforced public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、前例のないエボラ出血熱の流行で2,000人超の症例と754人の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない規模のエボラ流行（2,000例超、754死亡）が5州に拡大し、感染経路不明例が80%に上るなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株による流行で、承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しない。WHOは抗ウイルス薬の臨床試験を開始。実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍と推定されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratik Kongo Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Vakaları 2011'e Ulaştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Reach 2011
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,011 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 754 deaths, per Kinshasa authorities and Reuters’ latest data. Ebola is a highly lethal viral illness transmitted through direct contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person or animal. Patients commonly present with high fever, vomiting, and both internal and external bleeding. The Kinshasa-based report (cited by SANA) provides current figures but does not detail laboratory confirmation or specific infection sources beyond bodily-fluid exposure. This update underscores the ongoing burden of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the persistent risk to affected communities, highlighting the need for continued public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例が2011人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラという致死率の高い疾患で確認症例2,011例・死亡754例と規模が大きく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率の高いエボラの大規模流行(死亡率約37.5%)であり、詳細な感染源やラボ確認情報は記事に記載なし。続報でWHOやCDCの公式発表・対応状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Another COVID-19 death reported in A.P., three more test positive
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 deaths persist in Andhra Pradesh. A 66-year-old man with respiratory issues, pneumonia, diabetes, hypertension and kidney problems tested positive on July 3 and died July 15; officials attribute the death to comorbidities rather than COVID-19 alone. This follows two earlier AP deaths in YSR Kadapa district and Annamayya district. Three new positive cases were identified: two in Mangalagiri and one in Visakhapatnam; two patients are undergoing treatment at AIIMS Mangalagiri, with details on symptoms and travel history awaited. A politician with travel history to Hyderabad in the first week of July tested positive on July 12 after fever, bodyache and breathlessness and is stable at King George Hospital, Visakhapatnam. These developments indicate ongoing local transmission and imported-case dynamics in the state as of 2026-07-16.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID-19による死亡がまた1件報告、新たに3人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 既存流行病であるCOVID-19の散発的な症例・死亡報告であり、基礎疾患を有する高齢者の死亡等、通常の流行状況の範囲内で異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の流行病であり、地域レベルでの散発的症例・死亡の継続報告に留まる。死亡は基礎疾患（糖尿病、高血圧、腎疾患等）が主因とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : les chefs coutumiers s'engagent à renforcer la lutte contre Ebola aux côtés des autorités | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: Traditional chiefs commit to strengthening the fight against Ebola alongside the authorities | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, traditional chiefs from 48 sectors and chiefdoms gathered in Bunia on July 14, with the military governor and the Strategic Multisectoral Ebola Response Coordination, reaffirming their commitment to bolster the Ebola response alongside authorities. The chiefs agreed to intensify community mobilization, reinforce adherence to preventive measures, and promote rapid reporting of suspected cases to enable timely field actions. Response teams highlighted active case finding, contact tracing, ongoing community sensitization, and swift referral of symptomatic individuals to Ebola Treatment Centers, stressing that early treatment improves survival and limits transmission within households and communities. They warned against delaying care at home. The chiefs pledged stronger awareness campaigns, early referral support, and closer accompaniment of response teams, while seeking greater government and partner support for needed resources. Collective mobilization, trust, and active community leadership are deemed essential to end Ebola transmission in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：伝統的首長らがエボラ対策強化に向けて当局と協力を約束
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患が継続しており、地域社会での感染拡大防止・対応強化のための外部支援要請がみられるため、WPRO基準複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のイツリ州エボラ流行に対する地域社会・当局の対応強化に関するもので、新規発生や急変を示す情報ではないが、継続的なヒト-ヒト感染リスクと支援ニーズがあるためモニタリング継続が望ましい。
